domains.name: event
domains.description: Core operational domain managing the full lifecycle of live sports and entertainment events — planning, scheduling, production logistics, competition governance, and game-day execution. Owns event identity, fixture calendars, match results, season structures, tournament brackets, and event lifecycle from announcement through post-event reconciliation. Serves as SSOT for all event-related master data across leagues, concerts, and live experiences.

products.name: fixture
products.description: Core master entity and SSOT for event identity — any scheduled live sports or entertainment event. Captures event name, type (match, concert, PPV, exhibition, all-star, draft, awards), status (announced → confirmed → in-progress → completed/cancelled), scheduled date/time with timezone, doors-open time, event tier (regular season, playoff, championship, special event), home/away designation, neutral site flag, broadcast eligibility flag, classification (league, cup, friendly, touring), and lifecycle timestamps. Anchor entity referenced by all downstream domains.

attributes.name: actual_attendance

attributes.name: announced_timestamp

attributes.name: attendance_capacity

attributes.name: away_score

attributes.name: cancelled_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the fixture was officially cancelled or abandoned. Triggers refund processing workflows in Ticketmaster/AXS and revenue reversal entries in SAP S/4HANA FI.

attributes.name: confirmed_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the fixture was confirmed by the governing body or event organizer, transitioning from announced to confirmed status. Triggers ticketing on-sale activation in Ticketmaster/AXS and broadcast rights activation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when the fixture record was first created in the data platform. Audit trail field for data governance, SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) financial controls, and GDPR data lineage compliance.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) Financial Controls; GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation) Article 5 Data Integrity

attributes.name: doors_open_timestamp
attributes.description: Scheduled date and time when venue gates open to ticket holders. Critical for access control configuration in Ticketmaster/AXS gate scan systems and fan arrival experience planning.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster/AXS Access Control Standard; Archtics Venue Operations

attributes.name: event_classification
attributes.description: Competition or programming classification of the fixture indicating its governing framework (e.g., league regular season match, cup knockout tie, friendly/exhibition, touring concert). Used for league governance reporting and CBA compliance.
attributes.references: FIFA Competition Regulations; NFL Governance Office; CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement) Compliance

attributes.name: event_date
attributes.description: Calendar date of the fixture in the local venue timezone, stored as a DATE for day-level planning, fixture calendar display, and season schedule reporting. Distinct from the precise scheduled_start_timestamp used for operational systems.
attributes.references: NFL Schedule Publication Standard; NBA League Office Calendar

attributes.name: event_tier
attributes.description: Competitive tier or significance level of the fixture within its season or tournament structure. Determines pricing strategy, broadcast rights activation, and sponsorship inventory allocation. Drives dynamic pricing rules in Ticketmaster/AXS.
attributes.references: NFL Governance Office; NBA League Office; MLB Commissioner's Office Season Structure Guidelines

attributes.name: extra_time_played
attributes.description: Indicates whether the fixture required extra time or overtime periods beyond regulation. Affects broadcast window compliance, venue operations scheduling, and revenue reconciliation for extended event durations.
attributes.references: FIFA Competition Regulations Extra Time Rules; NFL Overtime Rules

attributes.name: fixture_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric business identifier for the fixture, used in operational systems such as Ticketmaster/AXS, Archtics, and SAP S/4HANA SD. Serves as the cross-system reference key for event scheduling and revenue management workflows.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster/AXS Event Management Standard; Archtics Venue Seating and Inventory Management

attributes.name: fixture_name
attributes.description: Official human-readable name of the fixture as published to fans, broadcasters, and sponsors (e.g., 'NBA Finals Game 7', 'UFC 300', 'FIFA World Cup Final'). Used in ticketing, broadcast schedules, and fan engagement platforms.
attributes.references: NBA League Office Event Naming Standard; FIFA Event Identification Guidelines

attributes.name: home_score
attributes.description: Final score or result for the home team or primary competitor at the conclusion of the fixture. Populated post-event. Used for standings calculation, WAR (Wins Above Replacement) analytics, and league governance reporting.
attributes.references: NFL Governance Office; NBA League Office; FIFA Competition Regulations Result Reporting

attributes.name: is_broadcast_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this fixture is eligible for broadcast distribution under existing media rights agreements. Drives activation of broadcast workflows in Dalet Galaxy and content rights management.
attributes.references: FCC Broadcast Regulation; DRM (Digital Rights Management) Policy; RSN (Regional Sports Network) Rights Agreements

attributes.name: is_neutral_site
attributes.description: Indicates whether the fixture is played at a neutral venue with no designated home team advantage. Affects revenue sharing agreements, ticketing allocation rules, and broadcast designation.
attributes.references: NFL Governance Office; FIFA Competition Regulations Neutral Site Rules

attributes.name: is_ppv
attributes.description: Indicates whether this fixture is designated as a Pay-Per-View (PPV) event requiring individual purchase for broadcast access. Triggers PPV pricing and DTC distribution workflows in OTT platforms.
attributes.references: FCC Pay-Per-View Regulations; DTC (Direct-To-Consumer) Distribution Policy

attributes.name: leg_number
attributes.description: Leg sequence number for two-legged ties or multi-game series (e.g., Leg 1, Leg 2 of a UEFA tie; Game 3 of an NBA playoff series). Nullable for single-leg fixtures.
attributes.references: FIFA Competition Regulations Two-Legged Tie Rules; NBA Playoff Series Format

attributes.name: lifecycle_status
attributes.description: Current operational state of the fixture within its lifecycle workflow from initial announcement through post-event reconciliation. Governs downstream system activations: ticketing goes on-sale at 'confirmed', broadcast feeds activate at 'in_progress', revenue reconciliation triggers at 'completed'.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster/AXS Event Lifecycle Standard; SAP S/4HANA SD Event Management

attributes.name: local_timezone
attributes.description: IANA timezone identifier for the venue's local timezone (e.g., 'America/New_York', 'Europe/London'). Required for accurate local time display in fan-facing platforms, broadcast scheduling, and ticket delivery.
attributes.references: IANA Time Zone Database; ISO 8601

attributes.name: matchday_number
attributes.description: Sequential matchday or game week number within the season or competition phase (e.g., Matchday 1, Week 12). Used for fixture calendar display, standings calculation, and broadcast scheduling.
attributes.references: FIFA Competition Regulations Matchday Structure; NFL Schedule Week Numbering

attributes.name: penalty_shootout
attributes.description: Indicates whether the fixture was decided by a penalty shootout or tiebreaker procedure. Used for competition result reporting and broadcast content tagging in Dalet Galaxy.
attributes.references: FIFA Competition Regulations Penalty Shootout Rules; NHL Shootout Rules

attributes.name: result_status
attributes.description: Official outcome classification of the fixture as determined by the governing body. Distinct from lifecycle_status — this captures the competitive result rather than the operational state. Used for standings, CAS (Court of Arbitration for Sport) appeals, and league governance.
attributes.references: FIFA Competition Regulations; CAS (Court of Arbitration for Sport); NFL Governance Office

attributes.name: scheduled_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Planned end date and time of the fixture in UTC. Used for broadcast window allocation, venue turnaround scheduling, and post-event reconciliation triggers in SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 Date/Time Standard; FCC Broadcast Scheduling Regulations

attributes.name: scheduled_start_timestamp
attributes.description: The principal real-world scheduled date and time when the fixture is planned to begin, stored in UTC with timezone offset. Used as the primary business event timestamp for broadcast scheduling, ticketing on-sale windows, and fan engagement notifications via Adobe Experience Platform.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 Date/Time Standard; FCC Broadcast Scheduling Regulations

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record from which this fixture record originated (e.g., Ticketmaster/AXS, Archtics, SAP S/4HANA SD, or league data feed). Supports data lineage tracking and Silver Layer reconciliation in the Databricks Lakehouse.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard; Databricks Lakehouse Data Lineage

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when the fixture record was last modified. Required for incremental data pipeline processing in the Databricks Silver Layer and audit trail compliance under SOX.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) Financial Controls; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer Incremental Processing

attributes.name: var_used
attributes.description: Indicates whether Video Assistant Referee (VAR) or equivalent video review technology (e.g., TMO in rugby) was deployed during this fixture. Required for competition governance reporting and broadcast production metadata.
attributes.references: FIFA VAR (Video Assistant Referee) Protocol; TMO (Television Match Official) Rugby Regulations

attributes.name: weather_condition
attributes.description: Recorded weather condition at the venue during the fixture. Used for performance analytics in SportsCode/Hudl, insurance claims, and post-event operational reporting. 'indoor' applies to enclosed venues. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: clear|cloudy|rain|snow|fog|extreme_heat|indoor — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

products.name: calendar
products.description: Master entity defining a competitive or programming season within a league or entertainment series. Serves as the SSOT for season identity AND the official published fixture calendar/schedule. Captures season name, year, sport/entertainment type, start/end dates, number of scheduled rounds/weeks, playoff structure flag, season status (planning, active, completed), governing body reference, CBA applicability flag, season format (regular, shortened, expanded), calendar publication date, calendar version, scheduling authority, blackout dates, bye weeks, international window dates, and calendar status (draft, published, amended). Owns the official release of fixture schedules to downstream consumers including broadcast, ticketing, and venue operations.

attributes.name: calendar_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the event calendar / season record. Primary key for this entity in the Silver Layer lakehouse.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 11179 — Data Element Naming and Definition

attributes.name: calendar_governing_body_id

attributes.name: league_id

attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: blackout_dates
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of specific dates on which no fixtures may be scheduled due to regulatory, contractual, or operational constraints (e.g., broadcast blackout windows, public holidays, conflicting major events). Enforced by the scheduling authority.
attributes.references: FCC Broadcast Regulation; NFL Governance Office; FIFA

attributes.name: bye_weeks
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of round/week numbers designated as bye weeks (no fixtures scheduled). Relevant primarily for NFL and similar league formats. Used by broadcast schedulers in Dalet Galaxy to fill programming gaps and by venue operations for maintenance windows.
attributes.references: NFL Governance Office; CBA

attributes.name: calendar_status
attributes.description: Current publication status of the fixture calendar. Controls downstream visibility and consumption: 'draft' is internal only; 'published' is the official release to broadcast, ticketing, and venue operations; 'amended' indicates a post-publication revision; 'suspended' indicates a temporary halt; 'archived' is end-of-life.
attributes.references: NFL Governance Office; FIFA; NBA League Office; FCC Broadcast Regulation

attributes.name: cba_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the season schedule is governed by an active Collective Bargaining Agreement (CBA) between the league and players' association. When true, CBA constraints on game counts, rest days, and travel windows must be validated against the fixture calendar.
attributes.references: CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement); NFL Governance Office; NBA League Office; MLBPA; NHLPA

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this event calendar record was first created in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and SOX financial controls compliance.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act); ISO/IEC 27001

attributes.name: gdpr_applicable
attributes.business_glossary_term: General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) Applicable Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether GDPR data privacy obligations apply to fan and participant data collected during this season, based on the host country and market reach. When true, data processing activities must comply with GDPR Articles 5-7 and fan consent management in Adobe Experience Platform.
attributes.references: GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation) Article 4; CCPA

attributes.name: has_playoff_structure
attributes.description: Indicates whether this season includes a post-season playoff or knockout tournament phase beyond the regular season. When true, playoff-specific broadcast rights, ticketing tiers, and venue contracts are activated.
attributes.references: NFL Governance Office; NBA League Office; NHL Board of Governors; FIFA

attributes.name: host_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the primary host nation for this season (e.g., 'USA', 'GBR', 'FRA'). Determines applicable regulatory frameworks (GDPR, CCPA, local tax), venue safety standards (OSHA, ADA), and broadcast licensing requirements (FCC).
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1; GDPR; CCPA; OSHA; ADA; FCC

attributes.name: international_window_dates
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of date ranges reserved for international competition windows (e.g., FIFA international breaks, Olympic qualifying periods) during which domestic league fixtures are suspended. Critical for fixture scheduling compliance with FIFA and IOC calendars.
attributes.references: FIFA; IOC; UEFA

attributes.name: is_international_season
attributes.description: Indicates whether this season includes fixtures played in multiple countries or international markets. When true, multi-jurisdiction regulatory compliance (GDPR, local broadcast licensing, visa/work permit requirements) is triggered.
attributes.references: FIFA; IOC; GDPR; FCC

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for operational notes, scheduling caveats, or amendment reasons associated with this season calendar record (e.g., 'Schedule amended due to venue unavailability in Week 7', 'Shortened season per CBA force majeure clause'). Supports audit trail and change management.
attributes.references: SOX; ISO 20121

attributes.name: number_of_participating_teams
attributes.description: Total count of teams, clubs, or acts participating in this season. Used for fixture generation, venue capacity planning in Archtics, and broadcast slot allocation. For concert series, represents the number of performing acts.
attributes.references: NFL Governance Office; FIFA; NBA League Office; NHL Board of Governors

attributes.name: playoff_format_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the playoff bracket or knockout structure (e.g., 'Single-elimination 12-team bracket', 'Best-of-7 series, 16 teams'). Supports broadcast production planning and fan engagement content in Adobe Experience Platform.
attributes.references: NFL Governance Office; NBA League Office; FIFA

attributes.name: playoff_start_date
attributes.description: Scheduled start date of the post-season playoff phase. Null if has_playoff_structure is false. Used to define the playoff broadcast rights window and premium ticketing on-sale dates in Ticketmaster/AXS.
attributes.references: NFL Governance Office; NBA League Office; NHL Board of Governors

attributes.name: publication_date
attributes.description: The official date on which the fixture calendar was publicly released by the scheduling authority. Triggers downstream on-sale windows in Ticketmaster/AXS and broadcast scheduling in Dalet Galaxy.
attributes.references: NFL Governance Office; FIFA; NBA League Office

attributes.name: season_end_date
attributes.description: Official end date of the competitive or programming season, inclusive of any playoff or championship rounds. Defines the effective-until boundary for broadcast rights, venue contracts, and sponsorship activation periods.
attributes.references: NFL Governance Office; FIFA; NBA League Office; FCC

attributes.name: season_format
attributes.description: Structural format of the season indicating whether it follows the standard schedule length or a modified format (e.g., shortened due to CBA disputes or COVID, expanded due to league growth). Critical for CBA compliance tracking and broadcast rights valuation.
attributes.references: CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement); NFL Governance Office; NBA League Office; MLBPA

attributes.name: season_phase
attributes.description: Current active phase of the season lifecycle. Drives phase-specific business rules across ticketing (Ticketmaster/AXS), broadcast (Dalet Galaxy), and venue operations. 'pre_season' = warm-up fixtures; 'regular_season' = main competition; 'post_season' = playoffs/finals; 'off_season' = between seasons.
attributes.references: NFL Governance Office; NBA League Office; FIFA; CBA

attributes.name: season_start_date
attributes.description: Official start date of the competitive or programming season as published by the governing body. Used as the effective-from boundary for broadcast rights windows, ticketing on-sale periods, and venue booking calendars.
attributes.references: NFL Governance Office; FIFA; NBA League Office; FCC

attributes.name: season_status
attributes.description: Operational lifecycle state of the season itself (distinct from calendar publication status). 'planning' = pre-season setup; 'active' = season in progress; 'completed' = all fixtures concluded; 'cancelled' = season abandoned; 'suspended' = temporarily halted (e.g., force majeure, labour dispute).

attributes.name: ada_accessible_seat_count
attributes.description: Number of ADA-compliant accessible seats allocated for this event at this venue configuration. Used by ticketing domain to configure accessible inventory in Archtics and ensure compliance with ADA minimum accessible seating ratios.

attributes.name: ada_compliant
attributes.business_glossary_term: Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Compliance Confirmed
attributes.description: Indicates whether ADA accessibility compliance has been formally confirmed for this event at this venue, including accessible seating, ramps, restrooms, and concession access. Required for regulatory compliance reporting and venue operations preparation.
attributes.references: ADA (Americans with Disabilities Act); ISO 20121 Event Sustainability Management

attributes.name: approved_capacity
attributes.description: Maximum number of attendees approved for this specific event at this venue, reflecting the capacity configuration type. May differ from the venue's total rated capacity due to event-specific restrictions, safety requirements, or reduced-capacity mandates. Used by ticketing domain to cap inventory in Archtics and Ticketmaster/AXS.
attributes.references: OSHA Venue Safety Standards; ADA Accessibility Requirements

attributes.name: assignment_code
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for this venue assignment, used in operational communications, venue operations work orders, and ticketing system configuration (e.g., Archtics seating inventory setup). Format: EVA- followed by 4-12 alphanumeric characters.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: assignment_effective_date
attributes.description: Calendar date from which this venue assignment is operationally effective. Venue operations teams use this date to begin facility preparation scheduling, and ticketing teams use it to open inventory configuration in Archtics.
attributes.references: Internal Event Operations Standard

attributes.name: assignment_expiry_date
attributes.description: Calendar date after which this venue assignment is no longer valid. Used for provisional or alternate assignments that have a defined validity window. Null for confirmed primary assignments with no expiry.
attributes.references: Internal Event Operations Standard

attributes.name: assignment_notes
attributes.description: Free-text operational notes related to this venue assignment, capturing special conditions, exceptions, or instructions for venue operations, ticketing, and broadcast teams that are not captured in structured fields.
attributes.references: Internal Event Operations Standard

attributes.name: assignment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the venue assignment. 'proposed' indicates initial planning stage; 'confirmed' indicates venue is locked and ticketing/operations may proceed; 'provisional' indicates conditional confirmation pending contract or regulatory approval; 'cancelled' indicates the assignment has been voided; 'superseded' indicates replaced by a newer assignment record.
attributes.references: Internal Event Operations Standard

attributes.name: broadcast_infrastructure_ready
attributes.description: Indicates whether the venue's broadcast infrastructure (OB (Outside Broadcast) unit connections, fiber feeds, camera positions, commentary positions) has been confirmed as ready for this event. Used by broadcast operations and Dalet Galaxy workflow planning.
attributes.references: FCC (Federal Communications Commission) Broadcast Regulation; Internal Broadcast Operations Standard

attributes.name: change_history_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this venue assignment record has been modified or superseded since initial creation, signaling that a prior assignment existed for this event. Used for audit trail tracking and downstream notification to venue operations and ticketing teams of venue changes.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) Financial Controls; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: change_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the reason for a venue assignment change, such as venue unavailability, weather conditions, safety concerns, league mandate, or contractual renegotiation. Populated when change_history_flag is True.
attributes.references: Internal Event Operations Standard; SOX Financial Controls

attributes.name: confirmation_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the venue assignment was formally confirmed, triggering downstream venue operations preparation and ticketing inventory configuration in Archtics. Null if assignment is still in proposed or provisional state.
attributes.references: Internal Event Operations Standard

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this venue assignment record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail requirements and data lineage tracking per SOX financial controls.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) Financial Controls; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity and Accountability)

attributes.name: designation_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether this venue is the primary assigned venue, an alternate venue held in reserve, a neutral-site venue (neither team's home ground, common in playoff or championship contexts), or a backup venue activated only if the primary is unavailable.
attributes.references: NFL Governance Office; FIFA Venue Regulations; NBA League Office

attributes.name: event_date
attributes.description: Scheduled calendar date of the event at this venue. Denormalized here to support venue operations scheduling and facility resource planning without requiring a join to the event master record.
attributes.references: Internal Event Operations Standard

attributes.name: field_setup_type
attributes.description: Specifies the physical configuration of the playing surface, court, or stage for this event. Determines sightline mapping, seating kill zones, and production logistics. 'standard' applies to normal league-regulation field/court layout; concert and stage variants apply to live entertainment events. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: standard|concert_stage|in_the_round|end_stage|thrust_stage|custom|floor_only|half_house — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ISO 20121 Event Sustainability Management; Internal Venue Operations Standard

attributes.name: ga_section_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether General Admission (GA) standing sections are enabled for this event at this venue. Affects ticketing inventory configuration, crowd management planning, and OSHA safety compliance for standing areas.
attributes.references: OSHA Venue Safety Standards; ADA Accessibility Requirements; Internal Ticketing Operations Standard

attributes.name: gate_open_time
attributes.description: Scheduled date and time when venue gates open to the public for this event. Used by venue operations, security staffing, and access control configuration in Ticketmaster/AXS gate scan systems.
attributes.references: Internal Venue Operations Standard; OSHA Venue Safety Standards

attributes.name: load_in_date
attributes.description: Date on which production equipment, staging, and event infrastructure begins loading into the venue. Critical for venue operations scheduling, HVAC (Heating Ventilation and Air Conditioning) activation, and BMS (Building Management System) configuration.
attributes.references: ISO 20121 Event Sustainability Management; Internal Venue Operations Standard

attributes.name: load_out_date
attributes.description: Date by which all production equipment and event infrastructure must be removed from the venue. Used for venue turnaround scheduling and back-to-back event planning.
attributes.references: ISO 20121 Event Sustainability Management; Internal Venue Operations Standard

attributes.name: media_rights_zone
attributes.description: Geographic media rights zone classification for this venue assignment, determining which RSN (Regional Sports Network), OTT (Over-The-Top Streaming), or broadcast network holds distribution rights for events at this venue. Used in broadcast rights management and content distribution.
attributes.references: FCC Broadcast Regulation; Internal Broadcast Rights Standard

attributes.name: neutral_site_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this venue assignment represents a neutral-site event where neither competing team or performer has a home-ground advantage. Common in playoff games, championship events, bowl games, and international fixtures. Affects revenue-sharing, ticketing allocation, and broadcast rights.
attributes.references: NFL Governance Office; FIFA Venue Regulations; NBA League Office; MLB Commissioner's Office

attributes.name: parking_capacity
attributes.description: Total number of parking spaces available at or designated for this venue for this event. Used in fan experience planning, transportation logistics, and ancillary revenue forecasting.
attributes.references: Internal Venue Operations Standard; ADA Accessibility Requirements

attributes.name: rental_fee_amount
attributes.description: Contracted rental fee payable to the venue operator for hosting this event. Used in event P&L (Profit and Loss) analysis and financial planning in Workday Adaptive Planning. Classified as confidential due to commercial sensitivity.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO (Financial Accounting / Controlling); SOX Financial Controls

attributes.name: rental_fee_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the venue rental fee amount (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR). Required for multi-currency financial reporting and SAP S/4HANA FI integration.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA FI (Financial Accounting)

attributes.name: revenue_share_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of event gross revenue contractually shared with the venue operator, covering concessions, parking, and ancillary revenue streams. Used in financial planning and EBITDA (Earnings Before Interest Taxes Depreciation and Amortization) modeling.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO; SOX Financial Controls; Internal Contract Management Standard

attributes.name: scheduled_start_time
attributes.description: Precise scheduled start date and time of the event at this venue, including timezone offset. Used by venue operations for gate opening scheduling, broadcast production (OB unit deployment), and fan communications.
attributes.references: Internal Event Operations Standard; FCC Broadcast Regulation

attributes.name: seating_manifest_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the seating manifest (kill zones, accessible sections, GA (General Admission) areas, SRO (Standing Room Only) sections) configured in Archtics for this event-venue assignment. Tracks changes to seating layout between events at the same venue.
attributes.references: Archtics Venue Seating and Inventory Management; Internal Ticketing Operations Standard

attributes.name: security_level
attributes.description: Designated security threat level for this event at this venue, driving staffing levels, screening protocols, and law enforcement coordination. Levels align with internal security classification framework and OSHA venue safety requirements.
attributes.references: OSHA Venue Safety Standards; Internal Security Operations Standard

attributes.name: surface_type
attributes.description: Type of playing surface configured for this event at this venue. Relevant for athlete safety compliance, league regulations (e.g., NFL CBA surface requirements), and broadcast production planning. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: natural_grass|artificial_turf|hardwood|ice|clay|grass|carpet|concrete|synthetic_clay — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NFL Governance Office; FIFA Venue Regulations; WADA; CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement)

attributes.name: sustainability_certification
attributes.description: ISO 20121 or equivalent sustainability certification status for this venue assignment, documenting environmental management compliance for the event. Supports ESG (Environmental Social Governance) reporting and league sustainability mandates.
attributes.references: ISO 20121 Event Sustainability Management Systems

attributes.name: ticketing_system_venue_code
attributes.description: Venue identifier code as configured in the ticketing platform (Ticketmaster/AXS or Archtics) for this specific event assignment. Used to map seating inventory, price tiers, and access control zones to the correct venue configuration.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this venue assignment record was last modified. Used for change detection, incremental data pipeline processing, and audit trail compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Financial Controls; GDPR Article 5; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: venue_contract_reference
attributes.description: Reference number of the venue rental or usage contract governing this assignment. Links to the contract management system for financial terms, liability clauses, and cancellation provisions. Classified as confidential due to commercial sensitivity.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD (Sales and Distribution); Internal Contract Management Standard

attributes.name: weather_contingency_plan
attributes.description: Reference identifier or description of the weather contingency plan applicable to this outdoor or partially-covered venue assignment. Includes rain delay protocols, lightning evacuation procedures, and postponement triggers.
attributes.references: OSHA Venue Safety Standards; ISO 20121 Event Sustainability Management

products.name: event_day_ops
products.description: Operational readiness, execution, and closeout record for each event held at a venue, capturing the full event-day lifecycle from pre-event certification through post-event reconciliation. Pre-event readiness attributes include checklist completion status, checklist version, HVAC/fire/emergency system verification, security sweep completion, ADA access confirmation, medical station readiness, critical-item failure count, overall readiness status (approved/conditional/rejected), and facility manager approval with timestamp. Execution attributes include gates-open/close times, load-in/load-out windows, actual attendance, peak concourse occupancy, active concession stand count, active parking lot count, security and medical staffing counts, weather conditions, and incident count. Post-event attributes include operational status (pre-event/in-progress/post-event/closed), damage assessment flag, and facility manager sign-off. Distinct from the event domain's event record — this is the venue's operational execution layer owning the single source of truth for event-day readiness certification and operational performance.

products.name: parking_activation
products.description: This association product represents the Event (activation) between event_day_ops and parking_lot. It captures the operational record of which parking lots are activated for a specific event, including per-lot capacity allocation, open/close timing, shuttle status, and activation state. Each record links one event_day_ops to one parking_lot with attributes that exist only in the context of this activation relationship — data that belongs neither to the event-day operation record nor to the parking lot master record alone.. Existence Justification: In live event venue operations, parking lot activation is a genuinely managed business process: operations managers explicitly open and close specific lots for each event, allocate capacity per lot, and track shuttle status and timing. A single event_day_ops record activates multiple parking lots, and a single parking lot is activated across many different event_day_ops records over its lifetime. The relationship itself — which lots are open, when, with how many spaces allocated — is operationally managed and carries its own data.

Storing it as a denormalized count on event_day_ops creates a maintenance burden and risks inconsistency with the activation records. It should be removed from event_day_ops and derived via query from this association table.]

products.name: config_section_allocation
products.description: This association product represents the operational allocation contract between a capacity_config and a seating_section. It captures how each seating section is configured — activated, killed, or restricted — within a specific capacity configuration profile. Each record links one capacity_config to one seating_section and carries attributes that exist only in the context of that pairing: how many seats are allocated, how many are killed, the section's operational status within the config, any price zone override, and access restrictions. Directly analogous to the manifest line concept in Archtics and Ticketmaster venue ticketing platforms.. Existence Justification: In professional sports and live entertainment venue operations, a capacity configuration (e.g., 'End-Stage Concert', 'Full Bowl Sports', 'Half-House Hockey') explicitly governs which seating sections are active, how many seats are allocated, which sections are killed, and what price zone overrides apply — for that specific configuration. A single capacity_config spans many seating_sections, and a single seating_section participates in many capacity_configs over its operational lifetime (e.g., Section 101 is open for a sold-out game, partially killed for a smaller event, and entirely closed for a concert stage setup). This is the 'manifest' concept in Archtics ticketing platforms — a recognized operational entity that venue operations teams actively create, update, and manage per event format.

Belongs to the allocation, not the section or config independently.

Sourced from SportsCode/Hudl performance analytics platform. Each record represents a statistical line for one athlete in one game or aggregated period, enabling broadcast overlays, fantasy sports feeds, and league standings calculations.

attributes.name: tertiary_performance_opponent_team_franchise_id
attributes.description: Reference to the opposing team faced during this game. Enables head-to-head performance analysis, matchup-based scouting reports, and broadcast narrative generation. Null for season or career aggregate records.

attributes.name: aggregation_method_override
attributes.description: An optional override to the KPI definition's default aggregation method, applied specifically when this stat record contributes to this KPI. Allows governance teams to specify non-standard aggregation for edge-case stat-KPI combinations without altering the master KPI definition.

attributes.name: assists
attributes.description: Number of assists credited to the athlete — passes or actions directly leading to a goal or score. Applicable across soccer, hockey, basketball, and other team sports. Key metric for broadcast overlays and fantasy sports scoring.
attributes.references: FIFA, NHL, NBA, MLS Statistical Standards

attributes.name: batting_average
attributes.description: Baseball-specific metric representing the ratio of hits to official at-bats (H/AB), expressed as a three-decimal fraction (e.g., 0.315). Null for non-baseball records. Foundational hitting metric for broadcast overlays, fantasy sports, and contract evaluation.
attributes.references: MLB Commissioner's Office Statistical Standards

attributes.name: blocks
attributes.description: Number of blocked shots or blocked passes credited to the athlete. Applicable to basketball (NBA shot blocks) and soccer/hockey (blocked shots). Null for non-applicable sport/position combinations.
attributes.references: NBA, FIFA, NHL Statistical Standards

attributes.name: certification_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which the statistical record was officially certified by the league or governing body. Formatted as yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Null for provisional or pending records. Required for official standings calculations and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, FIFA League Governance Standards

attributes.name: contribution_weight
attributes.description: The numeric weight (e.g., 0.0 to 1.0 or a raw multiplier) applied to this performance stat record when computing the target KPI value. Belongs to the relationship because the same stat may carry different weights for different KPIs.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which this performance statistic record was first ingested into the Silver layer lakehouse. Formatted as yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Supports data lineage, audit trails, and SLA monitoring for the SportsCode/Hudl ingestion pipeline.
attributes.references: Sports Entertainment Data Governance Standards; SOX Financial Controls

attributes.name: era
attributes.description: Earned Run Average (ERA) — baseball-specific pitching metric representing the average number of earned runs allowed per nine innings pitched. Null for non-baseball records. Primary pitching performance indicator for broadcast overlays, fantasy sports, and contract evaluation.
attributes.references: MLB Commissioner's Office Statistical Standards

attributes.name: field_goal_percentage
attributes.description: Ratio of successful field goals made to field goals attempted. Applicable to basketball (NBA) and American football (NFL kickers). Null for non-applicable sport/position combinations. Key shooting efficiency metric for broadcast overlays.
attributes.references: NBA, NFL Statistical Standards

attributes.name: fouls_committed
attributes.description: Total number of fouls committed by the athlete in this statistical period. Applicable to basketball (NBA personal fouls), soccer (FIFA/MLS), and hockey (NHL penalties). Tracks disciplinary and gameplay conduct for compliance and broadcast context.
attributes.references: NBA, FIFA, NHL, MLS Statistical Standards

attributes.name: games_played
attributes.description: Number of games in which the athlete appeared and was credited with participation. For game-level records this is always 1; for season or career records this represents the cumulative count. Used in rate-stat calculations and eligibility determinations.
attributes.references: Sports Entertainment League Operations Standards

attributes.name: games_started
attributes.description: Number of games in which the athlete was in the starting lineup. Distinguishes starter versus substitute contributions for roster management, contract incentive tracking, and broadcast narrative context.
attributes.references: Sports Entertainment League Operations Standards

attributes.name: goals
attributes.description: Number of goals scored by the athlete in this statistical period. Applicable to soccer (MLS/FIFA), ice hockey (NHL), and other goal-scoring sports. Null for sports where goals are not a primary scoring unit.
attributes.references: FIFA, NHL, MLS Statistical Standards

attributes.name: hudl_stat_record_reference
attributes.description: The native record identifier assigned by the SportsCode/Hudl performance analytics platform for this statistical entry. Used for source system traceability and reconciliation against the operational system of record.
attributes.references: SportsCode/Hudl Performance Analytics Platform

attributes.name: innings_pitched
attributes.description: Total innings pitched by a baseball pitcher in this statistical period, expressed in thirds of an inning (e.g., 6.2 = 6 innings and 2 outs). Null for non-pitcher or non-baseball records. Denominator for ERA and other rate-based pitching metrics.
attributes.references: MLB Commissioner's Office Statistical Standards

attributes.name: is_home_game
attributes.description: Indicates whether the athlete's team was the home team during this game. True = home team; False = away team. Null for season or career aggregate records. Enables home/away performance split analysis for broadcast storytelling and scouting.
attributes.references: Sports Entertainment Event Management Standards

attributes.name: is_primary_input
attributes.description: Indicates whether this performance stat record is the primary driver of the KPI value (true) or a secondary/supplementary input (false). Used by reporting systems to prioritise which stat to surface in broadcast overlays and governance dashboards.

attributes.name: minutes_played
attributes.description: Total minutes of active participation recorded for the athlete in this statistical period. Used for per-minute rate statistics, workload management, and injury risk analytics. Applicable to basketball, soccer, hockey, and other timed sports.
attributes.references: NBA, NHL, MLS Performance Analytics Standards

attributes.name: on_base_percentage
attributes.description: Baseball-specific metric measuring how frequently a batter reaches base per plate appearance, including hits, walks, and hit-by-pitch. Null for non-baseball records. Advanced hitting metric used alongside batting average for comprehensive offensive evaluation.
attributes.references: MLB Commissioner's Office Statistical Standards

attributes.name: passing_yards
attributes.description: Total passing yards accumulated by the athlete in this statistical period. NFL-specific metric for quarterbacks and passing plays. Null for non-football records or non-passing positions. Key broadcast overlay and fantasy sports metric.
attributes.references: NFL League Office Statistical Standards

attributes.name: plus_minus
attributes.description: The plus/minus differential representing the net score differential when the athlete was on the ice or court. Applicable to ice hockey (NHL) and basketball (NBA). Positive values indicate the team outscored opponents during the athlete's time on the field. Key advanced analytics input.
attributes.references: NHL, NBA Statistical Standards

attributes.name: points_scored
attributes.description: Total points scored by the athlete in this statistical period. Applicable to basketball (NBA), American football (NFL touchdowns/field goals), and other point-based sports. Null for sports where points are not individually attributed.
attributes.references: NBA, NFL Statistical Standards

attributes.name: position_played
attributes.description: The on-field position the athlete occupied during this game or statistical period (e.g., Quarterback, Pitcher, Point Guard, Center Forward, Goalkeeper). Position context is critical for sport-specific metric interpretation and broadcast overlays.
attributes.references: NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, FIFA Position Classification Standards

attributes.name: qbr
attributes.description: Quarterback Rating (QBR) — NFL-specific composite passing efficiency metric scaled 0–100 measuring a quarterback's overall performance including passing, rushing, and situational adjustments. Null for non-quarterback or non-football records. Used for broadcast overlays and fantasy sports feeds.
attributes.references: NFL League Office Statistical Standards; ESPN QBR Methodology

attributes.name: rebounds
attributes.description: Total number of rebounds (offensive plus defensive) credited to the athlete. Basketball-specific metric (NBA). Null for non-basketball records. Used in broadcast overlays, fantasy sports feeds, and player valuation models.
attributes.references: NBA League Office Statistical Standards

attributes.name: receiving_yards
attributes.description: Total receiving yards accumulated by the athlete in this statistical period. NFL-specific metric for wide receivers, tight ends, and running backs. Null for non-football records. Key fantasy sports and broadcast overlay metric.
attributes.references: NFL League Office Statistical Standards

attributes.name: red_cards
attributes.description: Number of red cards (ejections) received by the athlete in this statistical period. Soccer-specific (FIFA/MLS) disciplinary metric. Null for non-soccer records. Triggers automatic suspension and is tracked for league compliance and CBA reporting.
attributes.references: FIFA, MLS Disciplinary Standards; CBA Compliance

attributes.name: rushing_yards
attributes.description: Total rushing yards accumulated by the athlete in this statistical period. NFL-specific metric for running backs, quarterbacks, and other ball carriers. Null for non-football records. Used in broadcast overlays and fantasy sports scoring.
attributes.references: NFL League Office Statistical Standards

attributes.name: saves
attributes.description: Number of saves recorded by the athlete. Applicable to goalkeepers in soccer and hockey, and to relief pitchers in baseball (MLB save rule). Null for non-applicable sport/position combinations.
attributes.references: FIFA, NHL, MLB Statistical Standards

attributes.name: slugging_percentage
attributes.description: Baseball-specific advanced hitting metric measuring total bases per at-bat, reflecting extra-base hit power. Null for non-baseball records. Combined with on-base percentage to produce OPS (On-Base Plus Slugging) for comprehensive offensive evaluation.
attributes.references: MLB Commissioner's Office Statistical Standards

attributes.name: sport_discipline
attributes.description: The specific sport or discipline for which these statistics apply (e.g., American Football, Baseball, Basketball, Ice Hockey, Soccer, Tennis). Determines which sport-specific metric fields are populated and which are null. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: american_football|baseball|basketball|ice_hockey|soccer|tennis|golf|mma|rugby|cricket — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FIFA, NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, MLS Governance Standards

attributes.name: stat_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the game was played or the date representing the end of the aggregation period for season/career records. Formatted as yyyy-MM-dd per enterprise data standards.
attributes.references: Sports Entertainment Data Standards

attributes.name: stat_period_end_date
attributes.description: The end date of the window over which this performance stat record is considered a valid input to the KPI calculation. Together with stat_period_start_date, defines the contribution scope for this specific mapping.

attributes.name: stat_period_start_date
attributes.description: The start date of the window over which this performance stat record is considered a valid input to the KPI calculation. Scopes the contribution temporally without altering the stat record or the KPI definition.

attributes.name: stat_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the statistical record. Official records are certified by the league; provisional records are pending official certification; revised records have been corrected post-certification; voided records are invalidated due to forfeit, protest, or data error; pending_review records are under investigation.
attributes.references: NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, FIFA League Governance Standards

attributes.name: stat_type
attributes.description: Classifies whether this record represents a single-game statistical line, a season-level aggregate, a career-level aggregate, a playoff period, or a tournament-specific accumulation. Drives how the record is consumed by broadcast overlays, fantasy feeds, and standings engines.
attributes.references: Sports Entertainment Performance Analytics Standards

attributes.name: steals
attributes.description: Number of steals credited to the athlete. Primarily a basketball (NBA) defensive metric. Also applicable to baseball (stolen bases). Null for non-applicable sport/position combinations.
attributes.references: NBA, MLB Statistical Standards

attributes.name: strikeouts
attributes.description: Number of strikeouts recorded. For pitchers (MLB), this is the count of batters struck out. For batters, this is the count of times struck out. Null for non-baseball records. Key pitching and batting evaluation metric.
attributes.references: MLB Commissioner's Office Statistical Standards

attributes.name: tackles
attributes.description: Number of tackles made by the athlete. Applicable to American football (NFL) defensive players and soccer (FIFA/MLS) players. Null for sports or positions where tackles are not a tracked metric.
attributes.references: NFL, FIFA, MLS Statistical Standards

attributes.name: touchdowns
attributes.description: Total touchdowns scored or thrown by the athlete in this statistical period. NFL-specific metric covering passing touchdowns, rushing touchdowns, and receiving touchdowns. Null for non-football records.
attributes.references: NFL League Office Statistical Standards

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which this performance statistic record was last modified in the Silver layer lakehouse. Formatted as yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Tracks revisions, corrections, and re-certifications. Required for change data capture and audit compliance.
attributes.references: Sports Entertainment Data Governance Standards; SOX Financial Controls

attributes.name: war
attributes.description: Wins Above Replacement (WAR) — a composite advanced metric estimating the total number of additional wins the athlete contributed to their team compared to a replacement-level player. Sourced from SportsCode/Hudl analytics engine. Used for contract valuation, trade analysis, and broadcast storytelling.
attributes.references: MLB, NFL Advanced Analytics Standards; SportsCode/Hudl

attributes.name: yellow_cards
attributes.description: Number of yellow cards (cautions) received by the athlete in this statistical period. Soccer-specific (FIFA/MLS) disciplinary metric. Null for non-soccer records. Relevant for suspension tracking and league compliance reporting.
attributes.references: FIFA, MLS Disciplinary Standards

attributes.description: Standardized anatomical body part or region affected by the injury (e.g., 'left_knee', 'right_shoulder', 'lumbar_spine', 'hamstring_right'). attributes.name: broadcast_disclosure_approved

attributes.name: broadcast_injury_note
attributes.description: Approved public-facing injury description for use in broadcast, media, and fan communications. Sanitized version of the clinical description that omits protected health information. Populated only when broadcast_disclosure_approved is True. Used by Dalet Galaxy broadcast workflow for on-air injury reporting.
attributes.references: CBA Media Disclosure Provisions; GDPR Article 9; CCPA

attributes.name: case_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric case reference assigned by the team medical staff system at the time of injury intake. Used for cross-referencing with insurance claims, OSHA logs, and league medical reporting. Format: INJ-YYYY-NNNNNN.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1904 Recordkeeping; Internal Case Management Standard

attributes.name: concussion_protocol_triggered
attributes.description: Indicates whether the league's mandatory concussion evaluation and graduated return-to-play protocol was triggered for this injury. Drives specific compliance tracking requirements distinct from standard injury management. Required for league concussion protocol reporting.
attributes.references: NFL/NHL/FIFA Concussion Protocol; IOC Consensus Statement on Concussion in Sport

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this injury record was first created in the medical management system. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and OSHA recordkeeping compliance.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1904; SOX Internal Controls

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the insurance_reserve_amount (e.g., 'USD', 'EUR', 'GBP'). Required for multi-market operations across global leagues.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA FI Module

attributes.name: days_lost_actual
attributes.description: Actual number of calendar days the athlete was unavailable for competition, calculated upon return to play or case closure. Used for OSHA recordkeeping (days away from work), insurance settlement, and injury analytics benchmarking.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1904.7 General Recording Criteria; CBA

attributes.name: days_lost_estimated
attributes.description: Physician-estimated number of calendar days the athlete is expected to be unavailable for competition due to the injury. Used for roster planning, insurance claim valuation, and broadcast availability reporting. Distinct from actual days lost which is calculated from actual RTP date.
attributes.references: CBA Injury Reporting; Insurance Claim Standards

attributes.name: expected_rtp_date
attributes.description: Physician-projected date on which the athlete is expected to return to full competitive play (Return-to-Play / RTP). Used for roster management, broadcast scheduling, and fan communications. May be updated as recovery progresses.
attributes.references: CBA Return-to-Play Protocol; League Medical Standards

attributes.name: icd10_code
attributes.description: International Classification of Diseases, 10th Revision (ICD-10-CM) diagnosis code assigned by the treating physician. Standardizes injury classification for insurance claims, OSHA reporting, league medical databases, and cross-team analytics. Required for workers' compensation and insurance claim processing.
attributes.references: ICD-10-CM (WHO / CDC); OSHA 29 CFR 1904; PCI-DSS (insurance billing)

attributes.name: injury_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the injury or medical event was first sustained or identified. Principal business event date for the injury lifecycle. Used for OSHA recordkeeping, insurance claim filing windows, and roster eligibility calculations.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1904.29; WADA Medical Exemption Reporting

attributes.name: injury_description
attributes.description: Free-text clinical narrative describing the nature, mechanism, and circumstances of the injury or medical event as documented by the treating physician or athletic trainer. Supports detailed medical review and insurance claim documentation.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1904; HIPAA (where applicable to athlete health records)

attributes.name: injury_location
attributes.description: Setting or context in which the injury occurred. Distinguishes game-time injuries from practice, training facility, or travel-related incidents. Affects OSHA recordability determination, workers' compensation eligibility, and league reporting obligations.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1904.5 Work-Relatedness Determination

attributes.name: injury_mechanism
attributes.description: Mechanism by which the injury was sustained. 'contact' indicates collision with another player or object; 'non_contact' indicates injury without external contact (e.g., ACL tear during cutting); 'overexertion' indicates fatigue or training load-related; 'environmental' indicates field/court surface or weather-related cause. Critical for OSHA incident classification and injury prevention analytics.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1904.12; Sports Medicine Injury Surveillance Standards

attributes.name: injury_status
attributes.description: Current roster and medical status of the injury record reflecting the athlete's availability. 'day_to_day' indicates probable return within 1-2 days; 'injured_reserve' (IR) indicates formal IR designation per league CBA rules; 'returned' indicates the athlete has cleared return-to-play protocol; 'closed' indicates the case is administratively closed.
attributes.references: Collective Bargaining Agreement (CBA); League Roster Rules

attributes.name: injury_type
attributes.description: High-level clinical classification of the injury or medical event. 'acute' refers to sudden-onset traumatic injuries; 'chronic' refers to long-standing conditions; 'overuse' refers to repetitive stress injuries; 'concussion' is tracked separately per league concussion protocol requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: acute|chronic|overuse|illness|concussion|fracture|laceration|dislocation|sprain|strain — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICD-10-CM Classification; League Concussion Protocol; WADA

attributes.name: insurance_reserve_amount
attributes.description: Financial reserve amount (in USD) set aside by the team's insurance carrier for this injury claim. Represents the estimated total cost of the claim including medical treatment, salary continuation, and rehabilitation. Used for financial planning and SAP S/4HANA FI/CO reserve posting.
attributes.references: CBA Insurance Provisions; SAP S/4HANA FI Module; SOX Financial Controls

attributes.name: ir_designation
attributes.description: Formal league roster designation for the injured athlete per Collective Bargaining Agreement (CBA) rules. 'ir_standard' = standard Injured Reserve placement; 'ir_return_designated' = IR with designation to return (allows one return per season); 'ir_non_football' = injury unrelated to sport; 'pup_list' = Physically Unable to Perform list (pre-season). Drives roster count compliance and salary cap implications.
attributes.references: NFL/NBA/MLB/NHL CBA Roster Rules; League Operations Manual

attributes.name: is_osha_recordable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this injury meets OSHA recordability criteria under 29 CFR 1904 (i.e., results in days away from work, restricted duty, medical treatment beyond first aid, loss of consciousness, or diagnosis of a significant condition). Required for OSHA 300 Log annual reporting.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1904.7 General Recording Criteria

attributes.name: is_recurrence
attributes.description: Indicates whether this injury is a recurrence of a previously documented injury to the same body part. Recurrent injuries are tracked separately for medical analytics, contract risk assessment, and insurance underwriting purposes.
attributes.references: Sports Medicine Injury Surveillance Standards; CBA

attributes.name: is_wada_reportable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this medical event requires reporting to the World Anti-Doping Agency (WADA), typically when treatment involves substances on the WADA Prohibited List requiring a Therapeutic Use Exemption (TUE). Critical for anti-doping compliance.
attributes.references: WADA World Anti-Doping Code; WADA International Standard for Therapeutic Use Exemptions (ISTUE)

attributes.name: is_workers_comp_claim
attributes.description: Indicates whether a workers' compensation insurance claim has been filed for this injury. Triggers coordination with the insurance and finance teams for claim processing and reserve setting.
attributes.references: State Workers Compensation Laws; CBA Insurance Provisions

attributes.name: medical_staff_notes
attributes.description: Confidential clinical notes from the team's medical staff including athletic trainers, physical therapists, and team physicians documenting daily progress, treatment adjustments, and rehabilitation milestones. Restricted to authorized medical personnel per HIPAA and CBA medical privacy provisions.
attributes.references: HIPAA (where applicable); CBA Medical Privacy Provisions; GDPR Article 9

attributes.name: reported_date
attributes.description: Date on which the injury was formally reported to team medical staff or league operations. May differ from injury_date for delayed-onset conditions or injuries initially unreported. Critical for OSHA recordkeeping compliance windows.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1904.29; CBA Injury Reporting Obligations

attributes.name: rtp_clearance_stage
attributes.description: Current stage in the graduated Return-to-Play (RTP) protocol as defined by league medical standards and CBA. Tracks progression from initial rest through limited activity, non-contact practice, full practice, and final medical clearance. Critical for concussion protocol compliance.
attributes.references: League Concussion Protocol; CBA Medical Provisions; IOC Consensus Statement on Concussion

attributes.name: severity_grade
attributes.description: Clinical severity classification of the injury based on expected time loss and functional impact. 'minor' = <7 days; 'moderate' = 7-28 days; 'severe' = >28 days; 'career_threatening' = potential permanent impact on playing career. Used for insurance valuation, roster planning, and broadcast communications.
attributes.references: UEFA Injury Study Severity Classification; Sports Medicine Consensus Statement

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record from which this injury record was ingested or originated. Supports data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver Layer. Typical sources include SAP SuccessFactors HCM, SportsCode/Hudl performance analytics, or team-specific medical management systems.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard; Databricks Lakehouse Data Lineage

attributes.name: surgery_date
attributes.description: Date on which surgical procedure was performed, if applicable. Null when surgery_required is False. Used as a key milestone in recovery timeline planning and insurance claim documentation.
attributes.references: CBA Medical Provisions; OSHA 29 CFR 1904

attributes.name: surgery_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether surgical intervention is required or has been performed as part of the treatment protocol. Surgical cases typically have significantly longer recovery timelines and higher insurance claim values.
attributes.references: CBA Medical Provisions; Insurance Claim Standards

attributes.name: treating_physician_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the licensed medical professional (team physician, orthopedic surgeon, or specialist) who diagnosed and is managing the athlete's treatment protocol.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1904; Internal Medical Staff Registry

attributes.name: treatment_protocol
attributes.description: Structured description of the prescribed medical treatment plan including surgical intervention, physical therapy regimen, medication management, and rehabilitation milestones as documented by the treating physician. Supports medical staff coordination and insurance documentation.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1904; CBA Medical Treatment Provisions

attributes.name: tue_reference
attributes.description: Reference number for the WADA Therapeutic Use Exemption (TUE) application or approval associated with this injury's treatment protocol. Populated when is_wada_reportable is True and treatment involves a prohibited substance. Required for anti-doping compliance documentation.
attributes.references: WADA International Standard for Therapeutic Use Exemptions (ISTUE); CAS

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this injury record, including status changes, RTP date updates, or treatment protocol revisions. Supports audit trail and data freshness monitoring.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1904; SOX Internal Controls

products.name: draft_selection
products.description: Record of athlete selections made during league drafts (NFL Draft, NBA Draft, MLB Draft, MLS SuperDraft, etc.). Captures draft year, round number, overall pick number, selecting team, original team (if traded), draft class, pre-draft ranking, combine performance scores, and signing slot value per CBA. Tracks compensatory picks, traded picks, and conditional picks. Essential for league governance, salary cap management, and historical analytics.

attributes.name: actual_signing_bonus
attributes.description: The actual signing bonus amount in USD agreed upon in the athlete's rookie contract. May differ from signing_slot_value due to negotiations within CBA-permitted ranges. Used for salary cap accounting and financial reporting.

attributes.name: athlete_college
attributes.description: Name of the college, university, or prior professional club from which the athlete was drafted. Used for draft class analytics, alumni tracking, and broadcast storytelling content.

attributes.name: athlete_nationality
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code representing the athlete's nationality at the time of the draft. Relevant for international player rules, visa requirements, and global broadcast analytics.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; FIFA Nationality Rules; NBA International Player Rules; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: athlete_position
attributes.description: The primary playing position of the athlete at the time of the draft (e.g., QB, WR, PG, SP, ST). Position is sport-specific and drives positional scarcity analytics and roster construction. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: QB|WR|RB|TE|OL|DL|LB|DB|K|P|PG|SG|SF|PF|C|SP|RP|SS|GK|DEF|MID|FWD — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NFL Draft; NBA Draft; MLB Draft; MLS SuperDraft; Internal Athlete Domain

attributes.name: conditional_pick_terms
attributes.description: Free-text description of the conditions governing a conditional pick (e.g., 'Becomes 1st round if team makes playoffs; otherwise 2nd round'). Populated only when is_conditional_pick is True.
attributes.references: NFL CBA; NBA CBA Trade Rules; Internal League Governance

attributes.name: contract_option_years
attributes.description: Number of team option years available beyond the base rookie contract term (e.g., 5th-year option in NFL for 1st-round picks). Null if no option applies under the CBA.
attributes.references: NFL CBA Article 7 Fifth-Year Option; NBA CBA; MLB CBA

attributes.name: contract_years
attributes.description: Number of years in the standard rookie contract associated with this draft selection as defined by the applicable CBA (e.g., 4-year rookie deal in NFL, 2+2 in NBA). Drives roster planning and cap projection.
attributes.references: NFL CBA Article 7; NBA CBA Rookie Scale; MLB CBA; MLS SuperDraft Rules

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this draft selection record was first created in the lakehouse silver layer. Used for data lineage, audit trail, and ETL pipeline monitoring.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance; SOX Section 404 Audit Trail; GDPR Article 5 Data Integrity

attributes.name: draft_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which this specific pick was made during the draft event. Multi-day drafts (e.g., NFL Draft spans 3 days) require day-level precision for scheduling and broadcast.
attributes.references: NFL Draft; NBA Draft; MLB Draft

attributes.name: draft_year
attributes.description: Calendar year in which the draft event took place (e.g., 2024). Used for cohort analysis, salary cap slot assignment per CBA, and historical draft analytics.
attributes.references: NFL CBA; NBA CBA; MLB CBA; MLS SuperDraft Rules

attributes.name: eligibility_year
attributes.description: The year in which the athlete first became eligible for the draft under league rules (e.g., 3 years post-high school for NFL, 1 year post-high school for NBA). Used for eligibility compliance and age-based analytics.
attributes.references: NFL CBA Eligibility Rules; NBA CBA Age Eligibility; MLB Draft Eligibility; WADA Age Verification

attributes.name: is_compensatory_pick
attributes.description: Indicates whether this pick was awarded as a compensatory selection by the league office, typically for losing qualifying free agents. Compensatory picks have specific CBA rules on tradability.
attributes.references: NFL CBA Article 6; NBA CBA; MLB CBA Compensatory Pick Rules

attributes.name: is_conditional_pick
attributes.description: Indicates whether this pick was subject to conditions (e.g., round changes based on player performance or team standings) at the time of the trade agreement.
attributes.references: NFL CBA; NBA CBA Trade Rules

attributes.name: is_traded_pick
attributes.description: Indicates whether this draft pick was acquired through a trade from another team. True when selecting_team_id differs from original_team_id. Critical for trade value analytics and salary cap management.
attributes.references: NFL CBA Trade Rules; NBA CBA; MLB CBA

attributes.name: medical_clearance_status
attributes.description: Medical clearance status resulting from the team's pre-draft physical examination. 'cleared' = fully fit; 'conditional' = cleared with noted conditions; 'not_cleared' = failed physical; 'pending' = exam not yet completed. Impacts signing decision and contract terms.
attributes.references: NFL CBA Medical Examination Rules; NBA CBA; MLB CBA; OSHA Workplace Health Standards

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context about this draft selection, such as trade details, conditional pick resolution notes, or special circumstances noted by league operations staff.
attributes.references: Internal League Governance; NFL League Office; NBA League Office

attributes.name: overall_pick_number
attributes.description: The absolute sequential pick number across all rounds of the draft (e.g., pick 33 is the first pick of round 2 in a 32-team league). Primary ranking metric for draft analytics and historical comparisons.
attributes.references: NFL Draft; NBA Draft; MLB Draft; MLS SuperDraft Official Records

attributes.name: pick_number_in_round
attributes.description: The sequential pick number within the specific round (e.g., pick 3 in round 2). Combined with round_number to identify the pick within its round context.
attributes.references: NFL Draft; NBA Draft; MLB Draft Official Records

attributes.name: pick_type
attributes.description: Classification of the draft pick by its origin. 'standard' = regular draft order pick; 'compensatory' = awarded by league for losing free agents; 'supplemental' = special draft outside normal cycle; 'conditional' = pick contingent on performance conditions; 'traded' = pick acquired via trade.
attributes.references: NFL CBA Article 6; NBA CBA; MLB CBA; MLS SuperDraft Rules

attributes.name: pre_draft_grade
attributes.description: Numerical scouting grade assigned to the athlete prior to the draft on a standardized scale (e.g., 0.00–100.00 or 1.00–8.00 per NFL scouting convention). Reflects overall prospect evaluation by the team's scouting department.
attributes.references: NFL Scouting Convention; NBA Draft Scouting; MLB Scouting Bureau; SportsCode/Hudl Performance Analytics

attributes.name: pre_draft_ranking
attributes.description: The consensus pre-draft ranking of the athlete among all eligible prospects, as published by the league or a recognized scouting service prior to the draft. Used to measure draft value (reach vs. value picks) and scouting accuracy analytics.
attributes.references: NFL Draft Scout Rankings; NBA Draft Express; MLB Pipeline; Internal Scouting Reports

attributes.name: round_number
attributes.description: The round within the draft in which this selection was made (e.g., 1 for first round, 7 for seventh round in NFL Draft). Determines salary slot value per CBA and signing bonus expectations.
attributes.references: NFL CBA Article 7; NBA CBA; MLB CBA

attributes.name: selection_code
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for this draft pick in the format LEAGUE-YEAR-ROUND-PICK (e.g., NFL-2024-R1-P01). Used in league communications, broadcast graphics, and official records.
attributes.references: NFL Draft; NBA Draft; MLB Draft; MLS SuperDraft Official Records

attributes.name: selection_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the draft selection. 'announced' = pick made but contract not yet signed; 'signed' = athlete under contract; 'unsigned' = deadline passed without signing; 'voided' = selection invalidated; 'traded_rights' = negotiating rights traded post-draft; 'forfeited' = pick forfeited due to league penalty.
attributes.references: NFL CBA; NBA CBA; MLB CBA; CAS Arbitration Rules

attributes.name: selection_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the pick was officially announced and recorded during the draft event. Used for broadcast sequencing, official league records, and audit trail.
attributes.references: NFL League Office; NBA League Office; ISO 8601

attributes.name: signed_date
attributes.description: The date on which the athlete officially signed the rookie contract with the selecting team. Null if unsigned. Triggers salary cap activation and roster registration.
attributes.references: NFL CBA; NBA CBA; MLB CBA; SAP SuccessFactors HCM

attributes.name: signing_deadline
attributes.description: The CBA-mandated deadline by which the selected athlete must sign a rookie contract or forfeit draft rights for the current year. Critical for roster and contract management workflows.
attributes.references: NFL CBA; NBA CBA; MLB CBA Signing Deadline Rules

attributes.name: signing_slot_value
attributes.description: The CBA-mandated signing bonus slot value in USD assigned to this pick based on its round and overall pick number. Governs the maximum signing bonus a team may offer without penalty. Critical for salary cap management and EBITDA reporting.
attributes.references: NFL CBA Article 7 Rookie Signing; NBA CBA Rookie Scale; MLB CBA Draft Bonus Pool; SAP S/4HANA FI/CO

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this draft selection record was last modified in the lakehouse silver layer. Tracks status changes (e.g., unsigned to signed), contract updates, and data corrections.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance; SOX Section 404 Audit Trail; GDPR Article 5 Data Integrity

attributes.name: wada_clearance_status
attributes.description: Anti-doping clearance status of the athlete at the time of the draft per World Anti-Doping Agency (WADA) and league anti-doping program requirements. 'cleared' = no violations; 'pending' = under review; 'suspended' = serving ban; 'ineligible' = permanently ineligible.
attributes.references: WADA World Anti-Doping Code; CAS Arbitration; NFL Anti-Doping Policy; MLB Joint Drug Agreement

products.name: eligibility_status
products.description: Authoritative single source of truth for an athlete's current and historical eligibility to compete, encompassing all factors that grant or restrict participation rights. Covers: amateur/professional status, league registration, visa and work permit status, age eligibility, and all disciplinary actions including PED suspensions, conduct violations, game misconduct bans, and CBA disciplinary procedures. Tracks eligibility type, governing body (FIFA, NFL, NBA, WADA, CAS), effective/expiry dates, restriction details, suspension type and length (games, days, indefinite), financial penalties, issuing authority, reinstatement conditions, appeal status and outcomes, and chain of custody to originating doping test or incident. Critical for CBA compliance, international transfer regulations, WADA anti-doping enforcement, broadcast rights clearances, and real-time game-day eligibility verification. Replaces any separate suspension tracking — all disciplinary restrictions are eligibility events.

attributes.name: decision_date

attributes.name: eligibility_reference_number

attributes.name: financial_penalty_amount

attributes.name: game_day_eligible

attributes.name: notes

attributes.name: penalty_currency_code

attributes.name: penalty_paid
attributes.description: Indicates whether the athlete has satisfied the financial penalty associated with this disciplinary eligibility event. True when payment is confirmed; False when outstanding. Null when no financial penalty applies.

attributes.name: registration_date
