attributes.references: NFL/NBA/MLB/NHL/MLS Player Registration Rules; FIFA TMS; CBA Collective Bargaining Agreement

attributes.name: registration_number
attributes.description: Official registration number assigned by the league or governing body confirming the athlete's registration as a professional or amateur competitor. Required for roster submission and game-day eligibility verification.
attributes.references: NFL/NBA/MLB/NHL/MLS Player Registration Rules; FIFA TMS (Transfer Matching System); CBA Collective Bargaining Agreement

attributes.name: reinstatement_conditions
attributes.description: Free-text description of the specific conditions the athlete must satisfy to be reinstated to eligibility (e.g., completion of drug treatment program, payment of fine, community service hours, counselling). Null when no conditions are required.
attributes.references: WADA World Anti-Doping Code Article 10.12; CBA Collective Bargaining Agreement; NFL/NBA Personal Conduct Policy

attributes.name: reinstatement_date
attributes.description: Actual date on which the athlete was formally reinstated to eligible status following completion of a suspension or satisfaction of reinstatement conditions. Null if not yet reinstated.
attributes.references: WADA World Anti-Doping Code Article 10.12; CBA Collective Bargaining Agreement

attributes.name: restriction_scope
attributes.description: Defines the competitive scope of an eligibility restriction — whether the athlete is banned from all competitions globally, only league competitions, only international fixtures, a specific event, or is subject to a training ban.
attributes.references: WADA World Anti-Doping Code Article 10.12.1; FIFA Disciplinary Code; CBA Collective Bargaining Agreement

attributes.name: sample_collection_date
attributes.description: Date on which the biological sample (urine, blood) was collected from the athlete as part of the anti-doping testing process. Establishes chain of custody for WADA adjudication. Null for non-doping eligibility events.
attributes.references: WADA International Standard for Testing and Investigations (ISTI); WADA World Anti-Doping Code

attributes.name: transfer_clearance_status
attributes.description: Status of the international transfer certificate (ITC) or transfer clearance required for athletes moving between clubs or leagues across national associations. Applicable for FIFA-governed sports and international transfers.
attributes.references: FIFA RSTP Article 9 (International Transfer Certificate); FIFA TMS (Transfer Matching System)

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this eligibility status record, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Tracks changes to suspension length, appeal outcomes, reinstatement dates, and other mutable fields.
attributes.references: SOX Sarbanes-Oxley Act; GDPR Article 5; Internal Audit Standards

attributes.name: visa_expiry_date
attributes.description: Expiry date of the athlete's visa or work permit. Triggers compliance alerts when approaching expiry to prevent inadvertent ineligibility due to lapsed immigration documentation.
attributes.references: FIFA RSTP; IOC Eligibility Rules; Immigration Compliance

attributes.name: visa_issuing_country
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the nation that issued the visa or work permit. Used for international transfer compliance and immigration tracking.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; FIFA RSTP; IOC Eligibility Rules

attributes.name: visa_permit_number
attributes.description: Official visa or work permit document number issued by the relevant immigration authority, applicable when eligibility_type is visa_work_permit. Required for international athlete transfers and cross-border competition clearance.
attributes.references: FIFA RSTP Article 9 (International Transfer Certificate); GDPR Article 9 (Special Category Data); CCPA

attributes.name: whereabouts_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the athlete is currently compliant with WADA whereabouts filing requirements under the Registered Testing Pool (RTP). False triggers a whereabouts failure flag that may lead to a doping violation.
attributes.references: WADA International Standard for Testing and Investigations (ISTI) Article 11; WADA World Anti-Doping Code Article 2.4

attributes.name: whereabouts_failure_count
attributes.description: Cumulative count of whereabouts filing failures or missed tests within the rolling 12-month window. Three failures within 12 months constitutes an anti-doping rule violation under WADA Code Article 2.4.
attributes.references: WADA World Anti-Doping Code Article 2.4; WADA International Standard for Testing and Investigations (ISTI)

products.name: nil_agreement
products.description: Unified commercial agreement record for all athlete brand partnerships, endorsements, and Name/Image/Likeness (NIL) deals. Covers both amateur/collegiate NIL agreements (subject to NCAA/conference NIL policies) and professional endorsement contracts (subject to CBA and league sponsor conflict rules). Tracks deal category (NIL-amateur, NIL-collegiate, professional endorsement, appearance, social media, licensing), brand partner, product category, deal value, contract duration, exclusivity scope, usage rights (broadcast, digital, social, in-venue), performance incentives, morality clause terms, disclosure status, and compliance with applicable regulations. Supports athlete commercial valuation, sponsorship conflict-of-interest checks, NIL compliance reporting, and broadcast rights clearances for athlete-branded content.
products.reference: NIL Deal / Name Image Likeness Agreement

attributes.name: agreement_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the agreement, used in correspondence with athletes, agents, brand partners, and compliance bodies. Follows the format NIL-{YEAR}-{SEQUENCE}.
attributes.references: NCAA NIL Policy; CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement) Article on Endorsements

attributes.name: agreement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the NIL or endorsement agreement. Drives compliance reporting, broadcast rights clearance, and commercial valuation workflows.
attributes.references: Internal Contract Lifecycle Management; CBA Compliance

attributes.name: annual_value_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) Deal Value Amount
attributes.description: Annualized value of the agreement used for ARR (Annual Recurring Revenue) reporting, athlete commercial valuation, and financial planning in Workday Adaptive Planning.
attributes.references: Workday Adaptive Planning; SAP S/4HANA FI/CO

attributes.name: appearance_count
attributes.description: Number of personal appearances (events, activations, media days) the athlete is contractually obligated to make for the brand partner over the agreement term.
attributes.references: Standard Sports Endorsement Contract Terms; CBA Appearance Provisions

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current approval state of this specific SKU under the NIL agreement. Tracks the per-SKU approval workflow independently of the master agreement status — a single agreement may have some SKUs approved and others pending review.

attributes.name: auto_renewal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the agreement contains an automatic renewal clause that extends the term unless either party provides notice of non-renewal before the expiration date.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Contract Management; Standard Endorsement Contract Terms

attributes.name: broadcast_usage_rights
attributes.description: Indicates whether the brand partner has rights to use the athlete's name, image, or likeness in broadcast advertising (TV, OTT, RSN). Critical for broadcast rights clearance workflows in Dalet Galaxy.
attributes.references: FCC Broadcast Regulation; DRM (Digital Rights Management) Policy; Dalet Galaxy MAM

attributes.name: cba_compliance_status
attributes.description: Status of the agreement's compliance with the applicable CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement) endorsement and sponsor conflict provisions. Not applicable for amateur/collegiate NIL deals.
attributes.references: CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement) Endorsement Provisions; NFLPA/NBPA/MLBPA Rules

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this NIL agreement record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) Audit Controls; GDPR Article 5 (Accountability); Internal Data Governance

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary values in this agreement (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Supports multi-market global operations.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA FI

attributes.name: deal_category
attributes.description: Classification of the agreement type. NIL-amateur and NIL-collegiate are subject to NCAA/conference NIL policies; professional endorsement and licensing deals are governed by CBA and league sponsor conflict rules.
attributes.references: NCAA NIL Policy (2021); CBA Endorsement Provisions; NFLPA/NBPA/MLBPA Rules

attributes.name: deal_value_amount
attributes.description: Total gross contractual value of the NIL or endorsement agreement in the agreed currency. Represents the full deal value over the contract term before any performance incentives.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Contract Valuation; NCAA NIL Disclosure Requirements

attributes.name: digital_usage_rights
attributes.description: Indicates whether the brand partner has rights to use the athlete's name, image, or likeness in digital advertising (web, OTT streaming, DTC platforms, IPTV).
attributes.references: DRM (Digital Rights Management) Policy; GDPR Article 6; CCPA

attributes.name: disclosure_date
attributes.description: The date on which the NIL agreement was formally disclosed to the applicable governing body (NCAA, conference office, or league). Required for compliance reporting.
attributes.references: NCAA NIL Policy; Conference NIL Disclosure Rules

attributes.name: disclosure_status
attributes.description: Compliance disclosure status of the agreement with applicable governing bodies (NCAA, conference, league). Tracks whether the required disclosure has been filed, is pending, or is overdue.
attributes.references: NCAA NIL Policy; Conference NIL Disclosure Rules; CBA Endorsement Disclosure

attributes.name: dispute_resolution_mechanism
attributes.description: Contractually agreed mechanism for resolving disputes arising from the agreement. CAS arbitration applies to international sports disputes.
attributes.references: CAS (Court of Arbitration for Sport); CBA Grievance Procedures; Standard Contract Terms

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which the NIL or endorsement agreement becomes legally binding and commercially active.
attributes.references: NCAA NIL Policy; CBA; SAP S/4HANA SD Contract Management

attributes.name: exclusivity_scope
attributes.description: Defines the exclusivity terms of the agreement. Category-exclusive prevents the athlete from endorsing competing brands in the same product category. League-exclusive restricts endorsements conflicting with official league sponsors.
attributes.references: CBA Endorsement Exclusivity Provisions; League Sponsor Conflict Rules

attributes.name: exclusivity_territory
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes defining the geographic territory in which exclusivity applies. Supports global multi-market rights management.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1; FIFA International Transfer Regulations; CBA

attributes.name: execution_date
attributes.description: The date on which all parties formally signed and executed the agreement. May differ from the effective date if the agreement is backdated or post-dated.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Contract Management; Internal Legal Operations

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which the NIL or endorsement agreement expires. Null for open-ended agreements. Used for renewal tracking and compliance monitoring.
attributes.references: NCAA NIL Policy; CBA; SAP S/4HANA SD Contract Management

attributes.name: governing_law_country
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the jurisdiction whose laws govern the agreement. Determines applicable privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA) and dispute resolution forums.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1; GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation); CCPA; CAS (Court of Arbitration for Sport)

attributes.name: in_venue_usage_rights
attributes.description: Indicates whether the brand partner has rights to use the athlete's name, image, or likeness in venue signage, jumbotron displays, or in-venue activations.
attributes.references: Venue Operations Policy; League Sponsor Conflict Rules; Archtics

attributes.name: incentive_value_amount
attributes.description: Total potential value of performance-based incentives included in the agreement (e.g., bonuses tied to statistical milestones, award wins, or social media engagement thresholds).
attributes.references: CBA Performance Incentive Provisions; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: internal_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for internal legal, compliance, or commercial team notes regarding the agreement. Not shared externally. Supports deal management and audit workflows.
attributes.references: Internal Legal Operations; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: league_sponsor_conflict_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this agreement has been flagged as potentially conflicting with an official league or team sponsor in the same product category. Triggers a sponsorship conflict-of-interest review.
attributes.references: League Sponsor Conflict Rules; CBA Endorsement Provisions; Salesforce CRM Sponsorship Module

attributes.name: merchandise_usage_rights
attributes.description: Indicates whether the brand partner has rights to use the athlete's name, image, or likeness on licensed merchandise and retail products (SKU-level). Relevant for Shopify Plus merchandise operations.
attributes.references: IP (Intellectual Property) Licensing Standards; Shopify Plus; NCAA NIL Policy

attributes.name: morality_clause_included
attributes.description: Indicates whether the agreement contains a morality clause allowing the brand partner to terminate the deal if the athlete engages in conduct deemed harmful to the brand's reputation.
attributes.references: Standard Sports Endorsement Contract Terms; CBA Conduct Provisions

attributes.name: morality_clause_terms
attributes.description: Textual description of the specific morality clause terms and triggering conditions included in the agreement. Populated only when morality_clause_included is True.
attributes.references: Standard Sports Endorsement Contract Terms; CBA Conduct Provisions

attributes.name: payment_structure
attributes.description: Defines how the deal value is paid to the athlete: as a single lump sum, periodic installments, milestone-triggered payments, royalty-based (percentage of sales), or a hybrid combination.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Payment Terms; CBA Compensation Provisions

attributes.name: product_category
attributes.description: The product or service category of the brand partner's offering covered by this agreement (e.g., athletic footwear, sports nutrition, financial services, automotive, apparel). Used for league sponsor conflict-of-interest checks. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: athletic_footwear|apparel|sports_nutrition|financial_services|automotive|technology|beverage|healthcare|gaming|media — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: League Sponsor Conflict Rules; CBA Endorsement Provisions; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: renewal_notice_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days prior to expiration by which either party must provide written notice of non-renewal. Relevant when auto_renewal_flag is True.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Contract Management; Standard Endorsement Contract Terms

attributes.name: royalty_rate
attributes.description: Royalty percentage rate applied to brand partner net sales for royalty-based or hybrid payment structures. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0500 = 5%). Null for non-royalty payment structures.
attributes.references: IP (Intellectual Property) Licensing Standards; SAP S/4HANA SD Royalty Management

attributes.name: royalty_rate_override
attributes.description: Per-SKU royalty rate expressed as a decimal fraction that overrides the master agreement's deal value terms for this specific SKU. Enables differentiated royalty structures within a single NIL deal (e.g., higher rate for autographed memorabilia vs. standard apparel).
attributes.references: ISO standard royalty rate decimal format; aligns with sku_catalog.royalty_rate field convention

attributes.name: social_media_post_count
attributes.description: Number of sponsored social media posts the athlete is contractually obligated to publish for the brand partner over the agreement term. Relevant for NCAA NIL social media deal tracking.
attributes.references: NCAA NIL Policy; Adobe Experience Platform Fan Engagement

attributes.name: social_media_usage_rights
attributes.description: Indicates whether the brand partner has rights to use the athlete's name, image, or likeness in social media campaigns. Relevant for NCAA NIL social media deal compliance.
attributes.references: NCAA NIL Policy; GDPR Article 6; CCPA; Adobe Experience Platform

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: The date on which the agreement was early-terminated by either party. Null if the agreement ran to its natural expiration. Distinct from expiration_date which represents the scheduled end.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Contract Termination; CBA Termination Provisions

attributes.name: termination_reason
attributes.description: Reason code for early termination of the agreement. Populated only when termination_date is set. Supports compliance reporting and legal dispute tracking. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: mutual_agreement|morality_clause|breach_of_contract|athlete_retirement|league_suspension|brand_withdrawal|regulatory_violation — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CBA Termination Provisions; NCAA NIL Policy; Internal Legal Operations

attributes.name: territory_restriction
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes defining the geographic scope for this specific SKU authorization. May be narrower than the master agreement's exclusivity_territory — for example, a jersey SKU may only be authorized for US and CAN markets even if the master deal covers global rights.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this NIL agreement record was last modified. Used for change tracking, audit trail, and incremental data pipeline processing in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) Audit Controls; GDPR Article 5 (Accountability); Internal Data Governance

attributes.name: usage_rights_scope
attributes.description: Defines which specific usage rights (broadcast, digital, social, in-venue, merchandise) apply to this SKU under this NIL agreement. May be a subset of the master agreement's usage rights flags, allowing per-SKU restriction of rights.
attributes.references: Derived from nil_agreement usage rights boolean fields scoped to this specific SKU

attributes.name: wada_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the brand partner's product category has been reviewed for WADA compliance (e.g., sports nutrition or supplement brands must not promote PED-adjacent products). Relevant for anti-doping regulatory adherence.
attributes.references: WADA (World Anti-Doping Agency) Prohibited List; CAS (Court of Arbitration for Sport)

attributes.name: commission_basis

attributes.name: commission_rate_pct
attributes.description: The contractually agreed commission rate (expressed as a decimal fraction, e.g., 0.0300 = 3%) that the agent earns on the athlete's compensation under this representation agreement. Subject to CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement) maximum commission caps per league.

attributes.name: compliance_review_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent compliance review of this agent-athlete relationship, verifying that the agent's certification is current, commission rates comply with CBA caps, and no conflicts of interest exist.

attributes.name: compliance_review_outcome
attributes.description: Result of the most recent compliance review of this agent-athlete relationship. Passed indicates all requirements met; failed indicates one or more violations identified; pending indicates review in progress; waived indicates review exempted by league authority.
attributes.references: NFLPA Regulations Governing Contract Advisors; CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement); SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act)

attributes.name: conflict_of_interest_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a potential or confirmed conflict of interest has been identified for this agent-athlete relationship (e.g., agent also represents opposing team management, or represents multiple athletes competing for the same roster position). Triggers compliance review workflow.
attributes.references: NFLPA Regulations Governing Contract Advisors; NBPA Agent Regulations; CAS (Court of Arbitration for Sport)

attributes.name: conflict_of_interest_notes
attributes.description: Free-text description of the nature of any identified conflict of interest associated with this agent-athlete relationship. Populated only when conflict_of_interest_flag is True. Used by compliance and legal teams.
attributes.references: NFLPA Regulations Governing Contract Advisors; CAS (Court of Arbitration for Sport); SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act)

attributes.name: contract_negotiation_authority
attributes.description: Indicates whether this agent is authorized to negotiate the athlete's playing contract (salary, bonuses, incentives) with team management on the athlete's behalf. Core authority granted under standard player representation agreements.
attributes.references: NFLPA Regulations Governing Contract Advisors; NBPA Agent Regulations; MLBPA Regulations; CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this agent-athlete relationship record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) — Audit Trail; GDPR Article 5 — Data Integrity and Accountability

attributes.name: crm_record_reference
attributes.description: The unique identifier of the corresponding agent-athlete relationship record in Salesforce CRM, used for system-of-record traceability and bi-directional synchronization between the lakehouse and the CRM platform.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Relationship Record; Internal Data Integration Standard

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which the agent-athlete representation relationship becomes legally binding and operative. Aligns with the signed representation agreement commencement date.
attributes.references: NFLPA Regulations Governing Contract Advisors; CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement)

attributes.name: endorsement_representation
attributes.description: Indicates whether this agent relationship includes authority to negotiate commercial endorsement deals on behalf of the athlete, separate from the athlete's playing contract.
attributes.references: NFLPA Regulations Governing Contract Advisors; NBPA Agent Regulations; CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement)

attributes.name: is_primary_agent
attributes.description: Indicates whether this agent is the athlete's primary (lead) representative when the athlete has multiple agents covering different representation scopes. Only one agent relationship per athlete should be flagged as primary at any given time.
attributes.references: NFLPA Regulations Governing Contract Advisors; NBPA Agent Regulations

attributes.name: league_approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the relevant league office or players association formally approved the agent-athlete representation agreement, authorizing the agent to act on the athlete's behalf.
attributes.references: NFL Governance Office; NBA League Office; MLB Commissioner's Office; NHL Board of Governors

attributes.name: league_filing_date
attributes.description: The date on which the agent-athlete representation agreement was formally filed with the relevant league office or players association for approval and registration.
attributes.references: NFL Governance Office; NBA League Office; MLB Commissioner's Office; NHL Board of Governors

attributes.name: league_filing_status
attributes.description: Status of the agent relationship filing with the relevant league office or players association. Leagues require formal notification and approval of agent-athlete representation agreements before the agent may negotiate on the athlete's behalf.
attributes.references: NFL (National Football League) Governance Office; NBA (National Basketball Association) League Office; MLB (Major League Baseball) Commissioner's Office; NHL (National Hockey League) Board of Governors

attributes.name: legal_representation
attributes.description: Indicates whether this relationship includes legal representation authority (e.g., grievance filings, arbitration proceedings, disciplinary hearings). May require the agent to also be a licensed attorney depending on jurisdiction.
attributes.references: CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement); CAS (Court of Arbitration for Sport); WADA (World Anti-Doping Agency) Hearing Procedures

attributes.name: nil_representation
attributes.description: Indicates whether this agent relationship includes authority to negotiate NIL (Name Image and Likeness) deals on behalf of the athlete. NIL representation may be scoped separately from contract negotiation authority.
attributes.references: NIL (Name Image and Likeness) Policy; NCAA NIL Rules; CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement)

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for capturing additional context, special terms, or operational notes related to this agent-athlete representation relationship that are not captured in structured fields. Used by talent management and legal teams.

attributes.name: representation_scope

attributes.description: The timestamp when this agent-athlete relationship record was most recently modified, in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset. Used for change tracking, incremental data loads, and audit compliance.

Tracks suspension type (PED, conduct, game misconduct, league discipline), issuing authority, suspension length (games, days, indefinite), effective start and end dates, appeal status, reinstatement conditions, and financial penalties. Distinct from injury-related roster designations — suspensions are disciplinary actions with legal and compliance implications.

attributes.name: announcement_date
attributes.description: Date on which the suspension was publicly announced by the league or issuing authority. Null if the suspension has not been publicly announced or is confidential.
attributes.references: WADA Code Article 14.3; NFL Personal Conduct Policy; NBA Anti-Drug Program

attributes.name: appeal_body
attributes.description: The body or tribunal that is hearing or heard the appeal (e.g., CAS (Court of Arbitration for Sport), WADA, League Appeals Panel, Arbitration, Federal Court). Null or 'None' if no appeal was filed.
attributes.references: CAS Procedural Rules; WADA Code Article 13; CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement)

attributes.name: appeal_filed_date
attributes.description: Date on which the athlete or their representative formally filed an appeal against the suspension ruling. Null if no appeal was filed.
attributes.references: WADA Code Article 13; CAS Procedural Rules; CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement) Grievance Procedures

attributes.name: appeal_resolution_date
attributes.description: Date on which the appeal was formally resolved by the appellate body (e.g., CAS, league appeals panel). Null if the appeal is still pending or no appeal was filed.
attributes.references: WADA Code Article 13; CAS Procedural Rules; CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement) Grievance Procedures

attributes.name: appeal_status
attributes.description: Current status of any appeal filed by the athlete or their representative against the suspension ruling. 'Not Appealed' means no appeal was filed; 'Appeal Filed' means an appeal has been submitted; 'Appeal Pending' means the appeal is under review; 'Appeal Upheld' means the suspension was overturned or reduced; 'Appeal Denied' means the original ruling was confirmed; 'Appeal Withdrawn' means the athlete withdrew the appeal.
attributes.references: WADA Code Article 13; CAS Procedural Rules; CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement) Grievance Procedures; FIFA Disciplinary Code

attributes.name: broadcast_restriction_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the suspension includes restrictions on the athlete's appearance in broadcast content, media, or promotional materials during the suspension period. Relevant for broadcast rights compliance and content production scheduling.
attributes.references: FCC Broadcast Regulations; Dalet Galaxy Media Asset Management; CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement)

attributes.name: case_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known disciplinary case number or docket identifier assigned by the issuing authority (e.g., league office, WADA, CAS). Used for cross-referencing with legal and compliance systems.
attributes.references: WADA Code Article 10; CAS Procedural Rules; NFL Personal Conduct Policy; NBA Anti-Drug Program

attributes.name: competition_scope
attributes.description: Defines the scope of competitions from which the athlete is suspended. Some suspensions apply to all competitions (including international), while others are limited to specific competition types (e.g., league games only, international fixtures only).
attributes.references: FIFA Disciplinary Code; WADA Code Article 10.12; CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this suspension record was first created in the system. Aligns with the TRANSACTION_HEADER RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED category. Used for data lineage and audit trail.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) Internal Controls; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity); Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which the suspension is scheduled to end and the athlete becomes eligible for reinstatement. Null for indefinite suspensions. Aligns with the TRANSACTION_HEADER EFFECTIVE_UNTIL category.
attributes.references: CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement); WADA Code Article 10; FIFA Disciplinary Code

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date on which the suspension officially begins and the athlete is prohibited from participating in league activities. Aligns with the TRANSACTION_HEADER EFFECTIVE_FROM category.
attributes.references: CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement); WADA Code Article 10.11; FIFA Disciplinary Code

attributes.name: financial_penalty_amount
attributes.description: Monetary fine or financial penalty imposed on the athlete as part of the disciplinary action, expressed in the applicable currency. Null if no financial penalty was assessed. Tracked for compliance and payroll deduction purposes.
attributes.references: CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement); NFL Personal Conduct Policy; NBA Uniform Player Contract; SAP S/4HANA FI (Financial Accounting)

attributes.name: hearing_date
attributes.description: Date on which the formal disciplinary hearing was conducted before the suspension was issued. Null if no formal hearing was held (e.g., automatic suspensions for certain violations).
attributes.references: CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement) Disciplinary Procedures; FIFA Disciplinary Code; WADA Code Article 8

attributes.name: hearing_officer
attributes.description: Name or title of the independent arbitrator, hearing officer, or disciplinary panel chair who presided over the disciplinary hearing. Null if no formal hearing was held.
attributes.references: CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement) Disciplinary Procedures; WADA Code Article 8; CAS Procedural Rules

attributes.name: incident_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the incident or conduct that led to the suspension. Contains factual summary of the violation as documented by the issuing authority. Classified confidential due to sensitive legal and disciplinary nature.
attributes.references: NFL Personal Conduct Policy; NBA Anti-Drug Program; CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement); WADA Code

attributes.name: is_indefinite
attributes.description: Indicates whether the suspension is indefinite with no fixed end date. True when the athlete is banned until further review or reinstatement conditions are met. When True, effective_end_date will be null.
attributes.references: WADA Code Article 10.7; FIFA Disciplinary Code; NFL Personal Conduct Policy

attributes.name: is_lifetime_ban
attributes.description: Indicates whether the suspension constitutes a permanent lifetime ban from the sport or league. Typically applied for second PED (Performance Enhancing Drug) violations under WADA or severe integrity violations such as match fixing.
attributes.references: WADA Code Article 10.7.1; FIFA Disciplinary Code Article 22; IOC Anti-Doping Rules

attributes.name: is_public_announcement
attributes.description: Indicates whether the suspension has been publicly announced by the league or issuing authority. Some suspensions (particularly early-stage PED violations) may be kept confidential until the appeals process is exhausted.
attributes.references: WADA Code Article 14.3; NFL Personal Conduct Policy; NBA Anti-Drug Program; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: is_suspension_stayed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the suspension has been temporarily stayed (paused) pending the outcome of an appeal. When True, the athlete may continue to participate while the appeal is resolved.
attributes.references: WADA Code Article 13.2.2; CAS Procedural Rules; CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement) Grievance Procedures

attributes.name: issued_date
attributes.description: The date on which the suspension decision was formally issued or announced by the issuing authority. Represents the principal real-world business event timestamp (BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP category).
attributes.references: NFL Personal Conduct Policy; NBA Anti-Drug Program; WADA Code; CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement)

attributes.name: issuing_authority
attributes.description: The body or authority that issued the suspension (e.g., League Office, WADA, CAS (Court of Arbitration for Sport), Team, Referee Committee, Integrity Unit, Arbitration Panel). Determines the legal and procedural framework governing the suspension. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: league_office|wada|cas|team|referee_committee|integrity_unit|arbitration_panel — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: WADA Code; CAS Procedural Rules; FIFA Disciplinary Code; NFL/NBA/MLB/NHL/MLS Governance Policies

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this suspension record was most recently modified. Aligns with the TRANSACTION_HEADER RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED category. Tracks changes to appeal status, reinstatement, or penalty modifications.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) Internal Controls; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity); Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: nil_agreement_impact
attributes.description: Status of the athlete's NIL (Name, Image, and Likeness) agreements during the suspension period. Indicates whether NIL deals are suspended, terminated by sponsors, unaffected, or under review. Critical for commercial and sponsorship compliance tracking.
attributes.references: NIL (Name Image and Likeness) Regulations; NCAA NIL Policy; CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement); Salesforce CRM Sponsorship Records

attributes.name: penalty_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the financial penalty amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Required when financial_penalty_amount is populated.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA FI (Financial Accounting)

attributes.name: prior_violation_count
attributes.description: Number of prior disciplinary violations of the same type on the athlete's record at the time this suspension was issued. Used to determine escalating penalty tiers under WADA and league policies (e.g., first offense vs. second offense).
attributes.references: WADA Code Article 10.7; CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement); NFL Personal Conduct Policy

attributes.name: prohibited_substance_code
attributes.description: WADA-assigned code or name of the prohibited substance detected in the anti-doping violation (e.g., 'S1.1 — Testosterone', 'S6.A — Stimulants'). Null for non-PED (Performance Enhancing Drug) suspensions. Classified confidential due to sensitive health-adjacent nature.
attributes.references: WADA Prohibited List (annually updated); WADA Code Article 2.1; ISO 20121 Event Sustainability

attributes.name: reinstatement_conditions
attributes.description: Narrative description of any conditions the athlete must satisfy before being reinstated to active roster eligibility (e.g., completion of a treatment program, payment of fines, passing a drug test, counseling completion). Null if no conditions beyond serving the suspension period apply.
attributes.references: WADA Code Article 10.11; NFL Personal Conduct Policy; NBA Anti-Drug Program; CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement)

attributes.name: reinstatement_date
attributes.description: The actual date on which the athlete was formally reinstated to active eligibility following completion of the suspension and any required reinstatement conditions. Null if the athlete has not yet been reinstated.
attributes.references: WADA Code Article 10.11; CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement); NFL Personal Conduct Policy

attributes.name: salary_withheld_amount
attributes.description: Total salary amount withheld from the athlete during the suspension period as a consequence of the disciplinary action, expressed in the applicable currency. Distinct from financial_penalty_amount which is a separate fine. Tracked for payroll and CBA compliance.
attributes.references: CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement); SAP S/4HANA FI/CO (Financial Accounting and Controlling); SAP SuccessFactors Payroll

attributes.name: sample_collection_date
attributes.description: Date on which the biological sample (urine, blood) was collected for anti-doping testing that led to the adverse analytical finding. Null for non-PED suspensions. Classified confidential due to health-adjacent nature.
attributes.references: WADA Code Article 5; WADA International Standard for Testing and Investigations (ISTI)

attributes.name: source_system_reference
attributes.description: Identifier or reference code from the originating operational system of record where this suspension was first captured (e.g., SAP SuccessFactors case ID, Salesforce CRM case number). Enables traceability back to the source system for reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors HCM; Salesforce CRM; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: suspension_length_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days the athlete is suspended, as specified in the suspension ruling. Null if the suspension is measured in games or is indefinite. Common in WADA anti-doping cases and FIFA disciplinary proceedings.
attributes.references: WADA Code Article 10; FIFA Disciplinary Code; CAS Procedural Rules

attributes.name: suspension_length_games
attributes.description: Number of games the athlete is suspended from participating in, as specified in the suspension ruling. Null if the suspension is measured in days or is indefinite. Used for game-based suspensions common in NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL.
attributes.references: CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement); NFL Personal Conduct Policy; NBA Anti-Drug Program; MLB Joint Drug Prevention and Treatment Program

attributes.name: suspension_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the suspension record. 'Active' means the athlete is currently serving the suspension; 'Served' means the suspension period has been completed; 'Appealed' means the athlete has filed an appeal and the suspension may be stayed; 'Overturned' means the suspension was reversed on appeal; 'Reduced' means the original penalty was reduced; 'Pending' means the suspension has been issued but not yet commenced.
attributes.references: WADA Code Article 13; CAS Procedural Rules; CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement) Grievance Procedures

attributes.name: suspension_type
attributes.description: Classification of the disciplinary action by the nature of the violation. PED (Performance Enhancing Drug) violations are governed by WADA; conduct violations relate to personal conduct policies; game misconduct covers in-game rule infractions; league discipline covers CBA-governed actions; match fixing and financial breach are integrity-related. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ped_violation|conduct_violation|game_misconduct|league_discipline|match_fixing|financial_breach|eligibility_violation|anti-doping — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: WADA Code; CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement); FIFA Disciplinary Code; NFL Personal Conduct Policy; NBA Anti-Drug Program

attributes.name: testing_authority
attributes.description: Name of the anti-doping organization (ADO) or testing authority that conducted the drug test resulting in the violation (e.g., USADA, UKAD, WADA, NADO). Null for non-PED suspensions.
attributes.references: WADA Code Article 5; WADA International Standard for Testing and Investigations (ISTI)

attributes.name: union_grievance_number
attributes.description: The formal grievance or arbitration case number filed by the players' union (e.g., NFLPA, NBPA, MLBPA) on behalf of the athlete under the CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement) grievance procedures. Null if no union grievance was filed.
attributes.references: CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement) Grievance Procedures; NFLPA; NBPA; MLBPA; NHLPA

attributes.name: violation_category
attributes.description: Specific sub-category or rule code of the violation that triggered the suspension (e.g., 'Prohibited Substance — S1 Anabolic Agents', 'Domestic Violence', 'Gambling', 'Unsportsmanlike Conduct'). Provides granular classification beyond suspension_type for compliance reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: promote to reference product given large enumeration across leagues]
attributes.references: WADA Prohibited List; NFL Personal Conduct Policy; NBA Uniform Player Contract; CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement); FIFA Disciplinary Code

attributes.references: NFL/NBA/NHL/MLB CBA Salary Cap Accounting Rules; Workday Adaptive Planning

attributes.name: cap_hold_amount
attributes.description: The cap space reserved for a restricted free agent (RFA) or unsigned draft pick while the team retains their rights. Prevents teams from circumventing the cap by leaving players unsigned. Amount is set by league rules based on prior salary or draft position.
attributes.references: CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement) Restricted Free Agent (RFA) Cap Hold Rules

attributes.name: cap_relief
attributes.description: The reduction in cap hit achieved through a contract restructure, typically by converting base salary into a signing bonus that is then prorated. Represents the net cap space freed in the current year as a result of the restructure.
attributes.references: CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement) Contract Restructure Rules

attributes.name: cap_year
attributes.description: The league-defined fiscal/competitive year (e.g., 2024) to which this salary cap entry applies. Cap years may not align with calendar years depending on the league's CBA definition.
attributes.references: CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement) Cap Year Definition

attributes.name: cap_year_end_date
attributes.description: The last date of the league-defined cap year period during which this entry is active. Marks the boundary for cap accounting obligations in this record.
attributes.references: CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement) Cap Year Definition

attributes.name: cap_year_start_date
attributes.description: The first date of the league-defined cap year period during which this entry is active. Used for proration calculations and cap forecasting in Workday Adaptive Planning.
attributes.references: CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement) Cap Year Definition

attributes.name: contract_total_years
attributes.description: Total number of years in the underlying contract. Used as the denominator for signing bonus proration calculations across cap years.
attributes.references: CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement) Signing Bonus Proration Rules

attributes.name: contract_year_number
attributes.description: The sequential year number within the multi-year contract that this cap entry represents (e.g., Year 1, Year 2, Year 3 of a 5-year deal). Used to track proration schedules and contract progression.
attributes.references: CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement) Contract Year Definitions

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this salary cap entry record was first created in the system. Audit trail field supporting SOX financial controls and data lineage in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) Internal Controls; ISO 20121 Event Sustainability Management

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts in this cap entry record (e.g., USD for NFL/NBA/MLB/NHL, EUR for UEFA clubs, GBP for Premier League). Supports multi-league and international operations.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; FIFA Financial Regulations

attributes.name: dead_cap_value
attributes.description: The remaining prorated bonus and other accelerated cap charges that count against the team's cap after an athlete is released, traded, or their contract is terminated. Represents the cap penalty for parting ways with the athlete before contract expiry.
attributes.references: NFL/NBA/NHL/MLB CBA Dead Cap / Accelerated Cap Rules

attributes.name: entry_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of this salary cap entry. 'active' = currently counting against cap; 'restructured' = contract has been restructured, new entry supersedes; 'voided' = contract voided/nullified; 'dead_cap' = player released but cap charge remains; 'cap_hold' = restricted free agent tender hold; 'historical' = prior year closed record.
attributes.references: NFL/NBA/NHL/MLB CBA Salary Cap Accounting Rules

attributes.name: entry_type
attributes.description: Classification of the cap entry by contract category per CBA rules. Determines applicable cap calculation methodology. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: standard|rookie_scale|veteran_minimum|franchise_tag|transition_tag|cap_hold|two_way|10_day|rest_of_season — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement) Contract Classification Rules

attributes.name: incentive_earned_prior_year
attributes.business_glossary_term: Incentive Earned in Prior Year Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the athlete earned incentives in the prior cap year that were classified as 'unlikely' at the time, triggering a cap charge carryover into this cap year. True = prior year unlikely incentive was earned and creates a charge in this year.
attributes.references: CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement) Incentive Carryover Rules

attributes.name: is_cap_hold
attributes.description: Indicates whether this entry is a cap hold for a restricted free agent or unsigned draft pick rather than an active contract. True = cap hold; False = active contract cap entry.
attributes.references: CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement) Restricted Free Agent (RFA) Cap Hold Rules

attributes.name: is_dead_cap
attributes.description: Indicates whether this entry represents a dead cap charge (athlete has been released or traded but remaining prorated bonuses still count against the team's cap). True = athlete is no longer on roster but cap charge persists.
attributes.references: NFL/NBA/NHL/MLB CBA Dead Cap / Accelerated Cap Rules

attributes.name: is_restructured
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cap entry reflects a contract restructure that converted base salary to prorated bonus, generating cap relief in the current year. True = restructure has been applied to this entry.
attributes.references: CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement) Contract Restructure Rules

attributes.name: league_reported_date
attributes.description: The date on which this cap entry was officially reported to and acknowledged by the league office. Required for compliance with league transaction reporting deadlines under CBA rules.
attributes.references: NFL/NBA/NHL/MLB CBA Transaction Reporting Requirements; League Office Compliance

attributes.name: likely_incentive_amount
attributes.description: Total value of performance incentives classified as 'likely to be earned' per CBA rules based on the athlete's prior year performance. Likely incentives count against the current cap year. Per CBA definition, an incentive is 'likely' if the athlete achieved the same threshold in the prior season.
attributes.references: CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement) Incentive Classification Rules; NFL/NBA/NHL/MLB League Office

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for cap accountants and team finance staff to record contextual information about this entry, such as restructure rationale, league clarification notes, or special CBA provisions applied.
attributes.references: Internal Cap Accounting Operations

attributes.name: option_bonus_prorated
attributes.description: The prorated portion of any option bonus (e.g., option year exercise bonus, void year bonus) allocated to this cap year. Option bonuses are prorated over remaining contract years when exercised.
attributes.references: CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement) Option Bonus Proration Rules

attributes.name: per_game_roster_bonus
attributes.description: Bonus amount earned on a per-game-active basis for each game the athlete is on the active roster. Common in NFL contracts. Total potential value for the cap year is tracked here for cap forecasting purposes.
attributes.references: NFL CBA Per-Game Roster Bonus Rules

attributes.name: prior_year_incentive_carryover
attributes.description: The dollar amount of incentives earned in the prior cap year (classified as 'unlikely') that carry over as an additional cap charge in this cap year per CBA rules. Distinct from current-year incentive amounts.
attributes.references: CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement) Incentive Carryover Rules; NFL/NBA/NHL/MLB League Office

attributes.name: restructure_date
attributes.description: The date on which the contract restructure was executed, converting base salary to prorated signing bonus and generating cap relief. Null if no restructure has occurred for this entry.
attributes.references: CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement) Contract Restructure Rules

attributes.name: roster_bonus
attributes.description: Bonus amount payable to the athlete for being on the active roster on a specified date in this cap year. Counts fully against the cap in the year it is earned per CBA rules.
attributes.references: CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement) Roster Bonus Rules

attributes.name: signing_bonus_prorated
attributes.description: The portion of the total signing bonus allocated to this specific cap year after proration across the contract length per CBA rules. This amount is included in the cap hit calculation.
attributes.references: CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement) Signing Bonus Proration Rules; NFL/NBA/NHL/MLB League Office

attributes.name: signing_bonus_total
attributes.description: Total signing bonus paid to the athlete at contract execution. This amount is prorated across the contract years for cap purposes per CBA rules. Stored as the full contract-level total for reference.
attributes.references: CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement) Signing Bonus Proration Rules

attributes.name: unlikely_incentive_amount
attributes.description: Total value of performance incentives classified as 'unlikely to be earned' per CBA rules. Unlikely incentives do NOT count against the current cap year but create a cap charge in the following year if earned. Per CBA definition, an incentive is 'unlikely' if the athlete did NOT achieve the threshold in the prior season.
attributes.references: CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement) Incentive Classification Rules; NFL/NBA/NHL/MLB League Office

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this salary cap entry record was last modified. Tracks restructures, corrections, and status changes for audit trail and data lineage purposes in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) Internal Controls; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer Audit Standards

attributes.name: void_year_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cap year is a void year — a contract year that automatically voids, causing all remaining prorated bonuses to accelerate into the final non-void year. Common NFL cap management technique. True = this is a void year.
attributes.references: NFL CBA Void Year / Fake Year Cap Rules

attributes.name: workday_plan_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier linking this cap entry to the corresponding cap forecast scenario in Workday Adaptive Planning. Enables reconciliation between actual cap accounting records and forward-looking cap projections.
attributes.references: Workday Adaptive Planning Financial Planning and Analysis (FP&A)

attributes.name: workout_bonus
attributes.description: Bonus amount payable to the athlete for attending and completing mandatory off-season workout programs. Cap treatment varies by league CBA — may be fully or partially counted.
attributes.references: CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement) Workout Bonus Rules

products.name: free_agency_status
products.description: Tracks an athlete's free agency eligibility, classification, and market activity during free agency periods. Captures free agency type (unrestricted/UFA, restricted/RFA, exclusive rights/ERFA, franchise tag, transition tag), qualifying offer amount, tender amount, original team right of first refusal flag, free agency open date, signing deadline, and current negotiation status. Supports roster planning, salary cap management, and broadcast transaction reporting.
products.reference: Free Agency / Player Free Agency Status

attributes.name: free_agency_status_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the free agency status record. Primary key for the athlete.free_agency_status data product in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: compensatory_draft_pick_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to league.draft_pick. Business justification: When a franchise loses a free agent, compensatory draft picks are awarded. free_agency_status has draft_pick_compensation_flag but no FK to the actual pick awarded. Linking to the specific draft_pick
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: eligibility_status_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to athlete.eligibility_status. Business justification: Free agency eligibility is directly governed by an athlete's eligibility status record. The eligibility_status product tracks transfer clearance, visa status, league registration, and competition elig
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: league_id
attributes.description: Reference to the professional league governing this free agency period (e.g., NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, MLS). Determines applicable Collective Bargaining Agreement (CBA) rules.
attributes.references: NFL Governance Office; NBA League Office; MLB Commissioner's Office; NHL Board of Governors; MLS

attributes.name: primary_free_athlete_athlete_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the athlete whose free agency status is being tracked. Links to the athlete master record.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors HCM — Worker Object

attributes.name: primary_free_athlete_contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the athlete's most recently expired or expiring contract that triggered this free agency status record.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors HCM — Compensation Object; CBA

attributes.name: primary_free_franchise_id
attributes.description: Reference to the team that last held the athlete's rights prior to free agency. Used to determine right of first refusal and tender obligations.
attributes.references: CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement) — Player Rights Provisions

attributes.name: regulatory_filing_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_filing. Business justification: Free agency transactions require regulatory filings — tender filings, offer sheet submissions, ROFR exercise notices, and franchise tag designations are all submitted to league offices. free_agency_st
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: season_id
attributes.description: Reference to the league season associated with this free agency period. Determines the applicable salary cap year and CBA cycle.
attributes.references: League Competition Governance Standards

attributes.name: tertiary_free_signing_team_franchise_id
attributes.description: Reference to the team that ultimately signed the athlete upon conclusion of free agency. Null until negotiation_status reaches 'signed'. Used for transaction reporting and broadcast ticker updates.
attributes.references: League Transaction Reporting; Broadcast and Media Rights Distribution

attributes.name: transaction_window_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to league.transaction_window. Business justification: Free agency signings must occur within valid transaction windows. Linking free_agency_status to the applicable transaction_window enables signing deadline enforcement, window compliance validation, an
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: accrued_seasons
attributes.description: The number of CBA-qualifying seasons the athlete has accrued with the league. Determines free agency eligibility tier (e.g., UFA vs RFA vs ERFA) and vesting rights. Calculated per CBA accrued season definition.
attributes.references: CBA — Accrued Seasons Definition; NFL Governance Office; MLB Commissioner's Office

attributes.name: arbitration_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the athlete is eligible for salary arbitration in lieu of free agency, based on years of service and CBA thresholds. Particularly relevant in MLB where Super Two eligibility applies.
attributes.references: CBA — Salary Arbitration Provisions; MLB Commissioner's Office

attributes.name: arbitration_filing_deadline
attributes.description: The deadline by which the athlete or team must file for salary arbitration. Null when arbitration_eligible_flag is False. Governed by the applicable CBA calendar.
attributes.references: CBA — Arbitration Filing Procedures; MLB Commissioner's Office

attributes.name: cap_hold_amount
attributes.description: The salary cap charge held against the original team's cap space while the athlete remains unsigned as a free agent. Calculated per CBA formula based on qualifying offer or prior contract value. Expressed in USD. Relevant for roster and cap planning.
attributes.references: CBA — Salary Cap Hold Provisions; NFL Governance Office; NBA League Office; SAP S/4HANA FI/CO

attributes.name: cap_hold_released_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the original team has formally renounced the athlete's rights, releasing the associated salary cap hold. Once renounced, the athlete becomes an unrestricted free agent and the team loses all rights.
attributes.references: CBA — Cap Hold Renouncement Provisions; NBA League Office; NFL Governance Office

attributes.name: compensation_tier
attributes.description: The draft pick compensation tier assigned to this free agent based on prior contract value and performance metrics. Determines the round and value of compensatory draft picks owed. None: no compensation required; Tier 1-3: graduated compensation levels; Qualifying: qualifying offer compensation applies.
attributes.references: CBA — Compensatory Pick Formula; NFL Governance Office; MLB Commissioner's Office

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code applicable to all monetary amounts on this record (qualifying offer, tender, franchise tag, transition tag amounts). Defaults to USD for North American leagues.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 — Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA FI

attributes.name: draft_pick_compensation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the signing team is required to provide draft pick compensation to the original team upon signing this athlete. Applicable in leagues with compensatory pick systems (e.g., NFL compensatory picks, MLB Type A/B free agents).
attributes.references: CBA — Compensatory Draft Pick Provisions; NFL Governance Office; MLB Commissioner's Office

attributes.name: fa_open_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the athlete's free agency period officially opens and the athlete becomes eligible to negotiate with other teams. Governed by the applicable CBA calendar.
attributes.references: CBA — Free Agency Calendar; League Operations

attributes.name: fa_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for this free agency transaction, formatted as FA-{LEAGUE}-{YEAR}-{SEQUENCE}. Used in league transaction reporting, broadcast transaction tickers, and CBA compliance filings.
attributes.references: League Transaction Reporting Standards; CBA

attributes.name: fa_type
attributes.description: Classification of the athlete's free agency designation under the applicable CBA. Unrestricted Free Agent (UFA) may sign with any team; Restricted Free Agent (RFA) allows original team right of first refusal; Exclusive Rights Free Agent (ERFA) may only negotiate with original team; Franchise Tag and Transition Tag are one-year designations applied by the original team; Waiver indicates release via waiver wire. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: unrestricted|restricted|exclusive_rights|franchise_tag|transition_tag|waiver — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement) — Free Agency Article; NFL Governance Office; NBA League Office; MLB Commissioner's Office

attributes.name: franchise_tag_amount
attributes.description: The one-year salary value assigned to the athlete under a franchise tag designation. Calculated as the average of the top-N salaries at the athlete's position or a percentage of the salary cap, per CBA formula. Expressed in USD.
attributes.references: CBA — Franchise Tag Article; NFL Governance Office; SAP S/4HANA FI/CO

attributes.name: injury_reserve_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the athlete was on the injured reserve list at the time of contract expiration. May affect free agency timeline, qualifying offer calculations, and salary cap treatment under CBA provisions.
attributes.references: CBA — Injured Reserve Provisions; NFL Governance Office; NHL Board of Governors

attributes.name: league_filing_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time at which the free agency transaction was officially filed with the league office. Used for compliance verification, transaction ordering, and broadcast reporting. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: League Transaction Filing Requirements; CBA — Transaction Reporting

attributes.name: negotiation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the athlete's free agency negotiation process. Eligible: athlete is available for negotiation; Negotiating: active discussions underway; Offer Received: formal offer tendered; Signed: new contract executed; Withdrawn: athlete withdrew from market; Voided: status invalidated by league ruling; Deadline Passed: signing window closed without agreement. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: eligible|negotiating|offer_received|signed|withdrawn|voided|deadline_passed — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CBA — Free Agency Procedures; League Transaction Reporting

attributes.name: nil_agreement_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Name Image and Likeness (NIL) Agreement Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the athlete has active Name, Image, and Likeness (NIL) agreements that may affect contract negotiations, endorsement clauses, or league eligibility during the free agency period.
attributes.references: NIL (Name Image and Likeness) Regulations; NCAA; CBA — Endorsement Provisions

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for capturing supplementary information about the athlete's free agency status, including league rulings, CBA exceptions, grievance filings, or special circumstances not captured by structured fields.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: offer_sheet_received_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the athlete has received and signed an offer sheet from a team other than the original team. Triggers the original team's right of first refusal window when right_of_first_refusal_flag is True.
attributes.references: CBA — Offer Sheet Procedures; NBA League Office

attributes.name: opt_out_deadline
attributes.description: The deadline by which the athlete must formally notify the team of their decision to exercise or decline their player option. Null when player_option_flag is False.
attributes.references: CBA — Player Option Notification Provisions

attributes.name: player_option_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the athlete holds a player option on their contract for the upcoming season. If the athlete opts out, they enter free agency; if they exercise the option, they remain under contract.
attributes.references: CBA — Player Option Provisions; SAP SuccessFactors HCM

attributes.name: prior_team_option_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the original team holds a club option or team option on the athlete's services for the upcoming season, which if exercised would prevent free agency. Distinct from franchise and transition tag designations.
attributes.references: CBA — Contract Option Provisions; SAP SuccessFactors HCM

attributes.name: qualifying_offer_amount
attributes.description: The one-year salary amount tendered by the original team as a qualifying offer to retain restricted free agency rights. Expressed in USD. Calculated per CBA formula based on prior contract value or league minimum thresholds.
attributes.references: CBA — Qualifying Offer Provisions; SAP S/4HANA SD — Contract Pricing

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp at which this free agency status record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) — Audit Trail Requirements; GDPR Article 5 — Data Integrity

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp at which this free agency status record was most recently modified. Tracks status transitions, amount updates, and deadline changes throughout the free agency lifecycle. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) — Audit Trail Requirements; GDPR Article 5 — Data Integrity

attributes.name: renouncement_date
attributes.description: The date on which the original team formally renounced the athlete's rights, releasing the cap hold and converting the athlete to an unrestricted free agent. Null when cap_hold_released_flag is False.
attributes.references: CBA — Renouncement Provisions; NBA League Office

attributes.name: right_of_first_refusal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the original team retains the right of first refusal to match any offer sheet signed by the athlete with another team. True for restricted free agents where the original team has tendered a qualifying offer. Governed by CBA provisions.
attributes.references: CBA — Right of First Refusal Provisions; NBA League Office; NFL Governance Office

attributes.name: rofr_exercised_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Right of First Refusal (ROFR) Exercised Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the original team formally exercised its right of first refusal to match the offer sheet and retain the athlete. Null or False when no offer sheet was received or ROFR was waived.
attributes.references: CBA — Right of First Refusal Provisions; NBA League Office

attributes.name: rofr_response_deadline
attributes.business_glossary_term: Right of First Refusal (ROFR) Response Deadline
attributes.description: The date by which the original team must exercise or waive its right of first refusal after receiving a signed offer sheet from the athlete. Null when offer_sheet_received_flag is False.
attributes.references: CBA — Right of First Refusal Response Window; NBA League Office; NFL Governance Office

attributes.name: signing_date
attributes.description: The date on which the athlete formally signed a new contract, concluding the free agency period. Null until negotiation_status reaches 'signed'. Used for broadcast transaction reporting and league filing.
attributes.references: League Transaction Reporting; CBA — Contract Execution Provisions

attributes.name: signing_deadline
attributes.description: The final date by which the athlete must sign a new contract or return to the original team under applicable CBA provisions. Applies primarily to RFA and franchise/transition tag designations.
attributes.references: CBA — Signing Deadline Provisions; League Operations

attributes.name: tag_designation_deadline
attributes.description: The deadline by which the original team must formally apply a franchise tag or transition tag designation to the athlete. Applicable only when fa_type is franchise_tag or transition_tag.
attributes.references: CBA — Franchise Tag Article; NFL Governance Office

attributes.name: tender_amount
attributes.description: The one-year salary amount tendered by the original team for an exclusive rights or restricted free agent. Distinct from the qualifying offer amount; represents the minimum the team must offer to retain rights. Expressed in USD.
attributes.references: CBA — Tender Amount Provisions; SAP S/4HANA FI/CO

attributes.name: tender_deadline
attributes.description: The date by which the original team must submit a qualifying offer or tender to retain restricted free agency rights over the athlete. Failure to tender by this date converts the athlete to an unrestricted free agent.
attributes.references: CBA — Tender Deadline Provisions; NFL Governance Office; NBA League Office

attributes.name: transition_tag_amount
attributes.description: The one-year salary value assigned to the athlete under a transition tag designation. Typically lower than the franchise tag amount and calculated as the average of the top-N salaries at the athlete's position per CBA formula. Expressed in USD.
attributes.references: CBA — Transition Tag Article; NFL Governance Office; SAP S/4HANA FI/CO

attributes.name: wada_clearance_status
attributes.description: The athlete's current anti-doping clearance status as required by WADA and applicable league anti-doping programs. Cleared: no active violations; Pending Review: under investigation; Suspended: serving a doping suspension; Ineligible: permanently ineligible. Impacts free agency signing eligibility.
attributes.references: WADA (World Anti-Doping Agency) — World Anti-Doping Code; CAS (Court of Arbitration for Sport)

attributes.name: years_of_service
attributes.description: Total years of professional service credited to the athlete across all teams in the league. Used alongside accrued seasons for salary arbitration eligibility and pension vesting. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 3.17 years).
attributes.references: CBA — Service Time Provisions; MLB Commissioner's Office; NHL Board of Governors

attributes.name: professional_liability_insurance_carrier
