attributes.name: segment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the CRM segment definition record. Identifies which audience segment the fan has been assigned to for campaign targeting, personalization, or NPS cohort analysis.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Campaign / Segment Object; Adobe Experience Platform — Audience Segment

attributes.name: ab_test_variant
attributes.description: The A/B or multivariate test variant assigned to this fan within the segment for campaign experimentation. Supports controlled testing of personalization strategies, messaging, and offer effectiveness across fan cohorts.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform — A/B Test Audience Split; Salesforce CRM — Campaign Variant

attributes.name: activation_destination
attributes.description: The downstream system or platform to which this segment membership was activated (e.g., 'Adobe Target', 'Google Ads', 'Salesforce Marketing Cloud', 'Meta Ads'). Supports multi-channel activation tracking and attribution.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform — Destination Catalog; Salesforce CRM — Marketing Cloud Integration

attributes.name: activation_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether this segment membership has been activated for downstream use in a campaign, personalization engine, or ad platform. 'activated' means the membership has been pushed to an activation destination such as Adobe Target or a paid media platform.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform — Audience Activation Status; Salesforce CRM — Campaign Member Activation

attributes.name: activation_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this segment membership was activated and pushed to the downstream destination system. Distinct from assignment_timestamp; supports latency measurement between assignment and activation.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform — Audience Export Timestamp

attributes.name: assignment_channel
attributes.description: The system or interface channel through which the assignment was executed. 'crm' = Salesforce CRM automation; 'aep' = Adobe Experience Platform (AEP) audience activation; 'api' = external API call; 'batch' = scheduled batch job; 'manual_ui' = CRM analyst via user interface.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Campaign Member Source; Adobe Experience Platform — Activation Channel

attributes.name: assignment_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the fan was first assigned to this segment. Used for time-variant segment membership analysis and campaign eligibility windows.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Campaign Member Start Date; Adobe Experience Platform — Segment Qualification Date

attributes.name: assignment_method
attributes.description: The mechanism by which the fan was assigned to this segment. 'rule_based' indicates automated CRM rule evaluation; 'manual' indicates a CRM analyst override; 'ml_predicted' indicates an ML model classification; 'imported' indicates a bulk data import; 'api_triggered' indicates an external system API call via Adobe Experience Platform or Salesforce API.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Segment Assignment Source; Adobe Experience Platform — Audience Qualification Method

attributes.name: assignment_score
attributes.description: Numeric score or confidence value associated with this assignment, typically produced by an ML model or rule engine. For ML-predicted assignments, this represents the model's probability or propensity score (0.0–1.0). For rule-based assignments, this may represent a weighted rule match score.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform — Audience Propensity Score; Salesforce CRM — Lead Score

attributes.name: assignment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this fan-segment membership record. 'active' means the fan is currently a member of the segment; 'expired' means the assignment passed its expiry date; 'revoked' means it was manually removed; 'pending' means awaiting confirmation; 'suspended' means temporarily paused.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Campaign Member Status; Adobe Experience Platform — Profile Segment Membership Status

attributes.name: assignment_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time (with timezone) when the fan was assigned to this segment. Supports real-time campaign triggering and audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Campaign Member Created Date; Adobe Experience Platform — Profile Segment Entry Timestamp

attributes.name: consent_basis
attributes.description: The legal basis under which the fan's data is processed for this segment assignment. Required for GDPR Article 6 compliance documentation. 'explicit_consent' = fan actively opted in; 'legitimate_interest' = business interest assessment conducted; 'contract' = necessary for service delivery; 'legal_obligation' = required by law; 'opt_out_not_exercised' = CCPA default.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6 — Lawful Basis for Processing; CCPA Section 1798.120 — Right to Opt-Out

attributes.name: consent_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the fan's data processing consent has been verified as valid and current at the time of this segment assignment. Ensures GDPR and CCPA compliance for targeted marketing use of this membership record.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6 — Lawfulness of Processing; CCPA Section 1798.100 — Consumer Rights

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this segment assignment record was first created in the data platform. Serves as the audit trail creation marker for the Silver Layer lakehouse record.
attributes.references: SOX — Audit Trail Requirements; GDPR Article 5 — Data Integrity and Accountability

attributes.name: data_suppression_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this fan has exercised a right-to-suppress or opt-out request that should prevent this segment assignment from being used in outbound marketing or data sharing. Supports GDPR right to erasure and CCPA opt-out compliance.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 17 — Right to Erasure; CCPA Section 1798.120 — Right to Opt-Out of Sale

attributes.name: engagement_score_at_assignment
attributes.description: The fan's overall engagement score at the time of this segment assignment, as calculated by the CRM or Adobe Experience Platform. Captured as a point-in-time snapshot to support longitudinal analysis of how engagement drives segment membership.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform — Fan Engagement Score; Salesforce CRM — Contact Engagement Score

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which this fan's membership in the segment is scheduled to expire. Null indicates an open-ended assignment with no planned expiry. Supports time-limited campaign cohorts and seasonal segment windows.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Campaign Member End Date; Adobe Experience Platform — Audience Expiry

attributes.name: fan_type_at_assignment
attributes.description: The fan's account classification at the time of this segment assignment. Captured as a point-in-time snapshot to support historical cohort analysis. Values: individual consumer, family account, season ticket holder, VIP member, or fan club member.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Account Type; Ticketmaster / AXS — Account Classification

attributes.name: geographic_market
attributes.description: The geographic market or region associated with this segment assignment (e.g., 'USA', 'GBR', 'AUS'). Uses ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes. Supports geo-targeted campaign execution and regional compliance (GDPR for EU markets, CCPA for California).
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3 Country Codes; GDPR — EU Market Compliance; CCPA — California Market Compliance

attributes.name: is_primary_segment
attributes.description: Indicates whether this segment is the fan's primary or highest-priority segment assignment when a fan belongs to multiple segments simultaneously. Used for personalization and communication preference resolution.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Primary Campaign Membership; Adobe Experience Platform — Primary Audience

attributes.name: last_evaluated_timestamp
attributes.description: The most recent date and time when the segment rule engine or ML model re-evaluated this fan's eligibility for the segment. Supports freshness monitoring and identifies stale assignments that may need re-evaluation.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform — Profile Segment Re-evaluation; Salesforce CRM — Segment Refresh

attributes.name: loyalty_tier_at_assignment
attributes.description: The fan's loyalty program membership tier at the time of this segment assignment. Captured as a point-in-time snapshot to support time-variant analysis of how loyalty tier influences segment membership and campaign response.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Loyalty Tier Field; Adobe Experience Platform — Fan Loyalty Attribute

attributes.name: membership_duration_days
attributes.description: The number of days the fan has been (or was) a member of this segment, calculated as the difference between assignment_date and either the current date (for active memberships) or revocation_date/expiry_date. Stored as a business-meaningful snapshot for reporting without requiring real-time calculation.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Campaign Member Duration; Adobe Experience Platform — Audience Membership Duration

attributes.name: next_evaluation_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date for the next automated re-evaluation of this fan's segment eligibility. Supports segment refresh scheduling and ensures time-sensitive segments (e.g., event-proximity segments) are kept current.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform — Audience Refresh Schedule; Salesforce CRM — Segment Evaluation Schedule

attributes.name: nps_cohort_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this segment assignment is specifically designated for NPS (Net Promoter Score) survey cohort analysis. When true, the fan is included in NPS measurement campaigns for fan satisfaction tracking.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform — NPS Cohort Audience; Salesforce CRM — Survey Campaign

attributes.name: override_reason
attributes.description: Free-text justification provided by a CRM analyst when manually assigning or revoking a fan's segment membership, overriding automated rule-based or ML-predicted assignment. Populated only when assignment_method is 'manual'.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Campaign Member Notes; GDPR Article 22 — Right to Human Intervention

attributes.name: priority_rank
attributes.description: Numeric rank indicating the priority of this segment assignment relative to other active segment memberships for the same fan. Lower values indicate higher priority. Used for conflict resolution when a fan belongs to multiple segments with competing campaign rules.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Campaign Priority; Adobe Experience Platform — Audience Priority

attributes.name: revocation_date
attributes.description: The date on which this fan's segment membership was revoked or removed, either by automated rule exit, manual override, or consent withdrawal. Null if the membership has not been revoked.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Campaign Member Removal Date; GDPR Article 7 — Withdrawal of Consent

attributes.name: revocation_reason
attributes.description: The reason code explaining why this fan's segment membership was revoked. 'rule_exit' = fan no longer meets segment criteria; 'consent_withdrawn' = GDPR/CCPA consent revoked; 'manual_removal' = analyst override; 'data_quality' = data integrity issue; 'segment_deprecated' = segment definition retired; 'opt_out' = fan opted out of communications.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7 — Withdrawal of Consent; Salesforce CRM — Campaign Member Exit Reason

attributes.name: score_model_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the ML model or rule engine that produced the assignment_score. Enables model governance, reproducibility, and performance tracking over time. Applicable when assignment_method is 'ml_predicted'.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform — Model Governance; GDPR Article 22 — Automated Decision-Making Transparency

attributes.name: score_percentile
attributes.description: The percentile rank of the fan's assignment score within the segment population at the time of assignment (0.00–100.00). Used for tiered targeting and prioritization within a segment cohort.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform — Audience Ranking; Salesforce CRM — Scoring Percentile

attributes.name: segment_category
attributes.description: The analytical category of the segment to which the fan is assigned. Denormalized from the segment definition for query performance. Supports filtering and reporting by segment type without joining to the segment master.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Segment Type; Adobe Experience Platform — Audience Category

attributes.name: segment_version
attributes.description: Version label of the segment definition that was active at the time of this assignment. Enables historical analysis of how segment criteria evolved and ensures reproducibility of cohort membership.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Segment Version; Adobe Experience Platform — Audience Version

attributes.name: source_record_reference
attributes.description: The native record identifier from the originating source system (e.g., Salesforce CRM Campaign Member ID, Adobe AEP Segment Membership ID). Supports data lineage, reconciliation, and cross-system traceability.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Campaign Member ID; Adobe Experience Platform — Segment Membership Record ID

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record that originated this segment assignment. Identifies the upstream data source for lineage and reconciliation purposes.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM; Adobe Experience Platform; Ticketmaster / AXS; Shopify Plus

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this segment assignment record was most recently modified in the data platform. Supports change data capture, incremental processing, and audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: SOX — Audit Trail Requirements; GDPR Article 5 — Data Integrity and Accountability

SSOT for all fan privacy obligations.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.data_processing_record. attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.policy. Business justification: GDPR/CCPA consent management requires each consent record to reference the governing compliance policy that defines the lawful basis, consent notice version, and processing purpose. A DPO would expect

attributes.name: primary_consent_fan_profile_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the fan whose consent preference this record captures. Links to the fan master profile as the primary party reference.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4(1); CCPA Section 1798.140(o)

attributes.name: tertiary_consent_parental_guardian_fan_profile_id
attributes.description: Fan ID of the parent or legal guardian who provided consent on behalf of a minor fan. Null for adult fans. Links to the guardian's fan profile for family account management.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 8; COPPA; CCPA Section 1798.120

attributes.name: aep_consent_reference
attributes.description: External identifier of the corresponding consent record in Adobe Experience Platform. Supports synchronisation of consent signals to the fan engagement and personalisation platform.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform Consent and Preferences Schema; GDPR Article 7

attributes.name: consent_category
attributes.description: High-level category grouping for this consent type, aligned with IAB TCF (Transparency and Consent Framework) and cookie consent banner classifications. Supports consent management platform (CMP) integration and reporting.
attributes.references: IAB Transparency and Consent Framework (TCF) v2.2; ePrivacy Directive 2002/58/EC; GDPR Article 6

attributes.name: consent_date
attributes.description: Timestamp at which the fan actively granted this consent. Represents the principal business event timestamp for the consent lifecycle. Stored in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7(1); CCPA Section 1798.135; Adobe Experience Platform Consent Schema

attributes.name: consent_language_code
attributes.description: ISO 639-1 language code (optionally with ISO 3166-1 country subtag) of the language in which the consent notice was presented to the fan. Ensures consent was given in the fan's understood language, a GDPR requirement.
attributes.references: GDPR Recital 42; ISO 639-1; ISO 3166-1

attributes.name: consent_notice_url
attributes.description: URL of the specific privacy notice or consent form presented to the fan at the time of consent capture. Provides an auditable link to the exact disclosure document the fan reviewed.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 13; GDPR Article 14; CCPA Section 1798.100

attributes.name: consent_proof_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or URL pointing to the stored evidence of consent (e.g., a screenshot, form submission log, call recording reference, or digital audit token). Required for demonstrating consent under GDPR Article 7(1).
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7(1); CCPA Section 1798.135; ISO/IEC 29101

attributes.name: consent_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric reference number assigned to this consent record, used for audit trails, regulatory inquiries, and fan-facing acknowledgement receipts. Generated at point of consent capture.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7(1); CCPA Section 1798.135; ISO/IEC 29101

attributes.name: consent_renewal_reminder_date
attributes.description: Date on which a consent renewal reminder should be sent to the fan, typically triggered before the effective_until date. Supports proactive consent lifecycle management to avoid consent lapse.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; ICO Consent Guidance; Adobe Experience Platform Consent Schema

attributes.name: consent_source
attributes.description: The channel or touchpoint through which the fan provided or updated their consent. Used for audit purposes and to validate that consent was obtained through an appropriate mechanism. Values: web_form, mobile_app, in_venue_kiosk, call_center, paper_form, third_party.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7(1); CCPA Section 1798.135; Adobe Experience Platform Consent Schema

attributes.name: consent_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of this consent record. 'granted' indicates active consent; 'withdrawn' indicates the fan has revoked consent; 'pending' indicates consent request issued but not yet confirmed; 'expired' indicates consent has lapsed past its validity period.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7(3); CCPA Section 1798.120(b); Adobe Experience Platform Consent Schema

attributes.name: consent_type
attributes.description: Classification of the specific data processing activity for which consent is being captured. Covers marketing email, SMS, push notification, data sharing with partners, profiling/personalization, and cookie consent. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: marketing_email|sms|push_notification|data_sharing_partner|profiling_personalization|cookie — promote to reference product if additional types are required]
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6(1)(a); GDPR Article 9; CCPA Section 1798.120; ePrivacy Directive 2002/58/EC

attributes.name: consent_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the privacy policy, terms of service, or consent notice document that the fan agreed to at the time of consent. Enables tracking of consent against specific policy versions for regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7(1); CCPA Section 1798.135; ISO/IEC 29101

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp at which this consent preference record was first created in the system. Audit trail field for data lineage and regulatory record-keeping under GDPR Article 30.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 30; SOX Section 404; ISO/IEC 29101

attributes.name: crm_consent_record_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: CRM (Customer Relationship Management) Consent Record ID
attributes.description: External identifier of the corresponding consent record in Salesforce CRM. Enables bi-directional reconciliation between the lakehouse silver layer and the operational CRM system of record.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Consent Management; GDPR Article 30 (Records of Processing Activities)

attributes.name: data_portability_requested
attributes.description: Indicates whether the fan has submitted a Data Portability request under GDPR Article 20, requesting their personal data in a machine-readable format. Triggers data export workflows.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 20; CCPA Section 1798.100(d)

attributes.name: device_type
attributes.description: Type of device used by the fan when submitting their consent. Supports channel analytics and ensures consent UI was appropriate for the device used.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7(1); Adobe Experience Platform Consent Schema

attributes.name: double_opt_in_date
attributes.description: Timestamp at which the fan completed the double opt-in confirmation step. Null if double opt-in was not required or not completed. Supports audit evidence for email marketing consent.
attributes.references: GDPR Recital 32; ePrivacy Directive 2002/58/EC Article 13

attributes.name: double_opt_in_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the fan completed a double opt-in confirmation process (True) for this consent, such as clicking a confirmation link in an email. Provides stronger evidence of consent for email marketing under GDPR.
attributes.references: GDPR Recital 32; ePrivacy Directive 2002/58/EC Article 13

attributes.name: effective_from
attributes.description: Date from which this consent record is binding and processing under this consent is permitted. Supports forward-dated consent activations and consent version transitions.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; CCPA Section 1798.120; ISO/IEC 29101

attributes.name: effective_until
attributes.description: Date on which this consent record expires and processing must cease unless renewed. Null for open-ended consents with no defined expiry. Supports consent validity period management.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; CCPA Section 1798.120; ePrivacy Directive 2002/58/EC

attributes.name: erasure_request_date
attributes.description: Timestamp at which the fan submitted their Right to Erasure or CCPA deletion request. Null if no erasure request has been made. Starts the regulatory response clock (30 days under GDPR, 45 days under CCPA).
attributes.references: GDPR Article 17; GDPR Article 12(3); CCPA Section 1798.105(d)

attributes.name: iab_tcf_purpose_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: IAB Transparency and Consent Framework (TCF) Purpose ID
attributes.description: Numeric identifier of the IAB TCF v2.2 purpose associated with this consent record. Enables interoperability with programmatic advertising and digital media ecosystems for broadcast and OTT platforms.
attributes.references: IAB Transparency and Consent Framework (TCF) v2.2; GDPR Article 6(1)(a); FCC Broadcast Regulation

attributes.name: ip_address
attributes.description: IP address of the device from which the fan submitted their consent. Used as supporting evidence of consent origin and geographic jurisdiction determination. May be considered PII under GDPR.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4(1); GDPR Recital 30; CCPA Section 1798.140(o)

attributes.name: jurisdiction
attributes.description: The regulatory framework and geographic jurisdiction under which this consent record is governed. Determines which privacy law obligations apply. Values: EU_GDPR, CA_CCPA, UK_GDPR, BR_LGPD, AU_PRIVACY. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EU_GDPR|CA_CCPA|UK_GDPR|BR_LGPD|AU_PRIVACY|other — promote to reference product for full global coverage]
attributes.references: GDPR (EU) 2016/679; CCPA Section 1798; UK GDPR; LGPD (Brazil); Australian Privacy Act 1988

attributes.name: last_reviewed_date
attributes.description: Date on which this consent record was last reviewed or reconfirmed by the fan or by a compliance officer. Supports periodic consent refresh requirements and demonstrates ongoing validity.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; ICO Consent Guidance; CCPA Section 1798.135

attributes.name: legal_basis
attributes.description: The GDPR Article 6 lawful basis under which personal data is processed for this consent record. While this product primarily captures consent, the legal basis field supports cases where processing may shift to another basis (e.g., contract fulfilment). Values: consent, legitimate_interest, contract, legal_obligation, vital_interest, public_task.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6(1); GDPR Article 9(2); CCPA Section 1798.140

attributes.name: minor_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the fan is a minor (under 16 in EU, under 13 in US) at the time of consent. Triggers parental consent verification workflows and restricts certain processing activities under GDPR Article 8 and COPPA.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 8; COPPA (Children's Online Privacy Protection Act); CCPA Section 1798.120

attributes.name: opt_in_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the fan has actively opted in (True) or opted out (False) for this consent type. Provides a direct boolean signal for downstream marketing suppression lists and personalisation engines.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; CCPA Section 1798.120; Adobe Experience Platform Consent Schema

attributes.name: parental_consent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether verifiable parental consent has been obtained for a minor fan (True) or not (False). Required for fans identified as minors under GDPR Article 8 and COPPA.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 8; COPPA; CCPA Section 1798.120

attributes.name: processing_purpose
attributes.description: Detailed description of the specific data processing purpose for which consent is granted, as disclosed to the fan. Examples include 'personalised match recommendations', 'third-party sponsor marketing', 'fan behaviour analytics'. Supports GDPR purpose limitation principle.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5(1)(b); GDPR Article 13(1)(c); CCPA Section 1798.100

attributes.name: right_to_erasure_requested
attributes.description: Indicates whether the fan has submitted a Right to Erasure (Right to be Forgotten) request under GDPR Article 17 or CCPA deletion request. Triggers downstream data deletion workflows across all processing systems.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 17; CCPA Section 1798.105

attributes.name: suppression_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this fan is on a global marketing suppression list (True), overriding all consent grants for outbound marketing communications. Used by Salesforce CRM and Adobe Experience Platform to enforce hard suppression.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 21; CCPA Section 1798.120; CAN-SPAM Act; PECR (UK)

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp at which this consent preference record was last modified. Supports change tracking, audit trails, and incremental data pipeline processing in the Databricks Lakehouse silver layer.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 30; SOX Section 404; ISO/IEC 29101

attributes.name: withdrawal_date
attributes.description: Timestamp at which the fan withdrew or revoked this consent. Null if consent has not been withdrawn. Required for GDPR and CCPA audit trails demonstrating timely cessation of processing.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7(3); CCPA Section 1798.120(b)

attributes.name: withdrawal_method
attributes.description: The channel or mechanism through which the fan withdrew their consent. Null if consent has not been withdrawn. Supports audit trails and ensures withdrawal was as easy as granting consent per GDPR Article 7(3).
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7(3); CCPA Section 1798.120(b)

attributes.name: withdrawal_reason
attributes.description: Free-text or categorised reason provided by the fan or system for withdrawing consent. Supports fan experience analysis and identification of consent friction points. Null if consent has not been withdrawn.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7(3); Salesforce CRM Consent Management

attributes.name: billing_state_province
attributes.description: State or province component of the billing address. Used for AVS verification, tax jurisdiction determination, and CCPA/GDPR applicability assessment for fan data privacy compliance.

attributes.description: Funding classification of the payment card as determined from BIN lookup. Distinguishes credit, debit, prepaid, and charge cards. Impacts interchange fee rates, refund processing timelines, and eligibility for certain promotional financing offers on season tickets.

attributes.name: card_last_four
attributes.description: Last four digits of the payment card Primary Account Number (PAN). Displayed to the fan in account management and checkout screens to identify their saved card without exposing the full PAN. Permitted display element under PCI-DSS truncation rules.

attributes.name: cardholder_name
attributes.description: Name of the individual as it appears on the payment card or as registered with the payment instrument. attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 3.3; GDPR Article 5 (Data Minimisation); CCPA §1798.140

attributes.name: consent_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the terms and conditions or privacy policy under which the fan consented to storing this payment instrument. Enables compliance teams to identify fans who consented under outdated policy versions requiring re-consent.

attributes.name: currency_code

attributes.name: enrollment_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the payment instrument was first added to the fan account. Used for lifecycle management, fraud velocity checks, and compliance audit trails. Recorded in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 10; GDPR Article 30 (Records of Processing)

attributes.name: expiry_month
attributes.description: Two-digit calendar month (1–12) in which the payment card expires. Used in conjunction with expiry_year to determine card validity and trigger pre-expiry notification workflows for membership auto-renewal continuity.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 3.3; ISO 8583 Card Data Standards

attributes.name: expiry_notification_sent
attributes.description: Indicates whether a pre-expiry notification has been dispatched to the fan via their preferred communication channel (email, SMS, push) to prompt card update before membership or season ticket auto-renewal fails. Managed by Adobe Experience Platform journey automation.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform Journey Optimizer; Salesforce CRM Marketing Cloud

attributes.name: expiry_year
attributes.description: Four-digit calendar year in which the payment card expires. Combined with expiry_month to assess card validity. Triggers automated pre-expiry fan communications to update payment details and prevent lapsed season ticket or membership renewals.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 3.3; ISO 8583 Card Data Standards

attributes.name: fraud_risk_score
attributes.description: Numeric risk score (0.00–100.00) assigned to this payment instrument by the fraud detection engine at enrollment or last transaction. Higher scores indicate elevated fraud risk. Used to trigger step-up authentication, manual review, or instrument suspension. Not a calculated KPI — raw score from fraud provider.

attributes.name: gift_card_balance
attributes.description: Current monetary balance remaining on a stored-value gift card payment instrument. Applicable only when payment_method_type is 'gift_card'. Updated after each redemption transaction. Null for non-gift-card instruments. Denominated in the currency indicated by currency_code.

attributes.name: issuer_country_code

attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 10; GDPR Article 30; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: last_used_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time of the most recent successful transaction processed against this payment instrument. Used to identify dormant payment methods for cleanup workflows and to assess instrument activity for fraud monitoring.

attributes.name: method_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the payment instrument. 'active' — valid and available for transactions; 'expired' — card expiry date has passed; 'suspended' — temporarily blocked due to fraud or dispute; 'removed' — fan has deleted the instrument; 'pending_verification' — awaiting micro-deposit or 3DS verification.

products.name: club_membership
products.description: This association product represents the Enrollment between fan_profile and club. It captures the operational lifecycle of a fan's membership in an official fan club — including join date, membership tier, renewal date, dues payment status, and membership number. Each record links one fan to one club and carries attributes that exist only in the context of that specific fan-club enrollment. Enables CRM segmentation, loyalty benefit delivery, compliance tracking, and fan club governance.. Existence Justification: In sports entertainment, fans actively join multiple official fan clubs (e.g., a fan can be a member of both the LA Lakers Official Fan Club and a regional supporters chapter), and each club has many member fans. This is a genuine operational M:N relationship: the business actively manages fan club memberships as a lifecycle concept — fans enroll, pay dues, renew, and hold tiered membership status within each club. The relationship is not derivable from existing FKs; it requires its own record with join_date, membership_tier, renewal_date, dues payment status, and membership number.

With the club_membership association table in place, this flag becomes derivable (EXISTS query on club_membership where membership_status = 'active') and should be removed from fan_profile to avoid data inconsistency.]

Enables per-seat revenue attribution, access control entitlement generation, fulfillment tracking, and complimentary ticket audit.

attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: price_tier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the pricing tier (e.g., GA, VIP, SRO, premium) applied to this ticket line. Drives revenue attribution and pricing analytics.

attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: primary_ticket_event_fixture_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific sports or entertainment event for which this ticket grants admission. Links the ticket line to the event scheduling domain.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster/AXS Ticketing Platform; Archtics

attributes.name: primary_ticket_fan_fan_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the fan or patron who holds entitlement to this ticket. Supports fan engagement analytics, CRM integration, and access control.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM; Adobe Experience Platform; GDPR Article 4; CCPA

attributes.name: season_ticket_package_id
attributes.description: Reference to the season ticket package under which this ticket line was issued, if applicable. Links individual game tickets to their parent season ticket agreement for package revenue attribution.

attributes.name: ticket_inventory_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific seat inventory record in Archtics representing the physical or virtual seat assigned to this ticket line.

attributes.name: ticket_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent ticket order header under which this line item was created. Establishes the header/detail relationship for the ticket commerce transaction.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster/AXS Ticketing Platform; SAP S/4HANA SD (Sales and Distribution)

attributes.name: venue_id
attributes.description: Reference to the venue where the event is held. Supports venue operations reporting and access control entitlement generation.

attributes.name: access_status

attributes.name: barcode
attributes.description: The unique barcode or token printed or encoded on the ticket used for access control scanning at venue entry points. May be a traditional barcode, QR code value, or NFC token identifier.

attributes.name: cancelled_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this ticket order line was cancelled or voided. Populated only when line_status is 'cancelled' or 'voided'. Required for refund processing and revenue reversal tracking.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster/AXS Ticketing Platform; SAP S/4HANA FI; PCI-DSS

attributes.name: comp_reason_code
attributes.description: The reason code explaining why a complimentary ticket was issued. Required for comp ticket audit and financial controls. Only populated when is_comp is True. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: media|sponsor|athlete|staff|promotion|accessibility — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI; SOX Sarbanes-Oxley Act; League Governance (NFL/NBA/MLB/NHL)

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this ticket line (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR). Supports multi-currency operations across global markets.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA FI; SEC Financial Reporting

attributes.name: delivered_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the ticket was successfully delivered to the fan via the specified delivery method. Used for fulfillment SLA tracking and fan experience reporting.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster/AXS Ticketing Platform; ISO 20121 Event Sustainability Management

attributes.name: delivery_method
attributes.description: The method by which the ticket is delivered to the purchaser. Drives fulfillment workflows and fan experience design. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: mobile|print_at_home|will_call|mail|digital_wallet|kiosk — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Ticketmaster/AXS Ticketing Platform; ADA Americans with Disabilities Act

attributes.name: delivery_status
attributes.description: Current fulfillment status of the ticket delivery. Tracks whether the ticket has been successfully delivered to the fan via the specified delivery method.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster/AXS Ticketing Platform

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: The monetary discount applied to this ticket line as a result of a promotion code, loyalty program, or group sales discount. Reduces the effective selling price from the face value.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; Ticketmaster/AXS; SOX

attributes.name: dynamic_price
attributes.description: The actual selling price applied to this ticket after dynamic pricing model adjustments (demand-based, algorithmic, or promotional). May differ from face_value when dynamic pricing is active.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster/AXS Dynamic Pricing Engine; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: external_line_ref
attributes.description: The externally-known line item identifier assigned by the source ticketing system (Ticketmaster/AXS or Archtics). Used for reconciliation with the operational system of record.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster/AXS Ticketing Platform; Archtics Venue Seating and Inventory Management

attributes.name: face_value
attributes.description: The printed or base face value of the ticket before any service fees, facility fees, or dynamic pricing adjustments. Used for regulatory reporting, resale market compliance, and revenue attribution.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI (Financial Accounting); PCI-DSS; SOX Sarbanes-Oxley Act

attributes.name: facility_fee
attributes.description: The venue facility fee charged per ticket to fund venue operations, maintenance, and capital improvements. Distinct from the service fee and retained by the venue operator.
attributes.references: Archtics Venue Seating and Inventory Management; SAP S/4HANA FI; OSHA

attributes.name: gate_entry_point
attributes.description: The designated gate or entry point at the venue through which the ticket holder is authorized to enter (e.g., 'Gate A', 'North Entrance', 'VIP Entrance'). Supports venue operations and crowd management.
attributes.references: Archtics Venue Seating and Inventory Management; ADA Americans with Disabilities Act; OSHA

attributes.name: is_ada_accessible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this ticket is for an ADA (Americans with Disabilities Act) accessible seat or accommodation. Required for ADA compliance reporting and venue accessibility management.
attributes.references: ADA Americans with Disabilities Act; Archtics Venue Seating and Inventory Management

attributes.name: is_comp
attributes.description: Indicates whether this ticket was issued as a complimentary (comp) ticket at no charge. Comp tickets require audit tracking for financial controls and league governance compliance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI; SOX Sarbanes-Oxley Act; NFL/NBA/MLB/NHL League Governance

attributes.name: is_resale
attributes.description: Indicates whether this ticket was sold through the secondary/resale marketplace rather than primary sale. Distinguishes primary and secondary market revenue streams for analytics and league reporting.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster/AXS Resale Marketplace; League Governance (NFL/NBA/MLB/NHL)

attributes.name: issued_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this ticket order line was created and the ticket was issued in the ticketing system. Represents the principal business event time for this transaction line.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster/AXS Ticketing Platform; SAP S/4HANA SD; SOX

attributes.name: line_number
attributes.description: Sequential position of this ticket line within the parent order, starting at 1. Used for ordering, display, and reconciliation of multi-ticket orders.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster/AXS Ticketing Platform; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: line_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of this ticket order line. Drives fulfillment workflows, access control entitlement, and revenue recognition. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: issued|cancelled|refunded|transferred|voided|reissued — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Ticketmaster/AXS Ticketing Platform; SAP S/4HANA SD; PCI-DSS

attributes.name: line_total
attributes.description: The total amount charged for this ticket order line, calculated as dynamic_price + service_fee + facility_fee + tax_amount. Represents the net amount collected from the purchaser for this single ticket unit.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO; PCI-DSS; SOX

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The payment instrument used to purchase this ticket line (e.g., credit card, digital wallet, voucher). Supports PCI-DSS compliance reporting and payment channel analytics. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: credit_card|debit_card|digital_wallet|cash|voucher|comp — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: PCI-DSS PCI Security Standards Council; SAP S/4HANA FI; Ticketmaster/AXS

attributes.name: quantity
attributes.description: The number of ticket units represented by this line item. Typically 1 for individually assigned seats; may be greater than 1 for GA (General Admission) or SRO (Standing Room Only) allocations.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster/AXS Ticketing Platform; Archtics

attributes.name: resale_original_price
attributes.description: The original face value price at which the ticket was first sold in the primary market, retained for resale margin analysis and league resale policy compliance. Only populated when is_resale is True.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster/AXS Resale Marketplace; League Governance

attributes.name: sales_channel
attributes.description: The channel through which this ticket was sold (e.g., online, box office, mobile app, group sales). Supports DTC (Direct-To-Consumer) analytics, channel performance reporting, and fan acquisition cost analysis. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: online|box_office|mobile_app|kiosk|group_sales|resale — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Ticketmaster/AXS; Adobe Experience Platform; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: scan_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the ticket barcode was scanned at the venue access control point. Used for attendance analytics, gate throughput reporting, and security compliance.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster/AXS Access Control; OSHA Venue Safety

attributes.name: seat_number
attributes.description: The individual seat number within the assigned row and section. Together with seat_section and seat_row, forms the complete seat assignment for access control and fan experience.
attributes.references: Archtics Venue Seating and Inventory Management; ADA Americans with Disabilities Act

attributes.name: seat_row
attributes.description: The row designation within the assigned section (e.g., 'A', '12', 'AA'). Combined with seat_section and seat_number to uniquely identify the physical seat.
attributes.references: Archtics Venue Seating and Inventory Management

attributes.name: seat_section
attributes.description: The section designation within the venue where the assigned seat is located (e.g., 'A', '101', 'Lower Bowl'). Sourced from Archtics seating inventory.
attributes.references: Archtics Venue Seating and Inventory Management; ADA Americans with Disabilities Act

attributes.name: service_fee
attributes.description: The service/convenience fee charged by the ticketing platform (Ticketmaster/AXS) on top of the face value. A key revenue component for ticketing operations and partner settlement.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster/AXS Ticketing Platform; SAP S/4HANA FI; PCI-DSS

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: The total tax amount applied to this ticket line item, including applicable sales tax, amusement tax, or entertainment tax per jurisdiction. Required for financial reporting and tax compliance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO; SOX Sarbanes-Oxley Act; SEC Financial Reporting

attributes.name: ticket_type
attributes.description: Classification of the ticket unit indicating the commercial nature of the sale. Distinguishes single-event tickets, season ticket packages, group sales, complimentary tickets, resale marketplace tickets, and bundled packages. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: single|season|group|comp|resale|package — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Ticketmaster/AXS Ticketing Platform; Archtics

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this ticket order line record was last modified in the source system. Supports data lineage, audit trail, and incremental data pipeline processing in the Databricks Silver layer.
attributes.references: SOX Sarbanes-Oxley Act; GDPR Article 5; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer

attributes.description: Access control level granted by tickets at this tier, determining which venue zones and areas the ticket holder may enter. Mapped to access control zones in Ticketmaster/AXS and venue access control hardware (scanners, turnstiles).

attributes.description: Indicates whether this pricing tier is designated as ADA (Americans with Disabilities Act) accessible seating, meeting federal accessibility requirements for wheelchair spaces, companion seating, and accessible routes. Required for ADA compliance reporting.

attributes.name: effective_from
attributes.description: The date from which this pricing tier configuration is valid and binding. Supports temporal versioning of tier definitions — a tier may be reconfigured for a new season while retaining historical records for prior seasons.

attributes.name: effective_until
attributes.description: The date until which this pricing tier configuration remains valid. Null indicates the tier is open-ended with no planned expiry. Used for seasonal pricing tier versioning and historical audit.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Pricing Validity; Ticketmaster/AXS Pricing Configuration

attributes.name: eligibility_rule
attributes.description: Free-text or structured rule expression defining who is eligible to purchase tickets at this tier (e.g., 'Season ticket holders only', 'Members with Gold status', 'Military/First Responder ID required', 'Age 12 and under'). Enforced at point of sale in Ticketmaster/AXS.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster/AXS Access Control; Salesforce CRM Fan Segmentation

attributes.name: external_tier_code
attributes.description: The pricing tier identifier as assigned by the external ticketing system of record (Ticketmaster/AXS or Archtics). Used for system integration, reconciliation, and cross-system data lineage. Enables mapping between the internal BIGINT PK and the source system's native identifier.

attributes.name: face_value
attributes.description: The base printed face value of a ticket at this pricing tier in the operating currency, before any fees, taxes, or dynamic pricing adjustments. This is the regulated face value used for resale compliance and financial reporting. Sourced from Archtics/Ticketmaster pricing configuration.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster/AXS Pricing Configuration; PCI-DSS (Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard); SAP S/4HANA SD Pricing

attributes.name: facility_fee
attributes.description: Per-ticket facility/venue fee charged at this tier, retained by the venue operator to fund venue operations and capital improvements. Distinct from the service fee and reported separately in venue revenue accounting.
attributes.references: Archtics Venue Seating Inventory; SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Venue Revenue Accounting

attributes.name: includes_hospitality
attributes.description: Indicates whether hospitality benefits (food and beverage, lounge access, pre-event reception) are bundled with this pricing tier. Applicable to VIP, suite, and premium club tiers. Drives hospitality operations planning.

attributes.name: includes_merchandise
attributes.description: Indicates whether a merchandise item or voucher (e.g., team jersey, program, gift bag) is bundled with tickets at this pricing tier as part of the package offering.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster/AXS Package Configuration; Shopify Plus Merchandise E-Commerce

attributes.name: includes_parking
attributes.description: Indicates whether a parking pass is bundled with tickets at this pricing tier as part of the ticket package (e.g., VIP and suite tiers often include complimentary parking).
attributes.references: Ticketmaster/AXS Package Configuration; Archtics Venue Seating Inventory

attributes.name: inventory_class
attributes.description: Archtics inventory classification that maps this pricing tier to a physical seating inventory class within the venue manifest. Drives seat map allocation and capacity planning in Archtics Venue Seating Inventory system.
attributes.references: Archtics Venue Seating Inventory; Ticketmaster/AXS Inventory Management

attributes.name: max_price
attributes.description: The maximum allowable price for this tier when dynamic pricing is active. The dynamic pricing engine will not price tickets above this ceiling value. Null when dynamic_pricing_enabled is False.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster/AXS Dynamic Pricing Configuration; SAP S/4HANA SD Pricing Conditions

attributes.name: max_tickets_per_order
attributes.description: Maximum number of tickets at this tier that a single fan/customer may purchase in one order transaction. Enforces anti-scalping and fair access policies. Configured in Ticketmaster/AXS order rules.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster/AXS Order Rules Configuration; League Governance Policies

attributes.name: member_exclusive
attributes.description: Indicates whether this pricing tier is exclusively available to registered members or season ticket holders, restricting general public purchase. Integrates with Salesforce CRM membership validation at checkout.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Fan and Sponsor Relationship Management; Ticketmaster/AXS Access Control

attributes.name: min_price
attributes.description: The minimum allowable price for this tier when dynamic pricing is active. The dynamic pricing engine will not price tickets below this floor value. Null when dynamic_pricing_enabled is False.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster/AXS Dynamic Pricing Configuration; SAP S/4HANA SD Pricing Conditions

attributes.name: min_tickets_per_order
attributes.description: Minimum number of tickets at this tier required per order transaction. Primarily applicable to group sales tiers where a minimum group size must be met (e.g., minimum 10 tickets for group pricing).
attributes.references: Ticketmaster/AXS Order Rules Configuration

attributes.name: presale_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether tickets at this tier are available during presale windows (e.g., fan club presale, sponsor presale, credit card presale) before general public on-sale. Drives presale campaign configuration in Ticketmaster/AXS.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster/AXS Presale Configuration

attributes.name: price_tier_description
attributes.description: Detailed marketing and operational description of the pricing tier, including benefits, inclusions, and eligibility notes. Displayed to fans on the ticketing platform and used by box office staff for customer service.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster/AXS Product Content Configuration

attributes.name: price_tier_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the pricing tier: active (available for sale), inactive (temporarily unavailable), draft (under configuration, not yet published), archived (retired, historical reference only), suspended (paused pending review). Controls availability in the dynamic pricing engine and order processing.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster/AXS Pricing Configuration

attributes.name: resale_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether tickets at this pricing tier are eligible for listing on the secondary/resale marketplace. When False, tickets are non-transferable and resale is prohibited (e.g., certain VIP hospitality packages or promotional tickets).
attributes.references: Ticketmaster/AXS Resale Marketplace Configuration; League Governance Policies

attributes.name: resale_min_price
attributes.description: Minimum price at which a ticket of this tier may be listed on the secondary resale marketplace. Enforces floor pricing to protect face value integrity and prevent below-cost resale. Null when resale_eligible is False.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster/AXS Resale Marketplace Configuration

attributes.name: revenue_category
attributes.description: Financial revenue category classification for this pricing tier used in SAP S/4HANA revenue reporting and Workday Adaptive Planning financial forecasting. Segments ticket revenue streams for EBITDA and ARR (Annual Recurring Revenue) analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Revenue Accounting; Workday Adaptive Planning Financial Planning and Analysis

attributes.name: sale_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which tickets at this pricing tier are no longer available for purchase. After this date, the tier is automatically closed in the ticketing system. Null indicates the tier remains on sale until event day.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster/AXS On-Sale Configuration

attributes.name: sale_start_date
attributes.description: The date on which tickets at this pricing tier become available for general public purchase. Used to control on-sale windows in Ticketmaster/AXS and coordinate marketing campaigns.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster/AXS On-Sale Configuration

attributes.name: seating_type
attributes.description: Physical seating configuration associated with this pricing tier: RESERVED (assigned seat), GENERAL_ADMISSION (first-come seating), STANDING (standing area), SUITE (private suite), BOX (premium box), or ACCESSIBLE (ADA-compliant seating). Determines access control and entry validation logic.
attributes.references: Archtics Venue Seating Inventory; ADA (Americans with Disabilities Act) — Venue Accessibility

attributes.name: service_fee
attributes.description: Fixed service/convenience fee charged per ticket at this tier, in addition to the face value. Represents the ticketing platform processing charge (e.g., Ticketmaster convenience fee). Used in order total calculation and revenue allocation.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster/AXS Fee Configuration; SAP S/4HANA SD Pricing Conditions

attributes.name: sort_order
attributes.description: Numeric display sort order for presenting pricing tiers in the correct sequence on ticketing platforms, box office interfaces, and fan-facing purchase flows. Lower values appear first.

products.name: resale
products.description: Unified lifecycle record for all secondary market and peer-to-peer ticket activity. Captures listing creation (price, channel, seller type, listing status), marketplace transaction execution (sale price, platform fees, seller proceeds, buyer reference), and peer-to-peer transfers (gift, forward). Tracks movement type, transfer timestamp, new entitlement token issuance, transfer restrictions, anti-scalping rule compliance, and revenue share calculations. SSOT for all secondary market listings, resale transactions, and fan-to-fan ticket transfers. Replaces separate listing and transaction records with a single lifecycle entity progressing through states: listed → sold/transferred/expired/withdrawn.

attributes.name: source_system_code

attributes.references: Ticketmaster/AXS Access Control System; Archtics Venue Seating and Inventory Management

attributes.name: ticket_source_channel
attributes.description: Distribution channel through which the scanned ticket was originally acquired. attributes.references: Ticketmaster/AXS Access Control System; Archtics Venue Seating and Inventory Management

attributes.name: ticket_type
attributes.description: Classification of the ticket entitlement scanned at the gate. Reflects the pricing tier and access level: General Admission (GA), Very Important Person (VIP), Standing Room Only (SRO), season ticket, group ticket, complimentary, press credential, or staff pass. Sourced from Archtics inventory classification. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: GA|VIP|SRO|season|group|comp|press|staff — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Archtics Venue Seating and Inventory Management; Ticketmaster/AXS Access Control System

attributes.name: token_format
attributes.description: Format of the entitlement token presented at the gate. Indicates whether the ticket was a 1D barcode, 2D barcode, QR code, NFC chip, RFID tag, or mobile wallet pass. Supports digital ticket delivery channel analytics and technology adoption tracking.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster/AXS Access Control System

attributes.name: turnstile_identifier
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the specific turnstile or lane within a gate where the scan was processed. Enables granular throughput analysis and maintenance tracking at the individual turnstile level.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster/AXS Access Control System; Archtics Venue Seating and Inventory Management

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this gate scan record was last modified in the Databricks Silver Layer (e.g., following an override update or data correction). Supports audit trail and change tracking requirements. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOX Sarbanes-Oxley Act; GDPR Article 5

products.name: ticket_payment

SSOT for ticketing payment financial records.

attributes.name: ticket_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent ticket order that this payment is associated with. Links the payment to the originating ticket purchase transaction in Ticketmaster/AXS or Archtics.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster/AXS Order Management

attributes.name: authorization_code
attributes.description: Alphanumeric code returned by the card network or payment processor confirming that the payment was authorized. Required for dispute resolution, chargeback management, and financial audit trails. Null for failed or pending transactions.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 3; ISO 8583 Financial Transaction Message Standard

attributes.name: authorized_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the payment was authorized by the card network or payment processor. This is the principal business event timestamp for the payment lifecycle. Used for fraud detection time-window analysis and PCI-DSS audit trails.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 10.3 (Audit Logs); ISO 8583; Ticketmaster/AXS Transaction Logging

attributes.name: captured_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the authorized payment was captured (funds actually charged). Distinct from authorization timestamp; the gap between authorization and capture is monitored for compliance with card network rules. Null for non-captured transactions.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 10.3; Visa/Mastercard Capture Window Rules

attributes.name: card_expiry_month
attributes.description: The expiration month of the payment card (1–12). Stored in compliance with PCI-DSS to support recurring payment validation and card-on-file management for season ticket holders. Null for non-card payment methods.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 3.3; PCI SSC Data Security Standard

attributes.name: card_expiry_year
attributes.description: The four-digit expiration year of the payment card. Stored in compliance with PCI-DSS to support recurring payment validation and card-on-file management for season ticket holders. Null for non-card payment methods.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 3.3; PCI SSC Data Security Standard

attributes.name: card_network
attributes.description: The card network or scheme associated with the payment instrument (e.g., Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover, UnionPay). Used for interchange fee analysis, network-specific reporting, and chargeback routing.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0; ISO 7812 Issuer Identification Number Standard

attributes.name: chargeback_status
attributes.description: Current status of any chargeback dispute associated with this payment transaction. Tracks the chargeback lifecycle from initiation through resolution. Used for fraud management, financial loss reporting, and card network compliance. Default is 'none' for transactions with no chargeback.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 12; Visa/Mastercard Chargeback Rules; SAP S/4HANA FI Dispute Management

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this payment record was first created in the system. Serves as the audit trail creation marker for data lineage, PCI-DSS audit log requirements, and Silver layer ingestion tracking.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 10.3 (Audit Logs); SOX Section 302; GDPR Article 5(2) Accountability

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the payment transaction (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP, CAD). Supports multi-currency operations across global markets and SAP S/4HANA FI foreign currency revaluation.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA FI Multi-Currency; IFRS 21 Foreign Currency Transactions

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: Total monetary discount applied to the payment, including promotional codes, group sales discounts, season ticket holder discounts, and sponsor-funded promotions. Used for revenue leakage analysis and promotion ROI reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Pricing Conditions; Ticketmaster/AXS Discount Management

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: The foreign exchange rate applied at the time of payment when the transaction currency differs from the organization's functional currency (USD). Used for multi-currency financial reporting and SAP S/4HANA FI currency revaluation. Null for transactions in the functional currency.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Foreign Currency; IFRS 21; ISO 4217

attributes.name: failure_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized decline or failure code returned by the payment processor or card network when a payment is not authorized (e.g., insufficient_funds, card_expired, do_not_honor, fraud_suspected). Used for failed payment analysis, retry logic, and fan communication. Null for successful transactions.
attributes.references: ISO 8583 Response Codes; Visa/Mastercard Decline Code Standards; Ticketmaster/AXS Error Handling

attributes.name: failure_reason_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the payment failure reason corresponding to the failure_reason_code. Used by customer service teams in Salesforce CRM for fan outreach and dispute resolution. Null for successful transactions.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster/AXS Customer Service Integration; Salesforce CRM Case Management

attributes.name: fraud_score
attributes.description: Numeric fraud risk score assigned by the payment processor's fraud detection engine or an internal fraud scoring model at the time of payment (0.00–100.00, where higher values indicate greater fraud risk). Used for real-time payment decisioning, fraud trend analysis, and PCI-DSS fraud monitoring requirements.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 10.7 (Fraud Detection); Ticketmaster/AXS Fraud Prevention; Adobe Experience Platform Risk Scoring

attributes.name: gross_amount
attributes.description: The total face value of the ticket order before any discounts, promotions, or adjustments are applied. Represents the base revenue figure used in financial reporting and EBITDA calculations in SAP S/4HANA FI.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Revenue Recognition; SOX Section 302/404 Financial Controls

attributes.name: installment_number
attributes.description: The sequential installment number for recurring or installment-based payments (e.g., 1 of 4 for a season ticket payment plan). Null for one-time payments. Used for installment plan tracking and revenue recognition scheduling.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster/AXS Season Ticket Installment Plans; SAP S/4HANA FI Installment Processing

attributes.name: installment_total_count
attributes.description: The total number of installments in the payment plan for season ticket or group sales installment arrangements (e.g., 4 for a quarterly payment plan). Null for one-time payments. Used alongside installment_number for plan completion tracking.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster/AXS Season Ticket Installment Plans; SAP S/4HANA FI

attributes.name: is_3ds_authenticated
attributes.description: Indicates whether the payment was authenticated using 3D Secure (3DS) protocol (e.g., Visa Secure, Mastercard Identity Check). True if 3DS authentication was completed. Used for fraud liability shift determination and PCI-DSS compliance reporting.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 6.4; EMVCo 3DS Specification; Visa Secure / Mastercard Identity Check

attributes.name: is_recurring
attributes.description: Indicates whether this payment is part of a recurring payment arrangement, such as a season ticket installment plan or subscription-based fan membership. True for recurring charges. Drives card-on-file compliance and CBA-related payment plan management.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 3.6 (Card-on-File); Ticketmaster/AXS Installment Plans

attributes.name: masked_card_reference
attributes.description: Masked representation of the payment card number or digital wallet identifier (e.g., last 4 digits of card, masked wallet token). Stored in PCI-DSS compliant masked format for customer service, receipt display, and dispute identification without exposing full PAN.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 3.3 (Masking of PAN); PCI SSC Data Security Standard

attributes.name: net_amount
attributes.description: The final net amount charged to the fan after applying discounts and adding service fees and taxes (gross_amount - discount_amount + service_fee_amount + tax_amount). This is the actual amount captured from the fan's payment instrument. SSOT for revenue recognition.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Revenue Recognition; SOX Section 302/404; PCI DSS v4.0

attributes.name: payment_channel
attributes.description: The interface or touchpoint through which the fan submitted the payment (e.g., web browser, mobile app, venue box office, self-service kiosk, call center, third-party resale platform). Distinct from payment method type; used for channel analytics and fraud detection.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster/AXS Channel Attribution; Adobe Experience Platform

attributes.name: payment_method_type
attributes.description: Classification of the payment instrument used by the fan (e.g., credit card, debit card, digital wallet such as Apple Pay/Google Pay, bank transfer, gift card, cash at box office). Drives PCI-DSS scope determination and payment processing routing.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 1; ISO 20022 Payment Instrument Classification

attributes.name: payment_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments associated with the payment transaction, entered by customer service agents or system processes (e.g., manual override justification, special handling instructions for VIP fan payments, dispute context). Used in Salesforce CRM case management.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Case Notes; Ticketmaster/AXS Agent Notes

attributes.name: payment_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable payment reference number assigned by the payment processor or ticketing platform (e.g., Ticketmaster/AXS transaction reference). Used for customer-facing receipts, dispute resolution, and reconciliation with external systems.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster/AXS Payment Reference; PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 3

attributes.name: payment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the payment transaction. Tracks the workflow from authorization through capture, failure, or refund. Critical for revenue recognition, reconciliation, and PCI-DSS compliance reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: authorized|captured|failed|refunded|voided|pending — promote to reference product if additional states are required]
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 3; SAP S/4HANA FI Payment Processing

attributes.name: pci_scope_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this payment record falls within the PCI-DSS cardholder data environment (CDE) scope. True for card-based payments subject to PCI-DSS controls. Used for PCI-DSS scope boundary management, audit reporting, and data classification governance.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 2.2 (Scope Definition); PCI SSC Scoping Guidelines

attributes.name: processor_transaction_token
attributes.description: Tokenized reference assigned by the payment processor to uniquely identify this transaction within the processor's system. Replaces raw card data per PCI-DSS tokenization requirements. Used for refund initiation, dispute management, and settlement reconciliation.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 3.5 (Tokenization); PCI SSC Token Service Provider Guidelines

attributes.name: refund_amount
attributes.description: Total amount refunded to the fan for this payment transaction, applicable when payment_status is 'refunded'. May be a partial or full refund. Used for revenue reversal accounting in SAP S/4HANA FI and fan satisfaction tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Memo Processing; PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 3; Ticketmaster/AXS Refund Policy

attributes.name: refund_reason
attributes.description: Categorized reason for the refund when payment_status is 'refunded'. Supports refund trend analysis, event cancellation financial impact reporting, and fraud detection. Null for non-refunded transactions.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster/AXS Refund Management; SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Memo

attributes.name: refunded_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the refund was processed and submitted to the payment processor. Null for non-refunded transactions. Used for refund SLA monitoring and fan experience reporting.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 10.3; Ticketmaster/AXS Refund SLA

attributes.name: service_fee_amount
attributes.description: Ticketing service and convenience fees charged to the fan on top of the ticket face value (e.g., Ticketmaster facility charge, order processing fee). Reported separately for revenue transparency and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster/AXS Fee Schedule; FTC Transparency in Ticketing Guidelines

attributes.name: settlement_date
attributes.description: The date on which the payment was settled by the acquiring bank and funds were transferred to the organization's account. Critical for cash flow reporting, SAP S/4HANA FI bank reconciliation, and revenue recognition timing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Bank Reconciliation; SOX Section 302; ISO 20022

attributes.name: settlement_reference
attributes.description: The batch settlement reference number assigned by the payment processor or acquiring bank when the transaction is included in a settlement batch. Used for bank reconciliation, SAP S/4HANA FI bank statement matching, and financial close processes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Bank Reconciliation; PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 3; ISO 20022 Payment Settlement

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifies the originating operational system that generated this payment record (e.g., Ticketmaster, AXS, Archtics box office, resale marketplace). Used for data lineage tracking, system reconciliation, and Silver layer provenance in the Databricks Lakehouse.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster/AXS Integration; Archtics Venue Seating; Databricks Lakehouse Data Lineage

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total tax amount applied to the ticket payment, including applicable sales tax, VAT, or entertainment tax based on the venue jurisdiction. Required for tax remittance reporting and SAP S/4HANA FI tax accounting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Tax Accounting; SOX Section 302; GDPR Article 6 (Lawful Basis for Processing)

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this payment record was last modified (e.g., status change from authorized to captured, or refund applied). Supports change data capture, audit trails, and Silver layer incremental processing.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 10.3; SOX Section 302; GDPR Article 5(2)

attributes.name: wallet_provider

attributes.name: completed_timestamp

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the refund record was first created in the system of record (Ticketmaster/AXS). Audit trail field for data lineage and PCI-DSS compliance logging.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the refund transaction (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR). Supports multi-currency operations across global markets and SAP FI foreign currency revaluation.

attributes.name: gross_refund_amount

attributes.name: is_event_initiated

attributes.name: net_refund_amount

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Unstructured operational notes added by customer service agents or automated systems during the refund lifecycle. May include escalation context, fan communication history, or special handling instructions. Subject to GDPR data minimisation principles.

attributes.name: original_payment_method
attributes.description: The payment instrument used in the original ticket purchase transaction. Determines eligibility for ORIGINAL_PAYMENT refund routing and informs PCI-DSS cardholder data handling requirements.

attributes.name: payment_transaction_ref
attributes.description: The external payment processor transaction reference number for the refund settlement (e.g., Stripe charge ID, Adyen PSP reference). Used for reconciliation between Ticketmaster/AXS and the payment gateway. Never stores raw card data.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 10.2; SAP S/4HANA FI Bank Reconciliation

attributes.name: processed_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the refund was submitted to the payment processor or credit wallet system for execution. Distinct from approved_timestamp; marks the point of financial commitment.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 10; SAP S/4HANA FI Payment Run

attributes.name: reason_code

EVENT_CANCELLED and EVENT_POSTPONED are league/venue-initiated; FAN_REQUEST is voluntary; FRAUD triggers PCI-DSS fraud reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EVENT_CANCELLED|EVENT_POSTPONED|FAN_REQUEST|FRAUD|DUPLICATE_PURCHASE|VENUE_ISSUE|WEATHER — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 10.2.1; ISO 20121 Event Sustainability

attributes.name: reason_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative providing additional context for the refund reason beyond the standardized reason code. Captured by customer service agents or automated system messages in Salesforce CRM.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Case Notes; GDPR Article 5 (data minimisation)

attributes.name: refund_method
attributes.description: The channel or instrument through which the refund value is returned to the fan. ORIGINAL_PAYMENT reverses to the card/account used at purchase; CREDIT_WALLET posts to the fan's digital wallet; VOUCHER issues a future-use ticket credit. Governs SAP FI posting type.

attributes.name: refund_number

attributes.name: refund_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the refund request within the approval and processing workflow. Drives operational queues in Ticketmaster/AXS and SAP FI posting logic.

attributes.name: refund_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the refund covers the full ticket face value (FULL), a portion of the ticket value (PARTIAL), or is issued as a credit/voucher rather than a monetary return (CREDIT). Drives revenue recognition reversal logic in SAP CO.

attributes.name: rejection_reason

attributes.name: requested_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the fan or system initiated the refund request. Represents the principal business event time for the refund lifecycle. Used for SLA measurement and PCI-DSS audit trail.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 10.2; GDPR Article 12 (response timelines)

attributes.name: resale_refund_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the refund relates to a ticket purchased through the secondary/resale marketplace rather than the primary box office. Resale refunds may follow different policy rules and fee structures.

attributes.name: service_fee_refund_amount
