attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Cost Allocation; PCI DSS v4.0

attributes.name: sla_breach_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the refund processing exceeded the defined SLA target hours. Set to true when the elapsed time between approved_timestamp and processed_timestamp exceeds sla_target_hours. Drives escalation workflows.

attributes.name: sla_target_hours
attributes.description: The contracted or policy-defined maximum number of hours within which the refund must be processed from the point of approval. Used for SLA compliance monitoring and customer service KPI reporting.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record from which the refund record originated. Supports data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver layer and reconciliation across Ticketmaster/AXS, Archtics, and SAP S/4HANA.

attributes.name: source_system_refund_code
attributes.description: The native refund identifier as recorded in the originating operational system (e.g., Ticketmaster refund transaction ID, SAP FI document number). Enables cross-system reconciliation and audit trail back to the system of record.

attributes.name: tax_refund_amount

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the refund record was last modified in the system of record. Tracks state transitions through the approval workflow for audit and reconciliation purposes.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 10.2; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: voucher_code
attributes.description: The unique alphanumeric voucher code issued to the fan when refund_method is VOUCHER. Redeemable against future ticket purchases in Ticketmaster/AXS. Null for non-voucher refund methods.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster/AXS Voucher Management

attributes.name: voucher_expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which the issued refund voucher expires and can no longer be redeemed. Applicable only when refund_method is VOUCHER. Null for monetary refund methods.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster/AXS Voucher Policy; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: transfer_type

attributes.description: Household income band of the measured audience segment (e.g., Under $50K, $50K-$100K, $100K-$150K, $150K+). Used for premium advertiser targeting and sponsorship package valuation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Under $50K|$50K-$100K|$100K-$150K|$150K-$200K|$200K+ — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Nielsen Demographic Standards; MRC Audience Measurement Guidelines

attributes.name: demo_viewers_count
attributes.description: Number of viewers within the specific demographic segment (age band, gender, income band) defined for this record. Enables granular demographic reporting for advertiser guarantee reconciliation.
attributes.references: Nielsen; BARB; MRC Audience Measurement Guidelines

attributes.name: drm_protected
attributes.description: Indicates whether the broadcast content was delivered with DRM (Digital Rights Management) protection active during the measurement window. Relevant for OTT and IPTV platform compliance and piracy impact assessment on audience figures.
attributes.references: DRM (Digital Rights Management) Industry Standards; content.content_drm_policy

attributes.name: frequency
attributes.description: Average number of times a unique viewer was exposed to the broadcast during the measurement period. Used alongside reach to calculate GRP (Gross Rating Point) and assess advertising campaign effectiveness.
attributes.references: Nielsen; MRC Audience Measurement Guidelines; IAB

attributes.name: grp_value
attributes.description: Gross Rating Point value for this broadcast window, representing the sum of ratings across the target audience. Calculated as rating_pct multiplied by frequency. Primary currency for advertising inventory pricing and sponsorship valuation.
attributes.references: Nielsen; MRC GRP Standards; IAB (Interactive Advertising Bureau)

attributes.name: guarantee_met
attributes.description: Indicates whether the actual audience (total_viewers) met or exceeded the contractual audience guarantee target for this broadcast window. Drives make-good advertising inventory decisions and rights agreement penalty calculations.
attributes.references: Media Rights Agreement Standards; IAB Make-Good Standards

attributes.name: live_viewers
attributes.description: Number of viewers who watched the broadcast in real-time (live) as opposed to time-shifted. Distinguishes live audience from time-shifted for PPV event reporting and live sports rights valuation.
attributes.references: Nielsen Live+Same Day Standards; BARB; MRC

attributes.name: market_name
attributes.description: Name of the designated market area (DMA) or broadcast market within the territory (e.g., New York DMA, London ITV Region, Sydney Metro). Used for sub-national audience reporting and RSN rate card justification.
attributes.references: Nielsen DMA (Designated Market Area) Standards; BARB Regional Reporting

attributes.name: measurement_methodology
attributes.description: The data collection methodology used by the measurement source. Panel-based (Nielsen People Meter, BARB panel) uses a representative sample; Census measures all streams; Hybrid combines panel and census; Modeled uses statistical estimation; Self-Reported uses platform-provided data.
attributes.references: MRC (Media Rating Council) Accreditation Standards; Nielsen; BARB; Comscore

attributes.name: measurement_reference_code
attributes.description: Externally-known unique identifier assigned by the measurement provider (e.g., Nielsen panel ID, BARB survey code, OzTAM report reference, Comscore stream ID) for cross-system reconciliation.
attributes.references: Nielsen Audio/Video Measurement Standards; BARB (Broadcasters Audience Research Board); OzTAM; Comscore

attributes.name: measurement_source
attributes.description: The third-party or internal system that provided the audience measurement data. Determines methodology, panel composition, and credibility for advertiser and rights negotiations. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Nielsen|BARB|OzTAM|Comscore|Internal Streaming Analytics|Other — promote to reference product if additional sources are onboarded]
attributes.references: Nielsen; BARB; OzTAM; Comscore; FCC Broadcast Regulation

attributes.name: measurement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the audience rating record. Preliminary ratings are released within 24 hours; confirmed ratings are validated by the measurement provider; revised ratings incorporate late-reported data; final ratings are locked for contractual use; disputed ratings are under review.
attributes.references: Nielsen Fast Nationals / Live+Same Day Standards; MRC Audience Measurement Guidelines

attributes.name: peak_concurrent_viewers
attributes.description: Maximum number of viewers simultaneously watching the broadcast at any single minute during the window. Key metric for streaming platform capacity planning, CDN (Content Delivery Network) provisioning, and PPV event valuation.
attributes.references: Comscore Streaming Measurement; Nielsen Digital; Adobe Experience Platform Analytics

attributes.name: rating_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of the total universe of TV households or individuals that watched the broadcast, regardless of whether their TV was on. Distinct from share_pct which is based only on those actively viewing. Used for GRP (Gross Rating Point) calculation.
attributes.references: Nielsen; BARB; MRC Audience Measurement Guidelines

attributes.name: rating_type
attributes.description: Classification of the audience measurement metric captured in this record. GRP (Gross Rating Point) represents total delivery; CPM (Cost Per Mille) supports advertiser rate card justification; Reach measures unique audience; Frequency measures average exposures; AMA (Average Minute Audience) is the standard linear TV metric; Share is the percentage of viewing universe. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: GRP|CPM|Reach|Frequency|Viewership|AMA|Share — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Nielsen; BARB; MRC (Media Rating Council) Standards

attributes.name: reach
attributes.description: Total number of unique individuals who viewed at least one minute of the broadcast during the measured window. Distinct from total_viewers which may count repeat viewing. Used for unduplicated audience reporting to sponsors and rights holders.
attributes.references: Nielsen; BARB; MRC Audience Measurement Guidelines

attributes.name: reporting_period_type
attributes.description: Defines the time-shifted viewing window included in this measurement record per Nielsen and BARB standards. Live = real-time only; Live+1 includes same-day DVR; Live+3 includes 3-day playback; Live+7 includes 7-day playback; Live+35 is the C35 standard; VOD is on-demand only.
attributes.references: Nielsen Live+3 / Live+7 / C35 Standards; BARB VOSDAL; MRC

attributes.name: share_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of the total viewing universe (all households/individuals with TV/streaming access) that watched this broadcast during the window. Expressed as a decimal percentage (e.g., 12.500 = 12.5%). Core metric for competitive scheduling analysis.
attributes.references: Nielsen; BARB; MRC Audience Measurement Guidelines

attributes.name: sport_type
attributes.description: The sport or entertainment category of the broadcast content (e.g., NFL Football, NBA Basketball, FIFA Soccer, UFC MMA, Concert). Enables sport-specific audience trend analysis and rights valuation benchmarking. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: NFL Football|NBA Basketball|MLB Baseball|NHL Hockey|MLS Soccer|FIFA Soccer|UFC MMA|Tennis|Concert|Other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NFL; NBA; MLB; NHL; MLS; FIFA; UFC; ATP Governing Body Standards

attributes.name: territory_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code identifying the geographic territory in which the audience measurement was conducted. Critical for regional rights valuation, blackout rule enforcement, and RSN (Regional Sports Network) reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; FIFA; NFL; NBA; NHL; MLB; MLS Broadcast Rights Agreements

attributes.name: time_shifted_viewers
attributes.description: Number of viewers who watched the broadcast on a time-shifted basis (DVR, catch-up, VOD replay) within the measurement window. Reported separately per Nielsen Live+3 and Live+7 standards for contractual audience guarantee reconciliation.
attributes.references: Nielsen Live+3 / Live+7 Standards; BARB VOSDAL (Viewed on Same Day as Live)

attributes.name: total_viewers
attributes.description: Total number of individual viewers who watched the broadcast during the measured window. The primary headline metric used in media rights negotiations, advertiser rate cards, and contractual audience guarantees.
attributes.references: Nielsen; BARB; MRC Audience Measurement Guidelines

attributes.name: universe_size
attributes.description: Total size of the viewing universe (total TV households or individuals) used as the denominator for rating_pct and share_pct calculations in the given territory and demographic. Provided by the measurement source.
attributes.references: Nielsen Universe Estimates; BARB Universe Estimates; OzTAM

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this audience rating record was last modified, typically when preliminary ratings are revised or confirmed by the measurement provider. Supports audit trail and revised-rating reconciliation workflows.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; SOX Financial Controls; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity)

attributes.name: window_end_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the measured broadcast window ended. Combined with window_start_timestamp to define the exact measurement interval for AMA and share calculations.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; Nielsen Measurement Standards

attributes.name: window_start_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the measured broadcast window began, in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset. Used as the principal business event timestamp for scheduling optimization and rights valuation.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; FCC Broadcast Regulation

Records metric type (GRP delivered, CPM realized, impressions, reach, frequency, brand recall score, NPS lift, social media engagement rate, broadcast airtime seconds, in-venue dwell time), measurement period, actual value, contracted target value, variance, measurement methodology, and data source (Nielsen, Kantar, internal analytics). Feeds ROI reporting and renewal negotiations.

attributes.name: sponsor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the sponsor (brand/company) whose contracted KPI performance is being measured in this record.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Account Object

attributes.name: venue_id
attributes.description: Reference to the venue where in-venue sponsorship activations were measured. Relevant for naming rights, in-venue signage, and experiential activation metrics.
attributes.references: Sports Entertainment Venue Domain; ADA Venue Standards

attributes.name: activation_channel
attributes.description: The specific channel or placement through which the sponsorship was activated and measured. Covers broadcast TV, OTT (Over-The-Top) streaming, in-venue signage, jersey sponsorship, naming rights, digital display, social media, PPV (Pay-Per-View), and other channels. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: broadcast_tv|ott_streaming|in_venue_signage|jersey_sponsorship|naming_rights|digital_display|social_media|print|radio|ppv — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FCC Broadcast Regulations; Sports Entertainment Sponsorship Domain Standards

attributes.name: actual_value
attributes.description: The measured actual value delivered for this sponsorship KPI during the measurement period. Sourced from third-party measurement providers (Nielsen, Kantar) or internal analytics systems.
attributes.references: Nielsen Media Research; Kantar Brand Metrics; Adobe Experience Platform

attributes.name: brand_recall_score
attributes.description: Unaided or aided brand recall score measured via consumer survey panels (Kantar, Nielsen) during the measurement period. Expressed as a percentage of surveyed audience who recalled the sponsor brand in the context of the sports/entertainment property.
attributes.references: Kantar Brand Health Tracking; Nielsen Brand Effect

attributes.name: broadcast_airtime_seconds
attributes.description: Total number of seconds of broadcast airtime during which the sponsor's brand was visible or mentioned during the measurement period. Tracked via Dalet Galaxy broadcast workflow and third-party monitoring services.
attributes.references: Dalet Galaxy Media Asset Management; FCC Broadcast Standards

attributes.name: contracted_target_value
attributes.description: The agreed-upon target value for this KPI as stipulated in the sponsorship contract. Serves as the benchmark against which actual performance is measured for fulfillment and ROI reporting.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Contract KPI Terms; Sports Entertainment Sponsorship Contract Standards

attributes.name: cpm_realized
attributes.description: Actual Cost Per Mille (cost per 1,000 impressions) realized for this sponsorship activation during the measurement period. Used to benchmark media efficiency against contracted CPM rates and industry benchmarks.
attributes.references: IAB CPM Standards; Nielsen Media Research

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this performance metric record was first created in the system. Audit trail field for data lineage and compliance with SOX financial controls and GDPR data processing records.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act); GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity and Accountability)

attributes.name: data_source
attributes.description: The originating data source or measurement provider that supplied the actual metric value. Used for data lineage, audit, and credibility assessment in sponsor-facing ROI reports. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: nielsen|kantar|internal_analytics|adobe_experience_platform|social_platform_api|venue_analytics|manual — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Nielsen Media Research; Kantar Brand Metrics; Adobe Experience Platform

attributes.name: data_source_report_reference
attributes.description: The external report or file identifier from the measurement data source (e.g., Nielsen report ID, Kantar study reference number) that this metric record was derived from. Enables traceability back to the source measurement report.
attributes.references: Nielsen Media Research; Kantar Brand Metrics

attributes.name: frequency
attributes.description: Average number of times the target audience was exposed to the sponsorship asset (logo, brand mention, advertisement) during the measurement period. Component of GRP calculation.
attributes.references: Nielsen Media Research; GRP Industry Standard

attributes.name: fulfillment_status
attributes.description: Assessment of whether the contracted KPI target was met for this measurement period. Fulfilled = actual >= target; Partially Fulfilled = actual between 80-99% of target; Unfulfilled = actual < 80% of target; Over-Delivered = actual > 110% of target.
attributes.references: Sports Entertainment Sponsorship Fulfillment Standards; Salesforce CRM Contract Compliance

attributes.name: grp_delivered
attributes.description: Total Gross Rating Points delivered for broadcast and media sponsorship activations during the measurement period. GRP = Reach% × Frequency. Core broadcast sponsorship KPI used in media valuation and ROI reporting.
attributes.references: Nielsen Media Research; GRP Industry Standard (Reach × Frequency)

attributes.name: impressions
attributes.description: Total number of times the sponsor's brand asset (logo, advertisement, naming rights mention) was served or displayed across all channels (broadcast, digital, in-venue) during the measurement period.
attributes.references: IAB Impression Measurement Standards; Nielsen Media Research

attributes.name: in_venue_dwell_time_seconds
attributes.description: Average number of seconds fans spent in proximity to or engaged with in-venue sponsor activations (branded zones, experiential areas, digital signage) during the measurement period. Captured via venue analytics systems.
attributes.references: Sports Entertainment Venue Operations Analytics; ADA Venue Standards

attributes.name: is_contracted_kpi
attributes.description: Indicates whether this metric corresponds to a formally contracted KPI obligation in the sponsorship agreement (True) or is a supplementary/bonus metric tracked for additional insight (False). Drives fulfillment compliance reporting.
attributes.references: Sports Entertainment Sponsorship Contract Standards

attributes.name: make_good_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a make-good (compensatory delivery of additional sponsorship inventory) is required due to under-delivery against the contracted KPI target. Triggers make-good workflow in sponsorship fulfillment operations.
attributes.references: Sports Entertainment Sponsorship Contract Terms; Industry Make-Good Standards

attributes.name: measurement_methodology
attributes.description: The methodology used to capture and validate this performance metric. Determines the reliability and comparability of the measurement. Examples: panel survey (Nielsen/Kantar), set-top box data, digital pixel tracking, AI image recognition for logo exposure, manual audit. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: panel_survey|set_top_box|digital_pixel|manual_audit|ai_image_recognition|third_party_monitor|internal_analytics — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Nielsen Media Research Methodology; Kantar Measurement Standards; IAB Measurement Guidelines

attributes.name: measurement_period_end
attributes.description: End date of the measurement window during which the sponsorship KPI data was collected. Together with measurement_period_start defines the reporting interval.
attributes.references: Sports Entertainment Sponsorship Contract Terms

attributes.name: measurement_period_start
attributes.description: Start date of the measurement window during which the sponsorship KPI data was collected. Aligns with contracted reporting periods (weekly, monthly, quarterly, seasonal).
attributes.references: Sports Entertainment Sponsorship Contract Terms

attributes.name: measurement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of this performance metric record. Tracks the workflow from initial capture through sponsor verification and final acceptance used in renewal negotiations.
attributes.references: Sports Entertainment Sponsorship Fulfillment Workflow Standards

attributes.name: measurement_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when this performance metric observation was recorded or ingested from the measurement data source (Nielsen, Kantar, internal analytics platform). Represents the principal real-world event time.
attributes.references: Nielsen Media Research; Adobe Experience Platform

attributes.name: metric_category
attributes.description: High-level category grouping the metric type for reporting and ROI analysis. Enables aggregation across activation channels (broadcast, digital, in-venue, brand health, social media, print).
attributes.references: Sports Entertainment Sponsorship Domain Standards

attributes.name: metric_reference_code
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for this performance metric record, used in ROI reports, renewal negotiations, and sponsor-facing dashboards. Format: PM-YYYYMMDD-XXXX.
attributes.references: Sports Entertainment Sponsorship Operations Standards

attributes.name: metric_type
attributes.business_glossary_term: Sponsorship Key Performance Indicator (KPI) Metric Type
attributes.description: Classification of the sponsorship KPI being measured. Covers broadcast, digital, in-venue, and brand health metrics. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: grp_delivered|cpm_realized|impressions|reach|frequency|brand_recall_score|nps_lift|social_engagement_rate|broadcast_airtime_seconds|in_venue_dwell_time|jersey_logo_exposure|naming_rights_mention|digital_banner_clicks|share_of_voice — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Nielsen Media Research Standards; Kantar Brand Metrics; GRP/CPM Industry Standards

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for capturing contextual notes, measurement caveats, methodology exceptions, or sponsor feedback related to this performance metric record. Used by sponsorship account managers during review and renewal negotiations.
attributes.references: Sports Entertainment Sponsorship Operations Standards

attributes.name: nps_lift
attributes.description: Change in Net Promoter Score for the sponsor brand attributable to the sponsorship activation, measured via fan/consumer surveys. Positive values indicate brand sentiment improvement driven by the partnership.
attributes.references: Bain & Company NPS Methodology; Kantar Brand Metrics

attributes.name: reach_000s
attributes.description: Total unique audience reached by the sponsorship activation during the measurement period, expressed in thousands. Sourced from Nielsen or Kantar audience measurement panels.
attributes.references: Nielsen Media Research; Kantar Audience Measurement

attributes.name: reporting_period_type
attributes.description: The cadence or granularity of the measurement reporting period. Aligns with contractual reporting obligations to sponsors (weekly, monthly, quarterly, seasonal, annual, or tied to a specific event).
attributes.references: Sports Entertainment Sponsorship Contract Terms

attributes.name: social_engagement_rate
attributes.description: Percentage engagement rate for sponsor-related social media content during the measurement period ((likes + comments + shares + saves) / total impressions × 100). Sourced from Adobe Experience Platform social analytics.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform Analytics; IAB Social Media Measurement Standards

attributes.name: sponsor_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the sponsor has formally reviewed and accepted this performance metric measurement as accurate. Required for final ROI reporting and renewal negotiation documentation.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Sponsor Relationship Management; Sports Entertainment Sponsorship Governance

attributes.name: sponsor_verified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the sponsor formally verified and accepted this performance metric measurement. Null if sponsor_verified is False.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM; Sports Entertainment Sponsorship Governance

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit in which the metric value is expressed. Examples: seconds (broadcast airtime), impressions (digital/broadcast), GRP points (Gross Rating Points), CPM USD (Cost Per Mille in USD), score (brand recall/NPS), percentage (engagement rate). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: seconds|impressions|grp_points|cpm_usd|score|percentage|mentions|clicks|views|reach_000s — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Nielsen Media Research Standards; IAB Measurement Standards

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this performance metric record was most recently modified. Supports audit trail requirements, Silver Layer incremental processing, and SOX financial reporting controls.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act); GDPR Article 5; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer Standards

attributes.name: variance_pct
attributes.description: Percentage variance of actual performance against the contracted target value ((actual - target) / target * 100). Used in sponsor ROI dashboards and renewal negotiation scorecards.
attributes.references: Sports Entertainment Sponsorship ROI Reporting Standards

attributes.name: variance_value
attributes.description: Absolute difference between actual_value and contracted_target_value (actual minus target). Positive values indicate over-delivery; negative values indicate under-delivery against contracted KPI obligations.
attributes.references: Sports Entertainment Sponsorship ROI Reporting Standards

products.name: payment_schedule

Captures milestone name, due date, payment amount, payment type (cash, VIK, barter), invoice reference, payment status (scheduled, invoiced, received, overdue), and SAP S/4HANA FI document number. Supports accounts receivable tracking and cash flow forecasting for the finance domain.

attributes.description: Reference to the sponsor (brand or corporate entity) responsible for this payment obligation. Supports accounts receivable aging and sponsor-level cash flow reporting.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Account Object

attributes.name: adjustment_amount
attributes.description: Monetary adjustment applied to the scheduled amount for this milestone, including contractual discounts, performance-based deductions, early payment incentives, or penalty surcharges. Negative values represent reductions; positive values represent surcharges.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI — Discount/Surcharge Conditions; Sponsorship Contract Addendum

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA Controlling (CO) cost center code associated with the business unit responsible for fulfilling the sponsorship obligations tied to this payment milestone. Supports internal profitability analysis and EBITDA reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO — Cost Center Accounting; EBITDA Reporting

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this payment schedule milestone record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and SOX financial controls compliance.
attributes.references: SOX — Financial Record Audit Trail; SAP S/4HANA FI — Document Creation

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the payment milestone amounts (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP, AUD). Supports multi-currency sponsorship deals across global markets.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 — Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA FI Multi-Currency

attributes.name: days_overdue
attributes.description: Number of calendar days this payment milestone is past its due_date without confirmed receipt. Calculated as current date minus due_date when payment_status is 'overdue'. Used for accounts receivable aging buckets and collections escalation triggers.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI — AR Aging; GAAP Accounts Receivable

attributes.name: dispute_raised_date
attributes.description: Date on which the sponsor formally raised a dispute for this payment milestone. Null if no dispute has been raised. Used to track dispute resolution SLA compliance and aging.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Case Date; SLA Compliance

attributes.name: dispute_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the reason provided by the sponsor for disputing this payment milestone. Populated when payment_status is 'disputed'. Supports dispute resolution tracking and contract management.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Case/Dispute Management; Sponsorship Contract Governance

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: Contractually agreed date by which the sponsor must remit this payment milestone. Used for accounts receivable aging, overdue detection, and cash flow forecasting in Workday Adaptive Planning.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI — Net Due Date; Sponsorship Contract Terms

attributes.name: dunning_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent dunning (collections) notice was issued to the sponsor for this overdue payment milestone. Null if no dunning has been initiated. Used to track collections activity and enforce escalation timelines.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI — Dunning Date; Accounts Receivable

attributes.name: dunning_level
attributes.description: Current dunning (collections escalation) level for this overdue payment milestone, as managed in SAP S/4HANA FI dunning procedures. Level 0 = no dunning initiated; higher levels indicate escalating collection notices sent to the sponsor.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI — Dunning Procedure; Accounts Receivable Collections

attributes.name: early_payment_discount_date
attributes.description: Last date by which the sponsor must remit payment to qualify for the early payment discount on this milestone. Null if no early payment discount applies.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI — Cash Discount Date; Payment Terms

attributes.name: early_payment_discount_pct
attributes.description: Percentage discount offered to the sponsor for early payment of this milestone, as defined in the payment terms (e.g., 2.00 for a 2% early payment discount). Null if no early payment discount applies.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI — Cash Discount; Sponsorship Contract Terms

attributes.name: forecast_period
attributes.description: Fiscal quarter in which this payment milestone is expected to be received for cash flow forecasting purposes, formatted as YYYY-Q{N} (e.g., 2025-Q2). Used in Workday Adaptive Planning for sponsorship revenue forecasting and EBITDA projections.
attributes.references: Workday Adaptive Planning — Revenue Forecast; EBITDA Reporting

attributes.name: invoice_date
attributes.description: Date on which the invoice was formally issued to the sponsor for this payment milestone. Establishes the billing cycle start for payment terms calculation and revenue recognition timing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI — Billing Date; ASC 606 Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: late_fee_amount
attributes.description: Contractual late payment penalty fee assessed against the sponsor for overdue payment of this milestone, as defined in the sponsorship deal terms. Expressed in the deal currency. Zero or null if no late fee applies or has been assessed.
attributes.references: Sponsorship Contract Terms; SAP S/4HANA FI — Dunning Charges

attributes.name: milestone_name
attributes.description: Descriptive label for this payment milestone as defined in the sponsorship contract (e.g., 'Q1 Installment', 'Season Opener Activation Fee', 'Signing Bonus', 'Annual Naming Rights Fee'). Used in sponsor communications and invoice descriptions.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Contract Milestone

attributes.name: milestone_sequence
attributes.description: Ordinal position of this payment milestone within the overall deal payment schedule (e.g., 1 = first installment, 2 = second installment). Supports chronological ordering and installment tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI — Payment Plan Item Sequence

attributes.name: net_amount
attributes.description: Final net amount due after applying all adjustments to the scheduled amount (scheduled_amount + adjustment_amount). This is the amount reflected on the issued invoice and tracked in SAP S/4HANA accounts receivable.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI — Net Invoice Amount; ASC 606

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, internal commentary, or special instructions related to this payment milestone (e.g., 'Sponsor requested 30-day extension per email dated 2025-01-15', 'VIK to be fulfilled via stadium signage Q2'). For internal use by the sponsorship and finance teams.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Notes; SAP S/4HANA FI — Text Field

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Instrument or mechanism used by the sponsor to remit this payment (e.g., wire_transfer, ACH, check, credit_card, direct_debit, offset). Distinct from payment_type which captures the consideration form. Used for treasury reconciliation and PCI-DSS compliance tracking.
attributes.references: PCI-DSS — Payment Processing; SAP S/4HANA FI — Payment Method

attributes.name: payment_reference
attributes.description: Sponsor-provided remittance reference or bank transaction reference number accompanying the payment. Used for automated cash application and matching in SAP S/4HANA accounts receivable.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI — Payment Reference; Bank Statement Processing

attributes.name: payment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of this payment milestone. 'scheduled' = not yet invoiced; 'invoiced' = invoice issued awaiting receipt; 'received' = funds confirmed; 'overdue' = past due date without receipt; 'cancelled' = milestone voided; 'disputed' = sponsor has raised a formal dispute.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI — Accounts Receivable Item Status

attributes.name: payment_terms_code
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA payment terms code governing the due date calculation and early payment discount conditions for this milestone (e.g., 'NET30', 'NET60', '2/10NET30'). Derived from the sponsorship deal contract terms.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI — Payment Terms; Sponsorship Contract

attributes.name: payment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the payment consideration form. 'cash' = monetary wire/ACH/check; 'VIK' = Value-In-Kind (goods or services in lieu of cash); 'barter' = reciprocal exchange of services; 'offset' = applied against a credit balance; 'credit_note' = formal credit adjustment. Drives revenue recognition treatment under ASC 606.
attributes.references: ASC 606 — Revenue from Contracts with Customers; SAP S/4HANA FI Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: profit_center_code
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA Controlling (CO) profit center code for revenue attribution of this payment milestone. Enables segment-level P&L reporting by league, venue, or business unit for management accounting and ROI analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO — Profit Center Accounting; ROI Reporting

attributes.name: received_amount
attributes.description: Actual amount received from the sponsor for this milestone. May differ from net_amount in cases of partial payment, short payment, or currency conversion variance. Null until payment is received.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI — Clearing Amount; Accounts Receivable

attributes.name: received_date
attributes.description: Actual date on which the sponsor's payment was confirmed as received and cleared in the bank or SAP FI clearing account. Null when payment has not yet been received. Used for days-sales-outstanding (DSO) calculation and cash flow actuals.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI — Clearing Date; Accounts Receivable

attributes.name: revenue_recognition_date
attributes.description: Date on which the revenue associated with this payment milestone is recognized in the financial statements under ASC 606 / IFRS 15. May differ from the received_date for multi-period or performance-obligation-based sponsorship deals.
attributes.references: ASC 606 — Revenue Recognition; IFRS 15; SAP S/4HANA FI Revenue Accounting

attributes.name: promotion_type

attributes.name: requires_loyalty_membership

attributes.name: source_system

products.name: supplier_category_authorization
products.description: This association product represents the formal Contract between a merchandise supplier and a product category, capturing the authorization for that supplier to produce goods in that category under defined commercial terms. Each record documents one supplier's approval to manufacture or supply a specific product category, including pricing, lead time, order minimums, preferred status, and the validity window of the authorization. This is the operational Approved Supplier List at the category level, distinct from the licensing_agreement (which governs IP rights with the licensor) and from the sku_catalog (which represents resulting products).. Existence Justification: In licensed merchandise operations, a supplier is formally approved to produce specific product categories under defined commercial terms — this is the 'Approved Supplier Category Agreement' or 'Supplier Category Authorization'. A single supplier can be authorized to produce multiple product categories (e.g., Apparel AND Accessories), and a single product category can be produced by multiple approved suppliers. This is an actively managed operational record: procurement teams create, update, and expire these authorizations as part of sourcing and brand compliance workflows.

products.name: collection_item
products.description: This association product represents the membership relationship between a content collection and a digital asset in the Dalet Galaxy DAM. It captures the operational fact that a specific asset has been curated into a specific collection, including its position in the sequence, when it was added, who added it, and whether it is featured within that collection. Each record links one collection to one asset with attributes that exist only in the context of this membership relationship — not on the collection or asset alone.. Existence Justification: In DAM (Digital Asset Management) operations for sports entertainment, a content collection is explicitly defined as a curated grouping of multiple assets (highlight reels, playlists, galleries), and any single asset (a video clip, photo, article) can appear in multiple collections simultaneously — e.g., a LeBron James dunk clip may appear in a 'Top 10 Plays' collection, a 'Lakers Season Highlights' collection, and a 'PPV Event Bundle'. This is a foundational operational relationship in Dalet Galaxy DAM, where collection membership is actively managed by editorial staff with ordering, featured flags, and timestamps. The relationship is a recognized business entity ('collection membership' or 'collection item') that humans create, reorder, feature, and remove as part of daily content operations.

attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association PK

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the digital content asset that is a member of the collection.
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association FK

attributes.name: collection_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the parent content collection that contains this asset membership record.
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association FK

attributes.description: Ordinal position of the asset within the collection sequence. Drives playback order for playlists and display order for galleries. Belongs to the membership relationship, not to the asset or collection independently.

products.name: asset_tag
products.description: This association product represents the tagging event between a content asset and a controlled vocabulary metadata tag in the Dalet Galaxy DAM. It captures the operational record of each tag application — whether performed by an editorial user, an AI auto-tagging pipeline, or a bulk ingest process. Each record links one asset to one metadata tag and carries attributes that exist only in the context of that specific tagging action: when it was applied, by whom or what system, via which method, and with what AI confidence. This is the authoritative source of truth for all asset-tag associations across OTT, broadcast, and digital platforms.. Existence Justification: In DAM (Digital Asset Management) operations, a single content asset (e.g., a match highlight video) is tagged with MULTIPLE controlled vocabulary metadata tags simultaneously — sport, league, team, athlete, event type, mood, content rating, etc. Conversely, a single metadata tag (e.g., 'Premier League') is applied to thousands of assets. This is the canonical M:N relationship in every DAM system: content tagging. The business actively manages these tag applications through editorial workflows, AI auto-tagging pipelines, and compliance review processes — each tagging event carries its own operational data (who tagged it, when, how, with what confidence).

products.name: season
products.description: Defines a competitive season calendar and postseason structure for a league. Includes playoff/postseason bracket definition: bracket format (single elimination, best-of-series), number of rounds, seeding methodology, bye rules, home-court/field advantage rules, bracket position assignments per franchise, advancement status, and series results through each round to championship. Anchors all scheduling, standings, draft, and compliance calculations.

attributes.name: international_broadcast_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this game has international broadcast rights activated beyond the domestic market. Triggers GDPR-compliant geo-restriction logic for OTT/DTC streaming platforms and international media rights window management in Dalet Galaxy.

attributes.name: is_home_away_reversed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the standard home/away designation has been reversed for this game (e.g., a team plays a 'home' game at the opponent's venue due to facility unavailability or international series). Used for scheduling balance audits and CBA home game count compliance.

attributes.name: is_neutral_site

attributes.name: matchday_label
attributes.description: Human-readable label for the scheduling period as published by the league (e.g., 'Matchday 12', 'Week 7', 'Round of 16', 'Wild Card Weekend', 'Opening Day'). Used in fan-facing communications, broadcast graphics, and digital content distribution.
attributes.references: FIFA, MLS, NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL Official Schedule Publications

attributes.name: original_scheduled_date
attributes.description: The initially published league calendar date for this game before any postponement or rescheduling. Retained for audit trail, rescheduling impact analysis, and CBA transaction window compliance verification. Null if the game has never been rescheduled.
attributes.references: CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement) Compliance; NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, MLS, FIFA Governance

attributes.name: original_start_time

attributes.name: postponement_reason
attributes.description: Categorized reason for a game postponement or cancellation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: weather|facility_issue|public_safety|broadcast_conflict|force_majeure|covid_protocol|labor_dispute|bereavement|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ISO 20121 Event Sustainability; NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, MLS, FIFA Force Majeure Provisions; OSHA

attributes.name: ppv_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this game is designated as a Pay-Per-View (PPV) broadcast event, requiring separate consumer purchase beyond standard subscription. Affects OTT/DTC revenue recognition, broadcast rights activation, and FCC PPV reporting requirements.

attributes.name: published_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and timestamp when this schedule record was officially published by the league to external stakeholders (teams, broadcasters, ticketing partners, fans). Represents the business event time of schedule release, distinct from internal record creation.

attributes.name: round_number
attributes.description: The round or matchday number within the season or tournament phase (e.g., FIFA Matchday 12, MLB Series Game 3, NBA Playoff Round 2). Used for bracket progression, standings, and competition governance. Null for week-based league formats.
attributes.references: FIFA, MLS, MLB, NBA Playoff Competition Rules

attributes.name: salary_cap_window_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this game date falls within a salary cap compliance reporting window as defined by the applicable CBA. Used by league finance and compliance teams to trigger cap audit checkpoints aligned to the competitive calendar.
attributes.references: CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement) Salary Cap Provisions; NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, MLS Salary Cap Rules

attributes.name: scheduled_date
attributes.description: The official league-published calendar date on which the game is scheduled to be played (yyyy-MM-dd). Used as the primary planning date for event operations, venue staffing, and broadcast scheduling. Represents the current confirmed date (may differ from original_scheduled_date if rescheduled).
attributes.references: NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, MLS, FIFA Season Calendar Standards

attributes.name: scheduled_start_time
attributes.description: The precise date and timestamp (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX) at which the game is scheduled to begin, including timezone offset. Used for broadcast slot coordination, gate opening logistics, and fan notification via Adobe Experience Platform.
attributes.references: FCC Broadcast Regulation; NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, MLS, FIFA Scheduling Standards

attributes.name: scheduling_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the scheduled game. Drives downstream event operations, broadcast slot management, ticketing refund workflows (Ticketmaster/AXS), and standings calculation eligibility. Confirmed = league-approved and published; Postponed = delayed with new date TBD; Cancelled = permanently removed; Rescheduled = new date assigned; Pending = awaiting league confirmation; Suspended = mid-game stoppage requiring resumption.
attributes.references: NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, MLS, FIFA Competition Governance Rules; ISO 20121 Event Sustainability

attributes.name: season_phase
attributes.description: The phase of the competitive season in which this game falls. Drives CBA transaction window rules (e.g., trade deadlines, roster eligibility), salary cap compliance windows, and broadcast rights tier activation.
attributes.references: CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement); NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, MLS, FIFA Competition Rules

attributes.name: series_game_number
attributes.description: The sequential game number within a playoff or regular-season series between the same two franchises (e.g., Game 3 of 7 in an NBA Playoff series, Game 2 of 3 in an MLB series). Null for non-series single-game matchups.
attributes.references: NBA, MLB, NHL Playoff Series Rules; FIFA, MLS Competition Governance

attributes.name: series_game_total
attributes.description: The maximum number of games in the series to which this game belongs (e.g., best-of-7 = 7, best-of-5 = 5, two-game series = 2). Used alongside series_game_number for bracket progression logic and playoff scheduling management.
attributes.references: NBA, MLB, NHL Playoff Series Rules; FIFA, MLS Competition Governance

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record from which this schedule record originated (e.g., TICKETMASTER, AXS, SAP_SD, ARCHTICS, LEAGUE_API). Required for data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver layer and cross-system reconciliation.
attributes.references: Databricks Lakehouse Data Lineage Standards; SAP S/4HANA SD; Ticketmaster/AXS; Archtics

attributes.name: ticket_on_sale_date
attributes.description: The date on which tickets for this game become available for public purchase via Ticketmaster/AXS and DTC (Direct-To-Consumer) channels. Drives fan engagement campaign scheduling in Adobe Experience Platform and Salesforce CRM outreach workflows.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster/AXS Ticketing Standards; PCI-DSS (Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard)

attributes.name: timezone
attributes.description: IANA timezone identifier for the venue location where the game is played (e.g., 'America/New_York', 'Europe/London', 'Asia/Tokyo'). Required for accurate broadcast scheduling, fan notification timing, and international rights window management.
attributes.references: IANA Time Zone Database; FCC Broadcast Scheduling Standards; FIFA International Match Standards

attributes.name: transaction_window_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether this game falls within a CBA-defined transaction window (e.g., trade deadline, waiver period, roster freeze). Critical for league compliance officers to validate that no prohibited roster moves occurred in the window surrounding this game.
attributes.references: CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement) Transaction Window Rules; NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, MLS League Offices

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and timestamp when this schedule record was most recently modified. Used for change data capture (CDC) in the Databricks Silver layer, downstream broadcast and ticketing system synchronization, and audit trail compliance.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) Audit Trail Requirements; GDPR Article 5 Data Integrity; Databricks Lakehouse CDC Standards

attributes.name: var_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether Video Assistant Referee (VAR) or equivalent video review technology (e.g., TMO in rugby, instant replay in NFL/NBA/MLB) is activated for this game. Drives broadcast production requirements (OB truck setup) and officiating crew composition.
attributes.references: FIFA VAR Protocol; NFL Instant Replay Rules; NBA Replay Center Standards; TMO (Television Match Official) Protocols

attributes.name: weather_condition
attributes.description: Categorized weather condition at game time for outdoor or open-air venues. attributes.references: OSHA Venue Safety Standards; ISO 20121 Event Sustainability Management

attributes.name: week_number
attributes.description: The sequential week number within the season calendar (e.g., NFL Week 1 through Week 18). Used for standings calculations, bye week tracking, and scheduling balance analysis. Applicable primarily to weekly-format leagues (NFL, NHL, NBA). Null for round-based or matchday-based competitions.
attributes.references: NFL, NHL, NBA Scheduling Standards; CBA Scheduling Provisions

products.name: standing
products.description: Periodic snapshot of competitive standings for a franchise within a division, conference, and league for a given season. Tracks wins, losses, ties/draws, overtime losses, points (hockey/soccer), winning percentage, games behind leader, home/away/divisional/conference records, goal/run/point differential, current streak, last-10 record, strength of schedule, clinch/elimination status, and standings rank. Updated after each official game result. Drives playoff qualification logic and tiebreaker resolution.

attributes.name: division_id

attributes.description: Reference to the competitive season (e.g., 2024-25 NBA season) for which this standing snapshot applies.

attributes.name: away_losses
attributes.description: Total number of losses recorded in away (road) games as of the snapshot date.
attributes.references: NFL League Office; NBA League Office; MLB Commissioner's Office; NHL Board of Governors; MLS

attributes.name: away_ties
attributes.description: Total number of ties or draws recorded in away (road) games. Applicable in MLS, FIFA, and NFL regular season formats.

attributes.name: away_wins
attributes.description: Total number of wins recorded in away (road) games as of the snapshot date. Used in tiebreaker resolution.
attributes.references: NFL League Office; NBA League Office; MLB Commissioner's Office; NHL Board of Governors; MLS

attributes.name: clinch_indicator
attributes.description: Standard league clinch/elimination indicator code displayed in standings: x = clinched playoff berth, y = clinched division title, z = clinched best record in conference, e = eliminated from playoff contention, w = clinched best overall record, p = clinched home-field advantage. Null if no clinch or elimination status applies.
attributes.references: NFL League Office; NBA League Office; MLB Commissioner's Office; NHL Board of Governors; MLS

attributes.name: conference_losses
attributes.description: Total number of losses recorded against conference opponents as of the snapshot date.
attributes.references: NFL League Office; NBA League Office; NHL Board of Governors

attributes.name: conference_rank
attributes.description: Ordinal rank of the franchise within its conference as of the snapshot date. Used for playoff seeding and wild card qualification.
attributes.references: NFL League Office; NBA League Office; NHL Board of Governors

attributes.name: conference_wins
attributes.description: Total number of wins recorded against conference opponents as of the snapshot date. Used as a tiebreaker criterion in NFL, NBA, and NHL standings.
attributes.references: NFL League Office; NBA League Office; NHL Board of Governors

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this standing snapshot record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports audit trail and data lineage tracking.
attributes.references: SOX; GDPR Article 5; ISO 20121

attributes.name: current_streak_count
attributes.description: Number of consecutive games in the current streak of the same result type (wins, losses, or ties). Combined with current_streak_type to express the full streak.
attributes.references: NFL League Office; NBA League Office; MLB Commissioner's Office; NHL Board of Governors; MLS

attributes.name: current_streak_type
attributes.description: Type of the franchise's current consecutive result streak: W (Win), L (Loss), T (Tie), or D (Draw). Combined with current_streak_count to express the full streak (e.g., W5 = five consecutive wins).
attributes.references: NFL League Office; NBA League Office; MLB Commissioner's Office; NHL Board of Governors; MLS

attributes.name: division_losses
attributes.description: Total number of losses recorded against divisional opponents as of the snapshot date.
attributes.references: NFL League Office; NBA League Office; MLB Commissioner's Office; NHL Board of Governors

attributes.name: division_rank
attributes.description: Ordinal rank of the franchise within its division as of the snapshot date. Rank 1 indicates the division leader. Used for playoff seeding and tiebreaker resolution.
attributes.references: NFL League Office; NBA League Office; MLB Commissioner's Office; NHL Board of Governors; MLS

attributes.name: division_wins
attributes.description: Total number of wins recorded against divisional opponents as of the snapshot date. A primary tiebreaker criterion in NFL, NBA, MLB, and NHL standings.
attributes.references: NFL League Office; NBA League Office; MLB Commissioner's Office; NHL Board of Governors

attributes.name: elimination_number
attributes.description: Combined number of losses by the trailing team and wins by the leading competitor that would result in mathematical elimination from playoff contention. Null when already eliminated or clinched.
attributes.references: MLB Commissioner's Office; NBA League Office; NHL Board of Governors

attributes.name: games_behind
attributes.description: Number of games the franchise trails the division or conference leader in the standings. A value of 0.0 indicates the franchise is tied for or holds the lead. Calculated as ((leader_wins - team_wins) + (team_losses - leader_losses)) / 2.
attributes.references: MLB Commissioner's Office; NBA League Office; NFL League Office

attributes.name: games_played
attributes.description: Total number of official regular season or applicable competition games played by the franchise as of the snapshot date.
attributes.references: NFL League Office; NBA League Office; MLB Commissioner's Office; NHL Board of Governors; MLS

attributes.name: home_losses
attributes.description: Total number of losses recorded in home venue games as of the snapshot date.
attributes.references: NFL League Office; NBA League Office; MLB Commissioner's Office; NHL Board of Governors; MLS

attributes.name: home_ties
attributes.description: Total number of ties or draws recorded in home venue games. Applicable in MLS, FIFA, and NFL regular season formats.
attributes.references: MLS; FIFA; NFL League Office

attributes.name: home_wins
attributes.description: Total number of wins recorded in home venue games as of the snapshot date. Used in tiebreaker resolution and home-field advantage analysis.
attributes.references: NFL League Office; NBA League Office; MLB Commissioner's Office; NHL Board of Governors; MLS

attributes.name: last10_losses
attributes.description: Number of losses in the franchise's most recent 10 official games. Combined with last10_wins to express the last-10 record (e.g., 7-3).
attributes.references: NBA League Office; NHL Board of Governors; MLB Commissioner's Office

attributes.name: last10_wins
attributes.description: Number of wins in the franchise's most recent 10 official games. Used as a recent form indicator in standings displays and playoff race analysis.
attributes.references: NBA League Office; NHL Board of Governors; MLB Commissioner's Office

attributes.name: league_rank
attributes.description: Ordinal rank of the franchise across the entire league as of the snapshot date. Used for draft order determination and overall competitive positioning.
attributes.references: NFL League Office; NBA League Office; MLB Commissioner's Office; NHL Board of Governors; MLS

attributes.name: losses
attributes.description: Total number of official games lost by the franchise in regulation, overtime, or shootout as of the snapshot date.
attributes.references: NFL League Office; NBA League Office; MLB Commissioner's Office; NHL Board of Governors; MLS

attributes.name: magic_number
attributes.description: Combined number of wins by the leading team and losses by the closest competitor needed to clinch a division title or playoff berth. Null when not applicable or when already clinched/eliminated.
attributes.references: MLB Commissioner's Office; NBA League Office; NHL Board of Governors

attributes.name: overtime_losses
attributes.description: Total number of games lost in overtime or shootout. Used primarily in NHL standings where an overtime loss earns one point. Null or zero for leagues without overtime loss distinction.
attributes.references: NHL Board of Governors

attributes.name: playoff_seed
attributes.description: Projected or confirmed playoff seeding position for the franchise based on current standings. Determines bracket placement, home-field advantage, and first-round matchups. Null if the franchise is eliminated or the playoff field is not yet determined.
attributes.references: NFL League Office; NBA League Office; MLB Commissioner's Office; NHL Board of Governors; MLS

attributes.name: points
attributes.description: Total standings points accumulated by the franchise. Used in NHL (2 pts per win, 1 pt per OTL), MLS, and FIFA competition formats. Null for leagues using winning percentage as the primary ranking metric.
attributes.references: NHL Board of Governors; MLS; FIFA

attributes.name: run_differential
attributes.description: Net difference between total runs/goals/points scored and total runs/goals/points allowed across all games. Positive values indicate the franchise scores more than it concedes. Used as a tiebreaker and competitive health indicator across MLB (runs), NHL/MLS/FIFA (goals), and NBA (points).
attributes.references: MLB Commissioner's Office; NHL Board of Governors; MLS; FIFA; NBA League Office

attributes.name: runs_allowed
attributes.description: Total runs (MLB), goals (NHL/MLS/FIFA), or points (NBA/NFL) allowed by the franchise across all applicable games as of the snapshot date.
attributes.references: MLB Commissioner's Office; NHL Board of Governors; MLS; FIFA; NBA League Office; NFL League Office

attributes.name: runs_scored
attributes.description: Total runs (MLB), goals (NHL/MLS/FIFA), or points (NBA/NFL) scored by the franchise across all applicable games as of the snapshot date.
attributes.references: MLB Commissioner's Office; NHL Board of Governors; MLS; FIFA; NBA League Office; NFL League Office

attributes.name: snapshot_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which this standings snapshot was captured, typically updated after each official game result is processed.
attributes.references: NFL League Office; NBA League Office; MLB Commissioner's Office; NHL Board of Governors; MLS

attributes.name: standing_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this standing record: active (season in progress), clinched (playoff berth secured), eliminated (mathematically eliminated from playoff contention), pending (awaiting game result), or final (season concluded).
attributes.references: NFL League Office; NBA League Office; MLB Commissioner's Office; NHL Board of Governors

attributes.name: standings_type
attributes.description: Classification of the standings context: regular season, postseason, preseason, tournament group stage, or playoff bracket. Determines which game results are included in the standing calculation.
attributes.references: NFL League Office; NBA League Office; MLB Commissioner's Office; NHL Board of Governors; FIFA

attributes.name: strength_of_schedule
attributes.description: Composite metric representing the combined winning percentage of all opponents faced by the franchise as of the snapshot date. Used as a tiebreaker criterion in NFL standings and for playoff seeding analysis.
attributes.references: NFL League Office; NBA League Office

attributes.name: ties
attributes.description: Total number of official games ending in a tie or draw (applicable in MLS, FIFA, and NFL regular season). Null or zero for leagues that do not permit ties.
attributes.references: MLS; FIFA; NFL League Office

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this standing snapshot record was last modified, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Updated after each official game result is processed and standings are recalculated.
attributes.references: SOX; GDPR Article 5; ISO 20121

attributes.name: wild_card_rank
attributes.description: Ordinal rank of the franchise among wild card contenders within its conference or league. Null if the franchise has clinched a division title or is eliminated from wild card contention.
attributes.references: NFL League Office; NBA League Office; MLB Commissioner's Office; NHL Board of Governors

attributes.name: win_pct
attributes.description: Winning percentage calculated as wins divided by games played (ties count as half a win in applicable leagues). Primary ranking metric in MLB and NBA standings.
attributes.references: MLB Commissioner's Office; NBA League Office; NFL League Office

attributes.name: wins
attributes.description: Total number of official games won by the franchise in regulation, overtime, or shootout as of the snapshot date.
attributes.references: NFL League Office; NBA League Office; MLB Commissioner's Office; NHL Board of Governors; MLS

attributes.name: luxury_tax_threshold

attributes.name: mid_level_exception_amount

attributes.name: penalty_amount

attributes.name: player_share_percentage
attributes.description: The CBA-defined percentage of total league revenue allocated to player salaries and benefits for the cap year. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.5100 = 51%). Drives cap calculation methodology.
attributes.references: CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement); NBA League Office; NFL Governance Office; SOX

attributes.name: practice_squad_charges

attributes.name: record_type

attributes.name: snapshot_timestamp

attributes.name: soft_cap_amount

attributes.name: total_league_revenue_basis

products.name: draft
products.description: Master record for a league player draft event and all individual pick selections. At the event level: draft year, sport, number of rounds, total picks, draft format (live, virtual, hybrid), draft date and location, eligibility class (college, international, supplemental), draft order determination method (lottery, inverse standings, coin flip), and draft status. At the pick level: round number, overall pick number, current owning franchise, original owning franchise (if traded), full trade history chain, compensatory/conditional pick flags, pick protection level (top-N protected), pick status (available, traded, exercised, forfeited, voided), and selected athlete reference upon exercise. Supports draft asset management, trade analysis, and future pick valuation models.

products.description: This association product represents the Assignment between an official and a game_result. It captures the formal crew assignment record created by the league officiating bureau for each game, recording which official served in which crew role for a specific game result, along with per-game performance grading, VAR/TMO intervention tracking, and conflict-of-interest clearance. Each record links one official to one game_result and carries attributes that exist only in the context of that specific assignment.. Existence Justification: In professional sports leagues, each game is officiated by a multi-person crew (head referee, linesmen, VAR operators, etc.), meaning one game_result is associated with multiple officials. Simultaneously, each official works many games per season. The league officiating department actively manages these crew assignments as a formal business process — creating, updating, and tracking them with role, performance grade, and conflict-of-interest data that belongs to neither the official nor the game result alone.

attributes.name: official_assignment_id
attributes.description: Primary key for the official_assignment association
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association PK

attributes.name: game_result_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the official game result record for which this crew assignment was made
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association FK

attributes.name: official_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the assigned game official (referee, umpire, linesman, VAR operator, etc.)
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association FK

attributes.name: assignment_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the officiating bureau formally issued this crew assignment to the official. Used for lead-time tracking and conflict-of-interest window calculations.
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association Attribute

attributes.name: conflict_of_interest_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a conflict-of-interest concern was raised or reviewed for this specific official-game pairing (e.g., official has a known affiliation with one of the competing franchises). Managed per-assignment by the officiating bureau's integrity unit.
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association Attribute

attributes.name: crew_role
attributes.description: The specific officiating role this official performed in this game (e.g., Head Referee, Linesman, VAR Operator, TMO, Umpire). Distinct from official.primary_position which reflects career-level specialization; this captures the actual role performed on the day.
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association Attribute

attributes.name: performance_score
attributes.description: Numeric performance grade issued by the officiating bureau's evaluation team for this official's performance in this specific game. Distinct from official.performance_rating which is a rolling composite season score. Feeds into the composite rating calculation.
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association Attribute

attributes.name: var_tmo_intervened
attributes.description: Indicates whether this official exercised a VAR or TMO intervention decision during this specific game. Complements game_result.var_tmo_intervention_flag at the game level by attributing the intervention to the specific official responsible.
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association Attribute

domains.name: finance
domains.description: Corporate financial domain owning general ledger, cost centers, budgets, EBITDA reporting, ARR tracking, financial planning and analysis (FP&A), and SOX-compliant financial controls via SAP S/4HANA FI/CO. Manages chart of accounts, revenue recognition, expense allocation, intercompany settlements, and SEC financial reporting for publicly traded entities. SSOT for all enterprise financial master data.

products.name: gl_account
products.description: General ledger account master record defining a specific financial classification node within the enterprise chart of accounts. Each GL account represents a unique posting target (e.g., ticket revenue, broadcast rights income, venue operating expense, player salary, naming rights deferred revenue). Stores account number, description, account type (P&L vs balance sheet), currency, tax category, reconciliation account flag, cost element category, account group, and posting block status. SSOT for all account classification, financial statement line mapping, and cost element definitions across all Sports Entertainment legal entities in SAP S/4HANA FI.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the GL account master record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Primary key for all downstream joins and lineage tracking. Role: MASTER_RESOURCE.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Chart of Accounts; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.company_code. Business justification: GL accounts in SAP FI are defined within a specific company code's chart of accounts. The company_code string field is a denormalized reference that should be replaced with a typed FK to company_code.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: account_changed_by
attributes.business_glossary_term: General Ledger (GL) Account Last Changed By User
attributes.description: SAP user ID of the person who last modified this GL account master record (SKA1.AEDTM user). Required for SOX audit trail, segregation of duties compliance, and internal audit reviews. Supports detection of unauthorized changes to chart of accounts master data.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI SKA1; SOX Section 404; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: account_changed_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: General Ledger (GL) Account Last Changed Date
attributes.description: Date on which this GL account master record was last modified (SKA1.LAEDA). Used for change management tracking, SOX compliance, and data lineage in the Databricks Silver Layer. Triggers downstream reprocessing of dependent financial reporting datasets when account attributes change.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI SKA1; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: account_created_by
attributes.business_glossary_term: General Ledger (GL) Account Created By User
attributes.description: SAP user ID of the person who created this GL account master record (SKA1.ERNAM). Required for SOX audit trail and segregation of duties (SoD) compliance. Enables identification of unauthorized account creation and supports internal audit reviews of chart of accounts governance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI SKA1; SOX Section 404; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: account_created_date
attributes.description: Date on which this GL account master record was first created in the chart of accounts (SKA1.ERDAT). Used for audit trail, SOX compliance documentation, and chart of accounts change management reporting. Supports identification of accounts created outside of standard change control processes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI SKA1; SOX Section 404; ISO 20121

attributes.name: account_group_code
attributes.description: SAP account group (SKA1.KTOKS) that controls the number range and field selection for the GL account. Groups accounts by business function, e.g., revenue accounts, expense accounts, balance sheet accounts. Determines which fields are required, optional, or suppressed during account maintenance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI SKA1; GAAP ASC 230

attributes.name: account_long_name
attributes.description: Extended descriptive name of the GL account (SKAT.TXT50) providing full business context. Used in detailed financial disclosures, audit documentation, and SEC reporting narratives.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI SKAT; SEC Regulation S-X; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: account_name
attributes.description: Short descriptive name of the GL account as maintained in SAP S/4HANA (SKAT.TXT20). Used on financial reports, trial balances, and chart of accounts listings. Examples: 'Ticket Revenue', 'Broadcast Rights Income', 'Player Salary Expense', 'Naming Rights Deferred Revenue'.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI SKAT; GAAP ASC 230; IFRS IAS 1

attributes.name: account_number
attributes.description: The externally-known, human-readable GL account number as defined in the SAP S/4HANA chart of accounts (SKA1.SAKNR). Uniquely identifies the posting target within a chart of accounts. Used on all journal entries, financial statements, and cost element assignments.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI SKA1; GAAP ASC 230; IFRS IAS 1

attributes.name: account_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the GL account master record. 'active' accounts accept postings; 'blocked' accounts are temporarily prevented from receiving new journal entries; 'marked_for_deletion' accounts are pending archival after period-end close. Controls posting eligibility across all Sports Entertainment legal entities.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI SKA1/SKB1; SOX Section 404; GAAP ASC 230

attributes.name: account_type
attributes.description: Fundamental financial classification of the GL account indicating its role in the financial statements (SKA1.KTOKS mapped to account type). 'asset' and 'liability' and 'equity' are balance sheet accounts; 'revenue' and 'expense' are profit and loss (P&L) accounts. Drives financial statement line assignment and period-end closing behavior.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI SKA1; GAAP ASC 205; IFRS IAS 1; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: alternative_account_number
attributes.description: Alternative account number used for country-specific or group reporting chart of accounts mapping (SKA1.ALTKT). Enables mapping between the operational chart of accounts and a group consolidation chart of accounts or statutory reporting chart of accounts for international league entities operating under different GAAP/IFRS frameworks.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI SKA1; IFRS IAS 1; GAAP ASC 205

attributes.name: balance_sheet_account
attributes.description: Indicates whether this GL account is a balance sheet account (True) or a profit and loss (P&L) income statement account (False) (SKA1.XBILK). Balance sheet accounts carry forward balances at year-end; P&L accounts are closed to retained earnings. Fundamental for period-end close processing and financial statement preparation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI SKA1; GAAP ASC 205; IFRS IAS 1

attributes.name: chart_of_accounts_code
attributes.description: Four-character SAP chart of accounts key (SKA1.KTOPL) to which this GL account belongs. Sports Entertainment may maintain multiple charts of accounts for different legal entity frameworks (e.g., US GAAP vs IFRS for international leagues). Determines the account structure and financial statement mapping.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI SKA1; IFRS IAS 1; GAAP ASC 205

attributes.name: commitment_management
attributes.description: Indicates whether commitment management (purchase order commitments and funds reservations) is active for this GL account. When True, purchase orders and contracts posted against this account create budget commitments visible in FP&A reporting. Relevant for player contract commitments, venue capital expenditure, and broadcast production cost commitments.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM; GAAP ASC 420

attributes.name: controlling_area
attributes.description: Four-character SAP Controlling area code to which this GL account's cost element is assigned (SKA1 CO integration). The controlling area defines the organizational unit within which cost and revenue accounting is performed. Enables cross-company-code cost allocation, internal order settlement, and EBITDA reporting across Sports Entertainment's multi-entity structure.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM; GAAP ASC 420

attributes.name: cost_center_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a cost center assignment is mandatory when posting to this GL account. When True, all journal entries must include a valid cost center (e.g., venue operations cost center, broadcast production cost center, athlete management cost center). Enforces cost allocation discipline for EBITDA reporting and FP&A variance analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM; GAAP ASC 420; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: cost_element_category
attributes.description: Defines the cost element category in SAP Controlling (CO) module when this GL account is also a primary cost element (SKA1.KATYP). 'primary' cost elements correspond directly to P&L GL accounts (e.g., player salary expense, venue operating cost, broadcast production cost); 'secondary' cost elements are used for internal allocations and settlements between cost centers; 'none' for balance sheet accounts not used in CO. Critical for EBITDA reporting and cost center allocation in FP&A.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM; GAAP ASC 420; EBITDA reporting standards

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the account currency in which balances are maintained (SKB1.WAERS). Sports Entertainment operates across global markets with revenues in USD, EUR, GBP, CAD, AUD, and other currencies. Accounts may be maintained in local currency, group currency (USD), or hard currency. Drives foreign currency revaluation and translation for consolidated SEC reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI SKB1; ISO 4217; GAAP ASC 830; IFRS IAS 21

attributes.name: deletion_flag
