attributes.description: Indicates whether this GL account has been flagged for deletion from the chart of accounts (SKA1.XLOEV). Accounts flagged for deletion cannot receive new postings and are scheduled for archival after all dependent records are cleared. Supports chart of accounts rationalization and SOX control compliance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI SKA1; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: field_status_group
attributes.description: SAP field status group code assigned to the GL account that controls which fields are required, optional, or suppressed during document entry (SKB1.FSTAG). Ensures data completeness for postings — for example, cost center is required on expense accounts, profit center on revenue accounts, and business area on intercompany settlement accounts.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI SKB1; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: financial_statement_item
attributes.description: The financial statement version item code to which this GL account is assigned for external reporting (SKA1.BILKT). Maps the account to a specific line on the income statement, balance sheet, or cash flow statement as required for SEC 10-K/10-Q filings and EBITDA reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI SKA1; SEC Regulation S-X; GAAP ASC 205; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: functional_area
attributes.description: Business functional area to which this GL account is assigned for segment and functional reporting (SKA1.FUNC_AREA). Enables profit and loss reporting by business function such as event operations, broadcast, athlete management, venue operations, merchandise, sponsorship, and corporate. Supports SEC segment reporting requirements under GAAP ASC 280.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL; GAAP ASC 280; SEC Regulation S-X

attributes.name: house_bank_account
attributes.description: Indicates whether this GL account is a house bank account used for cash management and bank reconciliation (SKB1.XINTB). When True, the account is linked to a physical bank account for automated bank statement processing, cash pooling, and treasury operations. Relevant for Sports Entertainment's multi-entity cash management across leagues and venues.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-TR; GAAP ASC 230; PCI-DSS

attributes.name: intercompany_account
attributes.description: Indicates whether this GL account is designated for intercompany transactions between Sports Entertainment legal entities (e.g., between the league holding company, individual team entities, broadcast subsidiaries, and venue operating companies). When True, intercompany partner must be specified on postings for automated elimination in consolidated financial statements. Required for SOX-compliant intercompany reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL; GAAP ASC 810; IFRS IAS 27; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: interest_calculation
attributes.description: Indicates whether automatic interest calculation is activated for this GL account (SKB1.XINTB for interest indicator). Relevant for intercompany loan accounts, deferred revenue accounts (naming rights, multi-year broadcast deals), and overdue receivable accounts where interest accrual is contractually required.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI SKB1; GAAP ASC 835; IFRS IAS 39

attributes.name: line_item_display
attributes.description: Indicates whether individual line items are stored and displayable for this GL account (SKB1.XKRES). When True, each posting line is retained for drill-down reporting and audit trail purposes. Required for SOX-compliant audit trails on revenue accounts (ticket revenue, broadcast rights income, sponsorship fees) and significant expense accounts (player salaries, venue operating costs).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI SKB1; SOX Section 404; GAAP ASC 230

attributes.name: open_item_management
attributes.description: Indicates whether open item management is activated for this GL account (SKB1.XOPVW). When True, individual line items remain open until explicitly cleared against an offsetting entry (e.g., deferred revenue accounts for naming rights, advance ticket deposits, broadcast rights prepayments). Enables aging analysis and outstanding item tracking for FP&A.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI SKB1; GAAP ASC 606; IFRS IFRS 15

attributes.name: planning_level
attributes.description: Planning level code that controls how this GL account participates in financial planning and budgeting processes in SAP CO and Workday Adaptive Planning integration. Determines the granularity at which budget vs. actual variance analysis is performed — account level, cost center level, or profit center level. Supports FP&A EBITDA budgeting and ARR tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM; Workday Adaptive Planning; GAAP ASC 420

attributes.name: posting_block
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether postings to this GL account are currently blocked at the chart of accounts level (SKA1.XSPEA). When True, no journal entries can be posted to this account regardless of company code settings. Used during account restructuring, period-end close, or SOX control enforcement.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI SKA1; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: profit_center_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a profit center assignment is mandatory when posting to this GL account. When True, all postings must include a valid profit center enabling segment-level profitability reporting (e.g., by league, by venue, by broadcast network). Supports SEC segment reporting under GAAP ASC 280 and internal EBITDA reporting by business unit.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA EC-PCA; GAAP ASC 280; SEC Regulation S-X

attributes.name: reconciliation_account_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether this GL account serves as a reconciliation account for a subledger and, if so, which subledger type (SKA1.MITKZ). 'customer' reconciliation accounts aggregate accounts receivable subledger balances (e.g., fan ticket receivables, sponsor invoices); 'vendor' for accounts payable (e.g., venue contractor payables); 'asset' for fixed asset subledger (e.g., stadium infrastructure); 'none' for non-reconciliation accounts. Direct postings to reconciliation accounts are blocked.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI SKA1; GAAP ASC 310; IFRS IAS 39

attributes.name: revenue_recognition_category
attributes.description: Classification of the revenue recognition pattern applicable to this GL account under GAAP ASC 606 / IFRS 15. 'point_in_time' for single-event revenues (e.g., individual ticket sales, PPV events, merchandise sales); 'over_time' for performance obligations satisfied over a period (e.g., season ticket packages, multi-year broadcast rights, naming rights); 'deferred' for advance payments not yet earned (e.g., prepaid sponsorship fees, advance broadcast rights payments); 'not_applicable' for non-revenue accounts. Critical for SEC revenue disclosure and audit compliance.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 606; IFRS 15; SEC SAB 104; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: sort_key
attributes.description: Three-digit sort key code that determines the assignment field populated in the allocation field of line items posted to this account (SKB1.ZUAWA). Controls how line items are sorted and grouped in account displays and reports. Common sort keys include posting date, document number, and external document reference for reconciliation purposes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI SKB1

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the operational source system from which this GL account master record was extracted (e.g., 'SAP_S4HANA_PROD', 'SAP_S4HANA_EU'). Supports multi-instance SAP landscapes where Sports Entertainment operates separate SAP systems for different regions or leagues. Enables data lineage tracking and conflict resolution in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer Data Lineage Standards; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: sports_revenue_stream
attributes.description: Sports Entertainment-specific revenue stream classification for this GL account, enabling industry-specific financial analytics and KPI reporting. Examples: 'ticket_revenue', 'broadcast_rights_income', 'naming_rights_revenue', 'sponsorship_fees', 'merchandise_licensing', 'ppv_revenue', 'concession_revenue', 'player_transfer_fee', 'nil_licensing_income', 'venue_rental'. Used for EBITDA decomposition, ARR tracking, and league financial reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ticket_revenue|broadcast_rights_income|naming_rights_revenue|sponsorship_fees|merchandise_licensing|ppv_revenue|concession_revenue|player_transfer_fee|nil_licensing_income|venue_rental — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NBA/NFL/MLB/NHL/MLS League Financial Reporting Standards; GAAP ASC 606; SEC Regulation S-X

attributes.name: tax_category
attributes.description: Tax category assigned to the GL account controlling tax code entry behavior during posting (SKB1.MWSKZ). Determines whether tax codes are required, optional, or not allowed on journal entries to this account. Relevant for VAT/GST on international broadcast rights, ticket sales tax, merchandise sales tax, and venue concession tax compliance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-TX; IRS Publication 15; GAAP ASC 740; IFRS IAS 12

attributes.name: tax_relevant
attributes.description: Indicates whether this GL account is subject to tax reporting and requires a tax code on postings (SKB1.XMWNO negated). When True, postings must include a valid tax code for VAT, sales tax, or withholding tax compliance. Critical for international broadcast rights distribution, PPV revenue, and merchandise sales across jurisdictions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-TX; IRS; GAAP ASC 740; IFRS IAS 12

attributes.name: tolerance_group
attributes.description: Tolerance group code assigned to the GL account that defines acceptable variance thresholds for payment differences, rounding, and clearing (SKB1.ZUAWA tolerance reference). Controls automatic clearing of small differences on high-volume accounts such as ticket revenue clearing, merchandise POS settlement, and concession cash accounts. Supports SOX-compliant payment processing controls.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI SKB1; SOX Section 404; PCI-DSS

attributes.name: valid_from_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: General Ledger (GL) Account Valid From Date
attributes.description: Date from which this GL account is valid and available for posting. Supports time-dependent account activation for new business lines (e.g., a new OTT streaming revenue account activated at the start of a new broadcast deal, or a new NIL licensing income account activated upon regulatory approval). Enables historical accuracy in financial reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI; GAAP ASC 606; IFRS IAS 1

attributes.name: valid_to_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: General Ledger (GL) Account Valid To Date
attributes.description: Date until which this GL account is valid for posting. Null indicates the account has no planned expiry. Used to retire accounts associated with discontinued business lines (e.g., a closed venue, an expired broadcast rights agreement, a divested team entity) while preserving historical posting data for audit and SEC reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI; GAAP ASC 205; SOX Section 404

products.name: cost_center
products.description: SAP CO cost center master representing an organizational unit responsible for incurring costs — e.g., venue operations, broadcast production, athlete performance, league administration, merchandise fulfillment. Tracks cost center hierarchy, responsible manager, controlling area, validity period, and budget allocation. SSOT for cost accountability across all Sports Entertainment business units.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the cost center record in the Sports Entertainment lakehouse Silver layer. Primary key generated by the platform.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module — Cost Center Master Data

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.company_code. Business justification: Cost centers in SAP CO belong to a specific company code (legal entity). The company_code string field is a denormalized reference that should be replaced with a typed FK to company_code.company_code_
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Cost centers are assigned to profit centers in SAP CO for segment reporting. The profit_center_code string field is a denormalized reference that should be replaced with a typed FK to profit_center.pr
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: venue_id
attributes.description: Reference to the physical venue or facility primarily associated with this cost center, where applicable (e.g., a venue operations cost center linked to a specific arena). Enables venue-level cost analysis and facility management reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM; Sports Entertainment Venue Master Data

attributes.name: activity_type_code
attributes.description: Primary SAP CO activity type associated with this cost center, representing the unit of output or service provided (e.g., 'BROADCAST_HR' for broadcast production hours, 'VENUE_DAY' for venue operating days). Used for activity-based cost allocation and internal service pricing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM-ACT; Activity-Based Costing

attributes.name: allocation_method
attributes.description: Method used to allocate or settle costs from this cost center to other cost objects at period end: direct (direct activity allocation), assessment (using assessment cycles), distribution (using distribution cycles), activity_based (ABC costing), or statistical (for reporting only, no actual settlement).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM-CCA; IFRS 2; Activity-Based Costing Standards

attributes.name: budget_amount
attributes.description: Total approved annual budget allocated to this cost center for the current fiscal year, expressed in the cost center's primary currency. Sourced from Workday Adaptive Planning and loaded into SAP CO for variance reporting. Used in EBITDA forecasting and FP&A dashboards.
attributes.references: Workday Adaptive Planning; SAP S/4HANA CO-OM-CCA; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: business_domain
attributes.description: Sports Entertainment business domain that this cost center primarily supports. Enables cross-domain EBITDA analysis and cost attribution across the enterprise (e.g., 'venue' for arena operations, 'broadcast' for OTT/RSN production costs). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: venue|broadcast|athlete|league|sponsorship|merchandise|ticketing|fan_engagement|content|finance|workforce|compliance|digital_platform — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Sports Entertainment Enterprise Data Model; SAP S/4HANA CO-OM

attributes.name: business_unit
attributes.description: Sports Entertainment business unit or division that owns this cost center (e.g., 'NFL Operations', 'OTT Streaming', 'Venue Management', 'Athlete Performance'). Used for segment-level EBITDA reporting and ARR tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM; IFRS 8; SEC Regulation S-X

attributes.name: controlling_area_code
attributes.description: SAP CO controlling area to which this cost center belongs. The controlling area defines the organizational unit within which cost accounting is performed and cross-company cost allocations are managed (e.g., 'SE01' for Sports Entertainment North America).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM; IFRS 8 — Operating Segments

attributes.name: cost_center_category
attributes.description: Single-character or two-character SAP CO cost center category code that controls which activity types and statistical key figures can be posted (e.g., 'A' = general, 'B' = production, 'F' = financial). Determines default allocation rules and reporting groupings.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM-CCA

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: Alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the cost center within the controlling area, as defined in SAP CO. This is the externally-known business identifier used in journal entries, purchase orders, and budget allocations (e.g., 'VEN-OPS-001', 'BCAST-PROD-02').
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM-CCA; SOX Section 404 — Internal Controls over Financial Reporting

attributes.name: cost_center_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of the cost center's business purpose, scope of operations, and cost accountability. Provides context for financial analysts, auditors, and FP&A teams beyond what the name and code convey (e.g., 'Responsible for all operational costs of the home venue including HVAC, BMS, security, and event-day staffing').
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM-CCA; SOX Section 404 — Documentation Requirements

attributes.name: cost_center_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the cost center as maintained in SAP CO master data (e.g., 'Venue Operations — Staples Center', 'Broadcast Production — NFL Sunday Package'). Used in financial reports, budget dashboards, and FP&A outputs.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM-CCA; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: cost_center_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the cost center in SAP CO: active (accepting postings), inactive (temporarily suspended), locked (blocked for all postings), pending_activation (created but not yet effective), or archived (historical, no postings allowed). Drives period-end close controls and SOX compliance checks.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM-CCA; SOX Section 404 — Internal Controls

attributes.name: cost_center_type
attributes.description: SAP CO cost center category classifying the nature of cost incurrence: overhead (administrative/support), production (direct event/broadcast output), service (shared services), profit (revenue-generating unit tracked as cost center), or investment (capital project support). Drives allocation methodology and EBITDA reporting treatment.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM-CCA; IFRS 8; EBITDA Reporting Standards

attributes.name: cost_element_group
attributes.description: SAP CO cost element group defining the set of primary cost elements (GL accounts) that can be posted to this cost center. Controls which expense categories are tracked here (e.g., 'VENUE_OPEX' for venue operating expenses, 'TALENT_COSTS' for athlete/performer costs).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM-CCA; SAP FI Chart of Accounts

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the primary country where this cost center operates. Used for statutory reporting, VAT/tax jurisdiction assignment, and GDPR/CCPA data residency compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; GDPR Article 44; CCPA; SAP S/4HANA FI

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this cost center master record was first created in SAP CO. Used for audit trail, SOX compliance documentation, and data lineage tracking in the lakehouse Silver layer.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM-CCA; SOX Section 404; ISO 8601

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code representing the primary transaction currency for this cost center (e.g., 'USD', 'EUR', 'GBP'). Drives currency translation in SAP FI/CO and multi-currency EBITDA consolidation.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; SAP S/4HANA FI-GL; IFRS 21 — Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates

attributes.name: department_code
attributes.description: Organizational department code associated with this cost center, aligned to the SAP SuccessFactors organizational hierarchy. Enables workforce cost attribution and headcount-to-cost analysis across Sports Entertainment business units.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors HCM; SAP S/4HANA CO-OM

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: Fiscal year to which the budget amount and planning data for this cost center applies (e.g., 2024, 2025). Aligns with the Sports Entertainment fiscal calendar defined in SAP FI company code settings.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI; SOX Section 404; SEC Annual Report (Form 10-K)

attributes.name: functional_area_code
attributes.description: SAP FI/CO functional area classifying the cost center by business function for cost-of-sales accounting and segment reporting (e.g., 'ADMIN', 'SALES', 'PROD', 'R&D'). Required for SEC income statement presentation under US GAAP.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL; US GAAP ASC 220; SEC Regulation S-X

attributes.name: geographic_region
attributes.description: Geographic region or market where this cost center primarily operates (e.g., 'North America', 'EMEA', 'APAC'). Supports regional cost allocation, transfer pricing compliance, and multi-market EBITDA reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM; IFRS 8 — Operating Segments; OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines

attributes.name: gl_account_group
attributes.description: SAP FI GL account group associated with this cost center, defining the range of general ledger accounts used for cost postings. Ensures chart-of-accounts alignment and supports automated financial statement mapping for SEC reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL; US GAAP; IFRS; SEC Regulation S-X

attributes.name: hierarchy_level
attributes.description: Numeric level of this cost center within the standard cost center hierarchy (e.g., 1 = enterprise, 2 = division, 3 = department, 4 = operational unit). Used for rollup reporting in Workday Adaptive Planning and SAP CO standard hierarchy.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM-CCA Standard Hierarchy; Workday Adaptive Planning

attributes.name: intercompany_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cost center participates in intercompany cost settlements between Sports Entertainment legal entities (True = intercompany). Triggers intercompany elimination entries in consolidated financial statements and SEC reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL Intercompany; IFRS 10 — Consolidated Financial Statements; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent change to this cost center master record in SAP CO. Supports change detection for incremental lakehouse loads, SOX audit trails, and master data governance reviews.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM-CCA; SOX Section 404; ISO 8601

attributes.name: plan_lock
attributes.description: Indicates whether budget/plan postings to this cost center are currently blocked (True = locked). Prevents changes to approved budgets after the planning cycle is closed in Workday Adaptive Planning and SAP CO.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM-CCA; Workday Adaptive Planning

attributes.name: posting_lock
attributes.description: Indicates whether actual cost postings to this cost center are currently blocked (True = locked, no postings allowed). Used during period-end close, organizational restructuring, or SOX audit freeze periods to prevent unauthorized cost entries.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM-CCA; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: sap_changed_by
attributes.business_glossary_term: SAP Last Changed By User ID
attributes.description: SAP user ID of the person who last modified this cost center master record. Required for SOX change management controls and audit trail. Stored as the SAP logon ID.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM-CCA; SOX Section 404 — Change Management Controls

attributes.name: sap_created_by
attributes.description: SAP user ID of the person who created this cost center master record in SAP CO. Required for SOX segregation-of-duties controls and audit trail documentation. Stored as the SAP logon ID (not personal name).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM-CCA; SOX Section 404 — Segregation of Duties

attributes.name: segment_code
attributes.description: SEC/IFRS 8 reportable segment to which this cost center belongs for external financial disclosure (e.g., 'LIVE_EVENTS', 'MEDIA_RIGHTS', 'MERCHANDISE'). Drives segment footnote disclosures in SEC Form 10-K and quarterly 10-Q filings.
attributes.references: IFRS 8 — Operating Segments; US GAAP ASC 280; SEC Form 10-K

attributes.name: short_name
attributes.description: Abbreviated display name for the cost center used in condensed financial reports, dashboards, and SAP transaction screens where space is limited (max 20 characters per SAP CO standard).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM-CCA

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record from which this cost center master record was sourced (e.g., 'SAP_S4HANA' for records originating from SAP CO, 'WORKDAY' for records originating from Workday Adaptive Planning, 'MANUAL' for manually entered records). Supports data lineage and reconciliation.
attributes.references: Sports Entertainment Data Governance Policy; SAP S/4HANA CO; Workday Adaptive Planning

attributes.name: sox_relevant
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cost center is in scope for Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) internal control testing and audit (True = SOX relevant). SOX-relevant cost centers require documented controls, segregation of duties, and periodic management certification per SOX Sections 302 and 404.
attributes.references: SOX Sections 302 and 404; SEC Rules 13a-15 and 15d-15

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which this cost center is active and eligible to receive cost postings in SAP CO. Defines the start of the cost center's validity period for budget planning, actual cost collection, and period-end closing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM-CCA; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: valid_to
attributes.description: Date until which this cost center is active and eligible to receive cost postings. After this date, the cost center is locked for new postings. Null indicates an open-ended validity period. Used for fiscal year planning and organizational restructuring.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM-CCA; SOX Section 404

products.name: profit_center
products.description: SAP CO profit center master representing a revenue-generating business unit — e.g., a specific league franchise, venue, OTT streaming platform, or merchandise line. Enables EBITDA reporting and profitability analysis at the business segment level. Stores profit center hierarchy, controlling area, company code assignment, and segment classification.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the profit center record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Primary key generated by the lakehouse ingestion pipeline from SAP CO master data.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-PCA (Profit Center Accounting)

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.company_code. Business justification: Profit centers in SAP CO belong to a specific company code (legal entity). The company_code string field is a denormalized reference that should be replaced with a typed FK to company_code.company_cod
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: league_id
attributes.description: FK to league.league

attributes.name: venue_id
attributes.description: FK to venue.venue

attributes.name: annual_capex_budget
attributes.description: Approved annual capital expenditure budget for this profit center in local currency. Relevant for venue operations and broadcast infrastructure profit centers. Used in FP&A and SEC capital allocation disclosures.
attributes.references: Workday Adaptive Planning; SAP S/4HANA FI-AA (Asset Accounting); SEC Regulation S-K

attributes.name: annual_opex_budget
attributes.description: Approved annual operating expenditure budget for this profit center in local currency, as set in Workday Adaptive Planning. Includes direct costs and allocated overhead. Used for EBITDA margin planning and cost control.
attributes.references: Workday Adaptive Planning; SOX Section 404; EBITDA Reporting Standards

attributes.name: annual_revenue_budget
attributes.description: Approved annual revenue budget for this profit center in the profit center's local currency, as set in Workday Adaptive Planning FP&A. Used for budget vs. actual variance analysis and EBITDA forecasting.
attributes.references: Workday Adaptive Planning; SOX Section 302/404; SEC MD&A Reporting

attributes.name: arr_tracking_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this profit center tracks Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) as a primary financial metric. Applicable to OTT streaming, digital subscription, and DTC platform profit centers where ARR is a key investor KPI.
attributes.references: SEC MD&A Disclosure; Workday Adaptive Planning ARR Module; SaaS/OTT Revenue Metrics

attributes.name: broadcast_rights_type
attributes.description: Classification of broadcast rights revenue stream associated with this profit center where applicable. Drives revenue recognition treatment under ASC 606 for media rights deals. Values: RSN (Regional Sports Network), national_tv, OTT (Over-The-Top Streaming), PPV (Pay-Per-View), international, radio, none. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: rsn|national_tv|ott|ppv|international|radio|none — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FCC Broadcast Regulation; ASC 606 Revenue Recognition; IFRS 15; Dalet Galaxy MAM

attributes.name: business_unit_type
attributes.description: Classification of the revenue-generating business unit represented by this profit center within Sports Entertainment's portfolio. Drives EBITDA reporting structure and profitability analysis by segment. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: league_franchise|venue|ott_platform|broadcast_network|merchandise_line|athlete_management|concert_series|sponsorship_unit|corporate — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-PCA; Sports Entertainment Internal Taxonomy

attributes.name: controlling_area_code
attributes.description: SAP Controlling Area code to which this profit center belongs. The controlling area defines the organizational unit within which cost and profit center accounting is performed. Maps to SAP field KOKRS.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the primary operating country for this profit center. Drives regulatory compliance requirements (GDPR for EU, CCPA for California), tax treatment, and currency assignment.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1; GDPR; CCPA; FIFA International Regulations; IOC

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this profit center master record was first created in SAP CO. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and SOX control evidence. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-PCA Audit Log; SOX Section 404; ISO 8601

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the profit center's local reporting currency (e.g., 'USD', 'EUR', 'GBP'). Used for EBITDA reporting and currency translation in multi-currency consolidations. Maps to SAP field WAERS.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA CO-PCA; IFRS IAS 21

attributes.name: department_code
attributes.description: Organizational department code associated with this profit center, linking it to the functional area within Sports Entertainment (e.g., 'FINANCE', 'OPERATIONS', 'BROADCAST'). Maps to SAP field ABTEI.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-PCA; SAP SuccessFactors HCM Org Structure

attributes.name: elimination_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether postings to this profit center are subject to elimination during group financial consolidation. Prevents double-counting of intercompany revenues and costs in consolidated EBITDA and SEC financial statements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL Consolidation; IFRS 10; ASC 810 Consolidation; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: fiscal_year_variant
attributes.description: SAP fiscal year variant code defining the fiscal calendar applicable to this profit center (e.g., 'K4' for calendar year, 'V3' for April–March). Critical for period-end EBITDA and ARR reporting alignment. Maps to SAP field PERIV.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI; SEC Regulation S-X Annual Reporting

attributes.name: functional_area_code
attributes.description: SAP functional area code classifying the profit center's business function for cost-of-sales accounting and P&L by function reporting (e.g., 'SALES', 'ADMIN', 'PRODUCTION', 'MARKETING'). Maps to SAP field FUNC_AREA.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO; IAS 1 Presentation of Financial Statements

attributes.name: gl_account_group
attributes.description: SAP chart of accounts group assigned to this profit center, defining the range of GL accounts permissible for postings. Ensures correct revenue recognition and expense classification per the enterprise chart of accounts.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI — Chart of Accounts; GAAP ASC 606 Revenue Recognition; IFRS 15

attributes.name: hierarchy_level
attributes.description: Numeric depth of this profit center within the standard hierarchy tree (1 = enterprise root, 2 = segment, 3 = business unit, 4 = sub-unit). Used for hierarchical aggregation in EBITDA and FP&A reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-PCA; Workday Adaptive Planning

attributes.name: hierarchy_node_code
attributes.description: Code of the profit center group/node in the standard hierarchy (SAP EC-PCA hierarchy) to which this profit center belongs. Enables roll-up reporting from individual profit centers to business segments and enterprise level. Maps to SAP field KHINR.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-PCA; Workday Adaptive Planning FP&A Hierarchy

attributes.name: intercompany_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this profit center participates in intercompany transactions and settlements between legal entities within the Sports Entertainment group. When True, intercompany elimination rules apply during consolidation. Maps to SAP intercompany indicator.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI — Intercompany Accounting; IFRS 10 Consolidated Financial Statements; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this profit center master record in SAP CO. Supports change tracking, audit trail requirements, and incremental data pipeline processing in the Databricks Silver Layer. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-PCA Change Log; SOX Section 404; ISO 8601

attributes.name: manager
attributes.description: Name or employee ID of the person responsible for the profit center's financial performance and budget accountability. Used for management reporting, variance analysis, and SOX control ownership. Maps to SAP field VERAK.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-PCA; SOX Section 302 — Management Certification

attributes.name: nil_revenue_eligible
attributes.business_glossary_term: Name Image and Likeness (NIL) Revenue Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this profit center is eligible to record NIL (Name, Image, and Likeness) revenue streams from athlete endorsement and licensing arrangements. Relevant for athlete management and league franchise profit centers under NCAA and professional league NIL rules.
attributes.references: NCAA NIL Policy; NFL/NBA/MLB CBA NIL Provisions; ASC 606 Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: profit_center_code
attributes.description: The externally-known alphanumeric code that uniquely identifies the profit center within the SAP CO controlling area. Used in journal entries, cost allocations, and EBITDA reporting (e.g., 'PC-NBA-LAL', 'PC-OTT-001', 'PC-VENUE-MSG'). Maps to SAP field PRCTR.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-PCA; SOX Section 302/404 Financial Controls

attributes.name: profit_center_description
attributes.description: Long-form business description of the profit center's purpose, scope, and the revenue-generating activities it encompasses. Provides context for financial analysts, auditors, and FP&A teams. Maps to SAP field LTEXT.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-PCA

attributes.name: profit_center_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the profit center as defined in SAP CO master data (e.g., 'Los Angeles Lakers Franchise', 'OTT Streaming Platform - North America', 'Madison Square Garden Venue Operations'). Maps to SAP field KTEXT.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-PCA

attributes.name: profit_center_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the profit center in SAP CO. 'active' = postings allowed; 'locked' = postings blocked (e.g., during restructuring); 'inactive' = not yet activated; 'archived' = historical record retained for audit. Maps to SAP field LOCK_IND and activation status.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-PCA; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: region_code
attributes.description: Geographic region code for this profit center used in regional EBITDA roll-up and management reporting (e.g., 'NA-EAST', 'NA-WEST', 'EMEA', 'APAC'). Supports multi-regional financial analysis for global sports entertainment operations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-PCA; Sports Entertainment Regional Taxonomy

attributes.name: revenue_category
attributes.description: Primary revenue category for this profit center, classifying the dominant revenue stream for EBITDA reporting and segment analysis. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ticket_sales|media_rights|sponsorship|merchandise|concessions|digital_subscription|licensing|venue_rental|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Revenue Recognition; ASC 606; IFRS 15; SEC Regulation S-K

attributes.name: sap_changed_by
attributes.business_glossary_term: SAP Last Changed By User ID
attributes.description: SAP user ID of the person who last modified this profit center master record. Required for SOX audit trail and change management controls. Maps to SAP field AENAM.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-PCA; SOX Section 404 — Change Management Controls

attributes.name: sap_created_by
attributes.description: SAP user ID of the person who created this profit center master record in SAP CO. Required for SOX audit trail and segregation of duties (SoD) compliance. Maps to SAP field ERNAM.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-PCA; SOX Section 404 — Segregation of Duties

attributes.name: segment_code
attributes.description: Financial reporting segment classification code assigned to the profit center for IFRS 8 / ASC 280 segment reporting (e.g., 'LIVE-EVENTS', 'BROADCAST', 'MERCHANDISE', 'DIGITAL-OTT'). Drives SEC segment disclosures. Maps to SAP field SEGMENT.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI; IFRS 8 Operating Segments; ASC 280; SEC Regulation S-K

attributes.name: short_name
attributes.description: Abbreviated name of the profit center used in reports, dashboards, and financial statements where space is limited. Maps to SAP field MCTXT.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-PCA

attributes.name: sox_control_owner
attributes.description: Name or employee ID of the designated SOX internal control owner responsible for financial reporting controls associated with this profit center. Required for SOX Section 302/404 compliance documentation and audit evidence.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; SOX Section 404; SEC Regulation S-K Item 308

attributes.name: sox_risk_rating
attributes.description: SOX financial reporting risk rating assigned to this profit center based on materiality, transaction volume, and complexity. Determines the frequency and depth of internal control testing required by the external auditor.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; PCAOB Auditing Standard AS 2201; SEC Regulation S-K

attributes.name: target_ebitda_margin_pct
attributes.business_glossary_term: Target Earnings Before Interest Taxes Depreciation and Amortization (EBITDA) Margin Percentage
attributes.description: Planned EBITDA margin percentage for this profit center as a target set during annual budgeting in Workday Adaptive Planning. Expressed as a percentage of revenue. Used as the primary KPI for profitability performance management.
attributes.references: Workday Adaptive Planning; EBITDA Reporting; SEC MD&A; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which this profit center is effective and postings are permitted in SAP CO. Aligns with fiscal year activation. Maps to SAP field DATAB.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-PCA; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: valid_to
attributes.description: Date until which this profit center is effective. A value of 9999-12-31 indicates an open-ended, indefinitely active profit center. Maps to SAP field DATBI.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-PCA; SOX Section 404

products.name: company_code
products.description: Legal entity master record within the SAP S/4HANA organizational structure. Represents each incorporated Sports Entertainment subsidiary or operating company (e.g., league operating company, broadcast network entity, venue management LLC). Stores company code, legal name, country, currency, fiscal year variant, and chart of accounts assignment. Required for SOX-compliant intercompany and SEC reporting.

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate key for the company code record in the Sports Entertainment lakehouse Silver layer. Serves as the primary key for all downstream joins and lineage tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Organizational Structure; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: accounting_standard
attributes.description: The accounting standard framework applied to the financial statements of this company code. US_GAAP for SEC-registered US entities, IFRS for international subsidiaries, LOCAL_GAAP for statutory reporting in specific jurisdictions.
attributes.references: IFRS Foundation; US GAAP FASB; SEC Regulation S-X; SAP S/4HANA Ledger Configuration

attributes.name: business_area
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA business area code assigned to this company code for cross-company-code segment reporting. Represents a distinct business segment such as League Operations, Broadcast, Venue Management, or Merchandise. Supports EBITDA reporting by business segment per SEC ASC 280.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI (GSBER); SEC ASC 280 Segment Reporting; EBITDA Reporting

attributes.name: chart_of_accounts
attributes.description: Four-character SAP S/4HANA chart of accounts key assigned to this company code (e.g., 'SPRT'). Defines the general ledger account structure, account groups, and account number ranges used for all financial postings. Required for SOX-compliant financial controls and SEC reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI (KTOPL); SOX Section 404; SEC Regulation S-X

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City of the registered office or principal place of business. Used in conjunction with street address for regulatory filings and legal correspondence.
attributes.references: SEC Regulation S-K Item 102; SAP S/4HANA FI Address Management

attributes.name: company_code_code
attributes.description: The four-character alphanumeric SAP S/4HANA company code that uniquely identifies the legal entity within the enterprise organizational structure. Aligns with the SAP FI company code field (BUKRS). Used in all intercompany postings, chart of accounts assignments, and SEC financial reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module (BUKRS); SOX Section 302/404; SEC Regulation S-X

attributes.name: company_code_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the company code within the SAP S/4HANA organizational structure. Controls whether new financial postings, purchase orders, and sales documents can be created against this entity. 'in_liquidation' triggers SOX disclosure requirements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; SOX Section 404; SEC Regulation S-X

attributes.name: consolidation_unit
attributes.description: The consolidation unit identifier in SAP S/4HANA Group Reporting that maps this company code to the group consolidation structure. Used for automated intercompany elimination, minority interest calculation, and SEC consolidated financial statement preparation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Group Reporting; SEC Regulation S-X ASC 810; IFRS IFRS 10

attributes.name: controlling_area
attributes.description: Four-character SAP S/4HANA Controlling (CO) area code to which this company code is assigned. The controlling area is the organizational unit for cost accounting, cost center hierarchies, internal orders, and EBITDA reporting. A single controlling area may span multiple company codes for consolidated management reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module (KOKRS); SOX Section 404; EBITDA Reporting Standards

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the jurisdiction in which the legal entity is incorporated (e.g., 'USA', 'GBR', 'DEU'). Determines applicable tax law, regulatory reporting obligations (GDPR, CCPA), and functional currency assignment.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; SAP S/4HANA FI (LAND1); GDPR Article 3; CCPA

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the company code master record was first created in the SAP S/4HANA system or the lakehouse Silver layer. Used for audit trail, SOX compliance, and data lineage tracking.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; SAP S/4HANA Audit Log; ISO 8601

attributes.name: credit_control_area
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA credit control area assigned to this company code, governing credit limit management for sponsorship deals, broadcast rights receivables, and merchandise licensing. Controls credit exposure across the SD (Sales and Distribution) module.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD/FI (KKBER); PCI-DSS; Revenue Recognition ASC 606

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code representing the local (functional) currency of the company code (e.g., 'USD', 'EUR', 'GBP'). All financial postings in SAP S/4HANA FI are recorded in this currency as the primary valuation currency. Critical for EBITDA and ARR reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; SAP S/4HANA FI (WAERS); IFRS IAS 21; SEC Regulation S-X

attributes.name: deactivation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the company code was deactivated or blocked in SAP S/4HANA, preventing new financial postings. Populated when an entity is dissolved, merged, or placed in liquidation. Null for active entities.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Company Code Blocking; SOX Section 404; SEC Regulation S-X

attributes.name: document_number_range
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA document number range interval assigned to this company code for financial document numbering. Ensures sequential, gap-free document numbering required for SOX audit trails and SEC financial reporting integrity.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Number Ranges; SOX Section 404; SEC Regulation S-X

attributes.name: entity_type
attributes.description: Classification of the legal entity by its primary business function within the Sports Entertainment enterprise. Drives intercompany settlement rules, revenue recognition policies, and segment reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: league_operating_company|broadcast_network|venue_management|athlete_management|merchandise_licensing|holding_company|joint_venture — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SEC Regulation S-X Segment Reporting; SAP S/4HANA FI Organizational Structure

attributes.name: field_status_variant
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA field status variant assigned to this company code, controlling which fields are required, optional, or suppressed during financial document entry. Enforces data quality standards for SOX-compliant financial postings.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI (FSTVA); SOX Section 404 Internal Controls

attributes.name: fiscal_year_variant
attributes.description: Two-character SAP S/4HANA fiscal year variant code that defines the fiscal year structure for this company code (e.g., 'K4' for calendar year, 'V3' for April–March). Governs period-end closing, financial statement preparation, and FP&A planning cycles in Workday Adaptive Planning.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI (PERIV); IFRS IAS 1; SEC Regulation S-X Annual Reporting

attributes.name: functional_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 functional currency code as defined under IFRS IAS 21 or US GAAP ASC 830, representing the currency of the primary economic environment in which the entity operates. May differ from local currency for entities with predominantly USD-denominated broadcast rights or sponsorship revenues.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; IFRS IAS 21; US GAAP ASC 830; SEC Regulation S-X

attributes.name: gdpr_applicable
attributes.business_glossary_term: General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) Applicable Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this company code is subject to GDPR obligations due to operating in or processing personal data of EU residents. Triggers data privacy controls, fan data consent management, and Data Protection Officer (DPO) assignment requirements.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 3; GDPR Article 4; EU Regulation 2016/679

attributes.name: group_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 currency code for the group (parent) reporting currency used in consolidated financial statements (e.g., 'USD' for the Sports Entertainment parent). All company code financials are translated to this currency for SEC consolidated reporting and EBITDA roll-up.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; IFRS IAS 21; SEC Regulation S-X; SAP S/4HANA Group Reporting

attributes.name: hard_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 currency code for the hard currency (index currency) used in high-inflation countries per SAP S/4HANA parallel valuation. Applicable for Sports Entertainment entities operating in hyperinflationary economies per IFRS IAS 29.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; IFRS IAS 29; SAP S/4HANA FI Parallel Currencies (HWAER)

attributes.name: incorporation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the legal entity was formally incorporated or registered with the relevant government authority. Used in SEC filings, SOX attestations, and legal entity lifecycle management.
attributes.references: SEC Regulation S-K Item 101; SOX Section 302; SAP S/4HANA FI Legal Entity Master

attributes.name: intercompany_clearing_account
attributes.description: General ledger account number used for intercompany clearing transactions between Sports Entertainment subsidiaries (e.g., broadcast rights fees from broadcast network entity to league operating company). Critical for SOX-compliant intercompany elimination in consolidated SEC reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Intercompany (FILKD); SOX Section 404; SEC Regulation S-X ASC 810

attributes.name: language_key
attributes.description: ISO 639-1 two-letter language code representing the primary business language for this company code in SAP S/4HANA (e.g., 'EN', 'DE', 'FR'). Governs the language used for financial documents, correspondence, and system output for this entity.
attributes.references: ISO 639-1; SAP S/4HANA FI (SPRAS)

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the company code master record. Supports change data capture (CDC) in the Databricks lakehouse pipeline and SOX-compliant audit trail for financial master data changes.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; SAP S/4HANA Change Documents; ISO 8601

attributes.name: legal_entity_identifier
attributes.description: 20-character ISO 17442 Legal Entity Identifier (LEI) assigned by a Local Operating Unit (LOU) for publicly traded or regulated Sports Entertainment entities. Required for SEC financial reporting, derivatives reporting under Dodd-Frank, and international regulatory filings.
attributes.references: ISO 17442; SEC Regulation; GLEIF LEI Standard; Dodd-Frank Act

attributes.name: legal_name
attributes.description: The full registered legal name of the Sports Entertainment subsidiary or operating company as filed with the relevant government authority (e.g., 'Sports Entertainment Broadcast Network LLC', 'League Operating Company Inc.'). Used in SEC filings, SOX attestations, and intercompany agreements.
attributes.references: SEC Regulation S-K; SOX Section 302; SAP S/4HANA FI (BUTXT)

attributes.name: minority_interest_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of the legal entity's equity not owned by the Sports Entertainment parent, representing non-controlling interest. Used in SEC consolidated financial statements for minority interest disclosure and EBITDA attribution. Range 0.00 to 100.00.
attributes.references: SEC Regulation S-X ASC 810; IFRS IFRS 10; SAP S/4HANA Group Reporting

attributes.name: parent_company_code
attributes.description: The SAP S/4HANA company code of the immediate parent entity in the legal entity hierarchy. Enables hierarchical traversal of the Sports Entertainment corporate structure for intercompany settlement, consolidation, and segment reporting. Null for the ultimate parent holding company.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Organizational Hierarchy; SEC Regulation S-X; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code of the registered office address. Used for tax jurisdiction determination, regulatory filings, and ADA venue accessibility compliance mapping.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Address (PSTLZ); IRS Tax Jurisdiction; ADA Compliance

attributes.name: posting_period_variant
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA posting period variant assigned to this company code, controlling which fiscal periods are open or closed for financial postings. Enforces period-end close discipline and SOX-compliant financial controls by preventing backdated entries.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI (XVVWA / T001B); SOX Section 404

attributes.name: profit_center_standard_hierarchy
attributes.description: Name of the SAP S/4HANA profit center standard hierarchy node to which this company code's profit centers are assigned. Enables segment-level EBITDA reporting and management accounting roll-ups across league, broadcast, venue, and merchandise business units.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-PCA (Profit Center Accounting); EBITDA Reporting; SEC Segment Reporting ASC 280

attributes.name: region_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-2 state, province, or region code of the registered office (e.g., 'NY', 'CA', 'TX'). Used for state tax compliance, CCPA applicability determination, and regulatory jurisdiction mapping.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-2; CCPA; SAP S/4HANA FI Address (REGIO)

attributes.name: sec_reporting_entity
attributes.business_glossary_term: Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) Reporting Entity Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this company code is a registrant or consolidated subsidiary required to be included in SEC financial filings (10-K, 10-Q, 8-K). Drives inclusion in the consolidation perimeter for group financial reporting.
attributes.references: SEC Regulation S-X; SEC Exchange Act Section 13; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: short_name
attributes.description: Abbreviated or trading name of the legal entity used in internal reporting, dashboards, and ERP display fields. Corresponds to SAP S/4HANA company code short text (KTEXT). Distinct from the full legal name.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module (KTEXT)

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this company code master record was sourced. Primarily SAP S/4HANA FI/CO for financial master data. Supports data lineage, reconciliation, and Silver layer provenance tracking in the Databricks lakehouse.
attributes.references: Databricks Lakehouse Data Lineage; SAP S/4HANA FI; SOX Section 404 Audit Trail

attributes.name: sox_relevant
attributes.description: Indicates whether this company code is within scope for Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) Section 302 and 404 internal control assessments. True for all entities included in the consolidated SEC financial statements of the publicly traded Sports Entertainment parent.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; SOX Section 404; SEC Regulation S-X

attributes.name: street_address
attributes.description: Street address of the registered office or principal place of business for the legal entity. Used in SEC filings, regulatory correspondence, and legal notices. Classified as confidential organizational contact data.
attributes.references: SEC Regulation S-K Item 102; SAP S/4HANA FI Address Management

attributes.name: tax_registration_number
attributes.description: Government-issued tax identification number for the legal entity (e.g., US Employer Identification Number (EIN), EU VAT registration number). Required for tax filings, vendor invoicing, and regulatory reporting. Stored as confidential business data.
attributes.references: IRS EIN; EU VAT Directive 2006/112/EC; OECD BEPS; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: vat_registration_number
attributes.description: Value Added Tax (VAT) registration number for entities operating in VAT-applicable jurisdictions (EU, UK, etc.). Used on broadcast rights invoices, sponsorship agreements, and merchandise licensing contracts. Distinct from the domestic tax registration number.
attributes.references: EU VAT Directive 2006/112/EC; HMRC VAT Registration; SAP S/4HANA FI Tax

products.name: journal_entry
products.description: Core financial posting document in SAP FI representing a balanced double-entry accounting transaction with embedded line items (posting rows). Each journal entry contains one or more line items specifying GL account, amount, debit/credit indicator, cost center, profit center, and tax code. Captures document type (invoice, payment, accrual, intercompany, allocation), posting date, fiscal period, company code, reference document, posting user, reversal indicator, and SOX approval workflow status. SSOT for all financial movements across the general ledger including revenue recognition postings for ticket sales, broadcast rights, sponsorship, merchandise, and cost allocation postings. Line-item granularity is embedded within this product — no separate line product exists.

attributes.name: journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each journal entry record in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Primary key for this data product. Role: TRANSACTION_HEADER.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI — BKPF (Accounting Document Header)

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.company_code. Business justification: Journal entries in SAP FI are posted within a specific company code (legal entity). The company_code string field is a denormalized reference that should be replaced with a typed FK to company_code.co
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the SAP Controlling (CO) cost center to which this journal entry is allocated. Enables cost allocation reporting by business unit (e.g., Venue Operations, Broadcast, Athlete Management). Corresponds to BSEG.KOSTL.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO — CSKS (Cost Center Master); COSO Cost Allocation

attributes.name: fiscal_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fiscal_period. Business justification: Journal entries are posted to specific fiscal periods. The fiscal_year and fiscal_period INT columns are denormalized attributes that should be retrieved via JOIN to fiscal_period master table. This n
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: fixed_asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fixed_asset. Business justification: In SAP FI-AA, asset-related journal entries (depreciation postings, acquisition postings, disposal postings, impairment charges) are linked to specific fixed asset records. journal_entry does not curr
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary GL account associated with this journal entry header. For multi-line entries, this represents the controlling or summary account. Detailed line-item GL accounts are embedded within the line item attributes of this product. Links to the chart of accounts master data.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI — SKA1 (Chart of Accounts); GAAP ASC 230

attributes.name: ledger_id
attributes.description: Two-character identifier of the SAP New GL ledger to which this entry is posted (e.g., '0L' = leading ledger GAAP, 'L1' = IFRS parallel ledger, 'L2' = local GAAP ledger). Supports parallel accounting for multi-GAAP reporting requirements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI New GL — BKPF.RLDNR; IFRS IAS 1; GAAP ASC 810

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the SAP Controlling profit center representing the business segment responsible for this posting (e.g., NFL Division, Concert Touring, OTT Streaming). Enables EBITDA reporting by profit center and segment reporting per IFRS 8. Corresponds to BSEG.PRCTR.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-PCA — CEPC (Profit Center Master); IFRS 8; SEC Segment Reporting

attributes.name: controlling_area
attributes.description: Four-character SAP Controlling (CO) area code grouping company codes for management accounting and internal reporting. Defines the scope for cost center, profit center, and internal order reporting within Sports Entertainment. Corresponds to BKPF.KOKRS.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO — BKPF.KOKRS; COSO Management Reporting

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code of the transaction currency in which this journal entry was originally recorded (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Part of the MONETARY_TRIPLET. Corresponds to BKPF.WAERS.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI — BKPF.WAERS; ISO 4217; IFRS IAS 21

attributes.name: document_date
attributes.description: The date of the originating source document (e.g., invoice date, payment date, contract date) that triggered this journal entry. May differ from posting date when documents are processed with a lag. Corresponds to BKPF.BLDAT.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI — BKPF.BLDAT; GAAP ASC 606

attributes.name: document_number
attributes.description: SAP-assigned ten-digit accounting document number uniquely identifying the journal entry within a company code and fiscal year. This is the externally-known business identifier used in audit trails, reconciliations, and cross-system references. Corresponds to BKPF.BELNR.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI — BKPF.BELNR; GAAP ASC 230; IFRS IAS 1

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Two-character SAP document type code classifying the nature of the journal entry (e.g., SA=GL posting, KR=vendor invoice, DZ=customer payment, AB=accrual, IC=intercompany, AA=asset posting, ZP=payment run). Drives number range assignment and account type restrictions. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: SA|KR|DZ|AB|IC|AA|ZP|RE|KZ|DR — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI — BKPF.BLART; GAAP ASC 230

attributes.name: entry_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp recording when this journal entry record was first created in SAP FI. Serves as the RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED field for audit trail and SOX compliance. Corresponds to BKPF.CPUDT + BKPF.CPUTM.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI — BKPF.CPUDT/CPUTM; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: Foreign currency exchange rate applied to translate the transaction currency amount to local currency at the time of posting. Sourced from SAP exchange rate tables. Corresponds to BKPF.KURSF.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI — BKPF.KURSF; IFRS IAS 21; GAAP ASC 830

attributes.name: functional_area
attributes.description: SAP functional area code classifying the business function of this posting for cost-of-sales accounting (e.g., SALES, MKTG, ADMIN, PROD, R&D). Supports income statement presentation by function of expense per IFRS IAS 1. Corresponds to BSEG.FKBER.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI — BSEG.FKBER; IFRS IAS 1

attributes.name: group_currency_amount
attributes.description: Total amount of the journal entry translated into the group (consolidation) currency (typically USD for Sports Entertainment). Used for consolidated EBITDA reporting, SEC filings, and group-level financial analysis. Corresponds to the aggregate of BSEG.KZBTR.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI — BSEG.KZBTR; IFRS IAS 21; SEC Regulation S-X

attributes.name: header_text
attributes.description: Free-text description at the journal entry header level providing business context for the posting (e.g., 'Q3 Ticket Revenue Accrual — NFL Season', 'Broadcast Rights Amortization — RSN Deal', 'Intercompany Settlement — Venue Ops'). Corresponds to BKPF.BKTXT.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI — BKPF.BKTXT

attributes.name: intercompany_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this journal entry represents an intercompany transaction between two legal entities within the Sports Entertainment group (True) or an external third-party transaction (False). Critical for consolidation elimination and intercompany reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI — BKPF.BVTYP; IFRS 10; GAAP ASC 810

attributes.name: internal_order_number
attributes.description: SAP CO internal order number used to track costs and revenues for specific projects or events (e.g., a specific concert tour, stadium renovation project, or broadcast production). Enables project-level P&L and budget vs. actual analysis. Corresponds to BSEG.AUFNR.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OPA — BSEG.AUFNR; GAAP ASC 420

attributes.name: last_changed_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp of the most recent modification to this journal entry record. Serves as the RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED field for change tracking and SOX audit trail. Corresponds to BKPF.AEDAT.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI — BKPF.AEDAT; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: line_item_count
attributes.description: Total number of accounting line items (debit and credit rows) embedded within this journal entry document. A balanced double-entry posting requires a minimum of two line items. Supports validation of entry completeness and complexity classification.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI — BKPF line item count; GAAP Double-Entry Accounting

attributes.name: local_currency_amount
attributes.description: Total amount of the journal entry translated into the company code local (functional) currency. Used for statutory financial reporting, balance sheet, and P&L in local GAAP. Part of the MONETARY_TRIPLET. Corresponds to the aggregate of BSEG.DMBTR.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI — BSEG.DMBTR; IFRS IAS 21; GAAP ASC 830

attributes.name: local_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter code for the company code local currency (functional currency) used for statutory reporting. Distinct from transaction currency when cross-currency postings occur. Corresponds to BKPF.HWAER.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI — BKPF.HWAER; IFRS IAS 21; GAAP ASC 830

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date on which the journal entry is posted to the general ledger and affects account balances. Determines the fiscal period assignment. Distinct from document date and entry date. Corresponds to BKPF.BUDAT. This is the principal business event date (BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP category).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI — BKPF.BUDAT; GAAP ASC 230; IFRS IAS 1

attributes.name: posting_key
attributes.description: SAP two-digit posting key controlling the debit/credit indicator and account type for the primary line item of this journal entry (e.g., '40'=GL debit, '50'=GL credit, '01'=customer debit, '31'=vendor credit). Determines how the entry affects account balances. Corresponds to BSEG.BSCHL.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI — BSEG.BSCHL

attributes.name: posting_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the journal entry within the SAP FI workflow. 'posted' = fully committed to GL; 'parked' = saved but not yet posted pending approval; 'held' = incomplete draft; 'reversed' = offset by a reversal document; 'simulated' = test posting not committed; 'error' = failed validation. Serves as the LIFECYCLE_STATUS field.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI — BKPF posting status; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: reference_document_number
attributes.description: External reference number linking this journal entry to the originating source document (e.g., vendor invoice number, ticket sales batch ID, broadcast rights contract number, sponsorship deal reference). Enables cross-system traceability. Corresponds to BKPF.XBLNR.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI — BKPF.XBLNR; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: revenue_category
attributes.description: Business classification of the revenue stream associated with this journal entry, aligned to Sports Entertainment core revenue lines. Enables EBITDA reporting by revenue category and supports ARR tracking for recurring streams. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ticket_sales|broadcast_rights|sponsorship|merchandise|licensing|ppv|ott_streaming|venue_operations|nil_rights|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 606 (Revenue Recognition); IFRS 15; SEC Regulation S-K

attributes.name: reversal_document_number
attributes.description: Document number of the corresponding reversal entry if this journal entry has been reversed, or the original document number if this entry IS the reversal. Null if no reversal relationship exists. Enables audit trail for correction postings. Corresponds to BKPF.STBLG.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI — BKPF.STBLG; SOX Section 302; GAAP ASC 250

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this journal entry is a reversal document (True) or an original posting (False). Reversal entries offset prior postings for corrections, accrual reversals, or error remediation. Corresponds to BKPF.STBLG presence.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI — BKPF.STBLG; GAAP ASC 250 (Accounting Changes and Error Corrections)

attributes.name: reversal_reason_code
attributes.description: SAP two-digit reason code explaining why this journal entry was reversed (e.g., '01'=incorrect posting, '02'=accrual reversal, '03'=period-end correction). Null if not reversed. Corresponds to BKPF.STGRD.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI — BKPF.STGRD; GAAP ASC 250

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifier of the originating operational system that generated this journal entry (e.g., SAP_FI for direct GL postings, TICKETMASTER for ticket revenue interfaces, SHOPIFY for merchandise e-commerce, WORKDAY for payroll postings, MANUAL for manual journal entries). Supports data lineage and reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI — BKPF.AWTYP; SOX Data Lineage Requirements

attributes.name: sox_approval_status
attributes.description: Current status of the SOX-mandated approval workflow for this journal entry. 'pending' = awaiting approver action; 'approved' = authorized by designated control owner; 'rejected' = returned for correction; 'escalated' = routed to senior approver; 'exempt' = system-generated entry below materiality threshold. Required for SOX Section 404 internal controls over financial reporting.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; COSO Internal Control Framework; PCAOB AS 2201

attributes.name: sox_approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the SOX approval was granted for this journal entry. Null if pending or exempt. Provides immutable audit evidence for SOX Section 404 compliance and external auditor review.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; PCAOB AS 2201

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Tax amount (VAT, sales tax, or withholding tax) included in or associated with this journal entry in the transaction currency. Part of the MONETARY_TRIPLET adjustment component. Null for non-taxable postings. Corresponds to BSEG.HWSTE.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-TX — BSEG.HWSTE; GAAP ASC 740; IFRS IAS 12

attributes.name: tax_code
attributes.description: SAP two-character tax code applied to this journal entry for VAT, sales tax, or withholding tax calculation (e.g., 'I1'=input tax, 'O1'=output tax, 'W1'=withholding). Null for non-taxable postings. Corresponds to BSEG.MWSKZ.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-TX — BSEG.MWSKZ; GAAP ASC 740; IFRS IAS 12

attributes.name: trading_partner_code
attributes.description: Four-character company code of the intercompany trading partner entity when this is an intercompany journal entry. Used for automated intercompany elimination during group consolidation. Null for external transactions. Corresponds to BKPF.VBUND.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI — BKPF.VBUND; IFRS 10; GAAP ASC 810

attributes.name: transaction_amount
attributes.description: Gross total amount of the journal entry in the transaction currency. Represents the sum of all debit line items (which must equal the sum of all credit line items for a balanced entry). Part of the MONETARY_TRIPLET. Corresponds to the aggregate of BSEG.WRBTR across line items.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI — BSEG.WRBTR; GAAP ASC 230; IFRS IAS 1

products.name: budget
products.description: Financial planning record encompassing annual budgets, multi-year plans, and rolling forecasts per cost center, profit center, or WBS element. Managed in Workday Adaptive Planning and loaded into SAP CO. Captures budget/forecast version (original, revised, Q1-Q4 reforecast), scenario type (base, upside, downside), budget type (OPEX, CAPEX), fiscal year/period, planned amounts by GL account and cost element at monthly/quarterly granularity, committed amounts, actuals-to-date, and approval workflow status. Supports FP&A variance analysis, rolling forecast cycles, EBITDA projections, and investor relations guidance for Sports Entertainment.
products.reference: SAP CO Budget / Workday Adaptive Planning

attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric identifier for the budget record as assigned in Workday Adaptive Planning or SAP CO. Used for cross-system reconciliation and audit traceability.

attributes.name: budget_type

attributes.name: committed_amount

attributes.name: cost_element_code

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts in this budget record (e.g., 'USD', 'EUR', 'GBP'). Sports Entertainment operates across global markets requiring multi-currency budget management.

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: The start date from which this budget record is effective and valid for financial planning and posting. Aligns with the fiscal period start date.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module; Workday Adaptive Planning

attributes.name: effective_to_date
attributes.description: The end date through which this budget record is effective. Aligns with the fiscal period end date. Used to manage multi-year plan validity windows.

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: Foreign currency exchange rate applied to convert the budget amount to the group reporting currency (USD). Sourced from SAP FI currency tables at the time of budget load. Relevant for international operations (FIFA, UEFA markets).

attributes.name: forecast_amount
attributes.description: Latest rolling forecast amount for the fiscal period as updated in Workday Adaptive Planning. Reflects the most current expectation of financial outcome, incorporating actuals-to-date and revised forward projections.
attributes.references: Workday Adaptive Planning; SAP S/4HANA CO; SEC Regulation S-K

attributes.name: functional_area
attributes.description: SAP FI functional area classification for the budget record (e.g., 'Event Operations', 'Broadcast', 'Athlete Management', 'Venue Operations'). Supports functional P&L and SEC segment reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; SEC ASC 280

attributes.name: is_intercompany
attributes.description: Indicates whether this budget record relates to an intercompany transaction between legal entities within the Sports Entertainment group. True = intercompany; False = third-party. Required for intercompany elimination in consolidated financial reporting.

attributes.name: lock_date

attributes.name: notes

attributes.name: period_granularity

attributes.name: plan_type

attributes.references: Workday Adaptive Planning; SEC Regulation S-K

attributes.name: planned_amount
attributes.description: The original planned budget amount for the fiscal period in the transaction currency. Represents the baseline financial commitment approved at the start of the planning cycle. Core field for FP&A variance analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module; Workday Adaptive Planning; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: prior_year_actual_amount
attributes.description: Actual amount posted for the equivalent fiscal period in the prior fiscal year. Used as a benchmark for year-over-year variance analysis and budget calibration in FP&A.
