attributes.description: Indicates whether the invoice has been fully paid, partially paid, cleared, or voided in SAP FI-AP. Distinct from invoice_status which tracks the approval workflow.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP (BSEG-AUGBL); IAS 7

attributes.name: payment_terms_code
attributes.description: SAP payment terms key (e.g., NT30, 2/10NET30) defining the payment due date calculation, early payment discount percentage, and discount period. Drives cash flow forecasting and working capital management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP (BSEG-ZTERM); IAS 7

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date the invoice was posted to the general ledger in SAP FI. Determines the accounting period for revenue recognition and expense allocation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP (RBKP-BUDAT); IFRS 15; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: receipt_date
attributes.description: The date the invoice was physically or electronically received by the accounts payable department. Determines the start of the payment terms clock and early payment discount eligibility.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP (RBKP-EINDT); SOX Section 404

attributes.name: sap_document_number
attributes.description: The 10-digit SAP FI document number assigned upon posting of the invoice in SAP S/4HANA. Serves as the system-of-record identifier for audit trail and journal entry cross-reference.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP (RBKP-BELNR); SOX Section 404

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: The total tax amount (VAT, GST, sales tax) included in the invoice. Supports tax compliance reporting and reclaim processes across jurisdictions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP (RBKP-WMWST); GDPR; SEC Regulation S-X

attributes.name: three_way_match_status
attributes.description: Result of the three-way match validation between the Purchase Order (PO), Goods Receipt (GR), and Invoice Receipt (IR) in SAP MM-IV. MATCHED: all three documents align within tolerance; PARTIAL_MATCH: partial quantity or price variance; UNMATCHED: significant discrepancy; NOT_APPLICABLE: non-PO invoice.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM-Invoice Verification (MIRO); SOX Section 404; OSHA (for venue service invoices)

attributes.name: vendor_category
attributes.description: Business classification of the vendor type for spend analytics and category management. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: VENUE_SERVICES|BROADCAST_EQUIPMENT|ATHLETE_AGENT|MERCHANDISE_MFG|MEDIA_RIGHTS|CONTENT_PRODUCTION|FACILITY_MGMT|TECHNOLOGY|PROFESSIONAL_SERVICES|OTHER — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM-Vendor Master (LFM1); ISO 20121 Event Sustainability

attributes.name: vendor_invoice_number
attributes.description: The invoice number as printed on the vendor's source document. Used for three-way match reconciliation and vendor dispute resolution. Must be unique per vendor account.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP (RBKP-XBLNR); SOX Section 404

attributes.name: withholding_tax_amount
attributes.description: Amount of withholding tax deducted from the invoice payment, applicable for athlete agent fees, NIL agreement payments, and international vendor payments subject to withholding obligations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP Extended Withholding Tax (WITH_ITEM); IRS Form 1099; SEC Regulation S-X

products.name: payment
products.description: Financial payment transaction recording the settlement of accounts receivable and accounts payable obligations. Captures payment document number, payment date, payment method (ACH, wire, check, card, digital wallet), bank account, cleared invoice references, payment amount, currency, exchange rate, clearing document number, and payment run ID. Covers outbound vendor disbursements, inbound customer receipts, and automated payment program runs in SAP FI. Links to AR invoices (customer receipts) and AP invoices (vendor payments) for complete cash application and reconciliation.

attributes.name: payment_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each payment transaction record in the Sports Entertainment finance domain. Primary key for the payment data product in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Payment Document

attributes.name: agent_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to athlete.agent. Business justification: Payment records for agent commission disbursements must reference the agent being paid. Enables agent payment history tracking, commission reconciliation, and tax withholding compliance (1099/W-9) — a
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: ap_invoice_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary invoice (AR or AP) that this payment clears or partially clears. Links inbound customer receipts to AR invoices and outbound vendor disbursements to AP invoices for cash application and reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Clearing Document

attributes.name: ar_invoice_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.ar_invoice. Business justification: The payment table handles both AP payments (invoice_id → ap_invoice already exists) and AR receipts (customer payments against AR invoices). Adding ar_invoice_id FK enables proper linkage of incoming
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.company_code. Business justification: Payments are executed within a specific legal entity (company code). The company_code string field should be replaced with a typed FK to company_code.company_code_id.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the SAP CO cost center to which this payment is allocated for internal management accounting and EBITDA reporting. Supports expense allocation across event operations, venue management, broadcast, and athlete management divisions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Cost Center (CSKS)

attributes.name: fan_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer master record for inbound AR receipts. Identifies the payer for ticket sales, sponsorship receipts, merchandise revenue, and broadcast rights settlements. Null for outbound vendor disbursements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Customer Master (KNA1)

attributes.name: fiscal_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fiscal_period. Business justification: Payments are posted to fiscal periods for cash accounting and reconciliation. Normalizes fiscal_year and fiscal_period INT columns.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Payments post to specific GL accounts (bank clearing accounts, cash accounts). The gl_account_code string field should be replaced with a typed FK to gl_account.gl_account_id.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: membership_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fan.membership. Business justification: Membership fee payments (season tickets, VIP, fan club dues) must be reconciled against the specific membership record. Finance payment processing requires this link for cash application, auto-renewal
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: payment_run_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the SAP FI automatic payment program run (F110) that generated this payment. Groups all payments executed in a single batch payment run for reconciliation and audit. Null for manually posted payments.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Automatic Payment Program (F110)

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: FK to finance.profit_center

attributes.name: ticket_payment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ticketing.ticket_payment. Business justification: finance.payment (ERP payment record) must be reconciled with ticketing.ticket_payment (payment processor record) for cash reconciliation and period-end close. Linking these enables automated three-way
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: ach_trace_number
attributes.description: The NACHA ACH trace number assigned to this payment entry for ACH transactions. Used for ACH return processing, NOC (Notification of Change) handling, and bank reconciliation. Null for non-ACH payment methods.
attributes.references: NACHA ACH Operating Rules; SAP S/4HANA FI ACH Payment Processing

attributes.name: bank_key
attributes.description: The SAP FI house bank key (HBKID) identifying the financial institution through which this payment is routed. Used for bank reconciliation, liquidity planning, and treasury management reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI House Bank (T012.HBKID); NACHA; SWIFT

attributes.name: block_indicator
attributes.description: SAP FI payment block code (ZLSPR) indicating whether the payment is blocked from processing and the reason (e.g., manual block, dispute, audit hold, compliance review). Blank/null indicates no block. Critical for AP payment control and SOX compliance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Payment Block (BSEG.ZLSPR); SOX Section 404

attributes.name: business_area
attributes.description: The SAP FI business area (GSBER) representing the organizational segment (e.g., ticketing, broadcast, sponsorship, merchandise, venue) for cross-company-code financial reporting and internal balance sheet preparation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Business Area (BKPF.GSBER); GAAP; IFRS 8

attributes.name: check_number
attributes.description: The physical or electronic check number assigned to this payment when payment_method is 'check'. Used for check register management, positive pay file submission to banks, and stop-payment processing. Null for non-check payment methods.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Check Management (PAYR.CHECF); PCI-DSS v4.0

attributes.name: clearing_document_number
attributes.description: The SAP FI clearing document number (AUGBL) generated when this payment clears one or more open items in the AR or AP subledger. Used for cash application matching and open item management in the general ledger.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Open Item Clearing (BSEG.AUGBL)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this payment record was first created in the SAP FI system or ingested into the Databricks Silver Layer. Provides the audit trail creation point required for SOX Section 404 internal controls and GDPR data lineage.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; GDPR Article 5(2); SAP S/4HANA FI Document Header (BKPF.CPUDT/CPUTM)

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the transaction currency in which the payment is denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP, JPY). Essential for multi-currency operations across global sports markets. Part of the MONETARY_TRIPLET.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA FI Currency (BKPF.WAERS); IFRS 21

attributes.name: direction
attributes.description: Indicates whether the payment is an outbound disbursement (AP vendor payment) or an inbound receipt (AR customer collection). Fundamental discriminator for cash flow classification and treasury reporting under IAS 7.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI AP/AR; IAS 7 Statement of Cash Flows; GAAP ASC 230

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: The cash discount amount deducted from the gross payment when early payment terms are honored (e.g., 2/10 net 30). Corresponds to BSEG.SKFBT in SAP FI. Used for discount capture analytics and vendor relationship management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Cash Discount (BSEG.SKFBT); GAAP ASC 310

attributes.name: document_date
attributes.description: The date on the original payment instrument (check date, wire instruction date, or bank statement date). Corresponds to BLDAT in SAP BKPF. Used for instrument-level audit and bank reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Document Date (BKPF.BLDAT)

attributes.name: document_number
attributes.description: The externally-known SAP FI payment document number assigned at the time of posting. Serves as the primary business identifier for the payment transaction used in reconciliation, audit trails, and SOX financial controls. Corresponds to BELNR in SAP BKPF.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Payment Document (BKPF.BELNR); SOX Section 404

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: The contractual due date by which the payment obligation must be settled per invoice payment terms. Used for early payment discount eligibility, late payment penalty calculation, and days-payable-outstanding (DPO) / days-sales-outstanding (DSO) analytics.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Net Due Date (BSEG.FAEDT); GAAP ASC 310

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: The foreign currency exchange rate applied to convert the transaction currency amount to the company code local currency (typically USD) at the time of payment posting. Sourced from SAP FI exchange rate tables (TCURR). Critical for multi-currency reconciliation and FX gain/loss reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Exchange Rate (BKPF.KURSF); IFRS 21; GAAP ASC 830

attributes.name: gross_amount
attributes.description: The total gross amount of the payment before any deductions, discounts, or withholding taxes. Expressed in the transaction currency. Forms the basis for EBITDA reporting and revenue recognition in SAP FI. Part of the MONETARY_TRIPLET for this transaction.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Payment Amount (BSEG.WRBTR); GAAP ASC 606; IFRS 15

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp of the most recent modification to this payment record, including status changes, reversals, or data corrections. Required for SOX audit trail, change data capture (CDC) in the Databricks lakehouse pipeline, and GDPR accountability.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; GDPR Article 5(2); SAP S/4HANA FI Change Documents

attributes.name: local_currency_amount
attributes.description: The payment amount converted to the company code local currency (USD) using the exchange_rate at posting date. Used for consolidated financial reporting, SEC filings, and EBITDA calculations in the functional currency.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Local Currency Amount (BSEG.DMBTR); IFRS 21; SEC Regulation S-X

attributes.name: net_amount
attributes.description: The net amount actually transferred after deducting cash discounts and withholding taxes from the gross amount (gross_amount - discount_amount - withholding_tax_amount). Represents the actual cash movement for treasury and bank reconciliation. Part of the MONETARY_TRIPLET.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Net Amount; IAS 7; GAAP ASC 230

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: The principal business event date on which the payment was executed or value-dated by the bank. Used for cash flow reporting, aging analysis, and period-end close. Corresponds to ZFBDT (baseline date) or VALUT (value date) in SAP FI. Distinct from the document posting date.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Payment Date (BSEG.ZFBDT); IAS 7 Statement of Cash Flows

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The financial instrument or mechanism used to execute the payment. ACH = Automated Clearing House electronic transfer; wire = bank wire transfer (SWIFT/SEPA); check = paper or electronic check; card = credit/debit card (PCI-DSS governed); digital_wallet = PayPal, Apple Pay, or similar; direct_debit = pre-authorized bank debit. Drives bank file format selection in SAP F110.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Payment Method (BSEG.ZLSCH); PCI-DSS v4.0; NACHA ACH Rules

attributes.name: payment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the payment transaction within the SAP FI workflow. 'initiated' = payment instruction created; 'posted' = document posted to general ledger; 'cleared' = open items cleared; 'reversed' = payment reversed with reversal document; 'failed' = bank rejection or processing error; 'on_hold' = payment blocked pending approval or dispute resolution.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Document Status; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: payment_type
attributes.description: Business classification of the payment transaction purpose. vendor_disbursement = AP payment to supplier/contractor; customer_receipt = AR collection from ticket buyer, sponsor, or broadcaster; intercompany_settlement = payment between Sports Entertainment legal entities; payroll_disbursement = athlete or staff salary payment; tax_payment = remittance to tax authority; refund = return of funds to customer. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: vendor_disbursement|customer_receipt|intercompany_settlement|payroll_disbursement|tax_payment|refund — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO; SOX Section 404; SEC Financial Reporting

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The accounting period posting date on which the payment document was recorded in the SAP FI general ledger. Determines the fiscal period for revenue recognition and financial reporting. May differ from payment_date for cross-period transactions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Posting Date (BKPF.BUDAT); GAAP ASC 230; IAS 7

attributes.name: reference
attributes.description: Free-form reference text transmitted with the payment to the beneficiary bank (e.g., invoice number, contract reference, event name). Appears on bank statements and remittance advice. Corresponds to BVTYP/XBLNR in SAP FI. Critical for counterparty cash application.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Reference Document Number (BKPF.XBLNR); SWIFT MT103

attributes.name: remittance_advice_sent
attributes.description: Indicates whether a remittance advice notification has been sent to the payee or payer detailing the invoices cleared by this payment. Supports vendor and customer communication workflows in SAP FI output management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Output Management; NACHA Remittance Advice

attributes.name: reversal_document_number
attributes.description: The SAP FI document number of the reversal posting if this payment has been reversed (e.g., returned ACH, stopped check, duplicate payment correction). Null if the payment has not been reversed. Links to the reversing document for audit trail.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Document Reversal (BKPF.STBLG); SOX Section 404

attributes.name: reversal_reason_code
attributes.description: SAP FI reversal reason code (STGRD) explaining why the payment was reversed (e.g., wrong amount, duplicate, bank return, stop payment). Null if not reversed. Used for exception reporting and fraud detection analytics.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Reversal Reason (T041T); SOX Section 404

attributes.name: special_gl_indicator
attributes.description: SAP FI special GL indicator (UMSKZ) classifying non-standard postings such as down payments, guarantees, or security deposits associated with this payment. Blank for standard payment postings. Used for balance sheet sub-classification.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Special GL Transactions (BSEG.UMSKZ); GAAP ASC 210

attributes.name: swift_reference
attributes.description: The SWIFT end-to-end transaction reference (UETR or TRN) for wire transfer payments. Enables real-time payment tracking via SWIFT gpi and bank confirmation matching. Null for non-wire payment methods.
attributes.references: SWIFT MT103/MX pacs.008; SAP S/4HANA FI Bank Communication Management

attributes.name: terms_code
attributes.description: The SAP FI payment terms key (ZTERM) governing the due date calculation and early payment discount conditions for this transaction (e.g., NT30, 2/10NET30). Inherited from the invoice or vendor/customer master. Drives DSO and DPO analytics.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Payment Terms (T052.ZTERM); GAAP ASC 310

attributes.name: withholding_tax_amount
attributes.description: The amount of withholding tax deducted from the payment at source, applicable to athlete NIL payments, foreign vendor disbursements, and royalty settlements. Reported to tax authorities and reflected in SAP FI withholding tax tables (WITH_ITEM).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Withholding Tax (WITH_ITEM); IRS Form 1099/1042-S; GDPR; SOX

products.name: fixed_asset
products.description: Fixed asset master record in SAP FI-AA representing capitalized physical and intangible assets — stadium structures, broadcast towers, OB trucks, scoreboards, digital platform infrastructure, and acquired broadcast rights. Stores asset class, acquisition date, acquisition cost, useful life, depreciation method, accumulated depreciation, net book value, and disposal status. SSOT for CAPEX and depreciation accounting.

attributes.name: fixed_asset_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the fixed asset master record in the SAP FI-AA module. Primary key for the Silver Layer lakehouse table.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA Asset Master; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.company_code. Business justification: Fixed assets are owned by a specific legal entity (company code) in SAP FI-AA. The company_code string field should be replaced with a typed FK to company_code.company_code_id.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Fixed assets in SAP FI-AA are assigned to cost centers for depreciation allocation and cost reporting. The cost_center_code string field should be replaced with a typed FK to cost_center.cost_center_i
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Fixed assets post to specific GL accounts (asset acquisition accounts, accumulated depreciation accounts). The gl_account_code string field should be replaced with a typed FK to gl_account.gl_account_
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Fixed assets are attributed to profit centers for segment-level asset reporting and EBITDA calculation. The profit_center_code string field should be replaced with a typed FK to profit_center.profit_c
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: accumulated_depreciation
attributes.description: Total depreciation charged against the asset from the in-service date to the current reporting period. Contra-asset balance used to calculate net book value. Sourced from SAP FI-AA depreciation simulation/posting runs.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA (ANLC-KNAFA); IAS 16 para 73; GAAP ASC 360; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: acquisition_cost
attributes.description: Original historical cost of the fixed asset at the time of acquisition or capitalization, in the company code currency. Includes purchase price, import duties, and directly attributable costs to bring the asset to its intended use. CAPEX SSOT figure.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA (ANLC-KANSW); IAS 16 para 16; GAAP ASC 360-10; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: acquisition_date
attributes.description: Date on which the fixed asset was acquired, purchased, or constructed and capitalized. Used as the start date for depreciation calculation and CAPEX reporting. Corresponds to SAP FI-AA 'Capitalization Date'.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA (ANLA-AKTIV); IAS 16 para 7; GAAP ASC 360-10

attributes.name: annual_depreciation_charge
attributes.description: Planned annual depreciation expense for the current fiscal year as calculated by SAP FI-AA. Used in FP&A budgeting, EBITDA bridge analysis, and Workday Adaptive Planning depreciation forecasts.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA Depreciation Simulation; IAS 16; GAAP ASC 360; Workday Adaptive Planning

attributes.name: asset_category
attributes.description: High-level classification distinguishing tangible assets (stadium structures, OB trucks, scoreboards), intangible assets (broadcast rights, software licenses, NIL-related IP), right-of-use assets (IFRS 16 leases), and investment property. Drives balance sheet line-item presentation.
attributes.references: IAS 16; IAS 38; IFRS 16; GAAP ASC 360; ASC 350

attributes.name: asset_class_code
attributes.description: SAP FI-AA asset class code that determines the depreciation area, useful life defaults, and GL account determination (e.g., '1000' for Buildings, '2000' for Machinery, '3000' for Intangible Assets, '4000' for Broadcast Rights). Drives CAPEX categorization and balance sheet classification.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA Asset Class (ANLKL); IAS 16; IAS 38; GAAP ASC 360

attributes.name: asset_class_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the SAP asset class (e.g., 'Stadium Structures', 'Broadcast Equipment', 'OB Trucks', 'Digital Platform Infrastructure', 'Acquired Broadcast Rights', 'Scoreboards & LED Systems'). Used in financial reporting and CAPEX dashboards.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA Asset Class; IAS 16; IAS 38

attributes.name: asset_description
attributes.description: Short descriptive name of the fixed asset as recorded in SAP FI-AA (e.g., 'OB Truck Unit 7', 'Broadcast Tower – East Campus', 'Stadium Roof Structure – Section A'). Used on depreciation schedules and financial statements.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA Asset Master (ANLA-TXT50); IAS 16

attributes.name: asset_location_code
attributes.description: Physical or logical location code where the asset is deployed (e.g., venue code, broadcast facility code, data center identifier). Supports asset tracking, insurance valuation, and ADA/OSHA compliance reporting for venue assets.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA (ANLA-STORT); OSHA; ADA; ISO 20121

attributes.name: asset_location_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the asset's physical location (e.g., 'Main Stadium – East Stand', 'Broadcast Tower – Roof Level 3', 'OB Truck Depot – Training Facility'). Used in physical asset verification and insurance schedules.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA (ANLA-STORT); OSHA; ADA

attributes.name: asset_number
attributes.description: Externally-known SAP FI-AA asset number (main asset number) assigned at capitalization. Used as the primary business identifier on CAPEX reports, depreciation schedules, and audit trails. Format follows SAP company-code-prefixed numbering convention.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA Asset Master (ANLA-ANLN1); SOX Section 404

attributes.name: asset_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the fixed asset. 'under_construction' = Assets Under Construction (AUC) not yet capitalized; 'in_service' = actively depreciated; 'idle' = temporarily out of service; 'impaired' = impairment loss recognized; 'disposed' = sold, scrapped, or retired; 'transferred' = intercompany or intra-company transfer in progress.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA (ANLZ-DEACT); IAS 16 para 67; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: asset_subnumber
attributes.description: SAP FI-AA sub-number identifying a component or addition to the main asset (e.g., a scoreboard upgrade added to the main stadium structure asset). Enables component-level depreciation tracking.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA Asset Master (ANLA-ANLN2)

attributes.name: broadcast_rights_expiry_date
attributes.description: For intangible assets representing acquired broadcast rights (e.g., RSN rights, OTT streaming rights, PPV event rights), the contractual expiry date of the rights. Drives amortization end date and rights renewal planning. Null for tangible assets.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA; IAS 38 para 97; GAAP ASC 350; FCC Broadcast Regulation; DRM

attributes.name: capex_budget_code
attributes.description: Reference to the approved CAPEX budget line item or investment program code in Workday Adaptive Planning / SAP IM (Investment Management) that authorized the acquisition of this asset. Supports CAPEX vs. budget variance reporting.
attributes.references: SAP IM Investment Program; Workday Adaptive Planning; SOX Section 404; GAAP ASC 360

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the fixed asset master record was first created in SAP FI-AA. Provides the audit trail creation event required for SOX internal controls and data lineage in the Silver Layer lakehouse.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA Audit Log; SOX Section 302/404; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this asset record (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR). Supports multi-currency reporting for global sports entertainment operations.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; SAP FI Currency (TCURC-WAERS); IFRS; SEC Regulation S-X

attributes.name: depreciation_area_code
attributes.description: SAP FI-AA depreciation area identifier representing the valuation basis (e.g., '01' for book depreciation per local GAAP, '15' for tax depreciation, '30' for IFRS). Enables parallel valuation for SEC reporting and tax compliance.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA Depreciation Area (T090-AFABER); IAS 16; GAAP; SOX; SEC Regulation S-X

attributes.name: depreciation_method_code
attributes.description: SAP FI-AA depreciation key/method code defining the calculation method (e.g., 'LINR' for straight-line, 'DG30' for declining balance 30%, 'MANU' for manual, 'UNIT' for units-of-production). Determines how accumulated depreciation is calculated each period.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA Depreciation Key (ANLB-AFASL); IAS 16 para 62; GAAP ASC 360; SOX

attributes.name: disposal_date
attributes.description: Date on which the asset was retired, sold, scrapped, or otherwise disposed of. Triggers the derecognition of the asset from the balance sheet and recognition of any gain or loss on disposal in SAP FI-AA.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA (ANLA-DEAKT); IAS 16 para 67; GAAP ASC 360-10-40; SOX

attributes.name: disposal_proceeds
attributes.description: Net proceeds received upon disposal or sale of the asset. Used to calculate the gain or loss on disposal recognized in the income statement. Relevant for stadium asset sales, OB truck fleet disposals, and broadcast rights expirations.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA; IAS 16 para 71; GAAP ASC 360-10-40; SOX

attributes.name: disposal_type
attributes.description: Method by which the asset was disposed of. 'sale' = sold to third party; 'scrap' = physically scrapped; 'transfer' = intercompany or intra-company transfer; 'donation' = donated; 'write_off' = written off; 'insurance_claim' = disposed via insurance settlement (e.g., storm-damaged broadcast tower).
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA Retirement Transaction; IAS 16 para 69; GAAP ASC 360-10-40

attributes.name: impairment_loss
attributes.description: Cumulative impairment loss recognized on the asset where the carrying amount exceeds the recoverable amount (per IAS 36 / ASC 360). Reduces net book value. Relevant for broadcast rights, goodwill-adjacent intangibles, and underperforming venue assets.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA; IAS 36; GAAP ASC 360-10-35; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: in_service_date
attributes.description: Date the asset was placed into active service and depreciation commenced. May differ from acquisition_date for assets under construction. Drives the depreciation start period in SAP FI-AA.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA (ANLZ-ZUJHR); IAS 16 para 55; GAAP ASC 360

attributes.name: insurance_policy_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the insurance policy covering this asset against loss, damage, or liability. Critical for venue assets (stadium structures), broadcast infrastructure (OB trucks, towers), and high-value equipment. Supports risk management and claims processing.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA Insurance Data; ISO 20121; OSHA

attributes.name: insured_value
attributes.description: Declared insured replacement value of the asset as agreed with the insurer. May differ from net book value (NBV) for high-value venue and broadcast infrastructure assets. Used for insurance adequacy reviews.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA Insurance Data; ISO 20121

attributes.name: is_fully_depreciated
attributes.description: Indicates whether the asset has been fully depreciated (net book value equals residual value). Fully depreciated assets still in service are flagged for management review and potential useful life extension assessment per IAS 16.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA; IAS 16 para 51; GAAP ASC 360; SOX

attributes.name: is_leased
attributes.description: Indicates whether the asset is a right-of-use (ROU) asset recognized under IFRS 16 / ASC 842 (e.g., leased venue, leased OB truck, leased broadcast satellite capacity). Drives separate balance sheet presentation and lease liability linkage.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA; IFRS 16; GAAP ASC 842; SEC Regulation S-X

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent change to the fixed asset master record in SAP FI-AA. Used for incremental data loading, change detection in the Silver Layer, and SOX audit trail completeness.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA Change Log; SOX Section 302/404; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: last_physical_verification_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent physical inventory count or asset verification exercise confirming the asset's existence and condition. Required for SOX internal controls and annual audit procedures.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA Physical Inventory; SOX Section 302/404; GAAP

attributes.name: net_book_value
attributes.description: Current carrying amount of the fixed asset: acquisition_cost plus subsequent_acquisition_cost minus accumulated_depreciation minus impairment_loss. Reported on the balance sheet. Refreshed each period-end close from SAP FI-AA.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA (ANLC-KNBTR); IAS 16 para 73; GAAP ASC 360; SOX; SEC Regulation S-X

attributes.name: purchase_order_number
attributes.description: SAP MM purchase order number associated with the acquisition of the asset. Provides the procurement-to-capitalization audit trail required for SOX compliance and CAPEX authorization controls.
attributes.references: SAP MM Purchase Order (EKKO-EBELN); SOX Section 404; GAAP ASC 360

attributes.name: residual_value
attributes.description: Estimated amount the entity expects to recover from the asset at the end of its useful life (salvage value). Deducted from acquisition cost to determine the depreciable base. Reviewed annually per IAS 16.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA (ANLB-SCHRW); IAS 16 para 53; GAAP ASC 360

attributes.name: revaluation_amount
attributes.description: Cumulative upward or downward revaluation adjustment to the asset's carrying amount under the IAS 16 revaluation model (where adopted). Recorded in the revaluation surplus in equity. Applicable to stadium land and property assets.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA; IAS 16 para 31-42; IFRS

attributes.name: serial_number
attributes.description: Manufacturer's serial number or unique physical identifier for the asset (e.g., OB truck chassis number, scoreboard controller serial, broadcast transmitter serial). Used for physical verification, warranty claims, and insurance schedules.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA (ANLA-SERNR); OSHA; Insurance Schedule

attributes.name: subsequent_acquisition_cost
attributes.description: Cumulative cost of subsequent capital additions or improvements to the asset (e.g., stadium seat upgrades, scoreboard technology refresh, broadcast tower antenna replacement). Added to the asset's gross book value.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA (ANLC-KANSW subsequent postings); IAS 16 para 10; GAAP ASC 360

attributes.name: useful_life_periods
attributes.description: Estimated useful life expressed in fiscal periods (months) for assets with sub-annual depreciation granularity. Used in SAP FI-AA period-based depreciation calculations alongside useful_life_years.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA (ANLB-NDPER); IAS 16; GAAP ASC 360

attributes.name: useful_life_years
attributes.description: Estimated useful economic life of the asset in years, as determined at capitalization and used to calculate straight-line or other depreciation. Reviewed annually per IAS 16 (e.g., 40 years for stadium structures, 5 years for OB trucks, 3 years for broadcast rights).
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA (ANLB-NDJAR); IAS 16 para 50; GAAP ASC 360; SOX

attributes.name: wbs_element
attributes.description: SAP PS Work Breakdown Structure element linked to the asset, used for CAPEX project tracking during the Assets Under Construction (AUC) phase (e.g., stadium renovation project, broadcast tower installation). Populated until the AUC is settled to a final asset.
attributes.references: SAP PS WBS Element (PRPS-POSID); GAAP ASC 360; SOX

products.name: revenue_recognition_schedule
products.description: Revenue recognition schedule governing when and how deferred revenue is recognized into earned revenue per ASC 606 / IFRS 15 standards. Applies to multi-year broadcast rights contracts, season ticket packages, multi-event sponsorship deals, and long-term naming rights agreements. Stores contract reference, performance obligation description, total contract value, deferred balance, recognition method (straight-line, milestone, usage-based), recognition start/end dates, period recognition amounts, and cumulative recognized amount. SSOT for ASC 606 compliance, deferred revenue waterfall reporting, and period-end revenue recognition journal entry generation. Distinct from recurring_revenue which tracks commercial ARR/churn metrics — this product owns the accounting treatment and timing of revenue recognition.

attributes.name: revenue_recognition_schedule_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each revenue recognition schedule record within the finance domain. Primary key for the revenue_recognition_schedule data product.
attributes.references: ASC 606, IFRS 15

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.company_code. Business justification: Revenue recognition schedules are scoped to a specific legal entity for SEC reporting compliance. The company_code string field should be replaced with a typed FK to company_code.company_code_id.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: competition_round_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to event.competition_round. Business justification: Broadcast rights contracts often specify per-round fee tranches (e.g., quarterfinal, semifinal, final). Revenue recognition schedules must reference the competition round as the performance obligation
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Revenue recognition schedules are attributed to cost centers for cost allocation and reporting. The cost_center_code string field should be replaced with a typed FK to cost_center.cost_center_id.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: fiscal_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fiscal_period. Business justification: Revenue recognition schedules recognize revenue into specific fiscal periods. Normalizes fiscal_year and fiscal_period INT columns by linking to fiscal_period master.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: fixture_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to event.fixture. Business justification: Under ASC 606/IFRS 15, each fixture is a performance obligation for broadcast rights and gate revenue. Revenue recognition schedules must reference the specific fixture whose completion triggers defer
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.journal_entry. Business justification: Each recognition event generates a journal entry posting. The journal_entry_reference string field is a denormalized reference that should be replaced with a typed FK journal_entry_id → journal_entry.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: match_result_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to event.match_result. Business justification: Match result confirmation is the triggering event for recognizing gate receipts, PPV, and broadcast revenue. Linking revenue_recognition_schedule to match_result enables finance to confirm performance
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: media_rights_deal_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to broadcast.media_rights_deal. Business justification: Media rights deals are the primary contracts requiring ASC 606/IFRS 15 revenue recognition schedules. Finance creates recognition schedules per rights deal for deferred revenue management and period r
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: nil_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to athlete.nil_agreement. Business justification: NIL agreement revenue must be recognized over the agreement term per ASC 606. The revenue_recognition_schedule must reference the nil_agreement driving the recognition schedule for proper deferred rev
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Revenue recognition schedules are attributed to profit centers for segment-level revenue reporting. The profit_center_code string field should be replaced with a typed FK to profit_center.profit_cente
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: recognized_gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Revenue recognition schedules post recognized revenue to a specific GL account. The gl_account_code string field should be replaced with a typed FK recognized_gl_account_id → gl_account.gl_account_id.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: venue_assignment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to event.venue_assignment. Business justification: Venue revenue-sharing agreements (venue_assignment.revenue_share_pct) create deferred revenue obligations recognized over the event lifecycle. Finance must link recognition schedules to the specific v
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: accounting_standard
attributes.description: The revenue recognition accounting standard applied to this schedule. ASC_606 for US GAAP entities; IFRS_15 for international entities; ASC_606_IFRS_15 for dual-reporting entities. Determines the specific recognition criteria and disclosure requirements.
attributes.references: ASC 606 (FASB), IFRS 15 (IASB), SEC Regulation S-X

attributes.name: constraint_applied_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the variable consideration constraint has been applied to limit the recognized amount to the extent it is highly probable (IFRS 15) or probable (ASC 606) that a significant revenue reversal will not occur. Required for ASC 606 / IFRS 15 compliance documentation.
attributes.references: ASC 606 Step 3 — Constraining Estimates, IFRS 15.56–15.58

attributes.name: contract_effective_date
attributes.description: The date the underlying contract became legally binding and enforceable. Used as the ASC 606 contract inception date for determining transaction price and allocating to performance obligations.
attributes.references: ASC 606 Step 1, IFRS 15.9, SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: contract_expiry_date
attributes.description: The date the underlying contract expires or terminates. For multi-year broadcast rights or naming rights agreements, this may be several years in the future. Nullable for evergreen contracts.
attributes.references: ASC 606, IFRS 15, SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: contract_type
attributes.description: Classification of the underlying revenue contract driving this recognition schedule. Determines applicable recognition methodology and disclosure requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: broadcast_rights|sponsorship|naming_rights|season_ticket|multi_event|licensing|merchandise|ppv|ott_subscription|nil_agreement — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ASC 606 Step 1, IFRS 15, SEC Regulation S-X

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this revenue recognition schedule record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Provides the audit trail creation point required for SOX compliance and data lineage in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404, SAP S/4HANA FI Audit Trail

attributes.name: cumulative_recognized_amount
attributes.description: Total revenue recognized to date against this performance obligation since the recognition start date. Equals total_contract_value minus deferred_revenue_balance at any point in time. Used for period-end reconciliation and ASC 606 cumulative catch-up adjustment calculations.
attributes.references: ASC 606, IFRS 15.B1, SAP S/4HANA RAR

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts on this recognition schedule (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Required for multi-currency broadcast rights and international sponsorship contracts.
attributes.references: ISO 4217, IFRS 15, ASC 606

attributes.name: current_period_recognition_amount
attributes.description: Revenue amount to be recognized in the current accounting period for this performance obligation. Drives the period-end journal entry generation in SAP S/4HANA FI/CO. For straight-line method, equals total_contract_value divided by total periods; for milestone/event-based, equals the value of the milestone achieved.
attributes.references: ASC 606 Step 5, IFRS 15, SAP S/4HANA FI Journal Entry

attributes.name: deferred_revenue_balance
attributes.description: Current outstanding deferred revenue balance for this performance obligation — the portion of total contract value received or billed but not yet recognized as earned revenue. Drives the deferred revenue waterfall report and balance sheet liability disclosure. Updated each period-end close in SAP S/4HANA FI.
attributes.references: ASC 606, IFRS 15, SEC Regulation S-X, SAP S/4HANA FI

attributes.name: deferred_revenue_gl_account_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Deferred Revenue General Ledger (GL) Account Code
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA GL account code for the deferred revenue liability balance sheet account. The deferred revenue balance is carried here until recognized. Required for balance sheet reporting and SOX-compliant financial controls.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Chart of Accounts, ASC 606, SOX Section 404, SEC Regulation S-X

attributes.name: discount_rate
attributes.description: The discount rate (as a decimal, e.g., 0.0450 for 4.50%) used to adjust for the significant financing component in the transaction price. Reflects the rate that would be used in a separate financing transaction between the entity and the counterparty at contract inception. Null when significant_financing_flag is false.
attributes.references: ASC 606-10-32-15, IFRS 15.64, SAP S/4HANA RAR

attributes.name: last_recognition_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent revenue recognition posting for this performance obligation. Used to confirm period-end close completion and to identify schedules that have not been processed in the current period.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI, ASC 606, SOX

attributes.name: modification_date
attributes.description: The effective date of the most recent contract modification affecting this recognition schedule. Null when modification_flag is false. Used to determine the prospective or cumulative catch-up adjustment period.
attributes.references: ASC 606-10-25-12, IFRS 15.18, SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: modification_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this recognition schedule reflects a contract modification (e.g., renegotiated broadcast rights fee, amended sponsorship scope). When true, the modification accounting treatment (prospective or cumulative catch-up) per ASC 606-10-25-12 / IFRS 15.18 must be documented.

attributes.name: next_recognition_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date for the next revenue recognition posting. Used by the FP&A team in Workday Adaptive Planning for revenue forecasting and by the accounting team to manage period-end close calendars.
attributes.references: Workday Adaptive Planning, SAP S/4HANA RAR, ASC 606

attributes.name: performance_obligation_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the distinct performance obligation being recognized, as documented in the contract and required for ASC 606 / IFRS 15 disclosure. Examples: 'Exclusive broadcast rights for NFL regular season games FY2024-FY2026', 'Naming rights for stadium facade and digital signage', 'Season ticket package — 41 home games'.
attributes.references: ASC 606 Step 2, IFRS 15.22, SEC Regulation S-K

attributes.name: periods_recognized
attributes.description: Number of accounting periods for which revenue has been recognized to date against this performance obligation. Used to track progress toward full recognition and to validate cumulative_recognized_amount in period-end reconciliation.
attributes.references: ASC 606, IFRS 15, SAP S/4HANA RAR

attributes.name: recognition_basis
attributes.description: Indicates whether revenue is recognized over time (e.g., broadcast rights delivered continuously over a season) or at a point in time (e.g., a one-time PPV event, a single concert). Fundamental ASC 606 / IFRS 15 classification that determines the recognition pattern.
attributes.references: ASC 606 Step 5, IFRS 15.31–15.38

attributes.name: recognition_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which revenue recognition is expected to be fully completed for this performance obligation. For multi-year broadcast rights, this may span several fiscal years. Nullable for open-ended or usage-based obligations without a fixed end date.
attributes.references: ASC 606, IFRS 15, SAP S/4HANA RAR

attributes.name: recognition_method
attributes.description: The accounting method used to recognize revenue over the performance obligation period. Straight-line = equal amounts per period; Milestone = upon achievement of defined deliverables; Usage-based = proportional to actual consumption (e.g., broadcast impressions, CPM); Event-based = upon occurrence of specific events (e.g., game played); Proportional performance = based on percentage of obligation fulfilled.
attributes.references: ASC 606 Step 5 — Recognize Revenue, IFRS 15.39–15.45

attributes.name: recognition_start_date
attributes.description: The date on which revenue recognition commences for this performance obligation. Typically aligns with contract effective date or the date the entity begins satisfying the performance obligation (e.g., first broadcast date, season opener, naming rights activation).
attributes.references: ASC 606, IFRS 15.31, SAP S/4HANA RAR

attributes.name: recognition_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the revenue recognition schedule. Draft = under review; Active = currently recognizing revenue; Suspended = temporarily halted (e.g., contract dispute); Completed = fully recognized; Cancelled = contract terminated before full recognition.
attributes.references: ASC 606, IFRS 15, SAP S/4HANA RAR

attributes.name: schedule_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible business identifier for this recognition schedule, formatted as RRS-{YYYY}-{NNNNNN}. Used in SAP S/4HANA FI/CO journal entry references, audit workpapers, and SEC financial reporting disclosures.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Revenue Accounting and Reporting (RAR), ASC 606

attributes.name: significant_financing_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the contract contains a significant financing component requiring adjustment of the transaction price for the time value of money per ASC 606-10-32-15 / IFRS 15.60. Common in multi-year prepaid broadcast rights deals where cash is received significantly in advance of performance.

attributes.name: total_contract_value
attributes.description: The total transaction price allocated to this performance obligation as determined at contract inception per ASC 606 Step 3 (Determine Transaction Price) and Step 4 (Allocate Transaction Price). Expressed in the contract currency. Used as the basis for deferred revenue waterfall reporting.
attributes.references: ASC 606 Steps 3–4, IFRS 15.73–15.86, SAP S/4HANA RAR

attributes.name: total_recognition_periods
attributes.description: Total number of accounting periods over which revenue is to be recognized for this performance obligation. Used for straight-line recognition calculations and deferred revenue waterfall projections. For event-based recognition, represents the total number of qualifying events.
attributes.references: ASC 606, IFRS 15, Workday Adaptive Planning FP&A

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this revenue recognition schedule record, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Required for change data capture in the Databricks Silver Layer and SOX audit trail completeness.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404, SAP S/4HANA FI Audit Trail, Databricks Delta Lake

attributes.name: variable_consideration_amount
attributes.description: The estimated amount of variable consideration included in the transaction price at the most likely amount or expected value method per ASC 606. Applicable for contracts with performance bonuses, ratings escalators, or PPV revenue share components. Null when variable_consideration_flag is false.
attributes.references: ASC 606 Step 3, IFRS 15.53, SAP S/4HANA RAR

attributes.name: variable_consideration_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the transaction price includes variable consideration components (e.g., performance bonuses, ratings-based escalators, PPV revenue share, usage-based royalties). When true, the constraint on variable consideration per ASC 606 Step 3 must be applied and reassessed each reporting period.
attributes.references: ASC 606 Step 3 — Variable Consideration, IFRS 15.50–15.59

products.name: fiscal_period
products.description: Master reference table for fiscal_period. Referenced by fiscal_period_id.

attributes.name: fiscal_period_id
attributes.description: Primary key for fiscal_period

attributes.name: parent_fiscal_period_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent fiscal period for hierarchical period structures (e.g., a monthly period rolling up to a quarterly period). Null for top-level periods.

attributes.name: primary_prior_fiscal_period_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on fiscal_period (prior_fiscal_period_id)

attributes.name: budget_version
attributes.description: The budget version or scenario applicable to this fiscal period (e.g., Original Budget, Revised Budget, Forecast).

attributes.name: calendar_month
attributes.description: The calendar month (1-12) in which this fiscal period starts, used for calendar-to-fiscal mapping.

attributes.name: calendar_quarter
attributes.description: The calendar quarter (1-4) in which this fiscal period starts, used for calendar-to-fiscal mapping.

attributes.name: calendar_year
attributes.description: The calendar year in which this fiscal period starts, used for calendar-to-fiscal mapping.

attributes.name: closed_date
attributes.description: The date when this fiscal period was officially closed for transaction entry (yyyy-MM-dd). Null if not yet closed.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this fiscal period record was first created in the system (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX).

attributes.name: days_in_period
attributes.description: Total number of calendar days in this fiscal period, used for pro-rata calculations and variance analysis.

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: The last calendar date included in this fiscal period (yyyy-MM-dd).

attributes.name: fiscal_month
attributes.description: The fiscal month number within the fiscal year (1-12). Null for non-monthly periods.

attributes.name: fiscal_period_description
attributes.description: Additional descriptive information about the fiscal period, including special characteristics or notes.

attributes.name: fiscal_quarter
attributes.description: The fiscal quarter number within the fiscal year (1-4). Null for non-quarterly periods.

attributes.name: fiscal_week
attributes.description: The fiscal week number within the fiscal year (1-52 or 1-53). Null for non-weekly periods.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year to which this period belongs (e.g., 2024).

attributes.name: is_adjustment_period
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is a special adjustment period (e.g., Period 13) used for year-end adjustments and accruals (True/False).

attributes.name: is_current_period
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is the current active fiscal period (True/False).

attributes.name: is_year_end_period
attributes.description: Indicates whether this period is the final period of the fiscal year, requiring year-end closing procedures (True/False).

attributes.name: locked_date
attributes.description: The date when this fiscal period was locked for final reporting and audit (yyyy-MM-dd). Null if not yet locked.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this fiscal period record was last modified (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX).

attributes.name: period_code
attributes.description: Business identifier code for the fiscal period, typically combining fiscal year and period number (e.g., FY2024-Q1, FY2024-P01).

attributes.name: period_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the fiscal period (e.g., Q1 2024, January 2024, FY2024 Period 1).

attributes.name: period_number
attributes.description: Sequential period number within the fiscal year, used for ordering and reporting.

attributes.name: period_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the fiscal period. Future: not yet started; Open: active for transactions; Closed: no new transactions allowed; Locked: closed and finalized for reporting; Archived: historical record only.

attributes.name: period_type
attributes.description: Classification of the fiscal period granularity (annual, semi-annual, quarterly, monthly, weekly, or custom).

attributes.name: reporting_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code used for financial reporting in this period (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: sec_filing_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this fiscal period requires SEC financial reporting filings (10-Q, 10-K) for publicly traded entities (True/False).

attributes.name: sox_audit_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this fiscal period requires SOX compliance audit procedures (True/False).

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: The first calendar date included in this fiscal period (yyyy-MM-dd).

attributes.name: working_days_in_period
attributes.description: Number of business working days in this fiscal period, excluding weekends and holidays, used for operational metrics.

products.name: payment_run
products.description: Master reference table for payment_run. Referenced by payment_run_id.

attributes.name: payment_run_id
attributes.description: Primary key for payment_run

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: FK to finance.company_code

attributes.name: fiscal_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fiscal_period. Business justification: payment_run has fiscal_period (INT) and fiscal_year (INT) as raw denormalized columns but no FK to finance.fiscal_period. Payment runs are executed within specific fiscal periods for period-end close
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: primary_original_payment_run_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original payment run being reversed. Populated only when is_reversal is true. Used to maintain audit trail of corrections.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: The approval workflow status for the payment run: pending indicates awaiting authorization, approved indicates cleared for execution, rejected indicates denied by approver, bypassed indicates no approval required per policy.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the payment run was approved. Used for audit trails and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: completion_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the payment run execution finished, whether successfully or with errors. Used to calculate processing duration and SLA compliance.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the payment run record was first created in the system. Used for audit trails and data lineage.

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: The total cash discount amount taken across all payments in this run for early payment. Represents savings achieved through prompt payment programs.

attributes.name: error_log
attributes.description: Detailed error messages and exception logs for failed payments or processing issues. Used for troubleshooting and root cause analysis.

attributes.name: execution_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the payment run execution began. Critical for audit trails and reconciliation with banking systems.

attributes.name: failed_payment_amount
attributes.description: The sum of all failed payment amounts that were not disbursed. Represents funds that remain in the company account and require reprocessing.

attributes.name: failed_payment_count
attributes.description: The number of payment transactions that failed during processing due to validation errors, insufficient funds, or system issues. Requires manual intervention.

attributes.name: is_reversal
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this payment run is a reversal of a previous run. True indicates reversal, false indicates original payment run.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the payment run record was last modified. Used for audit trails and change tracking.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes and comments about the payment run. Used to document special circumstances, manual interventions, or business context.

attributes.name: payment_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all payments in this run. All disbursements within a single run are typically in the same currency.

attributes.name: payment_file_format
attributes.description: The electronic file format standard used for bank transmission: ISO 20022 for international standard, NACHA for US ACH, BAI2 for bank reporting, MT940 for SWIFT, CAMT.053 for account statements, proprietary for bank-specific formats.

attributes.name: payment_file_name
attributes.description: The name of the electronic payment file generated for bank transmission. Used for file tracking and reconciliation with bank acknowledgments.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The payment instrument used for disbursements in this run: ACH for Automated Clearing House, wire for wire transfer, check for physical checks, EFT for Electronic Funds Transfer, SEPA for Single Euro Payments Area, BACS for UK Bankers Automated Clearing Services.

attributes.name: payment_run_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the payment run: draft indicates initial creation, scheduled indicates approved and queued, processing indicates active execution, completed indicates successful finish, failed indicates execution error, cancelled indicates user-terminated run.

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: The standard payment terms code applied to invoices included in this run. Defines due date calculation and discount eligibility.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The accounting date on which payment transactions are posted to the general ledger. May differ from value date for period-end processing.

attributes.name: reconciliation_status
attributes.description: The status of bank statement reconciliation for this payment run: pending indicates awaiting bank confirmation, reconciled indicates matched with bank statement, discrepancy indicates mismatch requiring investigation, under_review indicates active reconciliation process.

attributes.name: run_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique identifier for the payment run, typically formatted as PR-YYYYMMDD-NNNN for external reference and audit trails.

attributes.name: run_type
attributes.description: Classification of the payment run based on business purpose: standard for regular scheduled runs, emergency for urgent off-cycle payments, supplemental for additional payments, reversal for payment corrections, adjustment for reconciliation runs, interim for partial disbursements.

attributes.name: scheduled_date
attributes.description: The date on which the payment run is scheduled to execute. Used for planning and cash flow forecasting.

attributes.name: successful_payment_amount
attributes.description: The sum of all successfully processed payment amounts. Used to reconcile actual cash outflows against planned disbursements.

attributes.name: successful_payment_count
attributes.description: The number of payment transactions that were successfully processed and transmitted to the bank. Used to calculate success rate and identify exceptions.

attributes.name: total_payment_amount
attributes.description: The sum of all payment amounts included in this run, expressed in the payment currency. Used for cash position management and bank account reconciliation.

attributes.name: total_payment_count
attributes.description: The total number of individual payment transactions included in this payment run. Used for reconciliation and control totals.

attributes.name: transmission_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the payment file was transmitted to the bank. Critical for cut-off time compliance and value dating.

attributes.name: value_date
attributes.description: The date on which funds are to be debited from the company account and credited to payee accounts. Used for cash flow forecasting and liquidity management.

attributes.name: withholding_tax_amount
attributes.description: The total withholding tax amount deducted from payments in this run. Required for tax compliance and reporting to tax authorities.

products.name: ledger
products.description: Master reference table for ledger. Referenced by ledger_id.

attributes.name: ledger_id
