attributes.name: adams_reference_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Anti-Doping Administration and Management System (ADAMS) Reference Number
attributes.description: Unique reference number assigned by the WADA ADAMS portal upon submission of the whereabouts filing. Used as the externally-known business identifier for cross-referencing with WADA and national anti-doping organisations.
attributes.references: WADA ADAMS System; WADA ISTI Article 11.3.2

attributes.name: athlete_response_deadline
attributes.description: Deadline by which the athlete must respond to a missed or incomplete filing notification. Typically 14 days from notification_date per WADA ISTI. Failure to respond within this window may result in the missed filing being confirmed.
attributes.references: WADA ISTI Article 11.3.4

attributes.name: authorised_representative_name
attributes.description: Full name of the authorised representative (agent, coach, or team official) who submitted the filing on behalf of the athlete, where applicable. Null if the athlete submitted directly.
attributes.references: WADA ISTI Article 11.3.2

attributes.name: cas_case_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: Court of Arbitration for Sport (CAS) Case Reference
attributes.description: Reference number of the CAS arbitration case associated with a disputed whereabouts filing violation, if applicable. Null if no CAS proceedings have been initiated. Format follows CAS standard case numbering (e.g., CAS 2024/A/9876).
attributes.references: CAS Arbitration Rules; WADA Code Article 13

attributes.name: competition_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the scheduled competition or event during the filing period. Defines the in-competition period boundary for testing jurisdiction and sample classification purposes.
attributes.references: WADA ISTI Article 11.3.3(d)

attributes.name: competition_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the scheduled competition or event during the filing period. Used to plan in-competition doping control and to validate athlete availability windows.
attributes.references: WADA ISTI Article 11.3.3(d)

attributes.name: compliance_status
attributes.description: Regulatory compliance determination for this filing period. COMPLIANT = filed on time and complete; MISSED = not filed by deadline; INCOMPLETE = filed but missing required information; LATE = filed after deadline; UNDER_REVIEW = compliance determination pending adjudication. Three MISSED or INCOMPLETE filings within 12 months trigger a WADA Code Article 2.4 violation.
attributes.references: WADA Code Article 2.4; WADA ISTI Article 11.3.3

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this whereabouts filing record was first created in the compliance data platform. Provides the audit trail creation anchor for the Silver Layer lakehouse record.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; WADA ISTI Article 11

attributes.name: data_source
attributes.description: Origin system or ingestion method through which this whereabouts filing record was loaded into the compliance data platform. ADAMS = direct integration with WADA ADAMS portal; MANUAL_ENTRY = entered by compliance staff; API_INTEGRATION = via anti-doping organisation API; BULK_IMPORT = batch file load.
attributes.references: WADA ADAMS System; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: dispute_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the reason provided by the athlete or their representative for disputing a missed or incomplete filing determination. Relevant for CAS arbitration proceedings and WADA Code Article 2.4 adjudication.
attributes.references: WADA Code Article 2.4; CAS Arbitration Rules

attributes.name: filing_deadline
attributes.description: Regulatory deadline by which the athlete must submit their whereabouts filing for the applicable quarter. Typically the last day of the preceding quarter per WADA ISTI requirements.
attributes.references: WADA ISTI Article 11.3.1

attributes.name: filing_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments recorded by the compliance officer or anti-doping administrator regarding this whereabouts filing. May include exceptional circumstances, force majeure events, or administrative observations relevant to compliance adjudication.
attributes.references: WADA ISTI Article 11; ISO 20121 Event Sustainability Management

attributes.name: filing_period_quarter
attributes.description: Calendar quarter (1=Q1 Jan-Mar, 2=Q2 Apr-Jun, 3=Q3 Jul-Sep, 4=Q4 Oct-Dec) to which this whereabouts filing applies. Under WADA Code Article 2.4, three missed filings within 12 months constitute a whereabouts failure violation.
attributes.references: WADA ISTI Article 11.3.1; WADA Code Article 2.4

attributes.name: filing_period_year
attributes.description: Calendar year (e.g., 2024) to which this whereabouts filing applies. Combined with filing_period_quarter to uniquely identify the quarterly filing obligation period.
attributes.references: WADA ISTI Article 11.3.1

attributes.name: is_late_submission
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the filing was submitted after the regulatory deadline (submission_date > filing_deadline). Late submissions may be treated as incomplete or missed filings depending on the anti-doping organisation's rules.
attributes.references: WADA ISTI Article 11.3.3; WADA Code Article 2.4

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time of the most recent amendment or update to this whereabouts filing record. Supports audit trail requirements and compliance adjudication when disputes arise over filing completeness.
attributes.references: WADA ISTI Article 11.3.3; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: missed_filing_count_rolling_12m
attributes.description: Running count of missed or non-compliant whereabouts filings by this athlete within the preceding 12-month rolling window at the time of this filing. When this value reaches 3, a WADA Code Article 2.4 whereabouts failure violation is triggered. Stored as a point-in-time snapshot for audit and adjudication purposes.
attributes.references: WADA Code Article 2.4; WADA ISTI Article 11.3.4

attributes.name: notification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the athlete was formally notified of the missed or incomplete filing determination. The 14-day response window for the athlete to contest the determination begins from this date.
attributes.references: WADA ISTI Article 11.3.4; WADA Code Article 2.4

attributes.name: notification_sent
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the athlete has been formally notified of a missed or incomplete filing determination as required by WADA ISTI. Notification is a prerequisite before a missed filing can be counted toward the Article 2.4 violation threshold.
attributes.references: WADA ISTI Article 11.3.4; WADA Code Article 2.4

attributes.name: overnight_location_address
attributes.description: Full street address where the athlete will be sleeping each night during the filing period. Required field under WADA ISTI for out-of-competition testing. Classified as restricted PII as it reveals the athlete's residential or accommodation location.
attributes.references: WADA ISTI Article 11.3.3(a)

attributes.name: overnight_location_city
attributes.description: City component of the athlete's overnight location for the filing period. Supports geographic analysis of testing pool distribution and logistics planning for out-of-competition testing.
attributes.references: WADA ISTI Article 11.3.3(a)

attributes.name: overnight_location_country
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the athlete's overnight location during the filing period. Used to coordinate testing jurisdiction between national and international anti-doping organisations.
attributes.references: WADA ISTI Article 11.3.3(a); ISO 3166-1

attributes.name: responsible_organisation
attributes.description: Name of the Anti-Doping Organisation (ADO) responsible for managing this athlete's whereabouts filing obligation for the period (e.g., WADA, USADA, UKAD, or the relevant International Federation). Determines which body adjudicates missed filing violations.
attributes.references: WADA ISTI Article 11.2.1; WADA Code Article 2.4

attributes.name: review_status
attributes.description: Current status of the compliance review process for this filing. PENDING = awaiting review; IN_REVIEW = under active compliance review; ACCEPTED = compliance determination finalised; DISPUTED = athlete or representative has contested the compliance determination; ESCALATED = referred to CAS or governing body for adjudication.
attributes.references: WADA Code Article 2.4; CAS Arbitration Rules; WADA ISTI Article 11.3.4

attributes.name: sixty_minute_slot_time
attributes.description: Specific 60-minute daily time window (HH:MM in 24-hour format, representing start of slot) during which the athlete guarantees availability for out-of-competition testing at the declared training venue. This is a mandatory WADA ISTI requirement for Registered Testing Pool athletes.
attributes.references: WADA ISTI Article 11.3.3(c)

attributes.name: sport_discipline
attributes.description: Sport and discipline for which the athlete is registered in the testing pool (e.g., Athletics - 100m Sprint, Swimming - Freestyle, Football). Used for sport-specific whereabouts rule application and reporting to governing bodies such as FIFA, IOC, or relevant International Federation.
attributes.references: WADA ISTI Article 11.2; IOC Anti-Doping Rules

attributes.name: submission_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the athlete or their authorised representative submitted the whereabouts filing. Used to determine whether the filing was on-time or late relative to the filing_deadline.
attributes.references: WADA ISTI Article 11.3.2

attributes.name: submission_method
attributes.description: Channel or mechanism through which the whereabouts filing was submitted. ADAMS_PORTAL and ADAMS_MOBILE are the primary WADA-approved electronic submission methods. Other methods may be accepted in exceptional circumstances per anti-doping organisation policy.
attributes.references: WADA ISTI Article 11.3.2

attributes.name: submission_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time (ISO 8601 with timezone offset) at which the whereabouts filing was received and recorded in the ADAMS portal. Provides audit-grade precision for compliance adjudication.
attributes.references: WADA ISTI Article 11.3.2; WADA Code Article 2.4

attributes.name: submitted_by
attributes.description: Role of the person who submitted the whereabouts filing on behalf of the athlete. Athletes may authorise agents, coaches, or team officials to submit on their behalf via ADAMS. Relevant for accountability and adjudication of missed filing disputes.
attributes.references: WADA ISTI Article 11.3.2; WADA Code Article 2.4

attributes.name: testing_pool_type
attributes.description: Classification of the registered testing pool to which the athlete belongs. RTP = Registered Testing Pool (international-level, managed by International Federation or WADA); NRTP = National Registered Testing Pool (managed by National Anti-Doping Organisation); TP = Testing Pool (lower-tier, no whereabouts filing obligation but tracked for completeness).
attributes.references: WADA ISTI Article 11.2; WADA Code Article 2.4

attributes.name: training_schedule_end_time
attributes.description: Scheduled end time of the athlete's regular training sessions during the filing period. Together with training_schedule_start_time, defines the daily availability window for doping control officers.
attributes.references: WADA ISTI Article 11.3.3(b)

attributes.name: training_schedule_start_time
attributes.description: Scheduled start time of the athlete's regular training sessions during the filing period. Combined with training_schedule_end_time, defines the 60-minute testing slot window required by WADA ISTI.
attributes.references: WADA ISTI Article 11.3.3(b)

attributes.name: training_venue_address
attributes.description: Full street address of the primary training venue for the filing period. Enables doping control officers to locate the athlete for unannounced out-of-competition testing.
attributes.references: WADA ISTI Article 11.3.3(b)

attributes.name: training_venue_name
attributes.description: Name of the primary training facility or venue where the athlete trains during the filing period. Required for out-of-competition testing planning and sample collection logistics.
attributes.references: WADA ISTI Article 11.3.3(b)

attributes.name: update_count
attributes.description: Number of times this whereabouts filing has been updated or amended after initial submission. Athletes may update filings up to the deadline without penalty; updates after the deadline may be flagged for review.
attributes.references: WADA ISTI Article 11.3.3

attributes.name: violation_threshold_reached
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this filing caused the athlete's missed filing count to reach or exceed the WADA Code Article 2.4 threshold of three missed/incomplete filings within 12 months, triggering a formal whereabouts failure violation.
attributes.references: WADA Code Article 2.4

products.name: eligibility_certification
products.description: Unified eligibility, certification, and exemption record confirming or modifying compliance status for athletes, participants, venues, and events. For certifications: covers league eligibility, amateur status, age/nationality eligibility, anti-doping clearance, medical clearance, ADA venue accessibility certification, and event safety certification. For exemptions: covers Therapeutic Use Exemptions (TUEs per WADA Code Article 4.4), broadcast territorial exemptions, ADA undue hardship exemptions, and FCC content exemptions. Captures record type (certification/exemption), issuing or reviewing authority, certified/exempt entity, effective and expiry dates, status, conditions or restrictions, medical justification (for TUEs), approved substance/method, WADA ADAMS TUE reference, and accommodation requirements. Integrates with athlete domain for competition gating and venue domain for operational permits.

attributes.description: Status of the identity verification process for the requestor. Mandatory step before fulfilling access or erasure requests.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 12(6); CCPA Section 1798.130(a)(3)(B)

attributes.name: interaction_type
attributes.description: Top-level discriminator indicating whether this record represents a data subject rights request (access, erasure, portability, etc.) or a consent management event (grant, withdrawal, update). Drives downstream processing workflow and regulatory deadline calculation.
attributes.references: GDPR Articles 15-21; CCPA Section 1798.100-1798.135

attributes.name: is_authorized_agent
attributes.description: Indicates whether the request was submitted by an authorized agent acting on behalf of the data subject rather than the data subject themselves. When True, agent authorization documentation must be collected and linked via agent_authorization_reference. Required for CCPA compliance.
attributes.references: CCPA Section 1798.135(b); GDPR Article 17(1)

attributes.name: legal_hold_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the data subject's records are subject to a legal hold that prevents erasure or restriction fulfillment. When True, the erasure or restriction request must be suspended pending resolution of the legal matter. Coordinated with the legal case management system.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 17(3)(e); CCPA Section 1798.105(d)(6)

attributes.name: processing_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field capturing internal notes, decisions, and observations recorded by the processing team during fulfillment. Includes documentation of exemptions applied, systems searched, and any complexities encountered. Confidential — not shared with the data subject.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5(2) (Accountability Principle); ISO/IEC 27701

attributes.name: reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-communicated, human-readable reference number assigned to the privacy request or consent record at submission. Used in all correspondence with the data subject and regulatory bodies. Format: PRV-{YYYY}-{8-digit sequence}.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 12; CCPA Section 1798.105

attributes.name: regulatory_deadline
attributes.description: Calculated deadline by which the organization must fulfill or respond to the privacy request. Derived from submitted_at plus the applicable regulatory window: 30 calendar days under GDPR (extendable to 90 with notice) or 45 calendar days under CCPA (extendable to 90). Stored as a business date for SLA monitoring and escalation triggers.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 12(3); CCPA Section 1798.105(b)

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Documented legal or operational basis for rejecting or partially fulfilling a privacy request. Required when response_outcome is 'rejected' or 'partially_fulfilled'. Must reference a valid legal exemption (e.g., 'legitimate interests override', 'legal obligation to retain', 'manifestly unfounded request'). Populated in the response letter to the data subject.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 12(4); GDPR Article 17(3); CCPA Section 1798.105(d)

attributes.name: request_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the privacy request or consent record. Tracks progression from initial submission through identity verification, processing, and final resolution. 'escalated' indicates referral to legal or DPO for complex cases. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: submitted|verified|in_progress|fulfilled|rejected|withdrawn|escalated — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GDPR Article 12(3); CCPA Section 1798.105(b)

attributes.name: request_type
attributes.description: Specific type of data subject rights request submitted. Applicable when interaction_type = 'rights_request'. Values: access_sar (Subject Access Request), erasure (Right to be Forgotten), portability (Data Portability), rectification (Correction), restriction (Processing Restriction), opt_out_of_sale (CCPA Opt-Out of Sale/Sharing). Null for consent records.
attributes.references: GDPR Articles 15-21; CCPA Section 1798.120

attributes.name: requestor_email
attributes.description: Email address provided by the requestor at submission. Used for identity verification correspondence and delivery of the privacy request response. Stored as PII under GDPR Article 4 and CCPA.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4(1); CCPA Section 1798.140(o)

attributes.name: requestor_full_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the individual submitting the privacy request. May differ from the fan record name when submitted by an authorized agent or legal representative on behalf of the data subject.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 12; CCPA Section 1798.130(a)(3)

attributes.name: response_delivery_method
attributes.description: Method used to deliver the privacy request response or consent confirmation to the data subject. Must align with the data subject's preferred contact channel and regulatory requirements for secure delivery of personal data.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 12(1); CCPA Section 1798.130(a)(2)

attributes.name: response_outcome
attributes.description: Final outcome of the privacy request fulfillment. 'fulfilled' = request fully completed; 'partially_fulfilled' = some data categories actioned, others exempted; 'rejected' = request denied with legal basis; 'no_data_found' = no personal data located for the subject; 'extended' = response period extended per regulatory allowance with notice sent.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 12(4); CCPA Section 1798.105(b)

attributes.name: submission_channel
attributes.description: Channel through which the data subject submitted the privacy request or provided/withdrew consent. Supports channel analytics and compliance audit trails. Values align with Adobe Experience Platform touchpoint taxonomy.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 12; CCPA Section 1798.130(a)

attributes.name: submitted_at
attributes.description: Exact date and time (with timezone) when the privacy request was submitted or the consent event was recorded. This is the principal business event timestamp and the anchor for all regulatory deadline calculations (GDPR 30-day, CCPA 45-day).
attributes.references: GDPR Article 12(3); CCPA Section 1798.105(b)

attributes.name: third_party_disclosures
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of third-party organizations to whom the data subject's personal data has been disclosed and who must be notified of erasure, restriction, or opt-out requests. Includes sponsors, broadcast partners, and analytics vendors. Required for GDPR Article 17(2) and CCPA opt-out propagation.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 17(2); GDPR Article 19; CCPA Section 1798.120

attributes.name: updated_at
attributes.description: Date and time when this privacy request record was most recently modified. Supports audit trail requirements and change detection for downstream integrations with Adobe Experience Platform and Salesforce CRM.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5(2); ISO/IEC 27701

attributes.name: us_state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code for data subjects residing in the United States. Used to determine applicability of state-level privacy laws beyond CCPA (e.g., VCDPA for Virginia, CPA for Colorado, CTDPA for Connecticut). Populated only when data_subject_jurisdiction = 'USA'.
attributes.references: CCPA; VCDPA; Colorado Privacy Act; Connecticut Data Privacy Act

attributes.name: verified_at
attributes.description: Date and time when the requestor's identity was successfully verified. Marks the start of the regulatory response clock in jurisdictions where the deadline begins upon verification rather than submission.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 12(3); CCPA Section 1798.105(b)

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the processing activity and associated DPIA/PIA was formally approved by the authorised approver (e.g., DPO, Chief Privacy Officer, or Legal Counsel). Marks the point from which processing may lawfully commence.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 35(7), ISO 27701

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or role of the individual who formally approved this processing activity record and associated DPIA/PIA (e.g., 'Chief Privacy Officer', 'Data Protection Officer', 'General Counsel'). Provides accountability trail.

attributes.name: assessment_outcome

attributes.name: assessment_type

'dpia' = Data Protection Impact Assessment (mandatory under GDPR Article 35 for high-risk processing); 'pia' = Privacy Impact Assessment (broader scope); 'screening' = pre-DPIA threshold assessment; 'none' = no assessment required.

attributes.name: ccpa_applicable
attributes.business_glossary_term: California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) Applicable Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this processing activity is subject to the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) / CPRA, applicable to fan data processing for California residents. Triggers additional consumer rights obligations including opt-out of sale.
attributes.references: CCPA Cal. Civ. Code § 1798.100, CPRA

attributes.name: controller_processor_role
attributes.description: Designates whether Sports Entertainment acts as a Data Controller, Data Processor, Joint Controller, or Sub-Processor for this processing activity, as defined under GDPR Article 4. Determines the applicable compliance obligations.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4(7), GDPR Article 4(8), GDPR Article 26

attributes.name: cross_border_transfer_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether personal data is transferred to a country outside the European Economic Area (EEA) or to an international organisation. Triggers mandatory documentation of transfer mechanisms under GDPR Chapter V.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 44, GDPR Article 30(1)(e)

attributes.name: data_domain
attributes.description: Business data domain to which this processing activity belongs (e.g., Fan, Athlete, Ticketing). Aligns with Sports Entertainment's enterprise data domain taxonomy for governance and ownership assignment. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: fan|athlete|broadcast|ticketing|sponsorship|finance|workforce|digital_platform|content|venue — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ISO 27701, GDPR Article 30

attributes.name: data_subject_categories
attributes.description: Categories of individuals whose personal data is processed (e.g., 'Fans/Ticket Holders', 'Athletes', 'Employees', 'Minors under 16'). Pipe-delimited list. Mandatory field under GDPR Article 30(1)(c). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: fans|athletes|employees|minors|sponsors|media_partners|venue_staff|contractors — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GDPR Article 30(1)(c)

attributes.name: dpia_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal Data Protection Impact Assessment (DPIA) is mandatory for this processing activity under GDPR Article 35 (e.g., large-scale processing of special category data, systematic monitoring, biometric identification for ticketing).
attributes.references: GDPR Article 35(1), GDPR Article 35(3)

attributes.name: dpo_consultation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the Data Protection Officer (DPO) was formally consulted regarding this processing activity or DPIA. Provides an audit trail for GDPR Article 35(2) compliance.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 35(2), GDPR Article 38

attributes.name: dpo_consulted
attributes.description: Indicates whether the Data Protection Officer (DPO) was formally consulted during the DPIA/PIA process, as required under GDPR Article 35(2). Mandatory for all high-risk processing activities.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 35(2), GDPR Article 37-39

attributes.name: identified_risks
attributes.description: Narrative description of privacy risks identified during the DPIA/PIA assessment (e.g., 'Unauthorised access to fan biometric data', 'Re-identification of pseudonymised athlete health records', 'Cross-border transfer of minors' data without adequate safeguards').
attributes.references: GDPR Article 35(7)(c), ISO 29134

attributes.name: includes_special_category_data
attributes.description: Indicates whether this processing activity involves special category personal data as defined under GDPR Article 9 (e.g., health data, biometric data, racial/ethnic origin). Triggers additional safeguards and explicit consent requirements.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 9

attributes.name: legal_basis
attributes.description: The lawful basis under GDPR Article 6 (and Article 9 for special category data) that authorises this processing activity. For example, 'consent' for fan marketing, 'contract' for ticketing, 'legal_obligation' for anti-doping compliance under WADA.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6, GDPR Article 9

attributes.name: legitimate_interest_description
attributes.description: Where legal basis is 'legitimate_interests', documents the specific legitimate interest pursued and the balancing test outcome. Required to demonstrate compliance with GDPR Article 6(1)(f) and to evidence the three-part test (purpose, necessity, balancing).
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6(1)(f), GDPR Recital 47

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next periodic review of this processing activity record and associated DPIA/PIA. GDPR Article 35(11) requires DPIAs to be reviewed when there is a change in risk. Typically annual for high-risk activities.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 35(11), ICO RoPA Guidance

attributes.name: pci_dss_applicable
attributes.business_glossary_term: Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI-DSS) Applicable Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this processing activity involves payment card data and is therefore subject to PCI-DSS requirements. Applicable to ticketing (Ticketmaster/AXS), merchandise (Shopify Plus), and POS transactions at venues.
attributes.references: PCI-DSS v4.0, PCI SSC

attributes.name: personal_data_categories
attributes.description: Categories of personal data processed, including special category data under GDPR Article 9 (e.g., 'Fan PII: name, email, purchase history', 'Athlete health data: injury records, biometrics', 'Payment data: PCI-DSS card data', 'Biometric data: facial recognition for ticketing'). Mandatory under GDPR Article 30(1)(c).
attributes.references: GDPR Article 9, GDPR Article 30(1)(c), PCI-DSS v4.0

attributes.name: processing_activity_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the personal data processing activity (e.g., 'Biometric Ticketing Enrollment', 'Fan CRM Profiling', 'Athlete Health Monitoring'). Serves as the primary identity label for the record in the RoPA register.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 30(1)(a)

attributes.name: processing_activity_reference
attributes.description: Externally-known unique reference code assigned to this processing activity in the official RoPA register (e.g., 'RoPA-FAN-20240001'). Used for cross-referencing in regulatory filings and supervisory authority correspondence.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 30, ISO 27701

attributes.name: processing_end_date
attributes.description: Date on which this personal data processing activity ceased or is scheduled to cease. Null for ongoing processing activities. Represents the effective-until date for the processing activity's lifecycle.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 30, GDPR Article 5(1)(e)

attributes.name: processing_owner
attributes.description: Business owner responsible for this processing activity (e.g., 'VP Fan Engagement', 'Head of Athlete Performance', 'Director of Ticketing Operations'). Accountable for ensuring ongoing compliance with the documented controls and review schedule.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5(2), ISO 27701 Section 5.2

attributes.name: processing_purpose
attributes.description: Detailed description of the specific purpose(s) for which personal data is processed (e.g., 'Fan personalization and targeted marketing via Adobe Experience Platform', 'Athlete health monitoring for injury prevention'). Must be specific and explicit per GDPR Article 5(1)(b) purpose limitation principle.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5(1)(b), GDPR Article 13(1)(c)

attributes.name: processing_start_date
attributes.description: Date on which this personal data processing activity commenced or is scheduled to commence. Represents the effective-from date for the processing activity's lifecycle.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 30, ISO 27701

attributes.name: processing_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the processing activity record within the RoPA register. 'Active' indicates live processing; 'Suspended' indicates temporarily halted; 'Retired' indicates decommissioned processing.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 30, ISO 27701 Section 6.15

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this RoPA/DPIA record was first created in the compliance register. Provides the audit trail creation point for GDPR Article 5(2) accountability principle.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5(2), ISO 27701

attributes.name: record_last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this RoPA/DPIA record was most recently modified. Supports audit trail requirements and change management tracking for GDPR Article 30 register maintenance.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5(2), GDPR Article 30

attributes.name: retention_basis
attributes.description: Legal or business justification for the defined retention period (e.g., 'SOX 7-year financial record requirement', 'WADA anti-doping sample retention 10 years', 'PCI-DSS transaction log 1 year', 'GDPR consent withdrawal'). Documents the regulatory driver for the retention schedule.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5(1)(e), SOX Section 802, WADA Code Article 17, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 10.7

attributes.name: retention_period_days
attributes.description: Maximum number of days personal data is retained for this processing activity before deletion or anonymisation, in accordance with GDPR Article 5(1)(e) storage limitation principle. Derived from the applicable retention schedule.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5(1)(e), GDPR Article 30(1)(f)

attributes.name: review_frequency
attributes.description: Scheduled frequency for periodic review of this processing activity record and DPIA/PIA. High-risk activities (e.g., biometric ticketing, athlete health systems) typically require annual or biannual review.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 35(11), ISO 27701 Section 6.15

attributes.name: risk_level
attributes.description: Overall residual privacy risk level assigned to this processing activity following DPIA/PIA assessment (e.g., 'high' for biometric ticketing, 'very_high' for athlete health data processing). Determines escalation and supervisory authority consultation requirements.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 35, CNIL DPIA Methodology, ISO 29134

attributes.name: risk_mitigation_measures
attributes.description: Specific technical and organisational measures implemented or planned to mitigate identified privacy risks (e.g., 'Biometric data encrypted with hardware security module', 'Athlete health data access restricted to medical staff via SAP SuccessFactors role-based controls', 'DRM applied to broadcast content containing athlete biometrics').
attributes.references: GDPR Article 35(7)(d), GDPR Article 32, ISO 27001

attributes.name: security_measures
attributes.description: Description of technical and organisational measures implemented to protect personal data (e.g., 'AES-256 encryption at rest, TLS 1.3 in transit, role-based access control, PCI-DSS tokenisation for payment data, pseudonymisation of fan analytics data'). Mandatory under GDPR Article 32 and Article 30(1)(g).
attributes.references: GDPR Article 32, GDPR Article 30(1)(g), PCI-DSS v4.0, ISO 27001

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record where the personal data originates or is primarily processed (e.g., 'Salesforce CRM', 'Ticketmaster/AXS', 'Adobe Experience Platform', 'SAP SuccessFactors', 'SportsCode/Hudl'). Enables data lineage tracing for GDPR accountability.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5(2), ISO 27701 Section 6.12

attributes.name: special_category_data_type
attributes.description: Specific type of special category data processed under GDPR Article 9, where applicable. For Sports Entertainment, common types include 'health' (athlete injury/medical records), 'biometric' (facial recognition ticketing), and 'genetic' (anti-doping testing under WADA). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: health|biometric|genetic|racial_ethnic|religious|political|trade_union|sexual_orientation|criminal_offence|none — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GDPR Article 9(1), WADA Code Article 14

attributes.name: supervisory_authority_consultation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the supervisory authority was formally consulted under GDPR Article 36. Null if consultation was not required or has not yet occurred.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 36

attributes.name: supervisory_authority_consultation_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Supervisory Authority Prior Consultation Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether prior consultation with the relevant supervisory authority (e.g., ICO, CNIL) is required before commencing this processing activity, as mandated by GDPR Article 36 when residual risk remains high after mitigation.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 36

attributes.name: third_party_recipients
attributes.description: Names and categories of third parties to whom personal data is disclosed (e.g., 'Ticketmaster/AXS — ticketing processor', 'Salesforce CRM — fan relationship management', 'WADA — anti-doping authority', 'Adobe Experience Platform — fan analytics'). attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes of countries to which personal data is transferred outside the EEA (e.g., 'USA|CAN|AUS'). Pipe-delimited. Required for GDPR Article 30 RoPA documentation and supervisory authority reporting.

attributes.name: incident_date
attributes.description: Date when the alleged incident or violation that triggered the investigation occurred.

attributes.name: incident_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the alleged incident, violation, or circumstances that prompted the investigation.

attributes.name: incident_location
attributes.description: Physical or virtual location where the alleged incident or violation occurred.

attributes.name: initiated_date
attributes.description: Date when the investigation was formally initiated and opened for review.

attributes.name: initiated_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the investigation was formally initiated, capturing the exact moment the case was opened.

attributes.name: investigation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the investigation indicating its progression through the investigative workflow.

attributes.name: investigation_type
attributes.description: Classification of the investigation based on the nature of the alleged violation or incident being investigated.

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the user who last modified this investigation record for audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this investigation record was last updated or modified for audit trail and data lineage purposes.

attributes.name: lead_investigator_name
attributes.description: Full name of the lead investigator assigned to the case for reference and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, comments, or contextual information related to the investigation for internal reference and case management.

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Priority classification indicating the urgency and business impact of the investigation.

attributes.name: recommended_action
attributes.description: Recommended corrective actions, sanctions, or remediation measures based on the investigation findings.

attributes.name: regulatory_filing_date
attributes.description: Date when the investigation findings or incident report was submitted to the relevant regulatory authority. Null if no filing required or not yet submitted.

attributes.name: regulatory_filing_required_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the investigation findings must be reported to external regulatory authorities or governing bodies.

attributes.name: sanction_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the imposed sanction or penalty expires or is lifted. Null for indefinite sanctions.

attributes.name: sanction_imposed
attributes.description: Description of the actual sanction, penalty, or disciplinary action imposed as a result of the investigation findings.

attributes.name: sanction_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the imposed sanction or penalty becomes effective.

attributes.name: severity_level
attributes.description: Classification of the severity or impact level of the alleged violation based on regulatory guidelines and internal risk assessment.

attributes.name: subject_name
attributes.description: Full name of the individual or entity under investigation for identification and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: subject_reference
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the individual or entity that is the primary subject of the investigation. Links to the appropriate master entity based on subject_type.

attributes.name: subject_type
attributes.description: Classification of the primary subject or entity under investigation.

attributes.name: target_completion_date
attributes.description: Planned or target date by which the investigation is expected to be completed based on regulatory timelines or internal policies.

attributes.name: witness_count
attributes.description: Total number of witnesses interviewed or providing statements as part of the investigation.

domains.name: gaming

Captures market type code, sport/league scope, settlement rules, market status (open, suspended, closed, settled), minimum/maximum stake limits, and jurisdiction availability flags. SSOT for all market definitions consumed by odds feeds, prop bet catalogs, and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: age_verification_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether bettors must complete age verification before placing wagers on this market. True = age verification mandatory; False = standard KYC suffices. Driven by jurisdiction-specific regulatory requirements.
attributes.references: GDPR; CCPA; State Gaming Regulatory Bodies; ADA

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this betting market definition record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and regulatory compliance reporting.
attributes.references: SOX; GDPR; CCPA

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which stake limits, payouts, and odds are denominated for this market (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR). Required for multi-jurisdiction operations.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; PCI SSC; SOX

attributes.name: display_order
attributes.description: Numeric ordering value controlling the sequence in which this market is presented within its market category on betting interfaces and odds feeds. Lower values appear first. Supports merchandising and fan engagement optimization.
attributes.references: Internal Gaming Operations Standard

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: The date from which this version of the market definition is valid and operative. Used for temporal validity tracking of market parameters across version changes.
attributes.references: State Gaming Regulatory Bodies; SOX

attributes.name: effective_until_date
attributes.description: The date until which this version of the market definition remains valid. Null for the current active version. Enables point-in-time reconstruction of market parameters for regulatory audit and dispute resolution.
attributes.references: State Gaming Regulatory Bodies; SOX; CAS

attributes.name: is_featured
attributes.description: Indicates whether this market is designated as a featured/promoted wagering product for enhanced placement in betting interfaces, marketing campaigns, and fan engagement platforms. True = featured; False = standard placement.
attributes.references: Internal Gaming Operations Standard

attributes.name: is_futures_market
attributes.description: Indicates whether this market is a futures wagering product where the outcome is determined at a future date (e.g., season champion, award winner). True = futures market; False = event-specific market. Affects settlement timeline and liability reporting.
attributes.references: State Gaming Regulatory Bodies; SOX

attributes.name: is_live_inplay
attributes.description: Indicates whether this market is offered as a live in-play (in-game) wagering product where odds update in real time during the event. True = live in-play market; False = pre-game market. Drives real-time odds feed routing and latency SLA requirements.
attributes.references: FCC; State Gaming Regulatory Bodies; Internal Gaming Operations Standard

attributes.name: is_parlay_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this market can be combined into a parlay or teaser multi-leg wager. True = eligible for parlay inclusion; False = must be wagered as a standalone market. Governs parlay construction rules in the betting platform.
attributes.references: Internal Gaming Operations Standard; State Gaming Regulatory Bodies

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this betting market definition record was most recently modified. Tracks changes to market parameters, status transitions, and settlement updates for audit and compliance purposes.
attributes.references: SOX; GDPR; CCPA

attributes.name: margin_percentage
attributes.description: The operator's built-in margin (overround/vig) applied to this market, expressed as a decimal percentage (e.g., 0.0500 = 5%). Represents the house edge embedded in the odds. Confidential commercial data used for profitability analysis and pricing strategy.
attributes.references: SOX; Internal Gaming Operations Standard

attributes.name: market_category
attributes.description: High-level grouping of the market by scope: Game = single-game outcome; Season = full-season result (e.g., division winner); Tournament = multi-round competition outcome; Player = individual athlete performance; Team = team-level statistic; Entertainment = non-sport event (e.g., awards show outcome).
attributes.references: Internal Gaming Operations Standard; State Gaming Regulatory Bodies

attributes.name: market_close_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this wagering market was closed and no further wagers were accepted. For pre-game markets this is typically event start time; for live markets it is the point of suspension or event conclusion.
attributes.references: State Gaming Regulatory Bodies; SOX

attributes.name: market_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying this market definition across odds feeds, prop bet catalogs, and regulatory reporting systems. Used as the business key in downstream integrations.
attributes.references: Internal Gaming Operations Standard; FCC Broadcast Regulation

attributes.name: market_name
attributes.description: Human-readable display name for the wagering market as presented to bettors and operators (e.g., 'NFL Week 5 Moneyline - Chiefs vs Raiders', 'NBA Finals Game 1 Total Points Over/Under').
attributes.references: Internal Gaming Operations Standard

attributes.name: market_open_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this wagering market was first opened and made available for bet placement. Used for audit trails, regulatory reporting, and market lifecycle analytics.
attributes.references: State Gaming Regulatory Bodies; SOX; GDPR

attributes.name: market_source_feed
attributes.description: Identifier of the external odds feed provider or internal pricing engine that originates the market definition and odds for this market (e.g., 'SPORTRADAR', 'GENIUS_SPORTS', 'INTERNAL_TRADING'). Supports feed reconciliation and SLA monitoring.
attributes.references: Internal Gaming Operations Standard; SLA

attributes.name: market_status
attributes.description: Current operational lifecycle state of the wagering market. Open = accepting wagers; Suspended = temporarily halted (e.g., injury news, VAR review); Closed = no longer accepting wagers; Settled = outcome determined and payouts processed; Voided = market cancelled with stakes returned; Pending = awaiting activation.
attributes.references: State Gaming Regulatory Bodies; WADA; CAS

attributes.name: market_type_code
attributes.description: Classification of the wagering market structure. Moneyline = straight win/loss; Spread = point spread handicap; Total = over/under aggregate score; Futures = outcome of future event; Parlay = multi-leg combined bet; Teaser = adjusted spread/total parlay; Prop = proposition/player-specific bet; Live In-Play = real-time in-game market. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: moneyline|spread|total|futures|parlay|teaser|prop|live_inplay — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Internal Gaming Operations Standard; State Gaming Regulatory Bodies

attributes.name: max_liability_amount
attributes.description: Maximum total financial exposure the operator accepts across all wagers on this market before triggering automatic suspension or odds adjustment. Expressed in the operating currency. Confidential risk management parameter.
attributes.references: SOX; State Gaming Regulatory Bodies; Internal Gaming Operations Standard

attributes.name: max_payout_amount
attributes.description: Maximum total payout the operator will honor for a single winning wager on this market, expressed in the operating currency. Caps operator liability for high-odds outcomes.
attributes.references: State Gaming Regulatory Bodies; Internal Gaming Operations Standard

attributes.name: max_stake_amount
attributes.description: Maximum wager amount permitted on this market per bet placement, expressed in the operating currency. Enforced to manage operator liability exposure and comply with responsible gaming limits.
attributes.references: PCI SSC; State Gaming Regulatory Bodies; GDPR

attributes.name: min_stake_amount
attributes.description: Minimum wager amount permitted on this market per bet placement, expressed in the operating currency. Enforced at point-of-sale to comply with operator risk management and regulatory minimums.
attributes.references: PCI SSC; State Gaming Regulatory Bodies

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text operational notes recorded by trading or compliance staff regarding special conditions, exceptions, or context for this market (e.g., 'Suspended pending VAR review', 'TMO decision pending'). Not displayed to bettors.
attributes.references: Internal Gaming Operations Standard

attributes.name: odds_format
attributes.description: Default odds presentation format for this market. American = moneyline (+/-); Decimal = European multiplier; Fractional = UK traditional; Hong Kong/Indonesian/Malay = regional formats. Drives display logic in betting interfaces and odds feeds.
attributes.references: Internal Gaming Operations Standard; State Gaming Regulatory Bodies

attributes.name: prop_bet_category
attributes.description: For proposition (prop) bet markets, classifies the type of proposition: Player Performance = individual athlete stat (e.g., passing yards, points scored); Team Statistic = team-level metric; Game Event = specific in-game occurrence (e.g., first score method); Entertainment = non-sport proposition; None = not a prop bet market.
attributes.references: Internal Gaming Operations Standard; State Gaming Regulatory Bodies

attributes.name: regulatory_market_code
attributes.description: The market identifier assigned by the relevant gaming regulatory authority for official reporting and audit purposes. Required for regulatory filings in licensed jurisdictions. May differ from internal market_code.
attributes.references: State Gaming Regulatory Bodies; SOX; CCPA

attributes.name: responsible_gaming_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this market has been flagged for enhanced responsible gaming controls (e.g., lower stake limits, mandatory cooling-off prompts, exclusion from promotional offers). True = enhanced controls active; False = standard controls apply.
attributes.references: GDPR; CCPA; State Gaming Regulatory Bodies; WADA

attributes.name: season_year
attributes.description: The calendar year of the sports season to which this market belongs (e.g., 2024 for the 2024-25 NBA season). Used for futures markets and season-long wagering products.
attributes.references: NFL Governance Office; NBA League Office; MLB Commissioners Office

attributes.name: settlement_outcome
attributes.description: The official result used to settle this market (e.g., 'HOME_WIN', 'OVER', 'PLAYER_A', 'PUSH'). Populated after event conclusion and official score confirmation. Null until market is settled. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: HOME_WIN|AWAY_WIN|DRAW|OVER|UNDER|PUSH|VOID|CANCELLED — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: State Gaming Regulatory Bodies; CAS; Internal Gaming Operations Standard

attributes.name: settlement_rule_code
attributes.description: Code referencing the official settlement rule set applied to determine winning outcomes for this market (e.g., REGULATION_TIME_ONLY, INCLUDING_OT, OFFICIAL_SCORE_AT_CLOSE). Governs how and when the market is settled post-event.
attributes.references: State Gaming Regulatory Bodies; CAS; Internal Gaming Operations Standard

attributes.name: settlement_rule_description
attributes.description: Plain-language description of the settlement rules for this market, including conditions for void, push, or partial settlement. Displayed to bettors and referenced in regulatory filings.
attributes.references: State Gaming Regulatory Bodies; CAS

attributes.name: settlement_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the market outcome was officially determined and winning wagers were settled. Null if market is not yet settled. Critical for financial reconciliation and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: State Gaming Regulatory Bodies; SOX; PCI SSC

attributes.name: sport_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the sport to which this market applies (e.g., NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, MLS, UFC, ATP). Scopes the market to the relevant league or governing body.
attributes.references: FIFA; NFL Governance Office; NBA League Office; MLB Commissioners Office; NHL Board of Governors

attributes.name: spread_value
attributes.description: The handicap value applied to the favored team or participant in a spread market (e.g., -3.5 means the favorite must win by more than 3.5 points). Null for non-spread market types.
attributes.references: Internal Gaming Operations Standard

attributes.name: total_line_value
attributes.description: The aggregate score or statistical threshold set for an over/under (totals) market (e.g., 47.5 total points in an NFL game). Bettors wager on whether the actual result exceeds or falls below this value. Null for non-totals market types.
attributes.references: Internal Gaming Operations Standard

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Incremental version counter for this market definition record. Incremented each time material changes are made to market parameters (e.g., spread adjustment, limit change). Supports change history tracking and regulatory audit requirements.
attributes.references: SOX; State Gaming Regulatory Bodies

products.name: odds_feed
products.description: High-frequency transactional record of odds price updates received from odds compilers and third-party odds providers (e.g., Sportradar, Kambi) for each betting market. Captures market ID, selection ID, decimal/fractional/American odds format values, implied probability, line movement direction, feed source, timestamp of update, and feed status. Supports real-time odds display, line movement analytics, and audit trails for regulatory compliance.

attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on odds_feed (superseded_odds_feed_id)

attributes.name: american_odds
attributes.description: The odds expressed in American moneyline format. Positive values (e.g., +150) indicate profit on a $100 stake; negative values (e.g., -200) indicate the stake required to win $100. Standard format for US sports wagering markets.
attributes.references: Internal Gaming Domain Standard; NFL Governance Office; NBA League Office

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which this odds feed record was first persisted in the Silver layer lakehouse. Used for data lineage and audit trail.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code applicable to stake and payout amounts for this odds feed record (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR). Supports multi-currency operations across global jurisdictions.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; PCI SSC Data Security Standard

attributes.name: decimal_odds
attributes.description: The odds expressed in decimal format (European format), representing the total payout per unit staked including the stake (e.g., 2.500000 means a $1 bet returns $2.50). Widely used in European and international markets.
attributes.references: Internal Gaming Domain Standard; FIFA Betting Integrity Framework

attributes.name: feed_channel
attributes.description: The technical delivery channel through which this odds update was received from the provider. Supports feed reliability monitoring and SLA compliance tracking.
attributes.references: Internal Gaming Domain Standard; SLA Agreement

attributes.name: feed_latency_ms
attributes.description: The measured latency in milliseconds between the provider_published_timestamp and the received_timestamp for this odds update. Used for SLA monitoring, provider performance benchmarking, and real-time display quality assurance.
attributes.references: Internal SLA Agreement; Sportradar Odds Feed API Specification

attributes.name: feed_reference_code
attributes.description: Externally-known unique identifier assigned by the odds provider for this specific odds update message. Used for deduplication, reconciliation, and audit trail against the provider's own records.
attributes.references: Sportradar Odds Feed API Specification; Kambi Sportsbook API Standard

attributes.name: feed_source_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the odds data provider or compiler that supplied this update (e.g., 'Sportradar', 'Kambi', 'Genius Sports', 'SBTech'). Used for provider performance monitoring and SLA tracking.
attributes.references: Internal Gaming Domain Standard; SLA Agreement

attributes.name: feed_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this odds feed record. 'active' indicates odds are live and tradeable; 'suspended' indicates trading is paused; 'settled' indicates the market has been resolved; 'cancelled' or 'void' indicates the record is no longer valid. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: active|suspended|settled|cancelled|resulted|void — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Internal Gaming Compliance Standard; FCC Broadcast Regulation

attributes.name: feed_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the odds feed protocol or API specification used by the provider for this update. Supports backward compatibility management and feed migration tracking.
attributes.references: Sportradar Odds Feed API Specification; Kambi Sportsbook API Standard

attributes.name: fractional_odds_denominator
attributes.description: The denominator component of fractional odds (UK format), representing the stake unit (e.g., denominator 1 in 3/1 means $1 staked). Combined with numerator to express the full fractional odds.
attributes.references: Internal Gaming Domain Standard

attributes.name: fractional_odds_numerator
attributes.description: The numerator component of fractional odds (UK format), representing the profit relative to the denominator stake (e.g., numerator 3 in 3/1 means $3 profit per $1 staked). Used in UK and Irish markets.
attributes.references: Internal Gaming Domain Standard

attributes.name: handicap_value
attributes.description: The handicap or point spread value associated with this selection, where applicable (e.g., -1.5 goals, +3.5 points). Null for non-handicap markets. Essential for Asian handicap, European handicap, and point spread markets.
attributes.references: Internal Gaming Domain Standard

attributes.name: implied_probability
attributes.description: The probability of the selection winning as implied by the current odds, expressed as a decimal between 0 and 1 (e.g., 0.400000 = 40%). Derived from decimal odds as 1/decimal_odds before margin adjustment. Used for overround analysis and pricing analytics.
attributes.references: Internal Gaming Analytics Standard; WADA Integrity Monitoring

attributes.name: integrity_alert_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this odds update has triggered a betting integrity alert (True), such as suspicious line movement that may indicate match-fixing or insider information. Supports regulatory reporting obligations to governing bodies (FIFA, NFL, NBA, etc.).
attributes.references: FIFA Betting Integrity Framework; IOC Integrity Rules; WADA; CAS; Internal Compliance Policy

attributes.name: is_in_play
attributes.description: Indicates whether this odds update relates to an in-play (live) betting market where the event is already in progress (True), or a pre-match market (False). In-play markets have different regulatory requirements and risk profiles.
attributes.references: Internal Gaming Compliance Standard; FCC Broadcast Regulation

attributes.name: is_resulted
attributes.description: Indicates whether the betting market has been officially resulted/settled (True) or is still open/pending (False). A resulted market has a confirmed outcome and all bets have been settled.
attributes.references: Internal Gaming Compliance Standard

attributes.name: is_suspended
attributes.description: Indicates whether the betting market was suspended at the time of this odds update (True = suspended, False = tradeable). Suspension may be triggered by significant events (e.g., red card, injury, VAR review, TMO decision) or risk management actions.
attributes.references: Internal Gaming Risk Management Standard; VAR/TMO Protocol

attributes.name: jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 or alpha-3 country/state code identifying the regulatory jurisdiction under which this odds feed record is governed. Critical for jurisdiction-specific compliance, licensing, and regulatory reporting (e.g., US state-level gaming regulations, GDPR for EU).
attributes.references: GDPR Article 3; CCPA; Internal Gaming Compliance Standard

attributes.name: line_movement_direction
attributes.description: Indicates the direction of the odds movement relative to the previous update for this selection. 'up' means odds lengthened (selection less favoured); 'down' means odds shortened (selection more favoured); 'unchanged' means no movement; 'open' is the first price; 'close' is the final price before event start.
attributes.references: Internal Gaming Analytics Standard

attributes.name: market_type
attributes.description: Classification of the betting market type for this odds update (e.g., match_result, over_under, handicap, first_goalscorer, prop_bet, futures, outright). Supports market-level analytics and regulatory reporting segmentation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: match_result|over_under|handicap|first_goalscorer|prop_bet|futures|outright — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Internal Gaming Domain Standard; FIFA Betting Integrity Framework

attributes.name: max_stake_amount
attributes.description: The maximum single bet stake permitted on this selection at the time of this odds update, in the operating currency. Reflects risk management limits set by the trading desk. Confidential as it reveals internal risk appetite.
attributes.references: Internal Gaming Risk Management Standard; Responsible Gaming Compliance

attributes.name: min_stake_amount
attributes.description: The minimum single bet stake permitted on this selection at the time of this odds update, in the operating currency. Enforced at point of bet acceptance.
attributes.references: Internal Gaming Domain Standard

attributes.name: odds_format
attributes.description: The primary odds format in which this update was received from the provider. Determines which odds value field is the authoritative source. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: decimal|fractional|american|hongkong|malay|indonesian — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Internal Gaming Domain Standard

attributes.name: overround_pct
attributes.description: The bookmaker's margin (vigorish/vig) expressed as a percentage, calculated as the sum of all implied probabilities for a market minus 100%. Represents the theoretical profit margin built into the odds. Used for pricing analytics and margin monitoring.
attributes.references: Internal Gaming Analytics Standard

attributes.name: previous_decimal_odds
attributes.description: The decimal odds value from the immediately preceding odds update for this selection and market. Enables line movement magnitude calculation and trend analysis without requiring a self-join.
attributes.references: Internal Gaming Analytics Standard

attributes.name: price_boost_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the odds for this selection have been artificially enhanced as part of a promotional price boost offer (True) or reflect standard market pricing (False). Price boosts are a common fan engagement and DTC acquisition tool.
attributes.references: Internal Gaming Marketing Standard; Responsible Gaming Compliance

attributes.name: provider_published_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which the odds provider published or generated this odds update on their end. Used to calculate feed latency (received_timestamp minus provider_published_timestamp) and for regulatory audit trails.
attributes.references: Sportradar Odds Feed API Specification; Kambi Sportsbook API Standard

attributes.name: received_timestamp

attributes.name: geolocation_state
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code (or equivalent jurisdiction code) where the bettor was physically located at time of wager placement, as verified by geolocation service. Critical for confirming the bettor is within a licensed wagering jurisdiction.

attributes.name: geolocation_verified

attributes.name: integrity_flag

Flagged wagers are reported to relevant sports governing bodies (FIFA, NFL, NBA integrity units) and gaming regulators.
attributes.references: INTEGRITY UNIT Reporting Requirements; FIFA Integrity Regulations; IOC Anti-Corruption Framework; CAS Arbitration Standards

attributes.name: ip_address
attributes.description: The IP address from which the wager was placed. Used for geolocation verification to confirm the bettor is within a licensed jurisdiction at time of placement. Subject to privacy regulations in EU and California jurisdictions.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA Section 1798.140; State Gaming Commission Geolocation Requirements

attributes.name: is_free_bet
attributes.description: Indicates whether this wager was funded by a promotional free bet credit rather than real money from the bettor's account. Free bets are excluded from certain regulatory gross gaming revenue calculations.

attributes.name: is_live_bet
attributes.description: Indicates whether this wager was placed as an in-play (live) bet after the event commenced, as opposed to a pre-game bet. Live bets carry different risk profiles and are subject to specific regulatory requirements in some jurisdictions.
attributes.references: State Gaming Commission In-Play Betting Regulations; UKGC Technical Standards

attributes.name: leg_count
attributes.description: The number of individual selections (legs) included in this wager. For straight bets this is 1; for parlays and teasers this is 2 or more. Used for parlay payout validation and risk management.
attributes.references: State Gaming Commission Technical Standards; AGA Standards

attributes.name: odds_at_placement
attributes.description: The decimal odds offered to the bettor at the exact moment the wager was placed. Locked in at placement time and used for payout calculation. Stored in decimal format (e.g., 2.50 = evens +100 American odds) regardless of display format shown to bettor.
attributes.references: State Gaming Commission Technical Standards; UKGC Technical Standards

attributes.name: odds_format
attributes.description: The odds display format presented to the bettor at time of placement (e.g., 'american' for +150/-110, 'decimal' for 2.50, 'fractional' for 3/2). Stored for display reconciliation and international market compliance.
attributes.references: UKGC Technical Standards; State Gaming Commission Regulations

attributes.name: placement_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time (with timezone) when the wager was accepted and confirmed by the sportsbook platform. This is the principal business event timestamp and is critical for in-play betting validation, regulatory reporting, and audit trails.
attributes.references: State Gaming Commission Reporting Requirements; UKGC Technical Standards

attributes.name: potential_payout
attributes.description: The maximum gross payout amount the bettor would receive if the wager wins, calculated as stake_amount multiplied by odds_at_placement. Captured at placement time for liability management and bettor communication.
attributes.references: State Gaming Commission Financial Reporting; AGA Standards

attributes.name: potential_profit
attributes.description: The net profit the bettor would receive if the wager wins, calculated as potential_payout minus stake_amount. Represents the bettor's net gain and is used in responsible gaming exposure monitoring.
attributes.references: State Gaming Commission Financial Reporting; Responsible Gaming Standards

attributes.name: reference_number
attributes.description: Externally visible alphanumeric reference number presented to the bettor on their bet slip or receipt. Used for customer service inquiries, dispute resolution, and regulatory audit trails.
attributes.references: State Gaming Commission Reporting Requirements; PCI DSS v4.0

attributes.name: responsible_gaming_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this wager triggered a responsible gaming alert or intervention at time of placement (e.g., exceeded deposit limit, velocity threshold, or self-exclusion proximity check). Used for regulatory compliance reporting and player protection monitoring.
attributes.references: NCPG Responsible Gaming Standards; State Gaming Commission Responsible Gaming Requirements; UKGC Social Responsibility Conditions

attributes.name: selection_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the bettor's selection within the betting market (e.g., 'Kansas City Chiefs to win', 'Over 48.5 total points', 'LeBron James to score 30+ points'). Captured at time of placement for audit and display purposes.
attributes.references: State Gaming Commission Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: self_exclusion_override
attributes.description: Indicates whether this wager was placed despite a self-exclusion or cooling-off period being active on the bettor's account. Should always be False for compliant operations; True values require immediate regulatory escalation.
attributes.references: State Gaming Commission Self-Exclusion Program Requirements; UKGC Social Responsibility Conditions

attributes.name: settlement_amount
attributes.description: The actual monetary amount paid out to the bettor upon settlement. For winning wagers this equals the gross payout; for losing wagers this is zero; for void/push wagers this equals the stake returned. Null until the wager is settled.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0; State Gaming Commission Financial Reporting; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: settlement_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the wager outcome was determined and the settlement amount was applied to the bettor's account. Null for pending wagers. Used for settlement cycle reporting and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: State Gaming Commission Reporting Requirements; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: stake_amount
attributes.description: The monetary amount wagered by the bettor at time of placement, in the transaction currency. Represents the bettor's financial exposure and is the basis for hold calculations and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0; State Gaming Commission Financial Reporting; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: tax_withheld_amount
attributes.description: The amount of tax withheld from the settlement payout at source, as required by applicable jurisdiction tax laws (e.g., US federal withholding on large winnings per IRS Form W-2G thresholds). Zero if no withholding applies.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 525 (Gambling Winnings); State Tax Regulations; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: ticket_terminal_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the specific betting terminal, kiosk, or point-of-sale device used to place the wager. Used for terminal-level reconciliation, fraud detection, and equipment audit trails in retail and kiosk channels.
attributes.references: State Gaming Commission Equipment Certification Requirements; PCI DSS v4.0

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this wager record was last modified in the sportsbook system (e.g., status change from pending to settled). Used for change data capture and audit compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity)

attributes.name: void_reason

[ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: event_cancelled|event_postponed|market_error|odds_error|bettor_request|regulatory_order|system_error|integrity_concern — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: wager_status

[ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: straight|parlay|teaser|prop|futures|round_robin|if_bet|reverse — promote to reference product]
