attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fan.payment_method. Business justification: Gaming wallet deposits are funded via fan-stored payment methods. This link enables deposit reconciliation, fraud detection (same card funding multiple wallets), and PCI compliance reporting — all sta
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: aml_risk_rating
attributes.description: Anti-Money Laundering (AML) risk classification assigned to this wallet based on transaction patterns, deposit sources, and bettor profile. Drives enhanced due diligence (EDD) requirements and regulatory reporting thresholds.
attributes.references: AML/BSA Compliance; FATF Recommendations; FinCEN Guidance; State Gaming Regulatory Authority

attributes.name: bonus_credit_balance
attributes.description: Current balance of promotional bonus credits awarded to the bettor (e.g., free-bet credits, deposit match bonuses, loyalty rewards). Bonus credits are subject to wagering requirements before conversion to withdrawable funds.
attributes.references: State Gaming Regulatory Authority; AGA Responsible Gaming Standards

attributes.name: bonus_wagering_progress_amount
attributes.description: Cumulative wagering amount applied toward satisfying the current bonus wagering requirement. When this value reaches (bonus_credit_balance × bonus_wagering_requirement_multiplier), the bonus converts to withdrawable funds.
attributes.references: State Gaming Regulatory Authority; AGA Standards

attributes.name: bonus_wagering_requirement_multiplier
attributes.description: The rollover multiplier applied to bonus credits before they can be converted to withdrawable real-money funds (e.g., 5x means the bettor must wager 5 times the bonus amount). Drives bonus liability calculations.
attributes.references: State Gaming Regulatory Authority; AGA Standards

attributes.name: close_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the gaming wallet was permanently closed. NULL for active wallets. Required for regulatory reporting and unclaimed property escheatment calculations.
attributes.references: State Gaming Regulatory Authority; State Unclaimed Property Laws

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this gaming wallet record was first created in the platform ledger system. Serves as the audit trail creation marker for the Silver layer record.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; GDPR Article 5(2)

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code denominating all monetary balances in this wallet (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR, CAD). A bettor may hold separate wallets per currency.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; PCI DSS v4.0

attributes.name: deposit_limit_daily
attributes.description: Maximum real-money deposit amount permitted within a rolling 24-hour period for this wallet, as set by the bettor or enforced by the operator under responsible gaming obligations. NULL indicates no limit is set.
attributes.references: AGA Responsible Gaming Standards; State Gaming Regulatory Authority; NCPG (National Council on Problem Gambling)

attributes.name: deposit_limit_monthly
attributes.description: Maximum real-money deposit amount permitted within a rolling 30-day period for this wallet. Regulators in many jurisdictions mandate operators to offer and honor monthly deposit limits.
attributes.references: AGA Responsible Gaming Standards; State Gaming Regulatory Authority; NCPG

attributes.name: deposit_limit_weekly
attributes.description: Maximum real-money deposit amount permitted within a rolling 7-day period for this wallet. Part of the responsible gaming self-exclusion and limit-setting framework.
attributes.references: AGA Responsible Gaming Standards; State Gaming Regulatory Authority; NCPG

attributes.name: dormancy_date
attributes.description: Date on which the wallet was classified as dormant. Used to calculate escheatment timelines and trigger unclaimed property reporting to state authorities.
attributes.references: State Unclaimed Property Laws; State Gaming Regulatory Authority

attributes.name: dormancy_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the wallet has been classified as dormant due to inactivity beyond the operator-defined dormancy threshold (typically 12 months with no transactions). Dormant wallets may be subject to inactivity fees or unclaimed property escheatment.
attributes.references: State Unclaimed Property Laws; State Gaming Regulatory Authority

attributes.name: geolocation_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the bettor's most recent session passed geolocation verification confirming they were physically located within a licensed jurisdiction at the time of wagering. True = compliant; False = geolocation check failed or bypassed.
attributes.references: State Gaming Regulatory Authority; Wire Act Compliance

attributes.name: kyc_verified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the bettor's identity has been fully verified through the Know Your Customer (KYC) process. True = verified; False = pending or failed. Unverified wallets may have restricted deposit and withdrawal capabilities.
attributes.references: AML/BSA Compliance; FATF Recommendations; State Gaming Regulatory Authority

attributes.name: last_deposit_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent real-money deposit credited to this wallet. Used for dormancy analysis, responsible gaming velocity checks, and AML monitoring.
attributes.references: AML/BSA Compliance; State Gaming Regulatory Authority

attributes.name: last_transaction_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent financial transaction (deposit, withdrawal, wager placement, wager settlement, bonus credit) recorded against this wallet. Used for dormancy detection and responsible gaming monitoring.
attributes.references: State Gaming Regulatory Authority; AML/BSA Compliance

attributes.name: last_withdrawal_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent withdrawal processed from this wallet. Used for dormancy analysis and AML monitoring.
attributes.references: AML/BSA Compliance; State Gaming Regulatory Authority

attributes.name: lifetime_bonus_awarded_amount
attributes.description: Cumulative total of all promotional bonus credits ever awarded to this wallet. Used for marketing ROI analysis, bonus liability reporting, and responsible gaming assessments.
attributes.references: State Gaming Regulatory Authority; AGA Responsible Gaming Standards

attributes.name: lifetime_deposit_amount
attributes.description: Cumulative total of all real-money deposits made into this wallet since account creation. Used for responsible gaming monitoring, AML thresholds, and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: AML/BSA Compliance; State Gaming Regulatory Authority; FATF Recommendations

attributes.name: lifetime_withdrawal_amount
attributes.description: Cumulative total of all real-money withdrawals processed from this wallet since account creation. Used for AML monitoring, tax reporting (e.g., IRS Form W-2G), and responsible gaming analytics.
attributes.references: AML/BSA Compliance; IRS Form W-2G; State Gaming Regulatory Authority

attributes.name: loss_limit_daily
attributes.description: Maximum net loss amount permitted within a rolling 24-hour period for this wallet. When reached, further wagering is blocked until the period resets. Supports responsible gaming mandates.
attributes.references: AGA Responsible Gaming Standards; State Gaming Regulatory Authority; NCPG

attributes.name: open_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the gaming wallet was first opened and activated for the bettor account. Used for tenure analysis, regulatory reporting, and responsible gaming lifecycle tracking.
attributes.references: State Gaming Regulatory Authority

attributes.name: operator_freeze_reason
attributes.description: Reason code for an operator-initiated wallet freeze or suspension. Required for audit trail and regulatory reporting when wallet_status is 'frozen' or 'suspended'. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: aml_investigation|fraud_review|regulatory_order|chargeback_dispute|responsible_gaming|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: AML/BSA Compliance; State Gaming Regulatory Authority; PCI DSS v4.0

attributes.name: pending_hold_amount
attributes.description: Total amount currently reserved (held) against the real-money balance for open/unsettled wagers. Funds are released back to real_money_balance upon wager settlement or cancellation.
attributes.references: State Gaming Regulatory Authority; PCI DSS v4.0

attributes.name: preferred_odds_format
attributes.description: Bettor's preferred display format for betting odds on this wallet's associated platform. Stored at wallet level to support personalized UX across jurisdictions.
attributes.references: AGA Standards; Internal UX Standards

attributes.name: real_money_balance
attributes.description: Current spendable real-money balance in the wallet denominated in currency_code. Represents deposited funds net of withdrawals, settled wager losses, and fees. Excludes bonus credits and pending holds.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0; State Gaming Regulatory Authority

attributes.name: reference_number
attributes.description: Externally visible alphanumeric reference number for the gaming wallet, used in customer communications, support tickets, and regulatory filings. Distinct from the internal surrogate key.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0; Internal Naming Standard

attributes.name: reserved_withdrawal_amount
attributes.description: Amount currently reserved for a pending withdrawal request that has been initiated but not yet processed or cleared by the payment processor. Reduces available withdrawable_balance.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0; State Gaming Regulatory Authority

attributes.name: self_exclusion_end_date
attributes.description: Date on which the bettor's self-exclusion period expires and the wallet may be reactivated, subject to a mandatory cooling-off review. NULL if self-exclusion is permanent or not active.
attributes.references: AGA Responsible Gaming Standards; State Gaming Regulatory Authority; NCPG

attributes.name: self_exclusion_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the bettor has voluntarily enrolled in a self-exclusion program, prohibiting all wagering activity on this wallet. True = self-excluded; False = not self-excluded. Triggers immediate wallet suspension.
attributes.references: AGA Responsible Gaming Standards; State Gaming Regulatory Authority; NCPG; GDPR Article 9

attributes.name: session_time_limit_minutes
attributes.description: Maximum continuous gaming session duration in minutes before the bettor is prompted to take a break or is automatically logged out. Responsible gaming control set by bettor or operator.
attributes.references: AGA Responsible Gaming Standards; State Gaming Regulatory Authority; NCPG

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational gaming platform or system of record from which this wallet record originates (e.g., SPORTSBOOK_PLATFORM, FANTASY_ENGINE). Supports data lineage and multi-platform reconciliation in the lakehouse.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standards; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: tax_withholding_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether federal or state tax withholding is currently applied to winnings paid out from this wallet (e.g., IRS backup withholding for bettors who have not provided a valid TIN). True = withholding active.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 3079; IRS Form W-2G; State Tax Authority

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this gaming wallet record in the platform ledger. Used for change data capture (CDC), audit trails, and Silver layer incremental processing.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; GDPR Article 5(2)

attributes.name: wager_limit_daily
attributes.description: Maximum total wagering stake permitted within a rolling 24-hour period for this wallet. Enforced at bet placement to support responsible gaming compliance.
attributes.references: AGA Responsible Gaming Standards; State Gaming Regulatory Authority

attributes.name: wallet_status
attributes.description: Current operational lifecycle state of the gaming wallet. 'active' = fully operational; 'suspended' = temporarily restricted by operator or regulator; 'frozen' = locked pending investigation or AML review; 'closed' = permanently deactivated; 'pending_verification' = KYC/AML checks incomplete.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 17; AML/BSA Compliance; State Gaming Regulatory Authority

attributes.name: wallet_type
attributes.description: Classification of the wallet by gaming product line. Determines which bet types, markets, and regulatory rules apply. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: sports_wagering|fantasy_sports|casino|poker|combined — promote to reference product if additional types emerge]
attributes.references: State Gaming Regulatory Authority; AGA (American Gaming Association) Standards

attributes.name: withdrawable_balance
attributes.description: Portion of the real-money balance that has met all wagering requirements and regulatory hold periods and is eligible for withdrawal to the bettor's registered payment method. May be less than or equal to real_money_balance.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0; State Gaming Regulatory Authority

products.name: jurisdiction
products.description: Reference master for all gaming regulatory jurisdictions in which Sports Entertainment holds or is pursuing a sports wagering or fantasy sports operating license. Captures jurisdiction code, jurisdiction name (state/province/country), license type (sports wagering, DFS, iGaming), regulatory body name, license number, license status (active, pending, suspended, expired), license expiry date, tax rate on gross gaming revenue (GGR), and applicable responsible gaming mandates. SSOT for jurisdiction-level compliance configuration.

attributes.name: jurisdiction_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each gaming regulatory jurisdiction record. Primary key for the gaming_jurisdiction reference master.

attributes.name: governing_body_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.governing_body. Business justification: Gaming jurisdictions are regulated by governing bodies tracked in compliance (e.g., Nevada Gaming Control Board, UKGC). Linking enables jurisdiction-level regulatory obligation tracking, audit schedul
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: parent_jurisdiction_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on jurisdiction (parent_jurisdiction_id)

attributes.name: aml_reporting_threshold
attributes.description: Monetary threshold (in jurisdiction currency) above which a single wagering transaction or cumulative patron activity must be reported to the regulatory authority under Anti-Money Laundering (AML) requirements (e.g., USD 10,000 per FinCEN CTR rules). Null if no statutory threshold applies.
attributes.references: FinCEN Currency Transaction Report (CTR) Rules; Bank Secrecy Act; State Gaming Regulatory Statutes

attributes.name: application_submission_date
attributes.description: Date on which Sports Entertainment submitted the initial or renewal license application to the regulatory authority. Used to track application pipeline and regulatory processing timelines.
attributes.references: State Gaming Regulatory Statutes

attributes.name: college_sports_wagering_permitted
attributes.description: Indicates whether wagering on college and university sporting events is permitted in this jurisdiction. Several jurisdictions prohibit wagering on in-state college teams or all college sports. True = college sports wagering authorized; False = prohibited.
attributes.references: State Gaming Regulatory Statutes; NCAA Governance; WADA

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code for the sovereign nation in which this jurisdiction resides (e.g., USA, GBR, CAN, AUS). Supports geographic segmentation and cross-border regulatory analysis.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the legal tender used in this jurisdiction for wagering, tax remittance, and financial reporting (e.g., USD, GBP, CAD, AUD, EUR).
attributes.references: ISO 4217; SAP S/4HANA FI Currency Configuration

attributes.name: data_localization_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the jurisdiction mandates that patron data and wagering transaction records must be stored within the geographic boundaries of the jurisdiction. True = data must remain in-jurisdiction; False = no localization requirement. Impacts cloud infrastructure and data residency architecture.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 44-49 (Data Transfers); CCPA; State Gaming Regulatory Statutes

attributes.name: deposit_limit_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the jurisdiction mandates that operators offer or enforce patron deposit limits as part of responsible gaming compliance. True = deposit limits are a regulatory requirement; False = not mandated.
attributes.references: AGA Responsible Gaming Framework; State Gaming Regulatory Statutes

attributes.name: dfs_permitted
attributes.description: Indicates whether Daily Fantasy Sports (DFS) contests are legally permitted in this jurisdiction. True = DFS authorized; False = not authorized. Drives DFS product availability and platform configuration.
attributes.references: State DFS Regulatory Statutes; FTC Guidelines

attributes.name: geolocation_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether real-time geolocation verification is required to confirm the patron is physically located within the jurisdiction at the time of wagering. True = geolocation check mandatory; False = not required.
attributes.references: State Gaming Regulatory Statutes; FCC Regulations

attributes.name: ggr_tax_rate
attributes.description: Statutory tax rate applied to Gross Gaming Revenue (GGR) in this jurisdiction, expressed as a decimal percentage (e.g., 0.1300 = 13%). GGR is defined as total wagers accepted minus winnings paid to players. Used in financial planning, P&L modeling, and tax remittance calculations.
attributes.references: State Gaming Tax Statutes; SOX Section 302; EBITDA Reporting Standards

attributes.name: in_play_wagering_permitted
attributes.description: Indicates whether in-play (live) wagering on ongoing sporting events is permitted in this jurisdiction. Some jurisdictions restrict wagering to pre-game markets only. True = in-play wagering authorized; False = pre-game only.
attributes.references: State Gaming Regulatory Statutes; NFL / NBA League Office Governance

attributes.name: integrity_fee_rate
attributes.description: Rate (expressed as a decimal percentage of handle or GGR) payable to sports leagues or governing bodies as a sports integrity fee or data royalty mandated by the jurisdiction (e.g., 0.0025 = 0.25%). Null if no integrity fee is required. Relevant for NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, MLS league data agreements.
attributes.references: State Gaming Regulatory Statutes; NFL / NBA / MLB / NHL League Office Governance; CAS

attributes.name: jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: Standardized short code uniquely identifying the jurisdiction (e.g., US-NJ for New Jersey, US-NV for Nevada, GB for Great Britain, ON for Ontario). Used as the business-facing key across compliance configuration and reporting systems.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 / ISO 3166-2; GDPR; CCPA

attributes.name: jurisdiction_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the gaming regulatory jurisdiction (e.g., State of New Jersey, Province of Ontario, United Kingdom). Used in regulatory filings, compliance reports, and operator-facing documentation.

attributes.name: kyc_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether Know Your Customer (KYC) identity verification is mandated by the regulatory authority before a patron may place wagers in this jurisdiction. True = KYC mandatory; False = KYC not required.
attributes.references: FinCEN AML/KYC Requirements; State Gaming Regulatory Statutes; GDPR

attributes.name: launch_date
attributes.description: Date on which Sports Entertainment commenced live wagering operations in this jurisdiction following license activation. Null if operations have not yet launched (e.g., license is pending). Used for market entry tracking and revenue attribution.
attributes.references: State Gaming Regulatory Statutes

attributes.name: max_single_wager_limit
attributes.description: Maximum monetary amount (in jurisdiction currency) permitted for a single wager as mandated by the regulatory authority. Null if no statutory cap exists. Used to configure wagering platform risk controls and patron-facing bet limits.
attributes.references: State Gaming Regulatory Statutes; PCI-DSS

attributes.name: min_age_requirement
attributes.description: Minimum legal age (in years) required for a patron to participate in sports wagering or fantasy sports in this jurisdiction (e.g., 18 or 21). Enforced at account registration and KYC verification.
attributes.references: State Gaming Regulatory Statutes; GDPR Article 8 (Child Data Protection); CCPA

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for compliance team annotations regarding jurisdiction-specific regulatory nuances, pending legislative changes, special conditions attached to the license, or operational constraints not captured in structured fields.

attributes.name: official_data_mandate
attributes.description: Indicates whether the jurisdiction requires operators to use official league-supplied data feeds for in-play wagering markets (as opposed to third-party data providers). True = official data required; False = no mandate. Impacts data vendor contracts and API integration requirements.
attributes.references: State Gaming Regulatory Statutes; NFL / NBA / MLB / NHL League Office Governance; API SLA Standards

attributes.name: online_wagering_permitted
attributes.description: Indicates whether online and mobile sports wagering is permitted in this jurisdiction, as distinct from retail (in-person) wagering. True = online/mobile wagering authorized; False = retail only.
attributes.references: State Gaming Regulatory Statutes; FCC Regulations; OTT / DTC Platform Compliance

attributes.name: promotional_deduction_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the jurisdiction permits deduction of promotional credits and free-play bonuses from gross gaming revenue before calculating the taxable GGR base. True = deductions permitted; False = gross revenue taxed without promotional deductions.
attributes.references: State Gaming Tax Statutes; AGA Responsible Gaming Framework

attributes.name: prop_bet_permitted
attributes.description: Indicates whether proposition bets (prop bets) on individual player or game-specific outcomes are permitted in this jurisdiction. Some jurisdictions restrict prop bets on college athletes or specific leagues. True = prop bets authorized; False = restricted.
attributes.references: State Gaming Regulatory Statutes; NCAA Governance; NFL / NBA League Office

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this gaming jurisdiction record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity and Accountability)

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this gaming jurisdiction record was most recently modified. Used for change detection, incremental data pipeline processing, and audit compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: region_or_state
attributes.description: Name of the sub-national administrative region, state, or province within the country (e.g., New Jersey, Nevada, Ontario, England). Null for country-level jurisdictions. Supports state-level regulatory mapping.

attributes.name: reporting_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which Sports Entertainment must submit regulatory compliance and financial reports to the governing authority in this jurisdiction. Drives automated report generation scheduling.
attributes.references: State Gaming Regulatory Statutes; SOX Section 302; SEC Financial Reporting

attributes.name: responsible_gaming_mandates
attributes.description: Free-text description of applicable responsible gaming compliance mandates imposed by the regulatory authority in this jurisdiction, including deposit limits, loss limits, session time limits, cooling-off periods, and problem gambling helpline display requirements.
attributes.references: AGA Responsible Gaming Framework; NCPG; State Gaming Regulatory Statutes; GDPR

attributes.name: retail_wagering_permitted
attributes.description: Indicates whether retail in-person sports wagering at licensed physical locations (e.g., sportsbooks at venues or casinos) is permitted in this jurisdiction. True = retail wagering authorized; False = not authorized.
attributes.references: State Gaming Regulatory Statutes; OSHA Venue Safety

attributes.name: self_exclusion_program_name
attributes.description: Name of the mandatory responsible gaming self-exclusion program administered by the regulatory authority in this jurisdiction (e.g., New Jersey Self-Exclusion Program, GamStop UK). Operators must integrate with this program as a condition of licensure.
attributes.references: AGA Responsible Gaming Framework; State Gaming Regulatory Statutes; NCPG (National Council on Problem Gambling)

attributes.name: sports_wagering_permitted
attributes.description: Indicates whether fixed-odds sports wagering is legally permitted in this jurisdiction under the current license. True = sports wagering authorized; False = not authorized. Drives product availability configuration.
attributes.references: PASPA Repeal (Murphy v. NCAA 2018); State Gaming Regulatory Statutes

attributes.name: suspension_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the reason for license suspension or revocation as communicated by the regulatory authority. Populated only when license_status is 'suspended' or 'revoked'. Used for legal and compliance case management.
attributes.references: State Gaming Regulatory Statutes; CAS (Court of Arbitration for Sport); SOX

attributes.name: tax_remittance_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which GGR tax payments must be remitted to the regulatory authority in this jurisdiction. Drives accounts payable scheduling and cash flow planning in SAP S/4HANA FI/CO.
attributes.references: State Gaming Tax Statutes; SAP S/4HANA FI Module

attributes.name: policy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.policy. Business justification: Responsible gaming limits (deposit limits, loss limits, session limits) are mandated by and must conform to specific compliance policies (e.g., UKGC mandatory deposit limit policy, NJDGE responsible g
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: primary_superseded_by_limit_responsible_gaming_limit_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing identifier pointing to the newer responsible_gaming_limit record that replaced this one when a limit was modified or updated. Null if this is the current active limit. Enables full limit history chain reconstruction for regulatory audit.
attributes.references: State Gaming Regulatory Authority; SOX; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: regulatory_report_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to gaming.regulatory_report. Business justification: Responsible gaming limit activations and changes must be reported to gaming regulators in many jurisdictions. responsible_gaming_limit has regulatory_notification_sent (BOOLEAN) and regulatory_notific
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: activated_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time when this responsible gaming limit transitioned to active status and began enforcement. May differ from requested_timestamp due to mandatory regulatory cooling-off periods before limit reductions take effect.
attributes.references: State Gaming Regulatory Authority; NCPG Standards

attributes.name: cooling_off_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which a mandatory regulatory cooling-off period ends, after which a limit increase or self-exclusion reversal may take effect. Null for limit decreases and new limits that take effect immediately.
attributes.references: State Gaming Regulatory Authority; NCPG Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this responsible gaming limit record was first persisted in the system of record. Used for data lineage, audit trail, and regulatory compliance reporting.
attributes.references: SOX; GDPR Article 5; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code applicable to the limit_amount field (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR). Null for non-monetary limit types such as session_time, cooling_off, and self_exclusion.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; PCI SSC

attributes.name: data_source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this responsible gaming limit record originated. Supports data lineage tracking and Silver Layer provenance in the Databricks Lakehouse.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard; SOX; GDPR Article 30

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which this responsible gaming limit becomes binding and enforceable. For player-initiated reductions, regulators may require a mandatory delay (cooling-off) before the reduced limit takes effect.
attributes.references: State Gaming Regulatory Authority; NCPG Standards

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which this responsible gaming limit ceases to be enforceable. Null for permanent or open-ended limits such as lifetime self-exclusion. After this date the limit_status transitions to expired.
attributes.references: State Gaming Regulatory Authority; NCPG Standards

attributes.name: interaction_channel
attributes.description: The platform or interface through which the bettor or operator submitted the responsible gaming limit request. Supports omnichannel analytics and regulatory channel-specific reporting requirements.
attributes.references: State Gaming Regulatory Authority; Adobe Experience Platform; Internal Digital Platform Standards

attributes.name: is_permanent
attributes.description: Indicates whether this responsible gaming limit is designated as permanent with no expiry date. True for lifetime self-exclusions and permanent bans. False for time-bound limits. Drives expiry_date nullability logic and regulatory reporting classification.
attributes.references: State Gaming Regulatory Authority; NCPG National Self-Exclusion Standards

attributes.name: limit_amount
attributes.description: The monetary ceiling or numeric threshold set by the limit. For deposit, loss, and wager limit types this is a currency amount. For session_time limits this field is null and limit_duration_minutes is used instead. For self_exclusion and cooling_off this field is null.
attributes.references: State Gaming Regulatory Authority; PCI SSC; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: limit_change_direction
attributes.description: Indicates whether this limit record represents an increase, decrease, new establishment, or reinstatement of a previously revoked limit. Regulators typically require immediate enforcement of limit decreases but allow a cooling-off period before increases take effect.
attributes.references: State Gaming Regulatory Authority; NCPG Standards

attributes.name: limit_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Duration in minutes applicable to time-based limit types such as session_time, cooling_off, and self_exclusion. For monetary limit types (deposit, loss, wager) this field is null.
attributes.references: State Gaming Regulatory Authority; NCPG Standards

attributes.name: limit_period
attributes.description: The rolling or fixed time window over which the limit amount or duration is measured and enforced. For example, a daily deposit limit resets every 24 hours, while a lifetime self-exclusion has no reset.
attributes.references: State Gaming Regulatory Authority; NCPG Standards

attributes.name: limit_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric reference code assigned to this responsible gaming limit record, used for regulatory reporting, audit trails, and customer-facing communications.
attributes.references: State Gaming Regulatory Authority Reporting Standards; SOX

attributes.name: limit_source
attributes.description: Identifies the originating party that established this responsible gaming limit. Player_initiated means the bettor voluntarily set the limit. Operator_imposed means the gaming operator applied the limit based on internal responsible gaming policies. Regulator_mandated means the applicable gaming regulatory authority required the limit.
attributes.references: State Gaming Regulatory Authority; NCPG Standards; GDPR Article 6

attributes.name: limit_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the responsible gaming limit. Pending indicates the limit has been requested but not yet enforced (e.g., awaiting cooling-off period before reduction takes effect). Active means the limit is currently enforced. Suspended means temporarily paused by operator or regulator. Revoked means cancelled. Expired means the limit reached its end date.
attributes.references: State Gaming Regulatory Authority; NCPG Standards; SOX

attributes.name: limit_type
attributes.description: Classification of the responsible gaming control applied to the bettor account. Defines the nature of the restriction: deposit limits cap funds added, loss limits cap net losses, wager limits cap individual bet amounts, session_time limits cap continuous play duration, cooling_off imposes a temporary break, and self_exclusion is a voluntary or mandated ban from wagering activity.
attributes.references: NCPG National Council on Problem Gambling Standards; State Gaming Regulatory Authority; WADA; CAS

attributes.name: operator_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for operator-entered notes or justification related to this responsible gaming limit, particularly for operator_imposed or regulator_mandated limits. Used for internal case management and regulatory audit documentation.

attributes.name: player_acknowledgement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the bettor has explicitly acknowledged and confirmed the responsible gaming limit through the platform interface. True means the player confirmed; False means acknowledgement is pending. Required for audit and GDPR consent documentation.

attributes.name: player_acknowledgement_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the bettor explicitly acknowledged and confirmed the responsible gaming limit. Null if player_acknowledgement_flag is False. Critical for GDPR consent audit trails.

attributes.name: previous_limit_amount
attributes.description: The monetary limit amount that was in effect immediately before the current limit was set. Enables regulators and auditors to assess whether a limit change represents an increase or decrease, which has different cooling-off period implications.
attributes.references: State Gaming Regulatory Authority; NCPG Standards; SOX

attributes.name: regulatory_notification_sent
attributes.description: Indicates whether the required regulatory notification for this limit event has been transmitted to the applicable gaming authority. True means notification has been sent; False means notification is pending or not yet required.

attributes.name: regulatory_notification_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the regulatory notification for this responsible gaming limit event was transmitted to the applicable gaming authority. Null if regulatory_notification_sent is False.
attributes.references: State Gaming Regulatory Authority; SOX; GDPR Article 33

attributes.name: requested_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time (ISO 8601 with timezone offset) when the bettor or operator submitted the request to establish or modify this responsible gaming limit. Serves as the principal business event timestamp for audit and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: State Gaming Regulatory Authority; GDPR Article 5; SOX

attributes.name: review_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date on which this responsible gaming limit is due for review by the operator's responsible gaming team. Applicable primarily to operator_imposed and regulator_mandated limits to ensure ongoing appropriateness.
attributes.references: State Gaming Regulatory Authority; NCPG Standards; Internal Responsible Gaming Policy

attributes.name: revocation_reason
attributes.description: The reason code explaining why this responsible gaming limit was revoked or cancelled. Null for limits that are active, pending, or expired. Required for regulatory audit trails when limit_status is revoked.
attributes.references: State Gaming Regulatory Authority; SOX; Internal Compliance Policy

attributes.name: revocation_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this responsible gaming limit was revoked or cancelled. Null for limits that are active, pending, or expired. Supports regulatory reporting on limit lifecycle events.
attributes.references: State Gaming Regulatory Authority; SOX

attributes.name: risk_trigger_code
attributes.description: Coded identifier of the responsible gaming risk indicator or algorithm trigger that prompted an operator_imposed or regulator_mandated limit. attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this responsible gaming limit record was last modified. Tracks changes to limit amounts, statuses, or dates for audit and regulatory compliance purposes.
attributes.references: SOX; GDPR Article 5; Internal Data Governance Standard

Distinct from responsible_gaming_limit — self-exclusion is a full account suspension, not a limit adjustment.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which this self-exclusion record was first created in the data platform. Serves as the audit trail creation marker for the Silver layer record.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the pending balance amount (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR). Supports multi-jurisdiction operations.

attributes.name: election_channel
attributes.description: The channel through which the exclusion was initiated or submitted. Online indicates self-service via web or mobile app; in_person indicates submission at a physical venue or gaming facility; phone indicates call center submission; mail indicates written submission; regulatory_portal indicates submission via a state gaming authority portal; third_party indicates submission by a guardian or legal representative.

attributes.name: exclusion_acknowledgment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the bettor formally acknowledged the terms and consequences of the self-exclusion (e.g., via digital signature, checkbox confirmation, or in-person signature). Required for voluntary self-exclusions to establish informed consent.
attributes.references: State Gaming Regulatory Authority; AGA Responsible Gaming Standards; GDPR Article 7

attributes.name: exclusion_duration_months
attributes.description: The elected or imposed duration of the exclusion in whole months, as selected at the time of enrollment. Common regulatory options include 6, 12, 24, 60 months, or lifetime. Null for permanent exclusions.
attributes.references: State Gaming Regulatory Authority; AGA Responsible Gaming Standards

attributes.name: exclusion_election_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time at which the exclusion was formally elected or imposed, representing the principal real-world business event time. Used for regulatory audit trails and compliance reporting.
attributes.references: NCPG National Self-Exclusion Program; State Gaming Regulatory Authority; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: exclusion_end_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the exclusion period is scheduled to expire. Null if the exclusion is permanent. Must be evaluated in conjunction with is_permanent flag.
attributes.references: NCPG National Self-Exclusion Program; State Gaming Regulatory Authority

attributes.name: exclusion_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric reference number assigned to this exclusion record, used for regulatory reporting, correspondence with the bettor, and cross-platform reconciliation. Format: SE-{JURISDICTION}-{SEQUENCE}.
attributes.references: NCPG National Self-Exclusion Program; State Gaming Regulatory Authority

attributes.name: exclusion_scope
attributes.description: Defines the breadth of the exclusion: single_platform restricts the bettor from one specific gaming platform; all_platforms restricts across all operator-owned platforms; statewide applies to all licensed operators in a jurisdiction; nationwide applies across all US jurisdictions; global applies internationally.
attributes.references: NCPG National Self-Exclusion Program; State Gaming Regulatory Authority; AGA Responsible Gaming Standards

attributes.name: exclusion_start_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the exclusion becomes effective and the bettor's account is suspended from all gaming activities within the defined scope.
attributes.references: NCPG National Self-Exclusion Program; State Gaming Regulatory Authority

attributes.name: exclusion_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the self-exclusion record. Active indicates the exclusion is in force; expired indicates the exclusion period has lapsed without reinstatement; reinstated indicates the bettor has been approved to resume gaming; pending_review indicates a reinstatement request is under evaluation; revoked indicates the exclusion was cancelled by regulatory authority.
attributes.references: State Gaming Regulatory Authority; AGA Responsible Gaming Standards

attributes.name: exclusion_type
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the exclusion's origin. Voluntary self-exclusion is bettor-initiated; operator exclusion is imposed by the platform; state-mandated exclusion is driven by a state gaming authority or NCPG list; court-ordered exclusion is legally mandated; guardian exclusion is filed on behalf of a minor or incapacitated person. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: voluntary_self_exclusion|operator_exclusion|state_mandated_exclusion|ncpg_exclusion|court_ordered_exclusion|guardian_exclusion — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NCPG National Self-Exclusion Program; AGA Responsible Gaming Standards; State Gaming Regulatory Authority

attributes.name: external_exclusion_list_code
attributes.description: The identifier assigned to this bettor by an external exclusion registry such as the NCPG national list or a state gaming authority exclusion database. Used for cross-referencing and deduplication against external lists.
attributes.references: NCPG National Self-Exclusion Program; State Gaming Regulatory Authority

attributes.name: initiated_by
attributes.description: Identifies the party that initiated the exclusion action. Bettor indicates voluntary self-exclusion; operator indicates platform-imposed exclusion; state_authority indicates a state gaming commission mandate; court indicates a judicial order; guardian indicates a legal guardian acting on behalf of the bettor; ncpg indicates the National Council on Problem Gambling list submission.
attributes.references: NCPG National Self-Exclusion Program; State Gaming Regulatory Authority

attributes.name: is_permanent
attributes.description: Indicates whether the exclusion is permanent with no scheduled end date. When True, exclusion_end_date must be null. Permanent exclusions typically require regulatory approval to lift.
attributes.references: NCPG National Self-Exclusion Program; State Gaming Regulatory Authority

attributes.name: marketing_suppression_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the bettor's account has been suppressed from all marketing communications (email, SMS, push notifications, direct mail) as required during the exclusion period. Must be True for all active exclusions per responsible gaming regulations.
attributes.references: AGA Responsible Gaming Standards; GDPR Article 21; CCPA; State Gaming Regulatory Authority

attributes.name: ncpg_list_match_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Council on Problem Gambling (NCPG) List Match Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this bettor's account was matched against the National Council on Problem Gambling (NCPG) national self-exclusion list during onboarding or periodic screening. True indicates a confirmed match requiring mandatory exclusion.
attributes.references: NCPG National Self-Exclusion Program; State Gaming Regulatory Authority

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for compliance officers or responsible gaming staff to record additional context, special circumstances, or case management notes related to the exclusion. Not for automated processing.
attributes.references: AGA Responsible Gaming Standards; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: open_wager_count
attributes.description: The number of open or unsettled wagers on the bettor's account at the time the exclusion was applied. Used to manage wager settlement obligations and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: State Gaming Regulatory Authority; AGA Responsible Gaming Standards

attributes.name: open_wager_disposition
attributes.description: Defines how open wagers are handled upon exclusion activation. void_all cancels all open bets and refunds stakes; settle_then_suspend allows existing bets to settle before account suspension; held_pending holds wagers for regulatory review; regulatory_directed follows specific authority instruction.
attributes.references: State Gaming Regulatory Authority; AGA Responsible Gaming Standards

attributes.name: operator_exclusion_reason
attributes.description: Free-text or coded reason provided by the operator when imposing an operator-initiated exclusion. Examples include suspected problem gambling behavior, bonus abuse, fraud, or regulatory directive. Null for voluntary self-exclusions.
attributes.references: AGA Responsible Gaming Standards; State Gaming Regulatory Authority

attributes.name: pending_balance_amount
attributes.description: The bettor's account balance at the time of exclusion that is pending disposition. Regulatory requirements in many jurisdictions mandate return of remaining funds to the excluded bettor. Expressed in the jurisdiction's base currency.
attributes.references: State Gaming Regulatory Authority; PCI SSC; AGA Responsible Gaming Standards

attributes.name: platform_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the specific gaming platform or product (e.g., sports wagering app, fantasy sports platform, online casino) from which the bettor is excluded. Relevant when exclusion_scope is single_platform.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard; State Gaming Regulatory Authority

attributes.name: regulatory_notification_status
attributes.description: Tracks the status of the mandatory regulatory notification submission to the governing gaming authority. Pending indicates not yet submitted; submitted indicates sent but not confirmed; acknowledged indicates confirmed receipt by authority; failed indicates submission error requiring retry.
attributes.references: State Gaming Regulatory Authority; NCPG National Self-Exclusion Program

attributes.name: regulatory_notification_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which the relevant state gaming authority or NCPG was notified of the exclusion, as required by jurisdictional reporting obligations.
attributes.references: State Gaming Regulatory Authority; NCPG National Self-Exclusion Program

attributes.name: reinstatement_approval_status
attributes.description: Current status of the bettor's reinstatement request. not_requested indicates no request has been filed; pending indicates under review; approved indicates reinstatement granted; denied indicates request rejected; withdrawn indicates bettor withdrew the request.
attributes.references: NCPG National Self-Exclusion Program; State Gaming Regulatory Authority

attributes.name: reinstatement_approved_date
attributes.description: The date on which the reinstatement request was formally approved by the operator and/or regulatory authority, allowing the bettor to resume gaming activities. Null if reinstatement has not been approved.
attributes.references: State Gaming Regulatory Authority; AGA Responsible Gaming Standards

attributes.name: reinstatement_cooling_off_days
attributes.description: The mandatory cooling-off period in days that must elapse after a reinstatement request before the bettor can be reinstated. Defined by jurisdictional regulation or operator policy.
attributes.references: State Gaming Regulatory Authority; AGA Responsible Gaming Standards

attributes.name: reinstatement_request_date
attributes.description: The date on which the excluded bettor formally submitted a request to be reinstated to gaming activities. Null if no reinstatement has been requested. Triggers the reinstatement review workflow.
attributes.references: NCPG National Self-Exclusion Program; State Gaming Regulatory Authority

attributes.name: responsible_gaming_counseling_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the bettor is required to complete a responsible gaming counseling or assessment program as a condition of reinstatement. Driven by operator policy or regulatory mandate.
attributes.references: NCPG National Self-Exclusion Program; AGA Responsible Gaming Standards; State Gaming Regulatory Authority

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this exclusion record originated (e.g., Salesforce CRM, Adobe Experience Platform, state regulatory portal, internal gaming platform). Supports data lineage and reconciliation in the Silver layer.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: state_exclusion_list_match_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this bettor was identified via a state-level exclusion list (distinct from NCPG national list). True indicates the exclusion was triggered by a state gaming authority's exclusion registry match.
attributes.references: State Gaming Regulatory Authority

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which this self-exclusion record was most recently modified in the data platform. Tracks reinstatement updates, status changes, and regulatory notification updates.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5; SOX; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: aml_review_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this payout has been flagged for Anti-Money Laundering review due to threshold triggers (e.g., cash equivalent payouts exceeding $10,000 CTR threshold) or suspicious activity patterns. When true, payout may be held pending compliance review.
attributes.references: Bank Secrecy Act (BSA); FinCEN CTR Reporting; FINCEN SAR Requirements; State Gaming Commission AML Policy

attributes.name: approval_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this payout requires manual review and approval before disbursement, triggered by large payout thresholds, AML flags, first-time large payout rules, or operator risk controls.
attributes.references: Internal Payout Risk Controls Policy; State Gaming Commission Large Payout Rules

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when manual approval was granted for this payout. Null if approval_required is false or approval is pending. Used for SLA measurement of approval-to-disbursement cycle time.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Username or employee identifier of the compliance or operations staff member who manually approved this payout when approval_required is true. Supports audit trail for large payout approvals and SOX financial controls.

attributes.name: bonus_amount_included
attributes.description: Portion of the gross payout amount attributable to bonus funds or promotional credits rather than real-money wagering. Used to separate real-money GGR from bonus-funded activity in regulatory reporting and financial reconciliation.
attributes.references: State Gaming Commission Bonus Reporting; Internal Promotions Accounting Policy

attributes.name: completed_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the payout was confirmed as successfully delivered to the bettor by the payment processor or banking network. Null if payout has not yet reached completed status. Used for settlement reconciliation and SLA tracking.
attributes.references: NACHA Operating Rules; PCI DSS v4.0; Internal SLA Policy

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Audit timestamp recording when this payout record was first created in the system of record. Supports data lineage, audit trail requirements, and SOX financial controls.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; GDPR Article 30; Internal Audit Policy

attributes.name: ctr_reportable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this payout triggers a FinCEN Currency Transaction Report (CTR) requirement, applicable when cash-equivalent payouts to a single bettor exceed $10,000 in a single gaming day. Drives CTR filing workflow.
attributes.references: Bank Secrecy Act (BSA); 31 U.S.C. § 5313; FinCEN CTR Form 112; IRS Publication 3079

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this payout record (gross, tax withheld, net). Supports multi-jurisdiction operations across USD, CAD, GBP, EUR, and other licensed markets.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; GDPR Article 4; Multi-Jurisdiction Gaming License Requirements

attributes.name: failure_reason
attributes.description: Descriptive reason code or message explaining why a payout failed or was reversed. Populated only when payout_status is 'failed' or 'reversed'. Examples: insufficient_account_info, bank_account_closed, aml_hold, duplicate_detected, bettor_self_excluded.
attributes.references: Internal Payout Operations Policy; AML Compliance Framework; State Gaming Commission Reporting

attributes.name: federal_withholding_rate
attributes.description: Federal income tax withholding rate applied to this payout, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.2400 for 24%). Determined by IRS backup withholding rules or regular gambling withholding rates based on payout type and bettor tax status.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 3079; 26 U.S.C. § 3402(q); IRS Form W-2G

attributes.name: geolocation_state
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code (or equivalent jurisdiction code) of the bettor's verified geolocation at the time the payout was triggered. Used to confirm the bettor was physically located in a licensed jurisdiction at time of payout initiation.
attributes.references: State Gaming Commission Geolocation Requirements; UIGEA; Internal Compliance Policy

attributes.name: ggr_period
attributes.description: YYYY-MM formatted reporting period to which this payout is attributed for Gross Gaming Revenue (GGR) calculations and regulatory financial reporting. GGR = Total Wagers - Total Payouts within the period. Supports monthly regulatory submissions.
attributes.references: State Gaming Commission GGR Reporting Requirements; SOX Financial Controls; Internal Revenue Recognition Policy

attributes.name: gross_payout_amount
attributes.description: Total payout amount before any tax withholding deductions, representing the full winning amount owed to the bettor. Used as the basis for W-2G threshold evaluation and Gross Gaming Revenue (GGR) calculations.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 3079 (Gaming Tax Guide); IRS Form W-2G; SOX Financial Controls

attributes.name: is_free_bet_payout
attributes.description: Indicates whether this payout originated from a free bet promotion where the stake was operator-funded. When true, the stake amount is excluded from the net payout per standard free bet payout rules (profit only, stake not returned). Affects GGR and bonus cost accounting.
attributes.references: Internal Promotions Accounting Policy; State Gaming Commission Bonus Reporting

attributes.name: net_payout_amount
attributes.description: Final amount disbursed to the bettor after deducting tax_withheld_amount from gross_payout_amount. This is the actual funds received by the bettor and the amount recorded in the payment processor instruction.
attributes.references: IRS Form W-2G; PCI DSS v4.0; SOX Financial Controls

attributes.name: odds_at_settlement
attributes.description: Decimal odds value at which the winning wager was settled. Used for W-2G threshold ratio verification (300:1 requirement for sports betting) and audit trail of payout calculation basis.
attributes.references: IRS Form W-2G; State Gaming Commission Audit Requirements

attributes.name: operator_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the licensed gaming operator or skin under whose license this payout was processed. Relevant for B2B platform operators managing multiple licensed brands or white-label operations across jurisdictions.
attributes.references: State Gaming Commission License Requirements; Internal Multi-Operator Platform Policy

attributes.name: payout_method
attributes.description: Disbursement channel used to deliver funds to the bettor. Wallet credit: instant credit to in-app gaming wallet; ACH: Automated Clearing House bank transfer; Check: physical check mailed to bettor; Wire transfer: bank wire for large payouts; PayPal/Venmo: third-party digital wallet. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: wallet_credit|ach|check|wire_transfer|paypal|venmo|prepaid_card — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0; NACHA Operating Rules (ACH); Internal Payment Operations Policy

attributes.name: payout_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the payout disbursement. Pending: awaiting approval; Approved: cleared for disbursement; Processing: submitted to payment processor; Completed: funds confirmed delivered; Failed: disbursement attempt unsuccessful; Reversed: payout recalled or clawed back post-disbursement.
attributes.references: Internal Gaming Operations Lifecycle Standard; PCI DSS v4.0

attributes.name: payout_timestamp
attributes.description: The principal business event timestamp recording when the payout was initiated and submitted for disbursement. Distinct from completion timestamp. Used for regulatory reporting windows, GGR period attribution, and financial reconciliation cutoffs.
attributes.references: IRS Form W-2G Reporting; State Gaming Commission Reporting; SOX Financial Controls

attributes.name: payout_type
attributes.description: Classification of the payout by its originating business event. Wager settlement covers standard sportsbook wins; DFS contest prize covers daily fantasy sports contest payouts; fantasy league prize covers season-long league prize distributions; bonus conversion covers wagering requirement completions; promotional credit covers operator-funded promotional payouts; free bet winnings covers winnings from free bet stakes. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: wager_settlement|dfs_contest_prize|fantasy_league_prize|bonus_conversion|promotional_credit|free_bet_winnings — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Internal Gaming Operations Taxonomy; WADA; State Gaming Commission Reporting Standards

attributes.name: prize_rank
attributes.description: Finishing rank or placement position of the bettor's DFS contest entry or fantasy league team that determined the prize payout amount. Null for sportsbook wager payouts. Used for prize structure validation and contest result reconciliation.
attributes.references: Internal DFS Prize Structure Policy; State Gaming Commission DFS Reporting

attributes.name: processor_name
attributes.description: Name of the third-party payment processor or banking network used to execute this payout disbursement (e.g., Worldpay, FIS, PayPal, Venmo, NACHA ACH network). Supports processor performance monitoring and reconciliation routing.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0; Internal Vendor Management Policy

attributes.name: processor_reference
attributes.description: Transaction reference number returned by the external payment processor (ACH network, wire transfer system, check issuer, or digital wallet provider) upon submission of the payout instruction. Used for payment reconciliation and dispute resolution.
attributes.references: NACHA Operating Rules; PCI DSS v4.0; Internal Payment Reconciliation Policy

attributes.name: reference_number
attributes.description: Externally visible alphanumeric reference number assigned to this payout transaction, used for bettor communications, customer service lookups, and reconciliation with payment processors.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0; Internal Payout Operations Standard

attributes.name: responsible_gaming_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this payout was subject to a responsible gaming intervention, such as a deposit limit, loss limit, or self-exclusion check at the time of disbursement. Supports responsible gaming compliance reporting to state gaming commissions.
attributes.references: NCPG National Problem Gambling Standards; State Gaming Commission RG Requirements; GDPR Article 22

attributes.name: reversal_reason
attributes.description: Reason for reversing a previously completed payout, such as voided wager settlement, fraud investigation, duplicate payout correction, or regulatory clawback. Populated only when payout_status is 'reversed'.
attributes.references: Internal Fraud and Risk Policy; State Gaming Commission Compliance; SOX Financial Controls

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the originating operational system that generated this payout record. Supports data lineage tracking in the silver layer and reconciliation between platform systems.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Policy; SOX IT General Controls

attributes.name: stake_amount
attributes.description: The original wager or contest entry fee amount placed by the bettor that generated this payout. Used for W-2G threshold ratio calculation (payout must be 300x stake for sports betting W-2G trigger) and GGR computation.
attributes.references: IRS Form W-2G; IRS Publication 3079; State Gaming Commission GGR Reporting

attributes.name: state_withholding_amount
attributes.description: State income tax withheld from the gross payout amount per the applicable state gaming jurisdiction's withholding requirements. Separate from federal withholding. Zero if the jurisdiction does not require state withholding.
attributes.references: State Gaming Commission Tax Regulations; IRS Form W-2G State Copy

attributes.name: tax_withheld_amount
attributes.description: Federal and/or state income tax withheld from the gross payout amount per IRS W-2G mandatory withholding rules. Triggered when gross payout meets or exceeds the W-2G reporting threshold ($600 for sports wagering at 300:1 odds or more; $5,000 for other gaming). Zero if below threshold.
attributes.references: IRS Form W-2G; IRS Publication 3079; 26 U.S.C. § 3402(q); State Gaming Commission Tax Regulations

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Audit timestamp recording the most recent modification to this payout record, including status transitions, reversal processing, or correction events. Supports change data capture in the silver layer.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; GDPR Article 30; Internal Audit Policy

attributes.name: w2g_form_reference
attributes.description: Reference number of the IRS W-2G tax form issued to the bettor for this payout. Populated only when w2g_reportable is true. Used for tax compliance tracking, bettor tax document retrieval, and IRS filing reconciliation.
attributes.references: IRS Form W-2G; IRS Publication 3079; 26 U.S.C. § 3402(q)

attributes.name: w2g_reportable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this payout meets IRS W-2G reporting thresholds and must be reported to the IRS as gambling winnings. True when gross payout is $600 or more and at least 300 times the wager amount for sports betting, or $5,000 or more for other gaming types. Drives W-2G form generation.
attributes.references: IRS Form W-2G; IRS Publication 3079; 26 U.S.C. § 3402(q)

products.name: plan_zone_designation
products.description: This association product represents the Role-based designation between emergency_response_plan and access_zone. It captures the specific operational role each physical access zone plays within a given emergency response plan — including triage staging, evacuation assembly, shelter-in-place, and command post assignments. Each record links one emergency_response_plan to one access_zone with attributes (zone role, activation sequence, triage/evacuation/shelter flags) that exist only in the context of this plan-zone pairing and cannot be stored on either entity alone.. Existence Justification: In sports venue emergency management, a single emergency response plan explicitly designates multiple access zones for specific operational roles — triage staging, evacuation assembly, shelter-in-place, command post. Conversely, a single access zone (e.g., the field level or a parking compound) can be designated under multiple emergency response plans (active shooter plan, MCI plan, severe weather plan) each assigning it a different role and activation sequence. The business actively manages these designations as a named operational concept called 'Plan Zone Designation', and the relationship carries its own data (zone role, activation sequence, triage/evacuation flags) that belongs to neither the plan nor the zone alone.

attributes.description: Primary key for the plan_zone_designation association
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association PK

attributes.name: access_zone_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Plan Zone Designation - Access Zone Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking this zone designation record to the specific physical access zone being designated a role within the plan.
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association FK

attributes.name: emergency_response_plan_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Plan Zone Designation - Emergency Response Plan Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking this zone designation record to the parent emergency response plan under which the zone role is defined.
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association FK

attributes.name: activation_sequence_order
attributes.description: Numeric sequence indicating the order in which this zone is activated or engaged during plan execution. Lower numbers indicate earlier activation. Enables responders to follow a structured zone-by-zone activation protocol during an incident.
attributes.references: NIMS/ICS activation sequencing standards

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which this specific zone designation became operationally active within the plan. Supports versioning of zone role assignments as plans are updated and zones are reconfigured.

attributes.name: evacuation_priority_level
attributes.description: Numeric priority ranking (1 = highest priority) for evacuating this zone under this specific plan. Priority may differ across plans — a VIP hospitality zone may be priority 1 under an active shooter plan but priority 3 under a severe weather plan.

attributes.name: evacuation_route_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of primary and secondary evacuation routes for this plan, including ADA-accessible routes, assembly points, and crowd flow management corridors. Aligned with venue floor plan and ADA compliance requirements. [Moved from emergency_response_plan: This STRING field in emergency_response_plan is a denormalized narrative that attempts to capture zone-level evacuation routing. The proper model is to designate specific access_zone records with evacuation_priority_level and zone_role_in_plan in the plan_zone_designation association, replacing this free-text field with structured, queryable zone designations. The narrative description, if needed, can be retained as a notes field on the designation record.]
attributes.references: NFPA 101 Life Safety Code; ADA Standards for Accessible Design; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.38

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which this zone designation expires or is superseded within the plan. Null indicates the designation remains active. Enables historical tracking of which zones served which roles under which plan versions.

attributes.name: shelter_in_place_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this access zone is designated as a shelter-in-place location under this specific emergency response plan. Belongs to the designation relationship because the same zone may be a shelter-in-place zone under a severe weather plan but an evacuation zone under a fire plan.

attributes.name: triage_zone_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this access zone is designated as a medical triage area under this specific emergency response plan. A zone may be a triage zone under an MCI plan but not under a fire evacuation plan — hence this flag belongs to the designation, not the zone master record.

attributes.name: zone_role_in_plan
attributes.description: The specific operational role this access zone is designated to perform under this emergency response plan. A zone may serve as a triage area under one plan and an evacuation staging area under another. This attribute belongs to the designation relationship, not to either the plan or the zone alone.
attributes.references: ICS (Incident Command System) zone role taxonomy

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `sports_entertainment_ecm`.`_metrics`.`athlete_profile`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Strategic athlete roster and demographic metrics providing executive visibility into active roster composition, career pipeline, NIL engagement, and physical profile distribution across sports and nationalities."
  source: "`sports_entertainment_ecm`.`athlete`.`athlete_profile`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "sport_code"
      expr: sport_code
      comment: "Sport discipline code enabling cross-sport roster and pipeline comparisons."
    - name: "career_status"
      expr: career_status
      comment: "Athlete career status (e.g. Active, Retired, Injured) for roster health segmentation."
    - name: "athlete_type"
      expr: athlete_type
      comment: "Classification of athlete type (e.g. Professional, Amateur, Draft Eligible) for pipeline analysis."
    - name: "nationality_code"
      expr: nationality_code
      comment: "Athlete nationality for international roster diversity and visa risk monitoring."
    - name: "primary_position"
      expr: primary_position
      comment: "Primary playing position for positional depth and roster gap analysis."
    - name: "eligibility_status"
      expr: eligibility_status
      comment: "Current eligibility status to identify athletes cleared vs. restricted for competition."
    - name: "injury_status"
      expr: injury_status
      comment: "Current injury designation for availability and roster planning decisions."
    - name: "nil_agreement_active"
      expr: nil_agreement_active
      comment: "Flag indicating whether the athlete has an active NIL agreement, relevant for brand and compliance oversight."
    - name: "wada_registered_testing_pool"
      expr: wada_registered_testing_pool
      comment: "Flag indicating WADA registered testing pool membership for anti-doping compliance tracking."
    - name: "draft_year"
      expr: draft_year
      comment: "Draft year cohort for generational talent pipeline analysis."
    - name: "country_of_birth_code"
      expr: country_of_birth_code
      comment: "Country of birth for talent origin and scouting geography analysis."
    - name: "pro_debut_date_year"
      expr: YEAR(pro_debut_date)
      comment: "Year of professional debut for career tenure cohort analysis."
  measures:
    - name: "total_athletes"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT athlete_profile_id)
      comment: "Total number of distinct athlete profiles. Baseline headcount KPI for roster sizing and league capacity planning."
    - name: "active_athletes"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN career_status = 'Active' THEN athlete_profile_id END)
      comment: "Count of athletes with Active career status. Directly informs available playing pool and roster sufficiency decisions."
    - name: "nil_active_athlete_count"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN nil_agreement_active = TRUE THEN athlete_profile_id END)
      comment: "Number of athletes with an active NIL agreement. Tracks NIL monetization penetration across the roster."
    - name: "nil_penetration_rate_pct"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN nil_agreement_active = TRUE THEN athlete_profile_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT athlete_profile_id), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of athletes with active NIL agreements. Measures NIL program adoption and revenue opportunity capture."
    - name: "wada_pool_athlete_count"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN wada_registered_testing_pool = TRUE THEN athlete_profile_id END)
      comment: "Number of athletes in the WADA registered testing pool. Critical compliance KPI for anti-doping program scope."
    - name: "avg_height_cm"
      expr: ROUND(AVG(CAST(height_cm AS DOUBLE)), 2)
      comment: "Average athlete height in centimeters. Used for positional profiling and scouting benchmark analysis."
    - name: "avg_weight_kg"
      expr: ROUND(AVG(CAST(weight_kg AS DOUBLE)), 2)
      comment: "Average athlete weight in kilograms. Used for positional profiling and physical conditioning benchmarking."
    - name: "injured_athlete_count"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN injury_status IS NOT NULL AND injury_status != 'Healthy' THEN athlete_profile_id END)
      comment: "Number of athletes currently carrying an injury designation. Directly impacts roster availability and game-day decisions."
    - name: "international_athlete_count"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN nationality_code != country_of_birth_code THEN athlete_profile_id END)
      comment: "Count of athletes whose nationality differs from country of birth, approximating international roster diversity and visa exposure."
$$
metric_views.description: Strategic athlete roster and demographic metrics providing executive visibility into active roster composition, career pipeline, NIL engagement, and physical profile distribution across sports and nationalities.
